In SOCS, we can readily modulate the control strength to align with the diffusion model's native capabilities and thereby enhance perceptual quality. Our method is compatible with a variety of linear stochastic differential equation backbones. Extensive experiments across a broad spectrum of image inverse tasks demonstrate that SOCS achieves accurate measurement-aligned reconstructions with improved visual fidelity and stronger quantitative performance.

AI.title_translation: 用于扩散逆问题的随机最优控制采样
AI.tldr: 提出了一种高效的随机最优控制采样（SOCS）方法，通过闭式更新规则在扩散模型的采样过程中引入控制信号，从而在保持测量一致性的同时提升图像重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于随机最优控制（SOC）的扩散模型逆问题求解方法需要优化整个采样轨迹，计算成本过高，因此需要一种更高效的控制策略。
AI.method: 提出了随机最优控制采样（SOCS）方法，将去噪过程建模为动力学系统，并通过推导出的闭式控制更新规则，在每个采样步骤中动态调整，将测量一致的预测拉回至去噪流中。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SOCS在多种图像逆问题任务中均能实现精确的测量对齐，并在视觉保真度和定量指标上均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: SOCS为解决扩散模型下的图像逆问题提供了一种高效、灵活且高质量的采样框架，通过在采样过程中动态引入控制信号，实现了更好的测量对齐与感知质量平衡。
AI.translation: 得益于其强大的数据分布捕捉能力，扩散模型已成为解决图像逆问题的有力工具。关键在于如何在遵循扩散先验的同时，可控地引导采样轨迹向测量结果靠拢。在这项工作中，我们引入了随机最优控制采样（SOCS），它将去噪过程建模为一个动力学系统，并通过随机最优控制（SOC）注入控制信号。先前的SOC方法通过优化整个轨迹来解决逆问题，计算成本高昂。相比之下，我们推导出了一个闭式控制更新规则，并在每个采样步骤中应用它，将测量一致的清洁预测拉回至去噪流中。在SOCS中，我们可以轻松调节控制强度，以符合扩散模型本身的特性，从而增强感知质量。我们的方法兼容多种线性随机微分方程骨干网络。在广泛的图像逆任务中进行的深入实验表明，SOCS实现了精确的测量对齐重建，并具有更好的视觉保真度和更强的定量性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了随机最优控制采样（SOCS）方法，旨在解决扩散模型在图像逆问题中采样效率与质量的平衡问题。通过将去噪过程建模为动力学系统并推导出闭式控制更新规则，SOCS能在每一步采样中实现测量一致性约束，在降低计算复杂度的同时显著提升了重建图像的感知质量。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 随机最优控制, 图像逆问题, 采样轨迹, 感知质量
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将随机最优控制（SOC）应用于扩散模型的采样过程，并推导出了一种高效的闭式更新规则，避免了传统SOC方法中对整个轨迹进行优化的计算负担。这种方法在保证测量一致性的同时，显著提升了图像重建的感知质量，具有较好的通用性和实用价值。

title: BREIT: A Framework for Brain Stroke Reconstruction using Multi-Frequency 3D EIT
summary: Multi-Frequency Electrical Impedance Tomography (MF-EIT) is a non-invasive, low-cost modality that reconstructs electrical property distributions from boundary voltages. For stroke imaging, progress in 3D deep-learning reconstruction is limited by the lack of large-scale datasets with paired ground-truth (GT) volumes and by non-standardized pipelines for data generation, simulation, and evaluation. We introduce BREIT, a modular framework for 3D MF-EIT stroke reconstruction providing: (i) a neuroimaging-to-EIT pipeline that converts CT/MRI into frequency-dependent GT admittivity volumes; (ii) a self-contained Python 3D Complete Electrode Model (CEM) forward solver for simulating MF-EIT voltages; and (iii) a 3D D-bar implementation supporting non-uniform electrode layouts. Building on BREIT, we propose dFNO-bar, which integrates Fourier Neural Operators into D-bar by learning a mapping from scattering data $t(ξ)$ to conductivity $σ(x){=}\Re\{γ\}$. We evaluate dFNO-bar against D-bar, Deep D-bar, and Gauss--Newton reconstructions on UCLH-matched synthetic data, and observe higher brain SSIM with comparable CC across noise settings. Code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/djahiddj13/BREIT

AI.title_translation: BREIT：一种用于多频3D电阻抗成像的脑卒中重建框架
AI.tldr: BREIT是一个模块化框架，通过标准化EIT数据生成和评估流程，并结合傅里叶神经算子提升了脑卒中3D重建的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有3D MF-EIT脑卒中重建研究受限于缺乏大规模成对数据集，且数据生成、模拟和评估流程缺乏统一标准。
AI.method: 提出了BREIT框架，包含：1. 将CT/MRI转换为频率依赖性真实值（GT）的转换流水线；2. 基于完全电极模型（CEM）的3D正向求解器；3. 支持非均匀电极布局的3D D-bar实现；4. 引入dFNO-bar模型，利用傅里叶神经算子学习散射数据到电导率的映射。
AI.result: 在UCLH匹配的合成数据上，dFNO-bar在多种噪声设置下表现出比D-bar、Deep D-bar和高斯-牛顿法更高的脑部结构相似度（SSIM），且相关系数（CC）相当。
AI.conclusion: BREIT框架有效提升了3D MF-EIT在脑卒中重建中的性能，通过dFNO-bar模型实现了比传统方法更高的结构相似度（SSIM），证明了该框架在医学成像领域的应用潜力和价值。
AI.translation: 多频电阻抗成像（MF-EIT）是一种非侵入式、低成本的成像方式，可通过边界电压重建电特性分布。在脑卒中成像领域，3D深度学习重建的发展受到缺乏大规模配对真实值（GT）体积数据集，以及数据生成、模拟和评估流程缺乏标准化的限制。我们引入了BREIT，这是一个用于3D MF-EIT脑卒中重建的模块化框架，提供：(i) 将CT/MRI转换为频率依赖性GT导纳体积的神经影像到EIT流水线；(ii) 用于模拟MF-EIT电压的自包含Python 3D完全电极模型（CEM）正向求解器；以及(iii) 支持非均匀电极布局的3D D-bar实现。基于BREIT，我们提出了dFNO-bar，它通过学习从散射数据t(ξ)到电导率σ(x)=Re{γ}的映射，将傅里叶神经算子集成到D-bar中。我们在与UCLH匹配的合成数据上评估了dFNO-bar与D-bar、Deep D-bar和高斯-牛顿重建的效果，并观察到在不同噪声设置下，该方法具有更高的脑部结构相似度（SSIM）和相当的相关系数（CC）。代码和数据已公开。
AI.summary: BREIT是一个用于3D多频电阻抗成像（MF-EIT）脑卒中重建的模块化框架，旨在解决数据标准化和算法评估的问题。该框架集成了从神经影像到EIT的转换流水线、3D正向求解器及D-bar算法。基于此框架提出的dFNO-bar模型，通过结合傅里叶神经算子，显著提升了脑部重建的结构相似度。
AI.keywords: 多频电阻抗成像, 脑卒中重建, 3D深度学习, 傅里叶神经算子, 神经影像转换
AI.comments: BREIT通过构建标准化的神经影像到EIT的转换流水线，解决了脑卒中成像领域数据匮乏和流程不统一的关键痛点。其核心创新在于将物理先验（D-bar算法）与深度学习（傅里叶神经算子）结合，为低成本、非侵入式脑成像提供了新的研究范式。

title: The registrar's function in a hybrid society. AI value chain,smart data and the concept of property
comments: 16 pages, 4 figures, United Nations Economic Commission for Europe Working Party on Land Administration and Registrars of Spain Workshop, How can AI and the digitalization in the land sector support achieving the Sustainable Develpment Goals, Barcelona, 9 and 10 June 2026, https://unece.org/housing-and-land-management/events/Barcelona_2026
summary: Artificial intelligence reaches the land registry not as another tool but as a value chain that turns data into intelligence and intelligence into economic value. This paper argues that the decisive legal move is to place validity, a functional, second-order concept, at the centre of that chain. Rights, liability and supervision organise around it. It traces three impacts.Registry information becomes smart data, governed simultaneously by registry law, the GDPR, the European data acts and the AI Act. Control emerges as the operative concept for digital representations of real estate, whose proprietary effect depends on anchoring to the register. In a hybrid society of human and artificial agents, the registry becomes the public node of validity, with blockchain complementing rather than replacing it. Across three legal cultures, the registra's value migrates from processing documents to guaranteeing validated data,making validity an asset for the UNO Sustainable Development Goals.
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, United Nations Economic Commission for Europe Working Party on Land Administration and Registrars of Spain Workshop, How can AI and the digitalization in the land sector support achieving the Sustainable Develpment Goals, Barcelona, 9 and 10 June 2026, https://unece.org/housing-and-land-management/events/Barcelona_2026

title: From Determinism to Delegation: AI-Native Software Engineering and the Evolution of the Agentic Engineer
summary:
Software engineering is experiencing its most significant transformation since the emergence of high-level programming languages. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly enable sustained, multi-step, tool-mediated execution, engineering value is shifting from writing deterministic code to supervising probabilistic and autonomous behavior. This paper argues that AI-Native Software Engineering is a paradigm shift rather than a mere tooling advance, creating a new professional archetype: the Agentic Engineer, whose primary artifact is the agentic system rather than the program.
  We characterize this transition through three changes: (i) the unit of work shifts from functions to supervised agent workflows, (ii) correctness shifts from binary assertions to statistical evaluation under uncertainty, and (iii) accountability shifts from code authorship to outcome ownership. Drawing on post-2022 research, we compare traditional and agentic engineering roles and define core mechanisms of autonomous agents, including reasoning-acting loops, context engineering, tool use, memory, behavioral drift, and compositional error.
  We place human-AI collaboration within socio-technical frameworks and examine mixed empirical evidence. While some studies report productivity gains, others show slowdowns among experienced developers, highlighting disciplined oversight rather than automation as the critical competency. Using established governance frameworks, we identify required skills and risks, including indirect prompt injection. We conclude that the future is one of symbiosis rather than substitution: agentic engineering builds upon and depends on classical software engineering principles.

AI.title_translation: 从确定性到委托：AI原生软件工程与代理工程师的演进
AI.tldr: 软件工程正从编写代码转变为监督自主AI代理，工程师需从代码编写者进化为代理系统架构师与监督者。
AI.motivation: 软件工程正经历重大变革，传统编写确定性代码的模式已不足以适应大型语言模型驱动的自主、多步骤、工具辅助的执行环境，亟需对这一范式转移进行定义与理论化。
AI.method: 通过对比传统工程与代理工程的角色转变，构建了包含推理-行动循环、上下文工程、工具使用、记忆管理及行为漂移等机制的分析框架，并结合社会技术框架与现有实证研究进行评估。
AI.result: 研究明确了从函数到工作流、从二进制正确性到统计评估、从代码作者到成果所有者的三大根本转变，并强调了 disciplined oversight（规范监督）在AI协作中的关键性，同时指出了间接提示注入等安全风险。
AI.conclusion: AI原生软件工程代表了范式的根本转变，未来的软件开发将是人类与代理系统共生协作的过程，而非简单的自动化替代，核心竞争力将从代码编写转向对代理工作流的监督与治理。
AI.translation: 软件工程正在经历自高级编程语言出现以来最重大的变革。随着大语言模型（LLMs）日益支持持续的、多步骤的、工具辅助的执行，工程价值正从编写确定性代码转向监督概率性和自主性行为。本文认为，AI原生软件工程不仅是工具的进步，更是一场范式转移，它创造了一种新的职业原型：代理工程师，其主要产出物是代理系统而非程序。我们通过三个变化来刻画这一转变：（i）工作单元从函数转变为受监督的代理工作流，（ii）正确性从二进制断言转变为不确定性下的统计评估，（iii）问责制从代码编写转变为结果所有权。基于2022年后的研究，我们对比了传统工程与代理工程的角色，并定义了自主代理的核心机制，包括推理-行动循环、上下文工程、工具使用、记忆、行为漂移和组合误差。我们将人机协作置于社会技术框架中，并考察了混合的实证证据。虽然一些研究报告了生产力的提升，但另一些研究显示经验丰富的开发人员反而出现了进度放缓，这突显了规范的监督而非自动化才是关键能力。利用现有的治理框架，我们识别了所需的技能和风险，包括间接提示注入。我们得出结论，未来是共生而非替代：代理工程建立在经典软件工程原则之上并依赖于它们。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了软件工程向AI原生范式的演进，定义了以代理系统为核心产出的“代理工程师”。文章通过分析工作单元、正确性标准及问责机制的改变，论证了开发重点从编写确定性代码转向监督概率性自主代理，并强调了在人机共生模式下，规范监督与治理能力是未来软件工程的核心。
AI.keywords: AI原生软件工程, 代理工程师, 代理系统, 人机协作, 范式转移
AI.comments: 本文准确捕捉到了软件工程领域从“编写确定性代码”向“监督概率性自主系统”演进的范式转移。其创新之处在于定义了“代理工程师（Agentic Engineer）”这一新角色，并提出了相应的评估与问责框架。局限性在于对AI协作带来的生产力混合实证结果探讨仍较初步，且该领域发展极快，理论体系尚需进一步验证。

title: Virtual Ring Try-On
summary: This paper presents an innovative approach that enables the users to capture their hand and try the jewel ring on their hand. The user captures the image of the hand using the React Native base GUI of the mobile application and selects the ring that the user wants to try, and the output image will have the user's hand with the ring image. This approach is implemented using a combination of MediaPipe hand point detection and YOLO-V8 custom object detection. The hand image uploaded by the user first undergoes mediapipe hand point detection. It will give the hand points and a Region of Interest mask where the ring is going to be placed. Then the ring is passed through YOLO object detection, in which ring points are detected, and background is removed. After that, using vector algebra, the angular discrepancy between the finger's reference axis and the ring's principal axis is computed. Also, ring size is rescaled according to finger thickness, preserving the aspect ratio to maintain perceptual realism. Then the ring is placed on the hand image and the output image is generated and shown on the user screen.

title: On design-unbiased algorithmic Machine Learning
summary: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, such as k-Nearest Neighbours (kNN) or random forest, eschew the ideal of true data models in favour of predictive performance. However, minimising the MSE or F-score cannot lead to unbiasedness directly, which is important in many situations such as official statistics. We study the conditions of algorithmic ML, other than the existence and knowledge of true data models, which lead to unbiased prediction or classification for a given finite population, including how the training data may be sampled from the population, how a trained prediction algorithm can be tuned to achieve unbiased prediction or classification for that population, and how the performance of out-of-sample prediction or classification can be assessed unbiasedly. The inference is based on the known probability design of samples and training sets, rather than any assumed distributions or models.

AI.title_translation: 关于设计无偏的算法机器学习研究
AI.tldr: 通过利用已知的采样概率设计，使机器学习算法在不依赖模型假设的情况下实现统计无偏性。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器学习算法（如kNN、随机森林）以预测性能为导向，无法直接保证统计上的无偏性，而无偏性在官方统计等领域至关重要。
AI.method: 基于已知的样本概率设计（probability design）而非模型假设，通过分析采样过程、调整训练算法以及设计无偏的样本外评估方法来实现预测无偏性。
AI.result: 论文论证了在已知采样设计的情况下，通过特定方法对训练算法进行调整和评估，可以实现对有限总体的无偏预测或分类。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用已知的样本概率设计，可以在不依赖模型分布假设的情况下，通过调整训练算法和评估过程实现针对有限总体的无偏预测。
AI.translation: 机器学习算法（如kNN或随机森林）倾向于以预测性能为目标，而放弃了真实数据模型的理想。然而，最小化MSE或F-score并不能直接导致无偏性，这在官方统计等许多情况下非常重要。我们研究了算法机器学习中除真实数据模型的存在和已知之外的条件，这些条件可以导致针对给定有限总体的无偏预测或分类，包括训练数据如何从总体中采样、如何调整训练好的预测算法以实现对该总体的无偏预测或分类，以及如何无偏地评估样本外预测或分类的性能。该推断基于已知的样本概率设计，而非任何假设的分布或模型。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了如何在不依赖数据分布假设的情况下，利用已知的概率采样设计，通过调整机器学习算法的训练和评估过程，实现针对有限总体的无偏预测与分类。
AI.keywords: 设计无偏性, 机器学习, 有限总体, 概率采样, 统计推断
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将传统统计学中的“设计无偏性”（design-unbiasedness）概念引入机器学习，试图在不依赖模型假设的前提下，通过采样设计实现无偏预测，这对于统计调查和官方统计领域具有重要的理论与实践意义。其局限在于可能牺牲了一定的预测性能。

title: Structure-Preserving Document Translation via Multi-Stage LLM Pipeline: A Case Study in Marathi
summary: Government documents in India are predominantly issued in regional languages such as Marathi, creating substantial accessibility barriers for non-native readers, interstate administrative bodies, and policy analysts. Although recent advances in neural machine translation have improved sentence-level translation quality, existing systems largely neglect document structure, formatting integrity, and domain-specific terminology, thereby limiting their applicability to official documentation. This paper presents a structure-preserving Marathi-to-English government document translation framework capable of performing end-to-end document transformation while maintaining layout fidelity. The proposed system integrates layout-aware optical character recognition, coordinate-based text extraction, large language model based translation, and structured document reconstruction through HTML representations. By enforcing spatial alignment constraints and preserving hierarchical document elements, the framework ensures structural consistency between the source and translated documents. Experimental evaluation on real-world Marathi government PDFs demonstrates improved structural preservation, translation coherence, and terminological consistency compared to conventional text-only translation pipelines. The proposed framework contributes toward scalable multilingual accessibility solutions for e-governance and administrative document processing.

title: Primary ICD Category Prediction using LLM-based Probing
comments: 9 pages, 2 figures. Supplementary materials provided as an ancillary file
summary:
Objective: ICD codes are central to reimbursement, research, and population health surveillance, yet automated coding systems often struggle to integrate diagnostic signals from both clinical narratives and structured electronic health record (EHR) variables. We evaluated whether frozen medical large language model (LLM) representations can serve as a shared embedding space for multimodal primary diagnosis category prediction.
  Materials and Methods: We constructed a MIMIC-IV cohort of 13,645 admissions from the 10 most frequent primary ICD-10 codes, consolidated into seven categories. Structured variables were serialized into clinical narratives and combined with leakage-pruned discharge notes. Using a frozen MedFound-Llama3-8B-finetuned backbone, we extracted hidden states from five transformer layers and trained linear probes for structured-only, unstructured-only, and combined inputs, comparing against XGBoost and information-matched PLM-ICD baselines and evaluating MIMIC-III adaptation with a compact bottleneck adapter.
  Results: The combined probe performed best on MIMIC-IV (87.69% strict; 91.45% medical accuracy), exceeding both single-modality probes and baselines. The structured-only probe outperformed its standard baseline by 6.19 points in medical accuracy. Diagnostic information became increasingly linearly separable in deeper layers, and a 2M-parameter adapter restored cross-dataset transfer to MIMIC-III using only 5% of target labels.
  Discussion: LLM embeddings can unify structured and narrative EHR information for multimodal diagnosis prediction, supporting efficient reuse of clinical representations across modalities and datasets through a small representation-level module.
  Conclusion: Multimodal probing of frozen medical LLM representations provides a practical approach for studying EHR modalities and adapting clinical representations across datasets.

AI.title_translation: 基于LLM探测的主要ICD类别预测
AI.tldr: 利用冻结医疗大语言模型作为统一嵌入空间，通过线性探测有效融合结构化与非结构化EHR数据，显著提升了ICD主要诊断类别的预测准确率及跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 自动化编码系统难以有效整合临床叙述与结构化电子健康记录（EHR）中的诊断信号，亟需一种能够统一多模态信息的有效机制。
AI.method: 构建MIMIC-IV数据集，将结构化变量序列化并与出院记录合并。利用冻结的MedFound-Llama3-8B模型提取隐藏层状态，训练线性探测器（Linear Probes）处理不同模态输入，并使用紧凑型瓶颈适配器进行跨数据集（MIMIC-III）迁移实验。
AI.result: 多模态联合探测在MIMIC-IV上表现最优（87.69%严格准确率，91.45%医学准确率），优于单一模态和基准模型。诊断信息在深层中更具线性可分性，且仅需2M参数的适配器即可实现高效的跨数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: 基于冻结医疗LLM表征的多模态探测方法是一种研究EHR模态及实现跨数据集临床表征迁移的实用方案。
AI.translation: 目标：ICD编码对于报销、研究和人口健康监测至关重要，但自动化编码系统往往难以整合来自临床叙述和结构化电子健康记录（EHR）变量的诊断信号。我们评估了冻结的医疗大语言模型（LLM）表征是否可以作为多模态主要诊断类别预测的共享嵌入空间。材料与方法：我们构建了一个包含13,645次入院记录的MIMIC-IV队列，涵盖10个最频繁的主要ICD-10编码，并将其合并为七个类别。结构化变量被序列化为临床叙述，并与经过泄露修剪的出院记录相结合。使用冻结的MedFound-Llama3-8B微调骨干模型，我们从五个Transformer层提取隐藏状态，并训练了针对结构化数据、非结构化数据和组合输入的线性探测器，将其与XGBoost和信息匹配的PLM-ICD基准进行比较，并使用紧凑型瓶颈适配器评估了其在MIMIC-III上的适应性。结果：组合探测器在MIMIC-IV上表现最好（87.69%严格准确率；91.45%医学准确率），超过了单一模态探测器和基准模型。仅使用结构化数据的探测器在医学准确率上比标准基准高出6.19个百分点。诊断信息在更深层中变得越来越线性可分，一个2M参数的适配器仅使用5%的目标标签就恢复了向MIMIC-III的跨数据集迁移。讨论：LLM嵌入可以统一结构化和叙述性EHR信息以进行多模态诊断预测，通过一个小的表征级模块支持跨模态和数据集的临床表征高效重用。结论：对冻结医疗LLM表征进行多模态探测，为研究EHR模态和跨数据集适应临床表征提供了一种实用方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用冻结的医疗大语言模型作为统一嵌入空间，对结构化EHR数据和临床叙述进行多模态主要诊断类别预测的方法。研究通过在MIMIC-IV上训练线性探测器，证明了该方法在多模态融合及跨数据集迁移上的显著优势。
AI.keywords: ICD编码, 大语言模型, 多模态预测, 电子健康记录, 线性探测
AI.comments: 本文创新性地利用冻结的医疗大语言模型（LLM）作为多模态嵌入空间，通过线性探测（Probing）有效融合了结构化EHR数据与临床叙述。该研究展示了LLM在处理医疗多模态数据方面的潜力，尤其是在数据效率和跨数据集迁移能力方面表现出色，为临床表现的重用提供了轻量级解决方案。

title: PSP: Harnessing Position and Shape Priors for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
comments: Accepted to MICCAI 2026. This is the pre-review submitted version, not the camera-ready version. The final authenticated version will be available in the MICCAI 2026 proceedings
summary: Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation (FSMIS) offers a powerful solution to data scarcity but struggles to generalize across different imaging modalities. This performance collapse stems primarily from the drastic texture discrepancies between domains, which mislead models trained on source-specific intensity distributions. While existing methods attempt to align frequency or local texture features, they often fail to decouple semantic structure from domain-specific appearance. To address this, we identify a critical invariance: despite distinct imaging physics, the position and geometric shape of organs remain robustly consistent across modalities. Therefore, we propose a novel framework that harnesses Position and Shape Priors (PSP) for cross-domain FSMIS. Specifically, PSP first introduces a Position Coordinate Embedding (PCE) module to inject relative spatial coordinates for rapid organ localization. Subsequently, a Shape Prototype Modulation (SPM) module constructs domain-invariant structural prototypes via explicit shape priors, effectively filtering out texture noise. Furthermore, the Hybrid-Prototype Prediction (HPP) module adaptively calibrates the support prototype to the query feature distribution, mitigating feature misalignment. Extensive experiments on two public medical imaging datasets demonstrate that PSP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

title: Viscosity in error upper bound for a consistent splitting scheme of the Navier-Stokes equations
summary: This paper investigates the role of viscosity in the error upper bounds of a consistent splitting scheme for the Navier-Stokes equations proposed by Huang and Shen [5]. In their original analysis the viscosity is fixed to unity. By following and extending their proof methodology while keeping the viscosity symbolic, we obtain an H1 velocity error bound that contains negative powers of viscosity, indicating that the scheme is not robust as viscosity tends zero. To establish this bound we refine a theorem in [8] on the constant in the Stokes pressure estimate, which is crucial to the error analysis. A targeted numerical experiment based on a perturbation of the Kovasznay flow corroborates this analytical prediction: the scheme of [5] blows up at high Reynolds number, and a comparison with a fully implicit Newton solver and with the time-dependent Stokes counterpart of the same scheme localizes the failure to the explicit treatment of the convection term.

title: Salami Slicing Trellis for Synchronization Errors in DNA Coding
summary: On top of substitution errors, DNA storage channels suffer from both insertions and deletions at the same time. It is therefore important to develop error-correcting codes with efficient encoders and decoders that can combat all three types of noise. This paper introduces the salami-slicing trellis, a decision-feedback trellis that computes bitwise posterior probabilities along each strand and is coupled with polar codes across strands. The decoder alternates between advancing the trellises by one position and polar-decoding the resulting cross-strand slice, feeding the decoded bits back to the trellises for the next position. Simulations suggest that the resulting coding scheme approaches the conjectured capacity of the substitution-insertion-deletion channel.

AI.title_translation: 用于DNA编码同步错误的萨拉米切片网格方案
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种萨拉米切片网格与极化码结合的解码方案，能够高效纠正DNA存储中的替换、插入和删除错误，并接近信道容量。
AI.motivation: DNA存储信道不仅存在替换错误，还同时存在插入和删除错误，亟需开发能够高效处理这三种噪声类型的纠错编码方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“萨拉米切片网格”（salami-slicing trellis）的决策反馈网格，该网格计算每条链上的位后验概率，并与跨链极化码耦合；解码器通过交替推进网格位置和进行跨链极化解码，并将解码结果反馈给后续位置的网格。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的编码方案在性能上接近替换-插入-删除（SID）信道的理论容量。
AI.conclusion: 萨拉米切片网格与极化码的结合方案能够有效应对DNA存储信道中的替换、插入和删除错误，并接近理论上的信道容量。
AI.translation: 除了替换错误外，DNA存储信道还同时面临插入和删除错误。因此，开发能够应对这三种噪声的、具备高效编解码器的纠错码至关重要。本文介绍了萨拉米切片网格，这是一种决策反馈网格，它计算每条链上的位后验概率，并与跨链的极化码耦合。解码器交替执行网格位置推进和跨链切片的极化解码，并将解码后的比特反馈给下一位置的网格。仿真结果表明，该编码方案接近了替换-插入-删除信道的推测容量。
AI.summary: 针对DNA存储信道中替换、插入和删除错误并存的问题，本文提出了一种萨拉米切片网格与极化码相结合的纠错方案。该方法通过决策反馈网格计算单链后验概率，并利用跨链极化码进行联合解码，有效提升了纠错效率并接近信道容量。
AI.keywords: DNA存储, 同步错误, 萨拉米切片网格, 极化码, 信道容量
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的“萨拉米切片”网格结构，巧妙地结合了针对单链的同步错误处理和针对多链的极化码纠错，为解决DNA存储中复杂的替换、插入和删除错误提供了一种高效的联合解码方案，在接近信道容量方面表现出巨大的潜力。

title: ViPSim: Collaborating Visual and Parameter Spaces for Consistent Long-Horizon Embodied World Models
comments: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026
summary: Embodied World Models (EWMs) have emerged as a scalable and risk-free paradigm for advancing embodied intelligence, enabling the safety-critical evaluation of Vision-Language-Action systems. However, their reliability as evaluation benchmarks and foundational simulators is often hindered by the representation gap between low-dimensional actions and high-dimensional video synthesis. This gap results in a lack of geometric correspondence, manifesting as accumulated trajectory drift and inconsistent robot-object interactions during long-horizon rollouts. To bridge this gap, we propose ViPSim, a framework that achieves consistent long-horizon generation through the synergistic collaboration of Visual and Parameter Spaces. We define the Visual Space as a domain of explicit spatial priors, integrating pixel-aligned projections of end-effector pose, camera perspectives, depth-informed scene geometry, and robotic morphological masks to provide dense structural grounding. Concurrently, the Parameter Space serves as a domain of numerical drivers, injecting raw action sequences and camera matrices to provide precise motion guidance. By unifying these two spaces, ViPSim ensures that the generated states are simultaneously anchored by geometric boundaries and steered by numerical commands. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ViPSim is backbone-agnostic and significantly enhances trajectory consistency. Notably, our approach exhibits emergent capabilities in generating complex interactions with deformable objects (e.g., cloth folding) and maintains robust performance in out-of-distribution and cross-embodiment scenarios, providing a high-fidelity foundation for the automated evaluation and predictive control of embodied agents.

title: Physics Models for Sim-to-Real Transfer in Professional-Level Robot Table Tennis
comments: 9 pages, 7 figures, additional information: https://ace.ai.sony/, To be submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: At competitive speeds and spins, a table tennis ball follows complex, counterintuitive trajectories that a robot must track and precisely counter within fractions of a second. Training a reinforcement learning policy capable of these skills is prohibitively expensive and dangerous in the real world, making high-fidelity simulation essential. Transferability of such policies, however, critically depends on how faithfully the simulation captures real-world dynamics--a requirement made even more stringent by the adversarial nature of the game, where any regime in which a model fails to approximate reality becomes an exploitable weakness for the opponent. Prior state-of-the-art in robot table tennis generally focuses on a limited range of velocities and spins and fails to capture the richness of ball behaviors encountered in professional-level play. In this work, we present physics models for the aerodynamic ball flight, for the contact dynamics between the ball and the table, as well as between the ball and the racket that accurately capture the ball behavior over a vast range of speeds and spins relevant to the game. Specifically, we model drag and Magnus force coefficients as functions of Reynolds number and spin ratio in the aerodynamics equations. For the table contact model we model effects of ball buckling on the coefficient of restitution and incorporate residuals into the instantaneous point-contact models. For the racket contact model we introduce a residual neural network component to complement coefficients related to normal and tangential coefficients of restitution as well as torsional spin damping. The resulting models were used for the first real-world robot table tennis AI agent capable of competing against professional players, to train reinforcement learning policies.

AI.title_translation: 用于专业级机器人乒乓球仿真到现实迁移的物理模型
AI.tldr: 通过构建精确的空气动力学和接触动力学模型，成功实现了机器人乒乓球AI从仿真到现实的高效迁移，使其具备了与专业选手对抗的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人乒乓球模型无法处理专业级比赛中的高速和高旋转，且直接在真实环境中训练风险大、成本高，因此需要高保真的仿真模型来支撑策略的迁移。
AI.method: 构建了包含空气动力学（考虑雷诺数和马格努斯效应）、球台接触（考虑球体形变）以及球拍接触（结合残差神经网络）的综合物理模型，并将其应用于强化学习策略的训练。
AI.result: 开发出了首个能够与专业乒乓球运动员进行对抗的机器人AI智能体。
AI.conclusion: 通过高保真物理建模，成功解决了机器人乒乓球在高速、高旋转条件下的仿真到现实迁移难题，实现了机器人与专业选手的对抗能力。
AI.translation: 在竞技速度和旋转下，乒乓球遵循复杂的、反直觉的轨迹，机器人必须在几分之一秒内进行跟踪并精确应对。训练能够掌握这些技能的强化学习策略在现实世界中代价高昂且危险，因此高保真仿真至关重要。然而，此类策略的可迁移性关键在于仿真对现实世界动力学的还原程度，由于乒乓球对抗性的本质，模型中任何无法近似现实的领域都会成为对手可利用的弱点，这一要求变得更加严格。现有的机器人乒乓球技术通常局限于有限的速度和旋转范围，无法捕捉专业级比赛中丰富的球体行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了用于空气动力学球飞行、球与球台之间以及球与球拍之间接触动力学的物理模型，这些模型准确地捕捉了与比赛相关的各种速度和旋转下的球体行为。具体而言，我们在空气动力学方程中将阻力和马格努斯力系数建模为雷诺数和旋转比的函数。对于球台接触模型，我们建模了球体形变对恢复系数的影响，并将残差纳入瞬时点接触模型中。对于球拍接触模型，我们引入了一个残差神经网络组件，以补充与法向和切向恢复系数以及扭转旋转阻尼相关的系数。所得模型被用于训练首个能够与专业选手竞争的现实世界机器人乒乓球AI智能体的强化学习策略。
AI.summary: 本文针对机器人乒乓球在专业级竞技中面临的复杂动力学挑战，提出了一套高保真物理模型。通过精确建模空气动力学、球台与球拍的接触动力学，解决了仿真与现实之间的差异，从而使强化学习策略能够有效迁移，实现了机器人与专业选手的对抗。
AI.keywords: 机器人乒乓球, 强化学习, 仿真到现实迁移, 空气动力学, 碰撞动力学
AI.comments: 该论文通过物理建模提升了模拟仿真到现实环境的迁移能力，在机器人乒乓球领域实现了关键突破。其创新点在于结合了空气动力学、球台碰撞及球拍接触的精细化物理模型，成功支撑了能够与专业选手对抗的AI训练。限制在于该模型主要针对乒乓球特定场景，通用性有待进一步验证。

title: Extending Detection Engineering to Digital Forensics: The Velociraptor Unified Detection-Forensics Methodology
comments: 12 pages, 3 figures. Preprint submitted to Forensic Science International: Digital Investigation
summary:
Detection engineering and digital forensics have evolved in parallel rather than in partnership, leaving a gap between real-time alerting and forensic analysis. This paper develops a unified detection-forensics methodology using Velociraptor, where detection logic directly initiates targeted evidence acquisition at the point of detection.
  The contribution is threefold: (1) a four-stage methodology (baseline establishment, evidence correlation, attack chain analysis, and scenario labelling with confidence) that converts artefact knowledge into reusable and testable detection rules suitable for both post-incident triage and live monitoring; (2) a practical demonstration, using three Velociraptor BaseVQL log sources (/forensics/windows/prefetch, /forensics/windows/usn, and /windows/wmi) that practitioners can deploy today, showing that artefact-based detections enable scalable forensic triage without full disk acquisition; and (3) evidence that periodic artefact analysis offers continuous monitoring while substantially reducing data volume compared to conventional endpoint logging.
  Two case studies illustrate the approach: a Prefetch/USN baseline for triage when Windows Event Logs are cleared or unavailable, and a WMI persistence correlation supporting both triage and continuous monitoring through periodic artefact analysis.

title: Human2Any: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Constraint-Aware Compositional Planning
summary: Human videos are a scalable source of supervision for robot manipulation, as they are abundant and naturally capture rich object interactions. However, transferring human demonstrations to robots remains challenging due to embodiment mismatch, scene variation, and robot-specific feasibility constraints. We present Human2Any, a framework for learning reusable object-centric interaction priors from human videos without requiring real-world robot demonstrations in the target task contexts. Human2Any represents manipulation through object-object interaction motion, capturing task-relevant scene changes while abstracting away embodiment-specific details. It composes learned interaction priors with robot-side feasibility reasoning and motion planning, allowing the same human-derived knowledge to adapt to different embodiments, scene geometries, and task contexts. We validate Human2Any across diverse manipulation settings, including real-world experiments on a Franka tabletop setup and an RBY-1 humanoid mobile robot, demonstrating robust interaction-centric manipulation without real-world robot training data. Project website: https://human2any.github.io/.

title: Categorizing Mathematical Concepts with LLM Voting Ensembles in Mathswitch
comments: Submitted (pre-peer-review) version. Accepted at CICM 2026; the Version of Record will appear in Springer LNAI. We'll add the DOI once the proceedings are published
summary: Mathswitch is an open-source project that imports mathematical concept records from sources such as Wikidata, Wikipedia, MathWorld, Encyclopedia of Mathematics, nLab, ProofWiki, and Agda-Unimath, and links records that refer to the same concept. It does not reorganize or redefine the imported content; each source retains its own structure. The current focus is on importing concept data from Wikidata and the resources it links to, with plans to expand to further sources and better concept linking. Because the concept set is approximated through queries over Wikidata's collaboratively edited graph, the imported data is noisy: some items are non-mathematical, while others are ambiguous. In this paper, we test whether a voting ensemble of LLM judges can filter this noise. We evaluate it on Wikidata items with known MathWorld identifiers as a positive control, and examine how classification changes when database identifiers are removed from context. We then inspect the cases where the judges disagree with MathWorld and group these disagreements into three categories (degenerate descriptions, narrow scope bias, and editorial-scope mismatches) that suggest different remediation strategies.

title: Trust-Calibrated Certified Repair for Physics-Constrained Decisions under Localized Model Misspecification
summary: Feasibility-restoration layers turn learned, market-based, or optimizer-generated decisions into actions satisfying hard constraints in systems such as power grids. Yet a repair is only as trustworthy as its constraint model: line parameters, sensitivities, ratings, and topology can be locally wrong, so a decision certified feasible under the nominal model may violate the deployed system. We identify this false safety as a dominant failure mode of model-trusting repair and propose Trust-Calibrated Certified Repair (TCR). TCR treats repair as trust calibration and answers four questions in one pipeline: where the physical model is wrong, discovered from measurements with false-discovery control; how much each constraint should be trusted, set by test-gated shrinkage and uncertainty-proportional security margins; what least-cost intervention restores feasibility, computed by a certified repair program; and why the cost was paid, attributed to genuine congestion versus avoidable model error through dual prices. On a physically grounded dynamic-line-rating benchmark whose true ratings follow IEEE 738 under real weather, TCR reaches 98% true-network feasibility, within two points of a clairvoyant oracle, at lower-than-naive cost and with perfect localization. Model-trusting repair, robust margins, and chance-constrained tightening leave substantial feasibility or cost gaps. The same method transfers unchanged to transmission redispatch over PGLib-OPF networks and distribution voltage regulation on the IEEE 33-bus feeder. Across all three task families, TCR gives the strongest deployable feasibility-cost frontier under localized physical-model misspecification. Calibrating trust in the constraint model is the missing ingredient for reliable AI-assisted engineering decisions.

AI.title_translation: 面向局部模型误设的物理约束决策：信任校准认证修复
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为TCR的框架，通过识别并校准物理模型中的局部错误，显著提升了电力系统在模型误设情况下的决策可行性与成本效益。
AI.motivation: 现有的可行性修复方法过度依赖模型，当物理模型（如参数、拓扑）存在局部错误时，会导致决策看似安全但在实际部署中失效，即“虚假安全”问题。
AI.method: 提出信任校准认证修复（TCR）框架，包含四个模块：基于测量数据进行虚假发现控制以定位模型错误；利用测试门控收缩和不确定性比例安全裕度来设置约束信任度；通过认证修复程序计算最低成本干预；以及利用对偶价格进行成本归因。
AI.result: 在动态线路额定值基准测试中，TCR达到了98%的实际网络可行性，接近全知预言机水平，且成本低于朴素方法，并实现了完美的错误定位。该方法在输电重调度和配电电压调节任务中均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过信任校准，TCR有效克服了局部物理模型错误导致的“虚假安全”问题，在多种电力系统任务中实现了优于传统修复方法的性能表现。
AI.translation: 可行性恢复层将学习到的、基于市场的或优化器生成的决策转化为满足电力系统等硬约束的行动。然而，修复的可靠性取决于其约束模型：线路参数、灵敏度、额定值和拓扑结构可能在局部是错误的，因此在标称模型下认证为可行的决策在实际部署的系统中可能会失效。我们指出这种“虚假安全”是模型信任型修复的主要失效模式，并提出了信任校准认证修复（TCR）。TCR将修复视为信任校准，并在一个流水线中回答四个问题：物理模型哪里错了（通过具有虚假发现控制的测量结果发现）；每个约束应该被信任多少（通过测试门控收缩和不确定性比例安全裕度设置）；什么最低成本干预能恢复可行性（通过认证修复程序计算）；以及为什么要付出这个成本（通过对偶价格归因于真实的拥堵还是可避免的模型错误）。在一个基于IEEE 738真实天气下动态线路额定值的物理基准测试中，TCR达到了98%的真实网络可行性，与全知预言机仅差两个百分点，且成本低于朴素方法，并具有完美的定位能力。模型信任型修复、稳健裕度和机会约束收紧在可行性或成本方面留下了巨大的差距。同样的方法在PGLib-OPF网络的输电重调度和IEEE 33节点馈线的配电电压调节中均可无缝迁移。在所有三个任务系列中，TCR在局部物理模型误设下提供了最强的可部署可行性-成本前沿。校准约束模型中的信任是实现可靠AI辅助工程决策的缺失环节。
AI.summary: 该论文针对物理约束决策中因局部模型误设导致的“虚假安全”风险，提出了一种信任校准认证修复（TCR）框架。该方法通过从测量数据中定位模型错误、动态调整约束信任度、执行最低成本修复以及进行成本归因，在保证系统可行性的同时优化了干预成本，显著提升了AI辅助工程决策的可靠性。
AI.keywords: 信任校准, 物理约束, 可行性修复, 电力系统, 模型误设
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将“信任校准”引入物理约束决策的修复过程，解决了现有方法在模型局部误设（misspecification）下失效的痛点。其核心贡献在于统一了故障定位、信任度量、可行性修复和代价归因，为AI辅助工程决策提供了更可靠的框架。

title: SAT-IT: an Online Interactive SAT Tracer
comments: 15-20 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at TEAL FLOC 2026. Technical paper on representation of data structures and algorithms used in modern SAT solvers (CDCL-based)
summary: Modern Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) solvers, based on the Conflict-Driven Clause Learning (CDCL) paradigm, achieve state-of-the-art efficiency but present a steep learning curve due to their sophisticated algorithms and highly optimized data structures. Understanding these complex mechanics and evaluating the effectiveness of problem encodings is notoriously challenging for students and emerging researchers. To ease this learning process, we introduce the Interactive SAT Tracer (SAT-IT), an open-access web environment designed to make the foundations of SAT solving highly visible and interactive. SAT-IT offers a staged pedagogical progression: from naive backtracking to DPLL and full CDCL with the two-watched literals scheme. Users can clearly inspect fundamental data structures, search space trails, and solving statistics. The tool interactive search space exploration is boosted with literal-level breakpoints for targeted inspection, alongside versatile automatic solving modes that offer both continuous real-time execution and state-based subroutine automation. Combined with a powerful ``what-if'' capability for stepping backward to explore alternative decisions, an instance manager, and an extensible architecture ready to support additional algorithms, SAT-IT serves as a practical, granular lens for experimenting with SAT solving algorithms and analysing encodings efficiency.
comment: 15-20 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at TEAL FLOC 2026. Technical paper on representation of data structures and algorithms used in modern SAT solvers (CDCL-based)

AI.title_translation: SAT-IT：一个在线交互式 SAT 追踪器
AI.tldr: SAT-IT 是一个在线教学工具，通过可视化和交互式调试功能，帮助用户直观理解复杂的 CDCL SAT 求解算法。
AI.motivation: 现代基于 CDCL 的 SAT 求解器算法复杂且高度优化，导致学生和研究人员难以理解其内部机制及评估问题编码的有效性。
AI.method: 开发了一款基于 Web 的交互式 SAT 追踪器（SAT-IT），支持从基础回溯、DPLL 到完整 CDCL（含两字句监控方案）的教学路径，并集成了断点调试、状态回溯、搜索空间可视化及自动求解模式。
AI.result: 成功构建了一个开源的 Web 环境，能够直观展示数据结构、搜索路径和求解统计数据，通过交互式功能帮助用户深入理解算法并分析编码效率。
AI.conclusion: SAT-IT 是一款有效的教育和研究工具，通过交互式可视化成功简化了对复杂 SAT 求解算法的理解与分析过程。
AI.translation: 现代布尔可满足性（SAT）求解器基于冲突驱动子句学习（CDCL）范式，虽然效率极高，但由于其复杂的算法和高度优化的数据结构，学习曲线陡峭。对于学生和新兴研究人员来说，理解这些复杂的机制并评估问题编码的有效性极具挑战性。为了简化这一学习过程，我们推出了交互式 SAT 追踪器（SAT-IT），这是一个开源的 Web 环境，旨在使 SAT 求解的基础知识变得高度可视化和交互式。SAT-IT 提供了分阶段的教学进展：从简单的回溯到 DPLL，再到带有双字句监控方案的完整 CDCL。用户可以清晰地检查基本数据结构、搜索空间轨迹和求解统计数据。该工具的交互式搜索空间探索功能通过用于目标检查的字面量级断点得到了增强，同时还具备多功能的自动求解模式，可提供连续实时执行和基于状态的子程序自动化。结合强大的“假设分析”能力（即向后回溯以探索替代决策）、实例管理器和支持额外算法的可扩展架构，SAT-IT 为实验 SAT 求解算法和分析编码效率提供了一个实用的、细粒度的视角。
AI.summary: SAT-IT 是一款旨在辅助 SAT 求解算法教学与分析的交互式 Web 工具。它通过分阶段的教学路径，将复杂的回溯、DPLL 和 CDCL 算法过程可视化，并提供包括断点、状态回溯及自动求解在内的多种功能，使学习者能够清晰地检查求解器的内部运作机制。
AI.keywords: SAT求解器, CDCL, 可视化教学, 算法调试, 交互式环境
AI.comments: 该工具通过交互式可视化降低了SAT求解器的学习门槛，对于教育和算法调试具有显著价值。其创新点在于将复杂的CDCL过程解构为可逐步探索的教学模块，并提供了“后悔”（回溯）和断点功能，这是传统静态文档所不具备的。

title: CoGS: Compositional Dynamic Human-Object Scenes Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Video
summary: Reconstructing dynamic human--object interaction scenes from monocular video is difficult because the human, manipulated object, and background obey different motion models while sharing the same pixels. Existing dynamic radiance-field and Gaussian-splatting methods often entangle these components, causing object motion to leak into the human or static scene, and monocular human reconstruction remains underconstrained in regions that are rarely observed. We present CoGS, a compositional Gaussian-splatting framework for monocular human--object scene reconstruction. CoGS decomposes the video into three coordinated branches: an articulated human initialized from a complete canonical prior, a rigid object field driven by an estimated object trajectory, and a static scene field regularized by weak scene-only planar primitives when available. A six-stage optimization schedule first stabilizes the human and object independently, then fuses them with the scene under full-image supervision, visibility-aware human anchoring, object silhouette and motion constraints, and delayed scene regularization. This design keeps each component responsible for its own geometry and motion while allowing photometric evidence to correct the final composite. Experiments on HOSNeRF and NeuMan show that CoGS improves both human--object interaction reconstruction and in-the-wild human--scene rendering, achieving stronger fidelity and perceptual quality across full-frame and human-focused evaluations. Code will be released upon publication.

title: Labeling Training Data for Entity Matching Using Large Language Models
summary:
Recent large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on entity matching without requiring task-specific training data. However, applying these models to large sets of candidate pairs remains slow and costly. In contrast, entity matchers using traditional machine learning methods or small language models (SLMs), such as RoBERTa, offer much faster inference but require task-specific training data.
  This paper investigates whether the need to provide task-specific training data can be avoided by using knowledge-distillation workflows, in which an LLM serves as a teacher model to label training pairs that are subsequently used to train a smaller student model. We investigate knowledge distillation for entity matching along the following dimensions: pair-selection strategy, teacher model, label post-processing method, and student model. We evaluate the workflows using the Abt-Buy, Walmart-Amazon, WDC Products, DBLP-ACM, and DBLP-Scholar benchmarks, and compare the performance of student models trained with machine-labeled data to the performance of the same models trained using the benchmark training sets.
  Our experiments show that student models trained using the machine-labeled sets perform approximately on par with models trained on the benchmark training sets, with the remaining differences in both directions staying below two F1 points. Using GPT-5.2 to label the training sets for all five benchmarks costs US\$28.31 to US\$40.88, whereas manually labeling the same training sets is estimated to require 470 hours of work. At inference time, Ditto is 41.5 to 534 times faster than directly using an LLM to perform the matching tasks.
  These results indicate that current LLMs, when combined with a suitable pair-selection method, can substantially reduce or even eliminate the manual effort required to label use case-specific training data for entity matching.

AI.title_translation: 利用大语言模型为实体匹配标注训练数据
AI.tldr: 通过LLM自动标注数据来训练高效的小型实体匹配模型，无需人工干预即可实现高性能，且成本更低、速度更快。
AI.motivation: 直接使用LLM进行实体匹配推理成本高、速度慢，而传统机器学习或小模型方法又依赖昂贵的人工标注数据，研究旨在通过知识蒸馏消除对人工标注的依赖。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLM）作为教师模型，对未标注的候选对进行自动标注，生成训练数据以微调较小且高效的学生模型（如Ditto/RoBERTa），并评估了配对选择策略、教师模型选择、标签后处理等维度。
AI.result: 学生模型在机器标注数据上训练后的表现与人工标注数据相当（F1差异小于2个点）；标注成本仅需数十美元，远低于数百小时的人工劳动；推理速度较直接使用LLM提升了41.5至534倍。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助的知识蒸馏流程能够有效替代人工标注，在保持模型性能的同时大幅降低成本并提升推理速度。
AI.translation:
最近的大语言模型（LLM）在不需要特定任务训练数据的情况下，在实体匹配方面表现出色。然而，将这些模型应用于大型候选对集合仍然缓慢且昂贵。相比之下，使用传统机器学习方法或小型语言模型（SLM，如RoBERTa）的实体匹配器推理速度快得多，但需要特定任务的训练数据。
本文研究了是否可以通过知识蒸馏工作流来避免提供特定任务训练数据的需求，在这种工作流中，LLM作为教师模型来标记训练对，随后用于训练较小的学生模型。我们从配对选择策略、教师模型、标签后处理方法和学生模型等维度研究了实体匹配的知识蒸馏。我们使用Abt-Buy、Walmart-Amazon、WDC Products、DBLP-ACM和DBLP-Scholar基准测试评估了这些工作流，并将机器标记数据训练的学生模型的性能与使用基准训练集训练的相同模型的性能进行了比较。
实验表明，使用机器标记集训练的学生模型的表现与基准训练集上训练的模型大致相当，双方的差异均保持在两个F1点以内。使用GPT-5.2为所有五个基准测试标记训练集花费了28.31美元至40.88美元，而手动标记相同的训练集估计需要470小时的工作。在推理阶段，Ditto比直接使用LLM执行匹配任务快41.5至534倍。
这些结果表明，当前的LLM与适当的配对选择方法相结合，可以大幅减少甚至消除实体匹配中标记特定用例训练数据所需的人工工作。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用大语言模型（LLM）进行知识蒸馏以替代实体匹配中的人工数据标注。研究发现，通过LLM自动标注训练集来微调小模型，不仅能显著降低标注成本和时间，还能在保持模型性能的同时，实现比直接使用LLM快得多的推理速度。
AI.keywords: 实体匹配, 大语言模型, 知识蒸馏, 自动数据标注
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种利用LLM作为教师模型来自动标注数据，进而训练小模型（学生模型）的方法，成功解决了传统小模型需要大量人工标注数据的瓶颈，同时规避了直接使用大模型进行推理时的高昂成本和延迟问题，具有极高的实用价值。

title: Exit-and-Join Dynamics and Equilibrium in Continuum Cooperative Games
summary: This paper develops a continuum theory of exit-and-join coalition dynamics in nonatomic cooperative games. We extend the Aumann-Shapley value and the Aumann-Drèze value to coalition structures in which each coalition is treated as a restricted nonatomic game, yielding a marginal-contribution-based payoff density that governs incentives for agents to remain in, exit, or join coalitions. We derive deterministic mean-field dynamics from decentralized switching rules and show that payoff-difference switching recovers replicator dynamics as a special case. We characterize exit-and-join equilibrium by the absence of profitable positive-mass deviations and prove its equivalence with stationarity of the induced mass dynamics under incentive-compatible and strictly payoff-responsive switching rates. For mass-based cooperative games, we construct a Lyapunov function and establish global convergence under strict concavity. We further show that the equilibrium is equivalent to a Wardrop equilibrium of an induced nonatomic population game and admits a variational inequality formulation. The framework is extended to incorporate switching costs and endogenous coalition acceptance rules, leading to constrained equilibria characterized by quasi-variational inequalities. The proposed theory unifies cooperative value allocation, noncooperative coalition mobility, mean-field dynamics, evolutionary game theory, and population games within a common framework for analyzing coalition formation and adaptation in large-scale multi-agent systems.

AI.title_translation: 连续合作博弈中的退出-加入动态与均衡
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种连续合作博弈框架，通过均场动力学分析大规模智能体系统的联盟形成与适应，并统一了合作博弈价值分配与演化博弈均衡理论。
AI.motivation: 现有理论难以有效分析大规模系统中智能体在联盟中的退出与加入行为及其动态平衡，需要一个统一框架来整合合作博弈价值分配与非合作联盟移动性。
AI.method: 通过扩展Aumann-Shapley和Aumann-Drèze值定义支付密度；推导去中心化切换规则下的确定性均场动力学；构建Lyapunov函数分析收敛性；利用变分不等式表征均衡。
AI.result: 推导出了基于边际贡献的支付密度；证明了支付差异切换可恢复演化博弈中的复制子动力学；建立了均衡与Wardrop均衡及变分不等式的等价关系。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了退出-加入均衡与诱导质量动力学的平稳性等价，并通过Lyapunov函数证明了特定条件下的全局收敛性，为理解大规模系统中的联盟动态提供了强有力的数学工具。
AI.translation: 本文发展了非原子合作博弈中退出-加入联盟动态的连续理论。我们将Aumann-Shapley值和Aumann-Drèze值扩展到联盟结构中，其中每个联盟被视为受限的非原子博弈，从而得出基于边际贡献的支付密度，该密度控制着智能体留在、退出或加入联盟的激励。我们从去中心化的切换规则推导出了确定性均场动力学，并表明支付差异切换可将复制子动力学作为特例恢复。我们通过不存在有利的正质量偏差来刻画退出-加入均衡，并证明了其在激励相容和严格支付响应切换率下与诱导质量动力学的平稳性等价。对于基于质量的合作博弈，我们构造了一个Lyapunov函数，并在严格凹性下建立了全局收敛性。我们进一步表明，该均衡等同于诱导非原子种群博弈的Wardrop均衡，并承认变分不等式表述。该框架被扩展以纳入切换成本和内生联盟接受规则，导致了以拟变分不等式为特征的受限均衡。所提出的理论在一个共同框架内统一了合作价值分配、非合作联盟移动性、均场动力学、演化博弈论和种群博弈，用于分析大规模多智能体系统中的联盟形成和适应。
AI.summary: 本文为非原子合作博弈中的联盟退出与加入动态构建了连续理论框架，通过扩展经典价值定义来推导均场动力学，并证明了联盟均衡与演化博弈中相关均衡概念的等价性，从而统一了合作与非合作联盟的分析范式。
AI.keywords: 连续合作博弈, 联盟动态, 均场动力学, 演化博弈, Wardrop均衡
AI.comments: 该论文通过将合作博弈论与演化博弈论及均场动力学相结合，成功构建了一个分析大规模多智能体系统联盟形成与适应的统一框架，具有很高的理论创新性。其局限性在于对复杂联盟结构和动态环境下的博弈假设较为理想化。

title: RefGlass-GS: A UAV-Enabled Fusion Framework for Photorealistic, Semantic and Interactive Digitization of Reflective Glass Facades via Gaussian Splatting
summary: Existing digitization of buildings with reflective glass facades suffers from geometric reconstruction distortion, unrealistic view-dependent texture rendering, and difficulties in object-based semantic enhancement. Therefore, we propose RefGlass-GS, a fusion framework that enables end-to-end UAV-based photorealistic, semantic, and interactive digitization of reflective glass facades. The contributions include: (1) proposing an individual glass panel segmentation method based on maximum a posteriori estimation with structural regularities, robust to severe reflection and background interference; (2) formulating a UAV viewpoint planning optimization function that maximizes the coverage of view-dependent appearance for sufficient data capture; (3) developing an optimized Gaussian Splatting framework with a Reflection MLP, a novel deferred shading function, and two enhanced regularization terms for effective modeling of high-frequency near-field reflections; (4) introducing a standardized data organization paradigm for structuring GS-based representations into object-based models, facilitating interactive facility management on digital twin platforms. Experiments on real-world reflective glass facade scenes validate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method. Specifically, the glass panel segmentation achieves an improvement of 0.1927 in mIoU over SOTA methods, and only our method enables instance-level panel extraction. The UAV view planning improves novel view synthesis for reflective facades by 13.15 dB in PSNR compared to commercially used nap-of-the-object planning methods. The RefGlass-GS modeling outperforms SOTA Gaussian Splatting approaches for reflective scenes with an average improvement of 5.08 dB in PSNR.

AI.title_translation: RefGlass-GS：一种基于无人机的反射玻璃幕墙高保真、语义化及交互式高斯溅射数字化融合框架
AI.tldr: RefGlass-GS通过改进高斯溅射和无人机路径规划，解决了反射玻璃幕墙三维重建中常见的畸变与渲染难题，实现了高质量的语义级数字孪生建模。
AI.motivation: 现有数字化方法在面对反射玻璃幕墙时，常出现几何重建畸变、视点依赖纹理渲染不真实以及难以进行基于对象的语义增强等问题。
AI.method: 1. 基于最大后验概率估计的玻璃面板分割方法；2. 最大化视点依赖外观覆盖的无人机路径规划函数；3. 结合反射MLP、延迟着色函数及增强正则化项的优化高斯溅射框架；4. 面向对象交互的标准化数据组织范式。
AI.result: 玻璃面板分割mIoU提升0.1927；无人机视点规划使新视角合成的PSNR提升13.15 dB；RefGlass-GS建模在反射场景下的平均PSNR较现有最佳方案提升5.08 dB。
AI.conclusion: RefGlass-GS框架通过多维度的技术优化，成功实现了复杂反射玻璃幕墙的高保真、语义化及可交互的三维数字化，显著优于现有技术。
AI.translation: 现有的反射玻璃幕墙建筑数字化技术存在几何重建畸变、视点依赖纹理渲染不真实以及难以进行基于对象的语义增强等问题。因此，我们提出了RefGlass-GS，一个支持端到端基于无人机的反射玻璃幕墙高保真、语义化和交互式数字化的融合框架。主要贡献包括：（1）提出了一种基于最大后验概率估计和结构正则性的独立玻璃面板分割方法，对严重的反射和背景干扰具有鲁棒性；（2）制定了一种最大化视点依赖外观覆盖的无人机视点规划优化函数，以确保数据采集的充分性；（3）开发了一种优化的高斯溅射框架，结合了反射MLP、一种新型延迟着色函数以及两项增强正则化项，用于有效建模高频近场反射；（4）引入了一种标准化数据组织范式，将基于GS的表示结构化为基于对象的模型，促进了数字孪生平台上的交互式设施管理。在真实世界反射玻璃幕墙场景上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性和优越性。具体而言，玻璃面板分割在mIoU上较SOTA方法提升了0.1927，且仅有本方法实现了实例级的面板提取。相比商业化的贴近目标飞行规划方法，无人机视点规划使反射幕墙的新视角合成PSNR提高了13.15 dB。RefGlass-GS建模在反射场景下优于现有的SOTA高斯溅射方法，PSNR平均提升5.08 dB。
AI.summary: RefGlass-GS是一个基于无人机的高斯溅射融合框架，旨在解决反射玻璃幕墙数字化中的几何失真和渲染难题。该框架通过创新的面板分割、优化的视点规划和专门设计的反射建模技术，实现了高质量的视觉重建与语义增强，并支持面向数字孪生的交互式管理。
AI.keywords: 高斯溅射, 反射玻璃幕墙, 无人机, 语义数字化, 数字孪生
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将高斯溅射（Gaussian Splatting）应用于极具挑战性的反射玻璃幕墙重建，通过结合结构先验、优化的视点规划以及针对反射建模的MLP架构，有效解决了传统方法在镜面反射场景下的几何畸变和渲染失真问题。其将数字化结果组织为对象级模型，为数字孪生平台提供了极佳的交互性。

title: LNN-Fly: Continuous-Time UAV Navigation for Robust Obstacle Avoidance under Timing Mismatch
comments: 8 pages, 7 figures, accepted for publication at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: End-to-end unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation can achieve impressive agility in simulation, yet its obstacle-avoidance behavior often degrades after deployment because the policy must tolerate simulator mismatch, sensing irregularity, and variable-rate control. These effects are especially dangerous in cluttered environments, where stale observations or short control irregularities can directly lead to collisions. We present LNN-Fly, a deployment-oriented continuous-time navigation policy for LiDAR-based UAV obstacle avoidance. The policy combines a dynamic-programming-inspired structured recurrent update, explicit conditioning on the elapsed control interval Δt, and an input-driven adaptive forgetting gate that refreshes stale latent state near hazards while preserving consistency during sustained maneuvers. It is trained with differentiable rollouts that incorporate deployment-relevant sensing and timing perturbations. In simulation, LNN-Fly improves obstacle-avoidance performance in the tested settings and shows better tolerance to reduced control frequency, sparse observations, and control-period jitter. It also transfers zero-shot from a simplified differentiable simulator to a physical quadrotor. In indoor cross-frequency real-world tests, the system achieves 100% success over 20 flights, while policy inference has a median latency of 0.514 ms on a desktop graphics processing unit (GPU) and about 2.5 ms on the onboard central processing unit (CPU), with onboard P95 latency below 30 ms.
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, accepted for publication at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

AI.title_translation: LNN-Fly：针对时序不匹配的鲁棒无人机连续时间避障导航
AI.tldr: LNN-Fly 是一种新型无人机避障策略，通过处理时序不匹配和控制延迟，实现了复杂环境下的鲁棒导航，并在真实飞行中取得了 100% 的成功率。
AI.motivation: 端到端无人机导航策略在模拟器中表现出色，但部署到真实环境时，受限于模拟器差异、感知不规律和变频控制的影响，容易出现避障能力下降甚至碰撞的问题。
AI.method: 提出 LNN-Fly 策略，结合了受动态规划启发的结构化循环更新、对控制间隔 Δt 的显式调节，以及输入驱动的自适应遗忘门，并在训练中加入了部署相关的感知和时序扰动。
AI.result: 在模拟测试中表现出更强的抗干扰能力；在真实环境测试中实现 20 次飞行 100% 的成功率；推理延迟极低，板载 CPU 上的 P95 延迟低于 30 ms。
AI.conclusion: LNN-Fly 成功克服了端到端无人机导航在复杂环境下的时序不匹配问题，通过仿真到现实的零样本迁移，在真实飞行测试中展现出极高的成功率和优异的实时性。
AI.translation: 端到端无人机（UAV）导航在模拟中可以实现令人印象深刻的敏捷性，但其避障行为在部署后往往会退化，因为策略必须容忍模拟器差异、感知不规律和变频控制。这些影响在杂乱的环境中尤其危险，陈旧的观察或短暂的控制不规律可能直接导致碰撞。我们提出了 LNN-Fly，这是一种面向部署的基于 LiDAR 的无人机避障连续时间导航策略。该策略结合了受动态规划启发的结构化循环更新、对经过的控制间隔 Δt 的显式调节，以及一种输入驱动的自适应遗忘门，它可以在危险附近刷新陈旧的潜在状态，同时在持续机动过程中保持一致性。它通过结合部署相关的感知和时序扰动的可微展开进行训练。在模拟中，LNN-Fly 提高了测试环境中的避障性能，并显示出对降低控制频率、稀疏观察和控制周期抖动的更好容忍度。它还可以从简化的可微模拟器零样本迁移到物理四旋翼飞行器。在室内跨频率真实世界测试中，该系统在 20 次飞行中实现了 100% 的成功率，而策略推理在桌面图形处理单元（GPU）上的中位延迟为 0.514 毫秒，在板载中央处理单元（CPU）上约为 2.5 毫秒，板载 P95 延迟低于 30 毫秒。
AI.summary: LNN-Fly 是一种面向部署的连续时间无人机避障导航策略。它通过引入显式的时间间隔处理机制和自适应状态更新，解决了变频控制和感知延迟导致的导航失效问题，实现了从仿真到真实世界的可靠零样本迁移。
AI.keywords: 无人机导航, 障碍物规避, 连续时间策略, 时序不匹配, 端到端学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了连续时间导航策略，通过显式处理时间不匹配（timing mismatch）问题，显著提高了无人机在真实环境中的部署鲁棒性。其核心贡献在于将动态规划思想与自适应遗忘门结合，有效解决了传统端到端方法在变频控制和传感器延迟下的性能退化问题。

title: Ground4D: Consistency-Aware 4D Reconstruction from Monocular Video
summary: Learning a 4D scene representation from a single monocular video that supports dynamic novel-view synthesis while maintaining faithful geometry over time remains challenging. Dynamic Gaussian Splatting achieves strong rendering performance through photometric optimization, yet does not explicitly enforce multi-view geometric consistency. In contrast, 3D foundation models recover coherent scene geometry and camera motion, but their point-based outputs are not designed for photorealistic rendering. We propose Ground4D, a geometry-grounded framework built on two stages. First, we perform geometry initialization via 3D foundation models, leveraging VGGT in a training-free manner to reconstruct multi-view-consistent 3D geometry and camera poses from monocular video. The recovered geometry provides a structured and reliable initialization for dynamic Gaussian representations. Second, we conduct geometry-consistency-aware refinement via dynamic Gaussian Splatting, optimizing the representation through differentiable rendering while maintaining multi-view geometric consistency across both observed and synthesized viewpoints. Furthermore, Ground4D inherently models the continuous 4D dynamics of the scene, naturally supporting rendering at arbitrary timestamps. By integrating foundation-level geometric priors into dynamic Gaussian optimization, Ground4D achieves stronger reconstruction fidelity and rendering performance, underscoring the role of geometry-grounded constraints in robust 4D scene modeling.

title: HARD-KV: Head-Adaptive Regularization for Decoding-time KV Compression
summary: Long-context LLM inference faces a fundamental conflict: head-adaptive compression algorithms (e.g., Top-$p$ nucleus sampling) offer superior accuracy by dynamically fluctuating memory budgets, yet modern inference engines (e.g., vLLM) demand rigid, static memory patterns to leverage CUDA Graphs and PagedAttention. We resolve this ``Static-Dynamic'' mismatch with HARD-KV, a unified framework that that bridges dynamic selection with rigid system constraints. HARD-KV introduces a Cascade Cache hierarchy, managing the token lifecycle across dense, sparse, and condensed tiers. Crucially, we propose a Logits Calibration mechanism that normalizes diverse importance metrics into a unified probability space, enabling consistent Top-$p$ budgeting across heterogeneous heads. To bridge the efficiency gap, we offer a system-level solution, which rewrites fragmented, dynamic indices into contiguous physical layouts compatible with high-performance inference engine. Extensive experiments on math-reasoning benchmarks (AIME, U-Math) verify that HARD-KV achieves up to 2$\times$ throughput improvement over static baselines while maintaining high-fidelity generation in 10k+ token scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/SuDIS-ZJU/HARDInfer.

title: Active Quantum Kernel Acquisition for Gaussian Process Regression
summary: Quantum kernel estimation on near-term hardware is shot-budgeted: every entry of the kernel Gram matrix is a Bernoulli expectation that must be sampled with a finite number of circuit executions. Recent work on quantum kernel classification has shown that allocating shots non-uniformly across kernel entries, weighted by their downstream task sensitivity, can reduce the shot budget required to reach a target accuracy. We extend this idea to Gaussian process (GP) regression, a setting whose downstream quantities (full-spectrum posterior variance, log-determinant, marginal likelihood) couple to kernel error more tightly than the sign-only outputs of classification. We derive three closed-form pair-level sensitivities predictive coupling $|α_iα_j|$, leave-one-out residual, and marginal-likelihood gradient and plug them into a Neyman-style minimum-variance allocation rule. To prevent catastrophic over-concentration when the warm-up sensitivity estimate is itself noisy, we add a high uniform coverage floor justified by a Frobenius lower bound on the missing-entry perturbation. On four UCI benchmarks and two synthetic RBF + Bernoulli controlled studies, the resulting allocator delivers $10$--$21\%$ test-RMSE improvement over uniform allocation across the moderate-budget regime. The gain transfers (i) to genuine ZZ and Pauli-Z quantum kernels on quantum-natural data ($-13$--$15\%$ at low budget, $p<0.05$ paired) and (ii) to four downstream tasks (Bayesian quadrature, heteroscedastic regression, hyperparameter learning, multi-output Cokriging). On UCI features embedded into a ZZ kernel the gain disappears, consistent with the exponential-concentration regime where shot allocation has nothing to exploit.

AI.title_translation: 高斯过程回归的主动量子核获取
AI.tldr: 通过根据任务灵敏度动态分配量子采样次数，显著提升了量子高斯过程回归的精度。
AI.motivation: 在近期的量子硬件上进行核估计时，采样次数（shots）是有限资源，如何非均匀地分配这些采样以提高高斯过程回归的精度是当前的核心挑战。
AI.method: 推导出三种闭式配对级灵敏度指标（预测耦合、留一法残差、边际似然梯度），并将其融入Neyman最小方差分配规则；同时引入基于Frobenius范数下界的均匀覆盖底线，以防止因预热灵敏度估计噪声导致的过拟合。
AI.result: 在UCI基准测试和合成研究中，该分配器在适度预算下将测试RMSE降低了10%至21%；在量子自然数据集上，也观察到了显著的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的一种基于灵敏度的主动量子核分配策略，能有效优化高斯过程回归中的采样预算分配，在多种回归任务和数据集上实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 在近期硬件上进行量子核估计受限于采样预算：核Gram矩阵的每个条目都是伯努利期望，必须通过有限次数的电路执行进行采样。近期关于量子核分类的研究表明，根据下游任务灵敏度非均匀分配采样可以减少达到目标精度所需的预算。我们将此思想扩展到高斯过程（GP）回归，这一设置的下游量（全谱后验方差、对数行列式、边际似然）与核误差的耦合比分类任务的符号输出更为紧密。我们推导了三种闭式配对级灵敏度——预测耦合|α_iα_j|、留一法残差和边际似然梯度，并将它们代入Neyman式最小方差分配规则。为了防止当预热灵敏度估计本身有噪声时出现灾难性的过度集中，我们增加了一个基于缺失条目扰动的Frobenius下界的均匀覆盖底线。在四个UCI基准测试和两个合成RBF + 伯努利对照研究中，所得分配器在中等预算范围内比均匀分配实现了10%–21%的测试RMSE改进。这种增益转移到了量子自然数据上的真实ZZ和Pauli-Z量子核（低预算下-13%–15%，p<0.05配对）以及四个下游任务（贝叶斯正交、异方差回归、超参数学习、多输出协同克里金法）。在嵌入ZZ核的UCI特征上，增益消失，这与射击分配无法利用的指数集中状态一致。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对高斯过程回归的主动量子核采样分配方法。通过推导回归任务特有的灵敏度指标并采用最优分配规则，有效减少了量子电路采样预算，显著提升了回归任务的预测精度。
AI.keywords: 量子核估计, 高斯过程回归, 采样预算分配, 灵敏度分析, 量子机器学习
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将统计学中的Neyman最优分配策略引入量子机器学习领域，解决了量子硬件上受限于有限采样次数（shot budget）的问题。通过推导回归任务中特定的灵敏度指标，显著提高了高斯过程回归的精度，具有很高的实用价值。局限性在于当数据处于指数集中状态时，分配策略的增益会消失。

title: Q-DASC: State-of-the-Art Safe Quantum Control for HVAC under Local Model Misspecification
summary: Variational quantum reinforcement learning offers a compact policy class for building-energy control, but it inherits a deployment weakness shared by learned controllers: when the thermal model is locally wrong, a policy that appears safe on the model can violate occupant comfort in the real building. Guarantees that depend on noisy quantum read-out are also insufficient for safety-critical control. We address this gap with Q-DASC, Discrepancy-Attributed Safe Quantum Control. Q-DASC wraps a variational-quantum-circuit (VQC) policy with a certified classical safety layer that discovers misspecified operating regimes with false-discovery-rate control, repairs their local thermal gains with shrinkage, projects the proposed quantum schedule onto the repaired comfort-feasible set, and attributes residual violations to policy error, model error, or physical limits. Because the final certificate is produced by classical projection, comfort feasibility is invariant to finite-shot and depolarizing read-out noise. On real BOPTEST building emulators across three buildings, two localized misspecifications, and three seeds, Q-DASC reduces average comfort violation from 26.0\% for the raw VQC controller and 55.3\% for a model-trusting scheduler to 0.02\%, matching a clairvoyant oracle, and remains at 0.24\% under NISQ read-out noise. A repair-aware VQC variant reaches 0.00\% violation and reduces projection intervention, while the default Q-DASC keeps lower energy and stronger observational-data behavior. The same wrapper transfers to EnergyPlus heating and cooling benchmarks and to real hospital air-handling-unit data. These results establish a safety-efficiency frontier for deploying quantum policies in physics-constrained control.

title: Fisher-Routed Mixture of Experts for Federated Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Federated Learning (FL) emerged as a promising distributed machine learning paradigm. However, extending FL to the class incremental learning scenarios introduces unique challenges: 1) Capacity conflict and catastrophic forgetting from the shared model overloading, 2) Heterogeneity from Non-Independent and Identically Distributed (Non-IID) data, and 3) Synchronized class misalignment. In this paper, we propose \textbf{F}isher-Routed \textbf{M}i\textbf{X}ture of Experts for \textbf{Fed}erated Class-Incremental Learning (\textsc{FedFMX}), a novel framework to address these challenges via adaptive expert specialization across clients. The crucial insight is to route each sample to an expert subset that jointly optimizes knowledge acquisition and retention. Specifically, we introduce a Fisher-Routed Expert Scoring (FRES) module to estimate expert importance via Fisher-based stability cost and gradient-based plasticity gain. Then, we design an Adaptive Expert Selection (AES) module by quantifying marginal contributions for adaptive expert subset determination. Finally, by the routing-aware regularization (RAR), we achieve load balance and efficient FL training. We theoretically prove the $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1})$ convergence rate. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks compared with state-of-the-art methods demonstrate the superiority of \textsc{FedFMX}.

AI.title_translation: 面向联邦类增量学习的费舍尔路由专家混合模型
AI.tldr: FedFMX通过引入费舍尔信息引导的专家路由机制，解决了联邦学习中类增量任务的灾难性遗忘与异构性挑战。
AI.motivation: 解决联邦学习在类增量场景下遇到的共享模型容量冲突、灾难性遗忘、数据非独立同分布（Non-IID）异构性以及类对齐不同步等挑战。
AI.method: 提出FedFMX框架，包含三个核心模块：1. 费舍尔路由专家评分（FRES）模块，用于评估专家重要性；2. 自适应专家选择（AES）模块，通过量化边际贡献确定专家子集；3. 路由感知正则化（RAR），实现负载均衡与高效训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中优于现有的最先进方法，并从理论上证明了其具备O(T^-1)的收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: FedFMX框架通过自适应专家路由有效解决了联邦类增量学习中的关键难题，在理论上保证了收敛性，并在实验中验证了其优越性。
AI.translation: 联邦学习（FL）已成为一种有前途的分布式机器学习范式。然而，将FL扩展到类增量学习场景带来了独特的挑战：1）共享模型过载导致的容量冲突和灾难性遗忘；2）非独立同分布（Non-IID）数据带来的异构性；以及3）同步类对齐偏差。在本文中，我们提出了用于联邦类增量学习的费舍尔路由专家混合模型（FedFMX），这是一个旨在通过跨客户端的自适应专家专门化来解决这些挑战的新框架。其核心洞察是将每个样本路由到联合优化知识获取和保留的专家子集。具体而言，我们引入了费舍尔路由专家评分（FRES）模块，通过基于费舍尔的稳定性成本和基于梯度的可塑性增益来估计专家重要性。然后，我们设计了一个自适应专家选择（AES）模块，通过量化边际贡献来确定自适应专家子集。最后，通过路由感知正则化（RAR），我们实现了负载均衡和高效的FL训练。我们在理论上证明了其O(T^-1)的收敛速率。在多个基准测试上与最先进方法的广泛实验证明了FedFMX的优越性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为FedFMX的联邦类增量学习框架，通过自适应专家路由机制，实现对不同客户端样本的知识获取与保留优化，从而有效缓解了模型过载、遗忘及数据异构带来的问题。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 类增量学习, 专家混合模型, 费舍尔信息, 灾难性遗忘
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入基于费舍尔信息（Fisher Information）的路由机制，巧妙地解决了联邦类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘和模型异构问题。其创新之处在于将专家路由与模型稳定性及可塑性相结合，提供了一种更为精细的参数分配策略，具有很高的学术价值和应用潜力。

title: A Comprehensive Design Framework for Vertical Power Delivery in High-Performance Computing
summary: Power delivery -- including high-to-low voltage conversion, complex power distribution across heterogeneously integrated chiplets, and efficient interconnect allocation -- remains a critical bottleneck in high-performance computing (HPC) systems. Existing vertical power delivery (VPD) solutions are estimated to achieve less than 70\% system-wide end-to-end power delivery efficiency, defined from platform input power to delivered on-chip load power, with substantial energy lost as heat before reaching on-chip point-of-loads (POLs). In the absence of systematic design methodologies, evaluating power quality, exploring architectural alternatives, and optimizing performance rely on computationally prohibitive simulations, resulting in suboptimal designs. This paper introduces an end-to-end scalable power delivery framework for HPC systems, including distributed VPD (DVPD) architecture, DVPD design optimization methodology, and analytical models. The framework leverages substrate-embedded GaN power switches together with arrays of unit inductors and capacitors tailored for HPC applications. Multi-stage power conversion schemes (48V-to-1V, 48V-to-24V-to-1V, and 48V-to-12V-to-1V) are explored, with system-wide voltage drops and power losses evaluated under steady-state conditions. Design specifications for passive and active devices are formulated to meet next-generation efficiency targets. For the 48V-to-1V case, the proposed DVPD approach achieves 84\% system-wide efficiency while occupying 54\% of the area beneath the load system, with efficiency increasing to 87.6\% at 75\% area utilization across a 1--50~kW load range. Furthermore, steady-state voltage drops peak at 2.7\% and transient drops at 9\% (without decoupling capacitors), demonstrating the viability of DVPD for future wafer-scale HPC platforms.

title: The Contagion Tensor: A Framework for Measuring Output-Distribution Coupling in Multi-Agent LLM Systems -- and Auditing the Claims It Enables
summary: We introduce the Contagion Tensor, a measurement framework for quantifying how large language model (LLM) output distributions couple across modalities, agents, and time steps. From the tensor we derive the Coupling Amplification Factor (CAF), a family of ratio-based metrics sharing the form CAF = E[T_condition] / E[T_baseline], providing unitless, baseline-referenced measurement with bootstrap confidence intervals. We instantiate CAF in four variants and evaluate the strongest in a complete 2x2x2 block-orthogonal simulation design with modality-specific ablation. The ablation reveals that an apparent image-condition super-linear effect (CAF = 1.40) collapses to sub-linear (CAF = 0.87) when the image perturbation module is disabled, a shift of -0.53 with zero effect on text conditions. We supplement with real-API experiments across two model families: DeepSeek-Chat (R=30) and GPT-4o-mini (R=15, real vision). Under uniform personas, text-only communication produces CAF approx 1.0 in both models. Diverse personas drive convergence (CAF = 0.88). A within-model comparison on GPT-4o-mini reveals: C3 (text) CAF = 1.02 vs. C5 (real vision, R=30) CAF = 1.72 [1.700, 1.733], delta = +0.70, validating the simulation's super-linear image-condition prediction. Of 11 conditions, 5 have been tested on real APIs and 6 remain unverified. Our contribution is two-layered: (1) a measurement instrument that makes output-distribution coupling quantitatively falsifiable; and (2) a transferable ablation protocol that any modular multi-agent simulator can adopt to distinguish genuine coupling from design artifacts.

title: DLGStream: Dynamic Language-embedded Guassian Splatting for Open-vocabulary Enabled Free-viewpoint Video Streaming
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting~(3DGS) has emerged as a promising paradigm for reconstructing streamable free-viewpoint video~(FVV) from multi-view videos. However, 3DGS-based FVVs typically lack user interaction and editing capabilities, which diminishes the immersive experience. Recent research has integrated language features from CLIP into 3DGS via distillation, enabling open-vocabulary queries and supporting many downstream applications. Nevertheless, the stringent requirements of FVV, low frame size and high FPS, make current language Gaussian representations unsuitable for language-embedded FVV. In this paper, we propose DLGStream, a novel language-embedded FVV representation that streams time-varying language features alongside Gaussian attributes to support 4D environment interaction, scene editing, and spatial intelligence. Specifically, we propose a dual-opacity dynamic language Gaussian representation, which maintains two opacity attributes for color and language features to deal with performance degradation that occurs when colors and features are jointly optimized. Furthermore, we introduce an interpolation-based deformation field to reduce temporal redundancy. This deformation field can also be used for 4D frame interpolation, boosting FVV sequences from low to high FPS. Experimental results demonstrate that DLGStream achieves superior performance in both on open-vocabulary segmentation and reconstruction quality with an average frame size of merely 43 KB. The code is available on \href{https://github.com/kkkzh/DLGStream}{https://github.com/kkkzh/DLGStream}.

title: LAMP: Lean-based Agentic framework with MCP and Proof Repair
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable of mathematical reasoning, but the proofs they generate are often unreliable and hard to verify. Interactive theorem provers such as Lean 4 address this by accepting only kernel-checked proofs; however, their reach is bounded by the formalized knowledge available. While Mathlib, a repository of formalized Lean 4 theorems that covers diverse mathematical areas, certain specialized areas remain underrepresented; notably, the domain of Combinatorics on Words (CoW). CoW studies sequences, exploring their properties such as periodicity, borders, conjugacy, and morphisms. As a result, specialized provers, trained on Mathlib-centered data, lack the lemmas to operate in CoW. We present two contributions. First, we introduce a Lean 4 formalization of CoW containing eight modules and \textbf{93} declarations of core definitions and foundational lemmas. Second, we present LAMP, a multi-agent framework that synthesizes kernel-verified Lean 4 proofs by providing explicit, structured domain knowledge at inference time through an ontology, rather than by fine-tuning a prover. LAMP coordinates a Planner, Builder, and Verifier with Model Context Protocol based access to a domain-specific CoW ontology. In a suite of 90 CoW theorems that span all eight modules and three difficulty levels, LAMP synthesizes verified proofs for 96.7% of theorems, substantially exceeding both an unscaffolded baseline and existing specialized provers. An ablation shows that removing LAMP's tool-grounded architecture or its Planner/Builder separation each cost roughly 12 percentage points, even with the backbone model held fixed.

AI.title_translation: LAMP：基于 Lean 的智能体框架，集成 MCP 与证明修复
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个名为 LAMP 的多智能体框架，通过在推理时动态调用组合数学领域知识，解决了大语言模型在 Lean 4 形式化证明中特定领域知识不足的问题，证明成功率高达 96.7%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学推理方面虽然有所进步，但生成的证明往往不可靠；而现有的 Lean 4 形式化工具在“组合数学”（CoW）等特定领域缺乏足够的引理支持。
AI.method: 提出了 LAMP 多智能体框架，包含规划者（Planner）、构建者（Builder）和验证者（Verifier），利用 MCP 协议在推理时引入特定的 CoW 领域本体知识，而非依赖传统的模型微调。
AI.result: 在包含 90 个 CoW 定理的测试集中，LAMP 成功合成了 96.7% 的已验证证明，显著优于基准模型和其他专业证明器。消融实验证明了工具接地架构和智能体分工对性能提升至关重要。
AI.conclusion: LAMP 框架通过结合领域本体知识和多智能体协同机制，成功解决了特定领域（组合数学）中形式化证明不足的问题，在验证成功率上表现优异。
AI.translation: 大语言模型在数学推理方面的能力日益增强，但其生成的证明往往不可靠且难以验证。Lean 4 等交互式定理证明器通过仅接受内核检查的证明来解决这一问题；然而，其覆盖范围受限于已有的形式化知识。虽然 Mathlib 包含广泛的数学领域知识，但某些专业领域（如组合数学，CoW）的代表性仍然不足。CoW 研究序列及其属性，如周期性、边界、共轭和态射。因此，在 Mathlib 数据上训练的专业证明器缺乏在 CoW 领域操作所需的引理。我们提出了两项贡献：首先，引入了一个包含 8 个模块和 93 个核心定义与基础引理的 Lean 4 CoW 形式化库；其次，提出了 LAMP，一个多智能体框架，通过在推理时利用本体论提供明确的结构化领域知识来合成内核验证的 Lean 4 证明，而非通过微调证明器。LAMP 通过基于模型上下文协议（MCP）访问特定领域的 CoW 本体，协调规划者、构建者和验证者。在一套跨越 8 个模块和 3 个难度级别的 90 个 CoW 定理测试中，LAMP 成功合成了 96.7% 的已验证证明，大大超过了无辅助基线和现有的专业证明器。消融实验表明，在保持骨干模型不变的情况下，移除 LAMP 的工具接地架构或其规划者/构建者分离机制，每项都会导致约 12 个百分点的性能下降。
AI.summary: 本文针对组合数学（CoW）领域缺乏 Lean 4 形式化支持的问题，构建了一个包含 93 项定义的 CoW 模块库，并提出了 LAMP 多智能体框架。该框架通过 MCP 协议在推理阶段动态注入领域本体知识，实现了高效且可验证的证明合成。
AI.keywords: Lean 4, 形式化证明, 多智能体框架, 组合数学, 模型上下文协议 (MCP)
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多智能体框架与领域本体（Ontology）相结合，通过MCP协议在推理时注入结构化知识，解决了大模型在特定领域（如组合数学）缺乏形式化证明能力的问题，证明了无需微调即可显著提升证明成功率的有效性。

title: Channel Capacity under the Subtractive Dithered Quantization Model
summary: We study the capacity of an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel followed by a subtractive dithered uniform quantizer. Under the Schuchman conditions and with negligible overload probability, the system admits an additive-noise representation in which the effective noise is the sum of Gaussian and uniform components. Capacity bounds are derived for this model when inputs are subject to an average-power constraint as well as a peak-amplitude constraint, where the latter accounts for the limited quantizer dynamic range. Specifically, a computable lower bound is obtained based on the entropy power inequality (EPI), using the maximum-entropy input under the above constraints. Tighter numerical lower bounds are derived using discrete input constellations with finite mass points. Finally, an upper bound is obtained by exploiting the fact that Gaussian distributions maximize entropy under a variance constraint. Numerical results show that, for a K-level quantizer, discrete constellations with K mass points already achieve near-optimal rates among the tested families. Moreover, our upper bound is close to the lower bounds in the moderate-SNR regime; it thus represents a good and simple capacity approximation in this regime.

title: The Heterogeneous Safety Impacts of Benign Multilingual Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning a large language model is a ubiquitous method for enhancing its capability on a specific downstream task. However, prior work has shown that this increase in capability comes with a cost: it can increase a model's tendency to respond to unsafe adversarial prompts, even when fine-tuning with non-adversarial data. We present the first comprehensive empirical study of this phenomenon in multilingual settings by fine-tuning Llama-3.2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 models using benign data translated across nine languages. We find that safety outcomes are highly sensitive to both the choice of fine-tuning language and the evaluation language, with adversarial compliance rates increasing four-fold in some settings. Multilingual safety drift is decoupled from general capability metrics, and occurs heterogeneously across languages and models. Fine-tuning in non-English languages often induces smaller internal representational drifts than English, but these shifts lead models to default to either exaggerated compliance or refusal. As such, assessing fine-tuning impacts solely in English provides inadequate assurance for deployment. To facilitate further research into these cross-lingual safety blind spots, we release the Multilingual-Benign-Tune dataset and the SORRY-Bench-Multilingual evaluation suite.

title: Personalizing MLLMs via Reinforced Multimodal Reference Game
summary: Personalizing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) aims to recognize users' unique concepts from visual data and provide personalized responses. Although prior work has shown the benefit of concept descriptions and reasoning for this task, MLLM descriptions often include information, such as state and context, that does not help and may in fact hinder the unique identification of the target concept among other visually similar items. Effective descriptions of personal concepts should instead be accurate, discriminative, and free of distracting details. To achieve such descriptions, we introduce Reinforced Reference Game (RRG), a learning framework that promotes discriminative descriptions through a novel reinforced multimodal reference game. The MLLM plays both the roles of speaker and listener in a contrastive game setting, whose goal is to effectively communicate discriminative information about a target concept. Our approach formulates a verifiable contrastive reward over hard positives (dissimilar views of the same concept) and hard negatives (visually similar but different concepts). Empirically, RRG achieves state-of-the-art across multiple tasks on three personalization benchmarks. RRG generalizes to unseen domains and outperforms existing methods based on concept descriptions and personalization-specific RL frameworks. We will release code and models in the project page.

AI.title_translation: 通过强化多模态参考游戏实现MLLM的个性化
AI.tldr: 通过引入强化学习驱动的参考游戏，训练MLLM生成更具区分度的个性化概念描述，有效提升了模型在识别用户独特视觉概念时的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLLM个性化方法生成的概念描述中常包含无关的上下文或状态信息，干扰了对目标概念的唯一性识别，因此需要一种能生成更准确、更具区分度且无干扰描述的方法。
AI.method: 提出了强化参考游戏（Reinforced Reference Game, RRG）框架，让MLLM在对比游戏中同时扮演“说话者”和“听众”，并通过针对硬正样本和硬负样本的对比奖励机制，训练模型生成更具区分度的概念描述。
AI.result: RRG在三个个性化基准测试中均达到了最先进的性能，且在未见过的领域表现出良好的泛化能力，优于现有的基于描述和强化学习的个性化方法。
AI.conclusion: RRG通过强化学习框架有效提升了MLLM对用户个性化概念的识别与描述能力，在多个基准测试中达到了SOTA水平，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）的个性化旨在从视觉数据中识别用户的独特概念并提供个性化响应。尽管以往的研究展示了概念描述和推理在此任务中的益处，但MLLM生成的描述往往包含状态和上下文等无关信息，这些信息不仅无助于，甚至可能阻碍在视觉相似项中唯一识别目标概念。因此，个性化概念的有效描述应准确、具有区分度且不含干扰细节。为了实现这一目标，我们引入了强化参考游戏（RRG），这是一种通过新型强化多模态参考游戏促进区分性描述的学习框架。MLLM在对比游戏设置中同时扮演说话者和听众的角色，其目标是有效传达关于目标概念的区分性信息。我们的方法在硬正样本（同一概念的不同视图）和硬负样本（视觉相似但不同的概念）上制定了可验证的对比奖励。实证结果表明，RRG在三个个性化基准测试的多个任务上达到了最先进水平。RRG能够泛化到未见过的领域，并优于现有的基于概念描述和个性化强化学习框架的方法。我们将在项目主页发布代码和模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Reinforced Reference Game (RRG) 的学习框架，用于提升多模态大模型（MLLM）对个性化概念的识别能力。该方法通过让模型在对比游戏中扮演说话者和听众，并利用硬正负样本的对比奖励机制，训练模型生成更具区分度、去噪后的概念描述，从而在多个基准测试中实现了性能提升。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 个性化, 强化学习, 参考游戏, 概念描述
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地引入了“参考游戏”（Reference Game）范式来优化多模态大模型的个性化能力，通过强化学习机制强制模型学习区分度高、去噪后的概念描述，解决了传统描述方法中包含过多干扰信息的问题。其对“硬正样本”和“硬负样本”的对比奖励机制设计非常巧妙。

title: wav2VOT: Automatic estimation of voice onset time, closure duration, and burst realisation with wav2vec2
summary: While automatic tools for speech annotation are now commonplace within phonetic research pipelines, many tasks require substantial manual correction or training sets to perform accurately. Simultaneously, large speech models such as wav2vec2 have been shown to perform well at speech classification tasks, raising the question of how these models may be applied to phonetic annotation tasks. We introduce wav2VOT: a tool for the automatic estimation of voice onset time, closure duration, and burst realisation using wav2vec2. We demonstrate that wav2VOT performs comparably with current approaches on unseen datasets, and can estimate with high accuracy with fine-tuning. Analysis of wav2VOT predictions demonstrate high fidelity across stop voicing and place of articulation. These results demonstrate that large speech models are capable of producing accurate annotations, and further motivate exploration of large speech models as tools in phonetic research pipelines.

title: EpiSAM: Character Segmentation in Challenging Stone Inscriptions
summary: Stone inscriptions are invaluable sources of historical and linguistic knowledge, yet their automated analysis remains a major challenge due to surface irregularities, erosion, and low visual contrast. Conventional document and handwriting analysis techniques fail to perform well in these scenarios. In this work, we propose character detection as a core strategy for robust inscription analysis. We introduce EpiSAM, a prompt-guided transformer framework for character segmentation in stone inscriptions. Rather than treating characters in isolation, EpiSAM employs a novel neighbor-aware strategy, explicitly predicting adjacent characters alongside the target. These contextual cues resolve boundary ambiguities, improving mask generation and enabling more accurate character segmentation. Furthermore, we expand an existing stone inscription dataset by adding dense polygonal annotations for characters, thereby enabling comprehensive research on Southeast Asian epigraphy. Experimental results show that EpiSAM achieves consistent improvements over existing baselines, while also exhibiting strong zero-shot generalization in challenging epigraphic scenarios.

AI.title_translation: EpiSAM：挑战性石刻铭文中的字符分割
AI.tldr: EpiSAM通过邻域感知Transformer框架，有效解决了石刻铭文中因环境复杂导致的字符分割难题，并提供了新的标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统文档分析技术在处理石刻铭文时，受限于表面不规则、侵蚀和低对比度，导致分割效果不佳，亟需一种稳健的字符检测与分割方案。
AI.method: 提出EpiSAM框架，采用提示引导的Transformer架构，并引入了一种邻域感知策略，通过同时预测目标字符及其相邻字符来解决边界模糊问题。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EpiSAM在石刻字符分割任务中超越了现有基线模型，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。此外，研究还扩展了包含密集多边形标注的石刻数据集。
AI.conclusion: EpiSAM通过邻域感知策略和提示引导的Transformer框架，有效提升了石刻铭文中字符分割的准确性和鲁棒性，为复杂环境下的铭文分析提供了高效解决方案。
AI.translation: 石刻铭文是历史和语言知识的宝贵来源，但由于表面不规则、侵蚀和低视觉对比度，其自动化分析仍然是一项重大挑战。传统的文档和手写分析技术在这些场景中表现不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出将字符检测作为稳健铭文分析的核心策略。我们引入了EpiSAM，这是一个用于石刻铭文字符分割的提示引导Transformer框架。EpiSAM没有孤立地处理字符，而是采用了一种新颖的邻域感知策略，明确预测目标字符旁边的相邻字符。这些上下文线索解决了边界模糊问题，改善了掩码生成，并实现了更准确的字符分割。此外，我们通过增加字符的密集多边形标注扩展了一个现有的石刻铭文数据集，从而为东南亚铭文的全面研究提供了支持。实验结果表明，EpiSAM在现有基线上取得了持续的改进，同时在具有挑战性的铭文场景中表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.summary: EpiSAM是一种专为石刻铭文设计的字符分割框架，通过引入邻域感知策略和提示引导的Transformer模型，利用上下文信息解决了复杂背景下的边界模糊问题，并显著提升了分割性能。
AI.keywords: 石刻铭文, 字符分割, EpiSAM, Transformer, 邻域感知策略
