AI.title_translation: Miti360：一个用于改进再造林监测的综合数据集
AI.tldr: Miti360是一个针对非洲再造林监测的综合数据集，包含高分辨率图像、地面真值和气象数据，旨在弥补非洲林业数据的空白，并已成功用于改进树冠追踪和机器学习模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习森林监测训练数据集主要来自北美、欧洲、亚洲和澳大利亚，导致非洲林业数据存在严重空白。本研究旨在通过提供Miti360数据集来解决这种有限的地理多样性问题，从而支持非洲再造林监测。
AI.method: Miti360数据集在肯尼亚Kieni森林770公顷的再造林区域收集，时间为2023年3月至2025年2月。数据集包括带有树木边界框注释的航空照片（正射影像和瓦片）、地面图像（单张和立体）以及详细数据记录，如树木生物物理参数、物种、GPS坐标和历史天气数据。航空测量使用DJI Mavic 2 Pro，图像通过Agisoft Metashape拼接，并使用ArcGIS Pro进行瓦片处理；地面采集则使用智能手机和定制立体相机。
AI.result: Miti360数据集成功地用于追踪三年间的树冠，并通过对其进行微调，将DeepForest模型的边界框精度提高了12%，边界框召回率提高了69%。
AI.conclusion: Miti360数据集能够训练机器学习系统，以应对撒哈拉以南非洲特有的挑战，最终推动这些代表性不足地区的再造林监测并促进可持续林业实践。
AI.translation: 在过去十年中，将机器学习（ML）应用于自动化森林监测的兴趣显著增长。然而，现有的训练数据集主要来自北美、欧洲、亚洲和澳大利亚，在非洲林业数据方面留下了关键空白。为了解决这种有限的地理多样性问题，我们推出了Miti360，一个用于再造林监测的综合数据集，它包含高分辨率图像、地面真值数据和长期天气数据。数据收集于2023年3月至2025年2月期间在肯尼亚Kieni森林一个770公顷的再造林区域进行。Miti360包括带有树木边界框注释的航空照片（正射影像和瓦片）、地面图像（单张和立体），以及详细的数据记录，包括树木生物物理参数、物种和GPS坐标，以及历史天气数据。航空测量使用了大疆御2专业版（DJI Mavic 2 Pro），图像通过Agisoft Metashape拼接，并使用ArcGIS Pro进行瓦片处理，而地面采集则使用了智能手机和定制的立体相机。Miti360使得机器学习系统能够进行训练，以完成诸如加速树木普查、将物种与地理区域匹配、根据天气条件建模生长以及开发数字孪生框架等任务。可以在Miti360上训练模型，以解决撒哈拉以南非洲特有的挑战，最终推进代表性不足地区的再造林监测并促进可持续林业实践。我们通过成功追踪三年间的树冠，并通过在Miti360上进行微调，将DeepForest模型的边界框精度和边界框召回率分别提高了12%和69%，从而证明了该数据集的实用性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Miti360，一个专门为弥补非洲林业数据空白而创建的综合数据集，旨在改进再造林监测。该数据集在肯尼亚Kieni森林收集，包含高分辨率航空和地面图像、树木生物物理参数、物种、GPS坐标及历史天气数据。Miti360支持训练机器学习系统，以实现树木普查、物种匹配、生长建模和数字孪生等任务，特别针对撒哈拉以南非洲地区的挑战。研究通过成功追踪树冠并显著提升DeepForest模型的性能，验证了该数据集的有效性。
AI.keywords: 再造林监测, 机器学习, 数据集, 非洲林业, Miti360
AI.comments: Miti360数据集的创新之处在于其专门针对非洲地区，填补了现有机器学习森林监测数据地理多样性不足的关键空白。其重要性体现在为撒哈拉以南非洲等代表性不足地区的再造林监测和可持续林业实践提供了急需的训练数据和工具。数据集的全面性，结合了高分辨率图像、地面真值和气象数据，使其在支持多种ML任务方面具有巨大潜力。通过实际案例证明其能有效改进现有模型性能，进一步凸显了其价值。

title: The Platonic Defense: Backdoor Defense for Self-Supervised Encoders in the Era of Large Scale Pre-training
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) pretrained models have become a dominant paradigm for visual representation learning, but they are vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses struggle to defend against such attacks in a fully black-box setting because they often require access to labels, attack patterns, or training data. To tackle this issue, we propose a new attack-agnostic, model-agnostic, and modality-agnostic black-box test-time defense paradigm, called \emph{Platonic Representation Defense}. It is inspired by the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, which suggests that large-scale independently trained encoders converge toward compatible projections of the same underlying reality. We formalize this idea as a conditional energy function defined over source representations and a set of reference representations. The energy function is trained for detection through noise-contrastive estimation and for representation purification through denoising score matching. Theoretically, the energy gap between matched and mismatched samples is lower bounded by the mutual information between source and reference representations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on multiple self-supervised encoders and more than 10 attacks. The method can perform both representation detection and purification, and achieves substantial performance gains across multiple attacks. Code is available \href{https://github.com/jsrdcht/Platonic-Representation-Defense}{here}.

AI.title_translation: 柏拉图式防御：大规模预训练时代自监督编码器的后门防御
AI.tldr: 利用不同预训练模型趋向于一致表征的特性，提出了一种无需攻击先验的黑盒后门防御方法，可有效检测并净化自监督学习模型中的后门。
AI.motivation: 现有的自监督学习（SSL）模型防御方法通常依赖于标签、攻击模式或原始训练数据，难以在完全黑盒的环境下有效抵御后门攻击。
AI.method: 提出一种名为“Platonic Representation Defense”的防御范式。它基于柏拉图表征假说，构建了一个定义在源表征和参考表征上的条件能量函数，利用噪声对比估计进行检测，利用去噪分数匹配进行表征净化。
AI.result: 该方法在多种自监督编码器和超过10种后门攻击下进行了验证，能够有效进行表征检测与净化，并在不同攻击场景下均取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用不同预训练模型之间的表征一致性，Platonic Defense提供了一种通用的、无需攻击先验的黑盒防御手段，有效提升了SSL模型在面对后门攻击时的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 自监督学习（SSL）预训练模型已成为视觉表征学习的主流范式，但它们极易受到后门攻击。现有的防御方法在完全黑盒设置下难以抵御此类攻击，因为它们通常需要访问标签、攻击模式或训练数据。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的与攻击无关、与模型无关且与模态无关的黑盒测试时防御范式，称为“柏拉图表征防御”（Platonic Representation Defense）。其灵感来源于“柏拉图表征假说”，该假说认为大规模独立训练的编码器会趋向于对同一潜在现实的兼容投影。我们将这一思想形式化为定义在源表征和一组参考表征上的条件能量函数。该能量函数通过噪声对比估计进行检测训练，通过去噪分数匹配进行表征净化。理论上，匹配样本与不匹配样本之间的能量差距下界为源表征与参考表征之间的互信息。我们在多个自监督编码器和超过10种攻击上证明了我们方法的有效性。该方法可以同时执行表征检测和净化，并在多种攻击中实现了显著的性能提升。代码已开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于柏拉图表征假说的黑盒后门防御方法。该方法无需任何关于攻击或训练数据的先验知识，通过构建条件能量函数来比较源表征与参考表征，从而实现对后门样本的检测与净化。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 后门防御, 柏拉图表征假说, 黑盒防御, 表征净化
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地利用了“柏拉图表征假说”，即不同模型在学习同一现实时会趋向于一致，从而在无需攻击先验知识的情况下实现防御。这种方法论上的创新使其在黑盒场景下具有很强的通用性，是解决SSL模型后门防御的重要一步。

title: Resonant Brane Splatting for Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution
summary: Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution (ASR) reconstructs images at continuous magnification factors. Recent methods accelerate inference by replacing computationally heavy implicit neural decoders with explicit 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS). However, since standard Gaussians are smooth low-pass primitives, modeling edges and fine textures requires multiple overlapping, well-aligned splats, which creates severe bottlenecks during rasterization. To address this, we introduce Resonant Brane Splatting (RBS), a feed-forward ASR framework. RBS replaces flat Gaussians with Branes: expressive primitives that emit spatially varying colors to natively model local contrast and complex textures within a single footprint. We achieve this by augmenting the standard Gaussian envelope with internal Gaussian-Hermite modes, assigning a distinct color coefficient to each. The zero-order mode recovers standard GS, while higher-order modes capture high frequencies. We predict Brane parameters directly from low-resolution features. Because Branes provide a mathematically richer formulation than simple Gaussians, far fewer primitives need to overlap to reconstruct a given target pixel. To exploit this, we introduce an efficient fully differentiable rasterizer with a precise culling strategy based on the classical quantum turning point. This allows us to safely skip negligible regions, drastically reducing the rendering overhead. Experiments on standard ASR benchmarks show that RBS improves reconstruction quality over implicit and GS baselines, while achieving superior speed-quality trade-off than prior GS methods.

AI.title_translation: 任意尺度超分辨率的共振膜片渲染
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为共振膜片渲染（RBS）的新型任意尺度超分辨率（ASR）方法，它使用更具表现力的“膜片”作为基本图元来替代传统的二维高斯泼溅，从而更有效地建模图像细节和纹理，并结合高效的光栅化技术，在提高图像重建质量的同时，实现了比现有方法更优越的速度-质量折衷。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于二维高斯泼溅（GS）的任意尺度超分辨率（ASR）方法在处理边缘和精细纹理时存在渲染瓶颈，因为标准的平滑高斯函数需要大量重叠的图元才能有效建模。
AI.method: 提出共振膜片渲染（RBS），一种前馈ASR框架。RBS使用“膜片”作为基本图元，通过在标准高斯包络中加入高斯-厄米模式来增强其表现力，使其能够在一个足迹内原生建模局部对比度和复杂纹理。此外，还引入了一种高效的可微分光栅化器，并结合基于量子转折点的精确剔除策略来减少渲染开销。
AI.result: 在标准的ASR基准测试中，RBS相比于隐式和GS基线方法提高了重建质量，并且在速度-质量折衷方面优于先前的GS方法。
AI.conclusion: 共振膜片渲染（RBS）通过使用更丰富的膜片图元和高效的光栅化技术，成功解决了现有ASR方法在细节建模和渲染效率上的瓶颈，并在重建质量和速度方面取得了显著的改进。
AI.translation: 任意尺度超分辨率（ASR）以连续的放大因子重建图像。最近的方法通过用显式的二维高斯泼溅（GS）替换计算量大的隐式神经解码器来加速推理。然而，由于标准高斯是平滑的低通图元，建模边缘和精细纹理需要多个重叠、对齐良好的泼溅，这在光栅化过程中会产生严重的瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了共振膜片渲染（RBS），一种前馈ASR框架。RBS用膜片替换了平坦的高斯函数：膜片是富有表现力的图元，可以发射空间变化的颜色，从而在一个足迹内原生建模局部对比度和复杂纹理。我们通过在标准高斯包络中加入内部高斯-厄米模式来实现这一点，为每个模式分配一个不同的颜色系数。零阶模式恢复了标准的GS，而更高阶的模式则捕捉高频信息。我们直接从低分辨率特征中预测膜片参数。由于膜片比简单的Gausssian提供了更丰富的数学公式，因此需要重叠的图元数量大大减少，就可以重建给定的目标像素。为了利用这一点，我们引入了一种高效的全微分光栅化器，并结合基于经典量子转折点的精确剔除策略。这使我们能够安全地跳过可忽略的区域，从而大大降低了渲染开销。在标准的ASR基准测试上的实验表明，RBS在重建质量上优于隐式和GS基线，同时在速度-质量折衷方面优于先前的GS方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为共振膜片渲染（RBS）的新型任意尺度超分辨率（ASR）框架。与依赖平滑高斯函数的传统方法不同，RBS引入了“膜片”作为基本图元，该图元通过内部高斯-厄米模式增强，能够在一个独立单元内捕捉局部对比度和复杂纹理。这种方法显著减少了对重叠图元的需求。此外，RBS还采用了一种高效的、基于量子转折点的可微分光栅化器，以优化渲染过程。实验结果表明，RBS在提高图像重建质量的同时，实现了优于现有方法的效率。
AI.keywords: 任意尺度超分辨率, 高斯泼溅, 共振膜片渲染, 图像重建, 渲染效率
AI.comments: 该研究在ASR领域取得了重要进展，通过引入“膜片”这一新颖的图元，有效解决了传统GS方法在细节建模上的效率问题。高效光栅化器的设计也进一步提升了方法的实用性。然而，对于高阶模式在不同尺度和纹理类型下的泛化能力，以及计算复杂度的具体分析，仍有待进一步研究。

title: How Much Due Diligence Before You Bid? Learning in Intractable Takeover Auctions
comments: 21 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/imperfect-information-deal-games
summary: When two companies bid to buy the same target, no one knows exactly what the target is worth. Each bidder pays for due diligence: costly, imperfect homework that sharpens its own private estimate before it bids. How much of that homework is worth buying? We build a simple computer model of the bidding contest and let it teach itself to bid well by playing against itself, the way a game engine learns chess. The economic question, how much diligence pays for itself, and the computational question, when the contest becomes too complex to solve exactly, are both controlled by a single thing: how many pieces of private information a bidder carries. Our main finding is that the right amount of diligence is modest and finite. It falls as diligence gets more expensive, and it falls further when both sides are doing their homework, because competition erodes the value of knowing more. We also test a recent claim from AI research: that simple, general self-play methods can rival the specialized, expensive algorithms usually built for games like these. Running on an ordinary laptop with no costly frontier AI, we find the simple methods are the best of the self-learning approaches, though purpose-built exact methods still win whenever the game is small enough to solve outright. The simple methods earn their keep only once the game grows too large to solve exactly, which is the regime real deals live in, and there we show they still find strong bidding strategies. The contribution is threefold: a cheap, reproducible way to study deal-making under uncertainty; a concrete, model-based answer to how much due diligence is worth buying; and evidence about when lightweight, general-purpose AI is good enough to replace specialized methods. We release all the games, code, and experiments.
comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/imperfect-information-deal-games

AI.title_translation: 在出价之前需要做多少尽职调查？学习棘手的收购拍卖
AI.tldr: 在收购拍卖中，尽职调查的成本与收益需要仔细权衡。通过模拟竞价过程，研究发现适度的尽职调查是最佳选择，并且当尽职调查成本增加或双方都进行尽职调查时，其价值会降低。此外，研究还表明，简单的通用人工智能（AI）方法在处理复杂竞价环境时，能够提供有效的竞价策略，甚至优于专门设计的算法。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决在收购拍卖中，竞标者在进行尽职调查（获取更多信息）和最终出价之间的权衡问题，以及在信息不对称和信息不完全的情况下，如何确定最优的尽职调查投入。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个简单的计算机模型来模拟竞价过程，并利用类似棋类游戏引擎的自学习方法进行训练。通过让模型与自身进行大量的模拟对弈，来学习最优的出价策略。研究还对比了这种自学习方法与专门设计的精确求解算法在不同复杂度下的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现，适度的、有限的尽职调查是最佳策略。尽职调查的投入量会随着其成本的增加而减少，当双方都进行尽职调查时，由于竞争加剧，信息优势的价值会降低，因此尽职调查的投入量也会进一步减少。在计算方面，当博弈变得过于复杂而无法精确求解时，简单的通用自学习AI方法能够找到有效的竞价策略，并且在这种情况下，其表现优于专门设计的算法。
AI.conclusion: 研究的主要贡献包括：提供了一种廉价、可复现的方法来研究不确定性下的交易过程；为“应投入多少尽职调查”这一经济问题提供了具体的、基于模型的答案；并证明了在复杂博弈环境下，轻量级的通用AI足以取代专门设计的算法。研究还强调了在信息不完全和不确定的拍卖环境中，适度尽职调查的重要性以及AI在其中扮演的关键角色。
AI.translation: 当两家公司竞购同一目标时，没有人确切知道目标的价值。每个竞标者都要为尽职调查付费：这是一项成本高昂、但不完美的尽职调查，可以在竞标前提高其自身的私人估计。多少尽职调查是值得购买的？我们构建了一个简单的计算机模型来模拟竞价过程，并让它通过与自身对弈来学习如何进行有效的竞价，就像游戏引擎学习下棋一样。经济学问题，即多少尽职调查能够收回成本，以及计算学问题，即何时竞价过程变得过于复杂而无法精确求解，都由一个因素控制：竞标者拥有多少私人信息。我们的主要发现是，适度的尽职调查是最佳选择。它随着尽职调查成本的增加而下降，并且当双方都在进行尽职调查时，其价值会进一步下降，因为竞争会侵蚀信息带来的价值。我们还测试了近期来自人工智能研究的一个说法：简单的、通用的自玩方法可以媲美通常为这类游戏构建的专门的、昂贵的算法。在普通笔记本电脑上运行，无需昂贵的前沿人工智能，我们发现简单的自学习方法是最好的，尽管专门设计的精确方法在游戏足够小时仍然获胜。只有当游戏变得过于复杂而无法精确求解时，简单的自学习方法才能发挥作用，而这正是真实交易发生的领域，并且在那里我们证明它们仍然能找到强有力的竞价策略。其贡献是三方面的：一种廉价、可复现的研究不确定性下交易过程的方法；为“应投入多少尽职调查”提供一个具体的、基于模型的答案；以及关于何时轻量级、通用人工智能足以取代专门方法。我们发布所有的游戏、代码和实验。
AI.summary: 本研究通过计算机模型和自学习方法，探讨了在收购拍卖中尽职调查的投入问题。研究发现，适度的尽职调查是最佳策略，其投入量受尽职调查成本和竞争激烈程度的影响。此外，研究还表明，在复杂的拍卖环境中，简单的通用人工智能方法能够有效地替代专门设计的算法，找到有效的竞价策略。研究为不确定性下的交易决策提供了新的见解和计算工具。
AI.keywords: 尽职调查, 收购拍卖, 自学习AI, 博弈论, 信息不对称
AI.comments: 这项研究巧妙地将经济学中的尽职调查决策与计算机科学中的博弈论和人工智能学习相结合。通过自学习模拟，研究不仅为“多少尽职调查才算够”这一经典的经济学问题提供了量化的答案，而且在计算方法上，也为处理复杂博弈问题提供了新的思路。其研究成果具有理论和实践双重意义，特别是对于理解和优化现实世界中的并购交易具有重要的参考价值。然而，模型的简化程度和现实世界复杂性的差异，可能仍是未来研究需要关注的方面。

title: Fundamental weak convergence theorem for stochastic Volterra integral equations and its applications
summary: We study weak convergence rates of numerical approximations for stochastic Volterra integral equations (SVIEs), a class of non-Markovian models that arises naturally in stochastic volatility modeling and other fields. The intrinsic non-Markovian nature prevents the direct application of classical weak error techniques developed for finite-dimensional Markov processes. To overcome this difficulty, we combine a Markovian lifting technique with a domino argument, Taylor expansions, and Fréchet differential calculus for path-dependent functionals, and establish a fundamental weak convergence theorem for nonsingular SVIEs, providing a unified approach to the weak error analysis for a broad class of numerical approximations. As applications, we derive the first-order weak convergence rate for the stochastic theta method and the Wong--Zakai approximation. Our results relax existing assumptions for Euler-type schemes by removing the boundedness requirement on the diffusion coefficient. Furthermore, to the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first weak convergence result for Wong--Zakai approximations of SVIEs. Numerical experiments for a stochastic volatility model corroborate the theoretical convergence rate.

AI.title_translation: 随机Volterra积分方程的基本弱收敛定理及其应用
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了用于随机Volterra积分方程（SVIEs）的数值逼近的弱收敛定理，结合了Markovian提升技术和多米诺骨牌论证，并推导了随机theta方法和Wong-Zakai逼近的一阶弱收敛率，放宽了对扩散系数有界性的要求，并首次为SVIEs的Wong-Zakai逼近提供了弱收敛结果。
AI.motivation: 随机Volterra积分方程（SVIEs）在随机波动率建模等领域有应用，但其非Markovian性质阻碍了经典弱误差技术的直接应用。
AI.method: 结合Markovian提升技术、多米诺骨牌论证、泰勒展开和路径依赖泛函的Fréchet微分演算，建立了非奇异SVIEs的基本弱收敛定理。
AI.result: 推导了随机theta方法和Wong-Zakai逼近的一阶弱收敛率，放宽了对扩散系数有界性的要求，并首次为SVIEs的Wong-Zakai逼近提供了弱收敛结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为SVIEs的数值逼近提供了一个统一的弱误差分析方法，并放宽了现有方法的假设，为随机微分方程的数值分析提供了新的见解。
AI.translation: 我们研究了随机Volterra积分方程（SVIEs）的数值逼近的弱收敛率，这是一类在随机波动率建模和其他领域中自然出现的非马尔可夫模型。固有的非马尔可夫性质阻止了为有限维马尔可夫过程开发的经典弱误差技术的直接应用。为了克服这个困难，我们将马尔可夫提升技术与多米诺骨牌论证、泰勒展开和路径依赖泛函的Fréchet微分演算相结合，为非奇异SVIEs建立了一个基本弱收敛定理，为一大类数值逼近提供了统一的弱误差分析方法。作为应用，我们推导了随机theta方法和Wong--Zakai逼近的一阶弱收敛率。我们的结果通过消除了对扩散系数有界性的要求，放宽了对欧拉型格式的现有假设。此外，据我们所知，这项工作首次为SVIEs的Wong--Zakai逼近提供了弱收敛结果。随机波动率模型的数值实验证实了理论收敛率。
AI.summary: 本研究针对随机Volterra积分方程（SVIEs）的数值逼近，提出了一种新的弱收敛定理。通过结合Markovian提升技术、多米诺骨牌论证、泰勒展开和Fréchet微分演算，研究人员克服了SVIEs非Markovian的挑战，并为数值逼近提供了统一的弱误差分析框架。该方法成功应用于随机theta方法和Wong--Zakai逼近，推导了一阶弱收敛率，并放宽了对扩散系数有界性的要求。此外，该研究首次为SVIEs的Wong--Zakai逼近提供了弱收敛结果，并通过数值实验验证了理论结果的有效性。
AI.keywords: 随机Volterra积分方程, 弱收敛, 数值逼近, Markovian提升, Wong-Zakai逼近
AI.comments: 这项工作在随机Volterra积分方程的弱收敛分析方面取得了重要进展，通过创新的方法解决了非Markovian性质带来的挑战。它不仅统一了对多种数值方法的分析，还放宽了现有理论的假设，并首次为Wong--Zakai逼近提供了理论保证，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Interpretable Inverse Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks with Large Language Model Agents
summary: Inverse design of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) requires searching a combinatorially vast space where property labels are expensive and most machine-learning models reveal little about why a structure succeeds. We introduce LLM4MOF, a closed-loop framework in which language-model agents reason about chemistry, build candidate MOFs, and test them in simulation, refining hypotheses over ten autonomous iterations. One agent proposes interpretable design hypotheses over metal nodes, linkers, pore geometry, and functional chemistry, and a second translates them into constraints that select candidate MOFs, each made of a metal node, organic linker, and matching topology. Each hypothesis is tested through four diagnostic beams that apply different subsets of its constraints, so comparing them shows whether geometry, chemistry, or metal choice drives performance. Even when blind to the global property landscape of databases, LLM4MOF concentrates its search on top-performing structures across six adsorption, separation, and electronic-structure tasks within 400 property evaluations. The same loop also generates new MOFs de novo and validates them in live simulation, where it adapts the geometry to each requested condition, outperforming random search and a genetic algorithm at roughly $1 per campaign. LLM4MOF shows that language-model agents can run interpretable, simulation-grounded inverse design without training a model per objective.

title: Understanding LLM Intervention Explanations in Multi-Party Human-Robot Interaction
comments: Accepted for 2026 36th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in social robots to support natural group interactions, yet their role in complex multi-party settings remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear how LLM-driven robots decide when and why to intervene in group conversations. This paper investigates the intervention explanations generated by an LLM-based orchestrator in a multi-party interaction involving three human participants and two robots. We conducted a between-subjects study with 24 groups (66 university students), comparing a homogeneous condition (two robots with the same role, i.e., a mover) and a heterogeneous condition (two robots with different roles, i.e., a mover and an opposer). At each conversational turn, the LLM orchestrator decided whether to intervene and generated a textual explanation of its decision. We performed a thematic analysis of 610 intervention explanations, identifying five recurring themes. Results show that explanations are facilitation-oriented, emphasizing agreement, participation, and interaction flow. While patterns remain stable across conditions, role differentiation emerges: the mover supports coordination, whereas the opposer drives goal-oriented interventions. These findings contribute to explainable AI by characterizing how LLM-driven systems justify intervention decisions in real-time, multi-party human-robot interaction.
comment: Accepted for 2026 36th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication

AI.title_translation: 理解多方人机交互中大语言模型的干预解释
AI.tldr: 研究分析了LLM驱动的机器人在多方交互中如何解释其干预决策，发现其解释逻辑受机器人角色（如协调者或反对者）的影响，且主要致力于促进群体互动。
AI.motivation: 目前LLM驱动的社交机器人如何在复杂的多方交互中决定何时以及为何进行干预尚不明确，缺乏对机器人干预行为背后可解释性的深入研究。
AI.method: 采用受试者间实验设计，包含24组共66名参与者，对比了同质化（两个移动者）和异质化（移动者与反对者）机器人角色设置。通过对610条LLM生成的干预解释进行专题分析，识别其决策逻辑和模式。
AI.result: 分析发现LLM生成的解释主要聚焦于促进互动、强调共识及参与度。研究证实了角色差异化对干预策略的影响：移动者侧重于协调，而反对者侧重于目标导向的干预，且这些模式在不同条件下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，LLM驱动的机器人能够通过特定角色的功能定位，生成具有协调性、参与导向的交互解释，有效支持多方人机交互的顺畅进行。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被嵌入到社交机器人中以支持自然的群体互动，但它们在复杂的多方环境中的作用仍未得到充分探索。特别是，LLM驱动的机器人如何决定何时以及为何干预群体对话尚不清楚。本文研究了多方交互中（涉及三名人类参与者和两名机器人）由基于LLM的协调器生成的干预解释。我们对24组（66名大学生）进行了受试者间研究，比较了同质条件（两个机器人角色相同，即移动者）和异质条件（两个机器人角色不同，即移动者和反对者）。在每次对话轮次中，LLM协调器决定是否干预并生成其决策的文本解释。我们对610条干预解释进行了专题分析，确定了五个重复出现的主题。结果表明，这些解释以促进互动为导向，强调共识、参与和互动流程。虽然模式在不同条件下保持稳定，但角色差异化显现出来：移动者支持协调，而反对者推动目标导向的干预。这些发现通过描述LLM驱动的系统如何在实时、多方人机交互中证明其干预决策的合理性，为可解释人工智能做出了贡献。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了基于LLM的机器人在多方人机交互中生成干预解释的机制。通过对比不同角色设置下的实验，分析了LLM如何实时justify其干预决策。研究识别出以促进互动为主的解释主题，并揭示了机器人角色差异化对干预逻辑的影响。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 多方交互, 人机交互, 可解释人工智能, 机器人干预
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证分析探讨了LLM在复杂多方交互中的决策逻辑，为提升人机交互的透明度和可解释性提供了重要参考。其局限性在于研究样本量较小（24组），且基于特定实验设置，通用性有待进一步验证。

title: From Phase to Phenomenon: Self-Supervised Learning of Subsurface Scattering with Minimal Phase-shift Inputs
summary: We propose a self-supervised pretraining framework for learning sub-surface scattering (SSS) light transport representations from minimal input. Our method leverages a stereo projector-camera setup that captures only eight high-frequency phase-shift profilometry (PSP) images per view to pretrain an encoder in a multi-view, multi-object setting. We introduce a tailored augmentation strategy for PSP-based SSS data, and show that it significantly outperforms standard ImageNet-style augmentations for SSL pretraining. The pretrained encoder learns generalizable SSS representations that transfer effectively to downstream tasks, including spatially varying relighting and representation evaluation using a kNN classifier. Combined with a decoder, the model reconstructs dense scattering footprint responses, trained using a dedicated cost function that improves accuracy, particularly for anisotropic footprints. Despite using only eight input images per view, our approach generalizes to unseen objects with complex geometry and material properties, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions while requiring orders of magnitude fewer images than prior methods.

AI.title_translation: 从相位到现象：基于极少量相位移输入的次表面散射自监督学习
AI.tldr: 利用每视图仅8张相位移图像，通过自监督预训练实现了复杂次表面散射的高保真重构与表征迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有的次表面散射（SSS）测量方法通常需要海量数据，为了降低数据采集的复杂性和成本，研究者探索仅使用极少量的相位移输入来实现SSS的表征学习与重构。
AI.method: 提出了一种自监督预训练框架，利用立体投影机-摄像机系统捕捉每视图仅8张高频相位移（PSP）图像，引入了针对PSP数据的定制化增强策略，并结合专门设计的损失函数训练编码器-解码器模型以重构散射响应。
AI.result: 该方法在仅使用8张输入图像的情况下，实现了对复杂几何和材质物体的高保真重构，其性能优于标准ImageNet增强策略，并能有效迁移至重光照及表征评估等下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了利用极少量相位移图像进行自监督预训练，能够有效地学习并迁移次表面散射的通用表征，为高效的三维场景与材质重构提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个自监督预训练框架，用于从极少量的输入中学习次表面散射（SSS）光传输表征。我们的方法利用立体投影机-摄像机设置，每个视图仅捕获八张高频相位移（PSP）图像，以在多视图、多物体的环境下预训练编码器。我们为基于PSP的SSS数据引入了一种定制的增强策略，并证明其在SSL预训练中显著优于标准的ImageNet风格增强。预训练的编码器学习到了可通用的SSS表征，这些表征能有效地迁移到下游任务，包括空间变化重光照和使用kNN分类器的表征评估。结合解码器，该模型能够重构密集的散射足迹响应，并使用专门的损失函数进行训练，从而提高了准确性，特别是在各向异性足迹方面。尽管每个视图仅使用八张输入图像，我们的方法仍能泛化到具有复杂几何形状和材质属性的未知物体，实现高保真重构，同时比现有方法所需的图像数量少几个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于极少量相位移输入（每视图8张）的自监督预训练框架，用于学习次表面散射（SSS）表示。通过引入定制的PSP数据增强策略和专用损失函数，该方法能够高效地从有限数据中学习到可泛化的SSS特征，实现对复杂物体散射响应的高质量重构。
AI.keywords: 次表面散射, 自监督学习, 相位移轮廓术, 表征学习, 光传输
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用极少量的相位移输入（仅8张）通过自监督学习实现了复杂次表面散射（SSS）的高保真重构。这种方法显著降低了数据采集成本，且其定制的增强策略在处理各向异性散射时表现出色，具有很强的泛化能力。其局限性在于依赖特定的立体投影机-摄像机硬件设置。

title: MIRROR: Aligning Semantic Relations from Language to Image via Gromov--Wasserstein
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit rich relational priors from their language backbones, yet often fail when asked to apply these relationships in visual contexts. We trace this failure to a structural blind spot: projection-based alignment trains each visual token to carry the right semantics, but never asks whether the relationships between concepts survive the crossing from language to vision. To address this, we propose MIRROR (Mapping Inter-concept Relations from language to visual Representation via Optimal-transport-based Regularization), a geometric regularization framework that transfers relational priors from language to vision by exploiting the rich relational structure encoded in language representations. Specifically, we derive a surrogate loss from the proposed Semi-Inverse Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW) problem, an inverse geometric problem that aligns visual representations with language-derived relational priors. We show that this formulation admits a unique closed-form solution that prescribes the ideal visual relational structure implied by language geometry and cross-modal coupling. The structure of the formulation also enables efficient computation, making it applicable to long token sequences. Applying SI-GW inside decoder-only Transformers requires careful design. We introduce targeted strategies at the layer, head, and token levels to ensure stable extraction without additional parameters or inference cost. MIRROR improves relational consistency while preserving performance on general vision-language tasks.

title: CellDETR: A Detection-Guided Framework for Scalable Cell Representation Learning from Histopathology Images
summary: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have substantially improved patch and slide level representation learning from whole-slide images (WSIs).However, cell-level representations learning remain underexplored, limiting cell resolved interpretability, biological discovery, and clinical translation. By introducing location feature decoupling and box-constrained attention mechanism, CellDETR enables automated extraction of cell-level embeddings, and outperform existing state-of-the-art methods in supervised cell classification on PanNuke data. In addition, by incorporating contrastive learning design, we build a CellDETR-based pretraining model for scalable cell representation learning from unlabeled WSIs, which improves downstream cell classification performance. Furthermore, we show that after pretraining with Xenium spatial transcriptomics-derived cell annotations, CellDETR achieves accurate cross-dataset cell classification, demonstrating the transferability and biological relevance of the learned cell embeddings. AI.title_translation: CellDETR：一种用于组织病理学图像可扩展细胞表征学习的检测引导框架
AI.tldr: CellDETR通过引入检测引导机制和对比学习，实现了病理图像中更具可解释性和可扩展性的细胞级表征学习。
AI.motivation: 现有的病理基础模型多集中于切片级或补丁级表征，缺乏细胞级的精细化表征学习，制约了病理学的可解释性和临床应用。
AI.method: 基于Deformable DETR架构，引入位置特征解耦和框约束注意力机制，并结合对比学习进行预训练，同时利用Xenium空间转录组数据进行辅助标注。
AI.result: 在PanNuke数据集上的监督细胞分类任务中优于现有SOTA方法；预训练模型提升了下游任务表现；在跨数据集细胞分类中表现出良好的泛化性和生物相关性。
AI.conclusion: CellDETR是一个可扩展的细胞级表征学习框架，能够有效提升计算病理学中的细胞解析能力、生物发现及临床转化水平。
AI.translation: 病理学基础模型的最新进展显著改善了全切片图像（WSI）的补丁级和切片级表征学习。然而，细胞级表征学习仍未得到充分探索，限制了细胞解析的可解释性、生物学发现和临床转化。我们提出了CellDETR，这是一个基于Deformable DETR构建的检测引导框架，用于从WSI中进行可扩展的细胞表征学习。通过引入位置特征解耦和框约束注意力机制，CellDETR实现了细胞级嵌入的自动提取，并在PanNuke数据的监督细胞分类中超越了现有的先进方法。此外，通过引入对比学习设计，我们构建了一个基于CellDETR的预训练模型，用于从无标注WSI中进行可扩展的细胞表征学习，这改善了下游细胞分类的性能。此外，我们证明了在使用Xenium空间转录组衍生的细胞注释进行预训练后，CellDETR实现了准确的跨数据集细胞分类，证明了所学细胞嵌入的可迁移性和生物相关性。总之，CellDETR为可解释计算病理学的通用细胞级表征学习框架提供了一条可扩展的途径。
AI.summary: CellDETR是一个利用检测引导的框架，通过Deformable DETR实现病理图像中细胞级特征的高效提取，并通过对比学习与空间转录组辅助，显著提升了细胞表征的可扩展性与分类准确度。
AI.keywords: 细胞级表征学习, Deformable DETR, 计算病理学, 对比学习, 空间转录组学
AI.comments: CellDETR通过将目标检测架构（Deformable DETR）引入病理图像分析，成功解决了细胞级表征学习的难题。其创新点在于位置特征解耦和框约束注意力机制，这不仅提升了分类精度，还通过对比学习实现了在无标注数据上的可扩展表征学习，具有重要的临床转化潜力。

title: Rank-Aware Hyperbolic Alignment for Vision-Language Dataset Distillation
comments: Accepted for publication at ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://andyj1.github.io/raha
summary: Vision-language dataset distillation (VLDD) compresses a large image-text paired dataset into a small set of synthetic pairs that can efficiently train contrastive vision-language models under strict data and compute budgets. Most existing methods match expert trajectories or cross-modal statistics, yet still enforce full-dimensional alignment in a Euclidean embedding space. This is often overly restrictive due to rank-deficient image--text correlation, with shared semantics concentrated in a low-dimensional range and remaining variation spread across a weakly correlated residual subspace. LoRS relaxes alignment at the similarity level by low-rank factorization, but does not explicitly control dominant alignment capacity and structure in the representation space. We thus propose a rank-aware hyperbolic alignment (RAHA) that combines hierarchical geometry with explicit alignment-capacity control. RAHA lifts multimodal representations to hyperbolic space and optimizes distilled pairs with asymmetric objectives that enforce geodesic alignment in the shared range while regularizing the residual subspace to preserve modality-private diversity and improve transfer robustness. Experiments on benchmarks show that RAHA demonstrates competitive cross-modal retrieval and improved transfer indicators under fixed budgets.
comment: Accepted for publication at ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://andyj1.github.io/raha

AI.title_translation: 面向视觉-语言数据集蒸馏的秩感知双曲对齐
AI.tldr: RAHA 通过在双曲空间进行秩感知对齐，在解决视觉-语言数据集蒸馏中的秩亏问题同时，提升了模型的跨模态性能与迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言数据集蒸馏方法多在欧几里得空间进行全维度对齐，忽略了图像-文本相关性的秩亏特性，导致过度限制了模型性能。现有低秩方法又缺乏对表示空间中对齐容量和结构的显式控制。
AI.method: 提出了秩感知双曲对齐（RAHA）方法，将多模态表示提升至双曲空间，采用非对称目标函数在共享语义范围实现测地线对齐，并对残差子空间进行正则化以保留模态私有信息。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，RAHA 在固定预算下表现出极具竞争力的跨模态检索性能，并提升了模型的迁移指标。
AI.conclusion: RAHA 通过在双曲空间实施秩感知对齐，有效提升了视觉-语言数据集蒸馏的性能和迁移鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言数据集蒸馏（VLDD）旨在将大规模图像-文本配对数据集压缩为一小部分合成配对，以便在严格的数据和计算预算下高效训练对比视觉-语言模型。大多数现有方法通过匹配专家轨迹或跨模态统计量来进行，但仍强制在欧几里得嵌入空间进行全维度对齐。由于图像-文本相关性存在秩亏，共享语义集中在低维范围，而其余变化分散在弱相关的残差子空间中，因此这种做法通常过于严格。LoRS 通过低秩分解在相似度层面放宽了对齐限制，但未显式控制表示空间中的主导对齐容量和结构。因此，我们提出了秩感知双曲对齐（RAHA），它将层次几何与显式的对齐容量控制相结合。RAHA 将多模态表示提升至双曲空间，并利用非对称目标优化合成配对，在共享范围强制实施测地线对齐，同时正则化残差子空间以保留模态私有多样性并提高迁移鲁棒性。基准测试表明，RAHA 在固定预算下展现了具有竞争力的跨模态检索性能和改进的迁移指标。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种用于视觉-语言数据集蒸馏的秩感知双曲对齐（RAHA）框架。该方法利用双曲几何的层次特性，通过非对称目标函数对共享语义进行测地线对齐，同时正则化残差子空间以增强多样性，解决了传统欧几里得空间对齐方法在处理秩亏相关性时的局限性。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言数据集蒸馏, 双曲空间, 秩感知对齐, 多模态表示, 迁移鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将双曲空间几何结构与秩感知对齐机制相结合，解决了视觉-语言数据集蒸馏中欧几里得空间全维度对齐过于严格的问题。通过区分共享语义空间与残差子空间，RAHA 提供了更灵活、更有效的蒸馏策略，对多模态模型高效训练具有重要参考价值。

title: Prototype Latent World Model Replay for Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-incremental learning requires a model to learn new classes while preserving decision regions for old ones. This is difficult when raw old samples are no longer available. We propose Prototype Latent World Model Replay, a memory-free framework that stores old classes as distributions over stable hidden states rather than as images. A frozen ImageNet-pretrained encoder maps each image into a latent state space. In this space, each class is summarized by several prototype-centered distributions with class-specific variances. When new classes arrive, the model samples old latent states from this prototype world model. It then trains a lightweight adapter and classifier using both sampled old states and real new-class features. We also add a supervised contrastive term in the adapter space to promote intra-class compactness and old-new class separation. On Split CIFAR-100, our method improves over fine-tuning under Inc5, Inc10, and Inc20 without storing raw exemplars. The full Ours-LWM+Con model raises LastAcc from 4.55% to 31.64%, from 9.06% to 37.06%, and from 16.96% to 43.10% in Inc5, Inc10, and Inc20, respectively. It also achieves AvgAcc of 45.86%, 52.19%, and 56.18%. Ablation and retention analyses show that stable latent-state replay is the main source of the gain. Contrastive separation further refines the old-new geometry. These results suggest that prototype latent memory preserves reusable class-state distributions, rather than only fitting the current classifier.

AI.title_translation: 面向类增量学习的原型潜在世界模型回放
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需存储原始图像的类增量学习方法，通过在潜在空间中对旧类建立原型分布模型进行回放，有效防止了遗忘并提升了分类性能。
AI.motivation: 类增量学习中，由于无法获取旧类原始样本，模型在学习新类时容易发生灾难性遗忘，需要一种高效的机制来保留旧类知识。
AI.method: 提出了一种无记忆的框架，使用冻结的预训练编码器将图像映射到潜在空间，用原型中心分布表示旧类别；在训练新类时，从原型世界模型中采样旧类潜在状态，结合新类特征训练轻量级适配器和分类器，并引入监督对比损失以增强类内紧凑性和类间分离。
AI.result: 在Split CIFAR-100数据集的Inc5、Inc10和Inc20配置下，该方法显著提升了最终准确率（LastAcc）和平均准确率（AvgAcc），且无需存储任何原始图像样本。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，该方法通过存储稳定的潜在状态分布，成功实现了在不存储原始样本的情况下，在多个增量基准测试中显著提升了分类性能，证明了潜在空间原型记忆的有效性。
AI.translation: 类增量学习要求模型在学习新类别的同时保留旧类别的决策区域。当无法获取原始旧样本时，这一过程变得非常困难。我们提出了原型潜在世界模型回放（Prototype Latent World Model Replay），这是一种无记忆框架，它将旧类别存储为稳定隐藏状态的分布，而不是图像。一个冻结的ImageNet预训练编码器将每张图像映射到潜在状态空间。在这个空间中，每个类别由几个以原型为中心的分布及类特定的方差来总结。当新类别到来时，模型从这个原型世界模型中采样旧的潜在状态。然后，它使用采样到的旧状态和真实的新类别特征来训练轻量级适配器和分类器。我们还在适配器空间中添加了一个监督对比项，以促进类内紧凑性和新旧类别的分离。在Split CIFAR-100上，我们的方法在Inc5、Inc10和Inc20设置下优于微调方法，且无需存储原始样本。完整的Ours-LWM+Con模型在Inc5、Inc10和Inc20中分别将LastAcc从4.55%提升至31.64%、从9.06%提升至37.06%、从16.96%提升至43.10%。它还分别达到了45.86%、52.19%和56.18%的AvgAcc。消融分析和保留分析表明，稳定的潜在状态回放是性能提升的主要来源。对比分离进一步优化了新旧类别的几何结构。这些结果表明，原型潜在记忆保留了可重用的类别状态分布，而不仅仅是拟合当前的分类器。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种原型潜在世界模型回放（PLWM）方法，用于解决类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。该方法通过将旧类存储为潜在空间中的原型分布，而非原始图像，实现了无需内存的知识回放，并通过监督对比学习优化了新旧类别的特征区分度。
AI.keywords: 类增量学习, 原型回放, 潜在空间, 灾难性遗忘, 对比学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“原型潜在世界模型回放”框架，通过存储类别的潜在分布而非原始图像，有效解决了类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，且无需内存存储原始样本，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Self-Supervised Calibration of Scientific Instruments Using Physical Consistency Constraints
summary: Calibration remains one of the principal obstacles to the deployment of machine learning in scientific instrumentation because it typically relies on expert intervention, dedicated procedures, and manually labelled data. We introduce a physics-informed self-supervised framework that jointly learns latent detector calibration parameters and task-specific predictions directly from raw measurements without requiring pre-calibrated signals or external labels. The method exploits known physical constraints to generate pseudo-labels iteratively, transforming calibration into a self-supervised optimization problem. The approach is demonstrated for ionic charge-state determination in the VAMOS++ magnetic spectrometer, where the calibration of a segmented ionization chamber and the inference of ionic charge states are learned simultaneously. Starting from a weak prior on the mean ionic charge state, the model progressively refines its predictions through iterative fractional pseudo-labelling driven by the discrete nature of atomic masses. Beyond accurate ionic charge-state reconstruction, the inferred calibration coefficients provide a compact representation of the detector state that enables automated monitoring of gain drifts, pressure variations, and detector aging. The resulting labels can subsequently be transferred to specialized models that quantify detector imperfections and track their spatial and temporal evolution. These results establish a general paradigm for self-calibrating and self-monitoring scientific instruments and represent a step toward intelligent experimental systems capable of autonomous calibration, analysis, and performance optimization.

AI.title_translation: 基于物理一致性约束的科学仪器自监督校准
AI.tldr: 通过引入物理约束，该框架使科学仪器能够无需人工标注，自动完成校准、任务预测及性能监测，推动了智能实验系统的发展。
AI.motivation: 科学仪器校准通常需要专家干预、专门程序和手动标注数据，这是机器学习在科学仪器应用中的主要障碍。
AI.method: 提出一种物理信息驱动的自监督框架，通过利用已知的物理约束生成伪标签，将校准任务转化为自监督优化问题，同时学习潜在探测器校准参数和任务特定预测。
AI.result: 在VAMOS++磁谱仪的应用中，成功实现了电离室的校准与离子电荷态的推断，不仅提高了重建精度，还能自动监测增益漂移、压力变化和探测器老化等状态。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了科学仪器的自监督校准与任务预测，证明了利用物理约束进行自动化仪器状态监测和性能优化的可行性，为未来智能实验系统奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 校准仍然是将机器学习应用于科学仪器的主要障碍之一，因为它通常依赖于专家干预、专门的程序和手动标注的数据。我们引入了一种物理信息自监督框架，该框架可以直接从原始测量中联合学习潜在探测器校准参数和特定任务预测，而无需预校准信号或外部标签。该方法利用已知的物理约束来迭代生成伪标签，将校准转化为一个自监督优化问题。该方法在VAMOS++磁谱仪的离子电荷态测定中得到了验证，其中分段电离室的校准和离子电荷态的推断是同时学习的。从对平均离子电荷态的弱先验开始，模型通过由原子质量的离散性质驱动的迭代分数伪标注逐步细化其预测。除了精确的离子电荷态重建外，推断出的校准系数还提供了探测器状态的紧凑表示，能够自动监测增益漂移、压力变化和探测器老化。由此产生的标签随后可以转移到专门的模型中，以量化探测器缺陷并跟踪其空间和时间演变。这些结果为自校准和自监控科学仪器建立了一个通用范式，并代表了向能够进行自主校准、分析和性能优化的智能实验系统迈出的一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种物理信息自监督框架，通过利用物理约束进行迭代伪标注，实现了科学仪器从原始测量数据中进行自动校准与任务推理，无需预校准信号或外部标签。该方法在VAMOS++磁谱仪上验证了其在离子电荷态测定及探测器状态监控方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 科学仪器校准, 物理约束, VAMOS++磁谱仪, 自动化监测
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将物理约束引入自监督学习，解决了科学仪器校准依赖人工标注的瓶颈。其重要性在于实现了仪器状态的自动化校准与监测，为构建自主运行的智能实验系统提供了通用范式。局限性在于该方法可能依赖于特定领域物理先验的准确性。

title: mamabench and mamaretrieval: Benchmarks for Evaluating Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Maternal, Neonatal, and Reproductive Health
comments: 13 pages, 3 tables. Datasets and construction code linked in the paper
summary: Medical question-answering benchmarks rarely cover the maternal, neonatal, child, and reproductive-health questions a nurse-midwife asks, and, to our knowledge, no public chunk-level relevance benchmark exists for maternal-health guideline retrieval. We release two benchmarks that fill these gaps. mamabench is a scope-filtered QA set of 25,949 items assembled from seven existing expert-authored sources across multiple-choice, short-answer, and rubric-graded tracks; to help users calibrate the LLM judge that scores the rubric track, we re-scope HealthBench's physician-labelled meta-evaluation to the domain. mamaretrieval pairs 3,185 clinical queries with graded (0-6) relevance labels over a 63,650-chunk maternal-health guideline corpus, using a decomposed rubric that distinguishes a chunk that answers a query from one merely on its topic. Three decisions shape both: assemble and filter expert sources rather than author questions, grade relevance rather than binarise it, and measure and disclose the limits of the labels -- scope-classifier agreement, a frontier-judge check, and a pooling-completeness audit -- rather than treat them as an oracle. A companion paper uses the benchmarks to evaluate a deployed on-device assistant; both are released openly for research.
comment: 13 pages, 3 tables. Datasets and construction code linked in the paper

title: MTD-Map: Single-Stage Long-Term LiDAR Map Maintenance Framework via Mixture Transition Distribution
summary: While robust map maintenance has advanced significantly, existing studies have focused on specific tasks, especially dynamic object removal or change detection. In this paper, we take a holistic view of the map maintenance problem and propose MTD-Map, a single-stage framework that handles both dynamic object removal and change detection without separate task-specific modules. MTD-Map employs an explicit representation that compactly encodes the direction and duration of occupancy transitions through Mixture Transition Distribution (MTD) modeling. We develop a recursive MTD formulation that encodes historical occupancy patterns into an augmented state to capture high-order temporal dependencies. Furthermore, a stability-driven adaptive strategy balances noise suppression with the preservation of quasi-static structures. Extensive experiments verify that MTD-Map robustly removes dynamic objects and achieves competitive change detection performance, subsequently reducing computational costs. Our project page is available at: https://taeyoung96.github.io/mtd_map/.

AI.title_translation: MTD-Map：基于混合转移分布的单阶段长期激光雷达地图维护框架
AI.tldr: 一种通过混合转移分布（MTD）实现动态物体移除和变化检测的统一激光雷达地图维护框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的地图维护研究多局限于特定任务（如仅动态物体移除或仅变化检测），缺乏统一的整体解决方案，且往往需要复杂的任务特定模块。
AI.method: 提出 MTD-Map 单阶段框架，利用混合转移分布（MTD）建模显式编码占用转换的方向和持续时间；开发递归 MTD 公式以捕捉高阶时间依赖；并采用稳定性驱动的自适应策略来平衡噪声抑制与准静态结构的保留。
AI.result: 实验表明，MTD-Map 在鲁棒移除动态物体的同时，在变化检测任务上表现出竞争力，并有效降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: MTD-Map成功实现了一个高效的单阶段框架，能够同时处理动态物体移除和变化检测，在减少计算成本的同时保持了优异的地图维护效果。
AI.translation: 尽管鲁棒的地图维护技术已取得显著进展，但现有研究多集中于特定任务，特别是动态物体移除或变化检测。在本文中，我们从整体视角审视地图维护问题，并提出了 MTD-Map，这是一个单阶段框架，无需单独的任务特定模块即可同时处理动态物体移除和变化检测。MTD-Map 采用了一种显式表示方法，通过混合转移分布（MTD）建模紧凑地编码了占用转换的方向和持续时间。我们开发了一种递归 MTD 公式，将历史占用模式编码为增强状态，以捕捉高阶时间依赖。此外，一种稳定性驱动的自适应策略平衡了噪声抑制与准静态结构的保留。大量实验验证了 MTD-Map 在鲁棒移除动态物体和实现竞争性变化检测性能方面的有效性，并随后降低了计算成本。项目主页：https://taeyoung96.github.io/mtd_map/。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 MTD-Map，这是一个用于激光雷达地图维护的单阶段框架。通过使用混合转移分布（MTD）显式编码占用状态的转换，该框架无需特定任务模块即可同时处理动态物体移除和变化检测，并利用递归公式和自适应策略提升了处理效率与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 地图维护, 激光雷达, 混合转移分布, 动态物体移除, 变化检测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种统一的单阶段框架，通过混合转移分布（MTD）模型同时处理动态物体移除和变化检测，避免了任务特定模块的复杂性。其利用递归MTD公式捕捉高阶时间依赖，并引入稳定性驱动的自适应策略，在保持计算效率的同时提升了地图维护的鲁棒性。

title: Structured Proper Loss Geometries for Multiclass Classification: Theory and Controlled Empirical Evaluation
summary: Strictly proper scoring rules identify the true conditional class distribution at population level, but their curvature can alter optimization and finite-sample behavior. We study three multiclass objectives: a class-aware quadratic Bregman score (CAPM), a strongly convex generator with constrained log-cosh ridges (HPG), and an HPG objective with an annealed probability-margin penalty (APMS). CAPM is treated as a structured instance of established quadratic scoring-rule theory. We derive conditional-regret, curvature, range, and logit-gradient bounds for CAPM and HPG, and prove exact penalty-range and conditional-target displacement bounds for APMS. Controlled five-seed experiments use Digits, Wisconsin breast cancer, and synthetic confusion and long-tail problems under clean labels, symmetric and pair-flip corruption, class imbalance, calibration evaluation, input corruption, and first-order adversarial perturbations. The candidates are close to cross-entropy on clean data and show descriptive gains in some noisy-label cells, but the five-seed comparisons are interpreted descriptively rather than as significance evidence. The selected noisy-label baselines perform better on Digits with 40% symmetric label noise, and explicit prior-adjustment methods perform better in the 30:1 synthetic long-tail experiment. Ablations do not show a consistent benefit from the candidate-specific graph, ridge, or margin components. The mathematical analysis establishes the stated properties, and the experiments delimit the empirical evidence; together they do not support a claim of general superiority.

title: Agent-Computer Observation Interfaces Enable Dynamic Computer Use
summary:
SWE-agent established the action interface as an underexplored design axis for software-engineering agents; we make the analogous case for the observation interface in computer-use (CU) agents. Current CU agents, closed and open-source alike, tie observation to action--one screenshot every 3-5 s, no audio--leaving them blind and deaf between screenshots to video, animations, transient UI events, meetings, and spoken instructions. We introduce the Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI), a model-agnostic perception layer that decouples continuous, adaptive observation from discrete actions through three gated components: inter-step keyframe capture, volume-gated audio transcription, and CU-model-generated visual narration that persists as text. Each produces almost nothing on static, silent content, reducing to the standard loop without degrading it.
  On DynaCU-Bench (100 dynamic browser tasks plus a 50-task static control), CU models from 7B to frontier scale gain +17 to +48 pp over their screenshot baselines with zero retraining, turning tasks that are near-impossible from periodic screenshots into largely solved ones. The gap is starkest on audio: on a spoken-content subset AOI agents solve every task, whereas streaming voice models hear accurately but cannot act on what they hear without the scaffold. The decomposition is as informative as the headline gain: keyframe selection turns out not to matter--the value comes from narrating captured frames into persistent text--and the interface is not a fixed bundle, since on a newer model (Gemini 3 Flash) the keyframe stream actively regresses through image-token dilution, so its components must be selected per model rather than shipped as one configuration.

title: MAVIN: Multi-Shot Audio-Visual Generation with Narrative Control
summary: While recent generative models produce high-fidelity videos, they struggle with the complex narrative control required for coherent multi-shot audio-visual generation. Existing methods suffer from temporal misalignment, limited controllability, and incomplete scripting. In this paper, we propose MAVIN, the first framework for multi-shot audio-visual generation with customized narrative control. To resolve temporal misalignment, we propose boundary-aware attention, which leverages hierarchical captions and boundary-aware token routing to render audio-visual elements within their respective temporal boundaries. To improve the controllability for multi-subject scenarios, we propose ID-aware propagation, utilizing identity embeddings and an identity-aware mask to bind specific identities to consistent visual appearances and vocal timbres. To provide comprehensive audio-visual narratives, we present a multi-agent scripting pipeline to transform free-form user inputs into hierarchical captions. Furthermore, we construct MAVINSet, a multi-shot audio-visual dataset for robust training and evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAVIN achieves state-of-the-art performance, opening up a new avenue for integrating generative models into professional filmmaking workflows.

title: CRAFT: Counterfactual Credit Assignment from Free Sibling Rollouts for Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Self-distilled agentic reinforcement learning augments trajectory-level reward with a token-level distillation loss, using as its teacher the same policy conditioned on privileged context. The prevailing recipe gates this loss by a single scalar, the teacher-student log-probability gap. This signal is doubly limited: it is retrospective, scoring only the realised rollout and never the counterfactual ones, and it is sign-blind, never signalling when a teacher-preferred action would have harmed the trajectory. We introduce CRAFT, a three-pillar credit-assignment scheme that addresses both limitations. Pillar 1, Counterfactual Token Importance, reuses the G-1 sibling rollouts that GRPO already samples and importance-weights them by the log-probability gap to form a self-normalised estimate of the group-level counterfactual change in advantage from up-weighting teacher-preferred actions at each step; this yields a signed per-token credit at near-zero extra compute. Pillar 2 is an asymmetric controller that raises the distillation weight as it lowers the reference-KL weight along an exponential moving average of gate activity, and conversely. Pillar 3 polarises the KL penalty token by token, switching between a mode-seeking and a mode-covering update according to the sign of the credit. Each pillar has an independent switch that, when disabled, renders the loss and gradient byte-identical to the baseline in IEEE-754 arithmetic, so any measured gain is attributable to algorithmic change rather than implementation drift. We prove the estimator's consistency and a variance bound, give structural and bit-exact reproducibility guarantees, and evaluate CRAFT across three agentic environments, four model scales, and five end-to-end methods, plus two tabulated prior-work baselines. Among these is Adaptive-CRINGE, a comparator sharing Pillar 2 with CRAFT, isolating the counterfactual contribution.

title: Chamber geometry and specification numbers of Boolean threshold functions
summary:
The specification number $σ_n(f)$ of a Boolean threshold function $f$ on $n$ variables is the least number of points whose $f$-values determine $f$ uniquely among all threshold functions. Its essential points form the unique minimum such set. We develop Zuev's geometric interpretation: the threshold functions are the chambers of a central hyperplane arrangement in the $(n+1)$-dimensional space of weights and thresholds, and the essential points of a function correspond exactly to the facets of its chamber, so the specification number is the chamber's facet number.
  The lower bound $σ_n(f)\ge n+1$ becomes the fact that a pointed full-dimensional cone has at least $n+1$ facets, with equality for simplicial chambers. The average specification number $\overlineσ_n$ becomes an average facet count. We evaluate this average exactly via the resonance arrangement and bound it through a theorem of Fukuda, Tamura, and Tokuyama, obtaining $\overlineσ_n\le 2n$; hence $\overlineσ_n=Θ(n)$. This settles a question of Gutekunst, Mészáros, and Petersen. The method also extends to polynomial threshold functions.
  The same geometry links threshold functions with a threshold zonotope, whose vertices are modified Chow vectors. Its one-skeleton is the one-inclusion graph, and a vertex's degree is the specification number of that function.
  Finally, we treat the operations of Lozin et al. on functions of minimum specification number. Adding a variable and extending on a variable both take the product of a chamber closure with a half-line, preserving simpliciality. For the symmetric-variables extension we give an exact thresholdness criterion and show that minimum specification number is preserved whenever the extension is a threshold function. We also resolve a question they pose concerning a fourth operation.

AI.title_translation: 布尔阈值函数的胞腔几何与规格数
AI.tldr: 本文通过几何方法将布尔阈值函数的规格数转化为超平面排列中胞腔的刻面计数问题，证明了其平均规格数为 Θ(n)，并推导了相关的几何性质。
AI.motivation: 旨在通过几何视角解释布尔阈值函数的规格数，建立阈值函数与超平面排列的联系，并解决关于平均规格数及其在特定函数操作下行为的开放性问题。
AI.method: 利用 Zuev 的几何解释，将阈值函数映射为 (n+1) 维空间中中心超平面排列的胞腔，将规格数转化为胞腔的刻面数；利用共振排列评估平均规格数；通过阈值带多面体研究其一骨架和顶点度数。
AI.result: 证明了平均规格数 $\overlineσ_n = Θ(n)$，且满足 $\overlineσ_n \le 2n$；验证了最小规格数在特定变量扩展操作下的性质，并解决了关于第四种操作的疑问。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了布尔阈值函数的平均规格数为 Θ(n)，通过几何方法揭示了阈值函数与超平面排列、阈值带多面体之间的深层联系，并解决了多项式阈值函数及操作的相关问题。
AI.translation: 布尔阈值函数 f 在 n 个变量上的规格数 σ_n(f) 是唯一确定 f 的最少点数。其本质点构成了唯一的最小此类集合。我们发展了 Zuev 的几何解释：阈值函数是权重和阈值 (n+1) 维空间中中心超平面排列的胞腔，函数的本质点恰好对应其胞腔的刻面，因此规格数就是胞腔的刻面数。下界 σ_n(f) ≥ n+1 转化为尖锐的全维锥至少有 n+1 个刻面这一事实，对于单纯形胞腔取等号。平均规格数 σ_n 变为平均刻面计数。我们通过共振排列精确评估了该平均值，并利用 Fukuda、Tamura 和 Tokuyama 的定理对其进行了界定，得到 σ_n ≤ 2n；因此 σ_n = Θ(n)。这解决了 Gutekunst、Mészáros 和 Petersen 提出的一个问题。该方法也扩展到了多项式阈值函数。同样的几何结构将阈值函数与阈值带多面体联系起来，其顶点是修改后的 Chow 向量。其一骨架是包含图，顶点的度数就是该函数的规格数。最后，我们处理了 Lozin 等人关于最小规格数函数的操作。添加变量和扩展变量都取胞腔闭包与半线的乘积，保持了单纯形性。对于对称变量扩展，我们给出了精确的阈值准则，并证明了只要扩展是阈值函数，最小规格数就会被保留。我们还解决了他们提出的关于第四种操作的问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种布尔阈值函数规格数的几何解释，将其视为 (n+1) 维空间超平面排列中胞腔的刻面数。通过这一模型，作者证明了阈值函数的平均规格数为线性增长，并建立了阈值函数与阈值带多面体之间的几何对应关系，同时分析了函数扩展操作对最小规格数的影响。
AI.keywords: 布尔阈值函数, 规格数, 超平面排列, 阈值带多面体, 几何解释
AI.comments: 该论文通过超平面排列的几何视角，为布尔阈值函数的规格数提供了深刻的解释。其创新之处在于将复杂的逻辑函数问题转化为几何中的胞腔刻面计数问题，不仅解决了关于平均规格数的猜想，还为多项式阈值函数的研究提供了推广框架。

title: To Reason or to Fabricate: Reasoning Without Shortcuts via Hint-Anchored Pairwise Aggregation
summary: While reinforcement learning (RL) significantly enhances LLM reasoning, its efficacy is severely undermined by Pre-RL data overlap, where RL datasets overlap with pretraining or SFT corpora, causing models to exploit shortcuts by memorizing correct answers and fabricating post-hoc reasoning. To address this, we introduce HIPPO, a novel RL framework that integrates hint-injected aggregation with a tailored pairwise reward model. By utilizing hint injection to deliberately trigger overlap-induced behaviors, the resulting traces naturally serve as explicit anchors for pairwise comparison. This provides highly discriminable preference signals, enabling a lightweight judge model to reliably distinguish genuine reasoning deduction from shortcut-driven rationalization, while the pairwise formulation ensures stable and robust optimization compared to standard PRMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HIPPO yields substantial improvements over standard baselines and generalizes effectively to out-of-distribution general tasks, showing it extracts authentic, transferable reasoning skills rather than superficial shortcut patterns.

AI.title_translation: 推理还是伪造：通过提示锚定配对聚合实现无捷径推理
AI.tldr: HIPPO框架通过提示注入和配对奖励机制，解决了大模型在强化学习中依赖数据重叠“走捷径”进行伪造推理的问题，提升了推理的真实性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在提升大模型推理能力时，常因预训练数据与RL数据重叠，导致模型通过记忆答案而非学习推理过程（即捷径效应）来获取奖励，从而产生伪造的推理过程。
AI.method: 提出HIPPO框架，通过提示注入（Hint Injection）诱导模型产生潜在的捷径行为，并使用配对奖励模型（Pairwise Reward Model）对真实推理和捷径推理进行对比，以实现更稳健的优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，HIPPO在多项任务中显著优于基准方法，且具有良好的分布外泛化能力，能够提取可迁移的真实推理技能。
AI.conclusion: HIPPO框架通过提示锚定配对聚合，有效抑制了强化学习中的捷径效应，提升了模型推理的真实性和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 尽管强化学习（RL）显著增强了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但其有效性严重受到RL前数据重叠的影响，即RL数据集与预训练或有监督微调（SFT）语料库重叠，导致模型通过记忆正确答案和伪造事后推理来利用捷径。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了HIPPO，这是一种结合了提示注入聚合与定制配对奖励模型的新型RL框架。通过利用提示注入来刻意触发重叠诱导的行为，产生的轨迹自然地充当了配对比较的明确锚点。这提供了高度可区分的偏好信号，使轻量级判断模型能够可靠地将真实的推理推导与捷径驱动的合理化区分开来，同时配对公式确保了与标准过程奖励模型（PRM）相比更稳定和鲁棒的优化。广泛的实验表明，HIPPO在标准基准测试上取得了实质性改进，并能有效地泛化到分布外通用任务，证明了它提取的是真实的、可迁移的推理技能，而非表面的捷径模式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HIPPO框架，旨在解决大模型强化学习中因数据重叠导致的推理捷径问题。该方法通过提示注入诱导捷径行为，并结合配对奖励模型进行区分，从而确保模型学习到真实的推理过程而非单纯的模式匹配。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 强化学习, 推理, 捷径效应, 提示注入
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地利用“提示注入”来主动诱导并识别模型对捷径的依赖，通过配对奖励机制有效区分真实推理与伪造解释，为解决大模型强化学习中的数据污染和捷径问题提供了一种鲁棒的解决方案。

title: From Design Principles to Prototype: A Game for Students with ADHD and Learning Disabilities Transitioning to Post-Secondary Education
summary: Students with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) and Learning Disabilities (LD) can face significant academic, social, and organizational challenges when transitioning to post-secondary education. This paper presents a literature-informed serious game prototype designed to support this transition. We synthesize prior work into design considerations for students with ADHD and LD and show how these considerations are instantiated in a story-driven game.

title: Fog Computing and Large Language Models: A vision for the mutual beneficiaries
comments: Paper accepted for publication at IEEE Computer Magazine
summary: Fog computing utilizes proximal computational resources for sensor data processing and actuation, and addresses the latency, network load, and privacy issues of cloud-centric Internet of Things. On the other hand, Large Language Models (LLMs) are a type of deep learning AI models, which are trained on enormous text data, that perform various natural language processing tasks such as translation, question answering, text summarization, and code generation. LLMs are generally cloud-centric, requiring abundant GPU memory and computing capabilities, again face the same issues that led to fog computing. This pushes the necessity for LLM support in the proximity on fog infrastructure, requiring LLM optimizations such as parameter-weight quantization, pruning, low-rank adaptation etc. Meanwhile, fog computing also gets benefit from LLM's ability for code generation, in the dynamic deployment of fog-based applications. The paper addresses how both fog computing and LLMs can be mutual beneficiaries, discussing the state-of-the-art and future research scope.
comment: Paper accepted for publication at IEEE Computer Magazine

title: The Calibrated Deepfake Trust Score (CDTS): Competence-Coupled Trust Degradation Across Deepfake Detectors
summary: Modern deepfake detectors are rarely consumed as bare classifiers. In moderation, provenance, and verification pipelines their output probability is read as a degree of trust, so its calibration matters as much as raw accuracy. We reframe deepfake detection as a calibrated, self-auditing trust instrument, the Calibrated Deepfake Trust Score (CDTS), and identify what governs its trustworthiness. Our central finding is a competence-calibration coupling: the calibration of the trust score degrades as the detector's discriminative competence falls. We establish it across 32 configurations (pooled Pearson r = -0.81), demonstrate it within a single dataset, reinforce it by inducing low competence directly, and replicate it on a fourth held-out dataset the detectors never trained on. It holds across three architecturally distinct detectors, two convolutional networks and a CLIP vision transformer (r = -0.88, -0.83, -0.86). The result is also deployable: a single calibrator frozen on in-domain data fails on exactly the low-competence generators the coupling flags (its error tracks competence at r = -0.98), and competence is estimable without labels, so a label-free monitor flags calibration risk on unseen generators and routing source-batches on a reference-free competence estimate lowers overall AURC and improves the low-to-mid coverage operating region relative to confidence-based routing. The same competence factor also drives calibration inequity across demographic subgroups (distinct from accuracy inequity) and explanation faithfulness. We therefore argue that detector trustworthiness is organized by competence as a shared driver, that competence is the right quantity to estimate and condition on, and that trust scoring must be competence-aware. We offer the CDTS wrapper as the mechanism, and report openly where the unification is tight and where it is architecture-specific.

AI.title_translation: 校准深度伪造信任评分（CDTS）：跨深度伪造检测器的能力耦合信任度退化问题
AI.tldr: 深度伪造检测器的信任度取决于其处理能力；当能力下降时，校准质量随之恶化。作者提出了CDTS框架，通过感知能力来监控和修复检测器的信任风险。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造检测器的输出概率常被视为信任度，但现有的检测器缺乏有效的校准机制，且在面对不同生成器或数据分布时，其校准表现与辨别能力之间的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出了校准深度伪造信任评分（CDTS）框架，通过分析检测器的辨别能力（competence）与校准误差之间的耦合关系，构建了无需标签的风险监控器，并实现了基于能力的路由策略以优化检测性能。
AI.result: 研究发现检测器的辨别能力与校准质量存在强相关性（Pearson r = -0.81）；CDTS机制能有效识别低能力模型，通过标签无关的监控器降低整体AURC，并在人口统计学子群中提升了校准公平性。
AI.conclusion: 检测器的可信度与能力密切相关，必须构建“感知能力”的信任评分机制（CDTS），以应对未见过的生成器带来的校准风险。
AI.translation: 现代深度伪造检测器很少被视为纯粹的分类器。在内容审核、来源追踪和验证流水线中，其输出概率被解读为信任程度，因此其校准（calibration）与原始准确率同样重要。我们将深度伪造检测重构为一种校准过的、自审计的信任工具，即“校准深度伪造信任评分”（CDTS），并识别了决定其可信度的因素。我们的核心发现是“能力-校准耦合”：随着检测器辨别能力的下降，信任评分的校准质量会随之退化。我们在32种配置中确立了这一关系（汇总Pearson r = -0.81），并在单个数据集内进行了验证，通过直接诱导低能力状态进行了强化，并在检测器从未见过的第四个留存数据集上进行了复现。该结论适用于三种架构截然不同的检测器（两个卷积网络和一个CLIP视觉Transformer，r分别为 -0.88, -0.83, -0.86）。该成果具有实用价值：在域内数据上冻结的单个校准器会在耦合标记的低能力生成器上失效（其错误与能力的跟踪相关性r = -0.98），且能力无需标签即可估计。因此，一个无标签监控器可以标记未见生成器上的校准风险，而基于无参考能力估计的路由源批次可以降低整体AURC，并改善低至中等覆盖范围内的运行表现。相同的能力因素也驱动了跨人口统计学子群的校准不公平性（区别于准确率不公平性）以及解释的忠实度。因此，我们认为检测器的可信度由能力作为共同驱动因素组织，能力是进行估计和调节的正确量，且信任评分必须具备“能力感知”。我们提供了CDTS封装器作为实现机制，并公开了这种统一性在何处紧密相关，以及在何处具有架构特异性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了深度伪造检测器中“辨别能力”与“输出校准”之间的耦合关系，提出了一种名为CDTS的校准信任评分机制。研究表明，随着检测器能力的下降，其校准质量会显著恶化。作者通过实验验证了这一耦合现象，并开发了一种无需标签的风险监控方案，证明了建立感知能力的信任评分系统对于提高检测系统可靠性的重要性。
AI.keywords: 深度伪造检测, 校准, 信任评分, 模型能力, 自审计
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“能力-校准耦合”这一新颖视角，揭示了深度伪造检测器在性能下降时校准能力也会随之恶化的必然性。其核心贡献在于提出了一种无需标签即可评估检测器风险的CDTS框架，不仅提升了检测系统的鲁棒性，还为解决深度伪造检测中的信任度量和公平性问题提供了可行的工程化方案。

title: Should children follow their parents' research paths? Intergenerational research continuity and divergence in academic families
summary: How academic advantages are transmitted within families is usually studied as occupational inheritance, but it is not clear whether scholarly research orientations persist across generations and if it is an advantage when it does. To address this, we link Wikidata kinship records with OpenAlex bibliometric profiles to study 3,229 documented parent-child scholar pairs and 488,659 publications. Field-level research similarity was evident but not universal: whilst the median similarity was 0.546, 25.3% of parent-child pairs had no Field overlap (i.e., similarity 0). These pairs were substantially more similar than publication-period-matched comparison pairs (median 0.098). Direct academic interaction was uncommon: 10.4% of parent-child pairs had co-authored, 9.8% of children had cited their parents, and 6.9% of parents had cited their children. Nevertheless, each 0.1 increase in Field similarity was associated with 38-39% higher adjusted odds of co-authorship and cross-citation. There was also intergenerational continuity in academic achievement and recognition. Parents' publication volume and field-normalized citation impact were positively associated with those of their children. Children of national academy members had approximately twice the odds of becoming national academy members themselves (Odds Ratio = 2.04), while children of prizewinning parents had 46% higher odds of winning prizes (Odds Ratio = 1.46). However, children of national academy members showed lower research similarity to their parents. Greater research differentiation was associated with higher field-normalized citation impact among children, but not with publication output or higher odds of academic recognition. Academic families therefore appear to transmit resources and advantages with the sole exception that diverging from parental fields seems to confer a citation advantage.

title: Which Tokens Need Context? A Reference-Based Analysis of Translation Responsibility Using Fertility and Entropy
comments: This is a work in progress. An extended version with machine translation output analysis and attention correlation is in preparation
summary: When humans translate, not every word depends equally on the surrounding context. Some tokens, particularly function words like pronouns and auxiliaries, rely heavily on preceding or following sentences, while others, such as proper nouns, do not. Understanding this inherent context sensitivity is essential for evaluating whether machine translation systems use context in human-like ways. However, existing approaches to analysing context usage rely on discourse-specific test sets or model internals, making them narrow or model-dependent. We propose a post-hoc, model-agnostic framework to quantify context sensitivity at lexical and syntactic levels using two measures derived from word alignments: fertility (number of target tokens generated per source token) and entropy (stability of fertility patterns across contexts). Using reference translations for three language pairs (German $\leftrightarrow$ English, English $\rightarrow$ Hindi) under four context conditions, we show that context selectively redistributes generative responsibility from source to context tokens without altering overall fertility. Function words show the largest fertility reductions, while content words remain stable, suggesting that context resolves ambiguity rather than adding new information. Our framework provides a ground-truth characterisation of selective context usage in human translation, establishing a diagnostic baseline for evaluating machine translation models.
comment: This is a work in progress. An extended version with machine translation output analysis and attention correlation is in preparation

AI.title_translation: 哪些标记需要上下文？基于生育率和熵的翻译责任参考分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种量化翻译中上下文敏感度的新方法，发现人类翻译主要利用上下文来解决功能词的歧义。
AI.motivation: 现有的分析上下文使用的方法往往依赖于特定的语篇测试集或模型内部结构，导致其通用性较差且具有模型依赖性，因此需要一种通用的方法来理解人类翻译中不同词汇对上下文的依赖程度。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于词对齐的后验、与模型无关的分析框架，通过计算生育率（每个源标记生成的目标标记数量）和熵（生育率模式在不同上下文中的稳定性）来量化词汇和句法层面的上下文敏感度。
AI.result: 实验发现，上下文会选择性地将生成责任从源标记转移到上下文标记，而不改变整体的生育率。功能词（如代词、助动词）表现出最大的生育率下降，而内容词则保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明人类翻译中上下文的使用具有选择性，其主要作用是解决歧义而非增加新信息。该框架为评估机器翻译中的上下文利用能力提供了一个可靠的基准。
AI.translation: 在人类翻译过程中，并非每个词对周围上下文的依赖程度都相同。一些标记，特别是代词和助动词等功能词，在很大程度上依赖于前后的句子，而专有名词等其他标记则不然。理解这种固有的上下文敏感度对于评估机器翻译系统是否以类似人类的方式使用上下文至关重要。然而，现有的分析上下文使用的方法依赖于特定语篇的测试集或模型内部结构，导致其范围狭窄或具有模型依赖性。我们提出了一种事后、与模型无关的框架，利用从词对齐中得出的两个度量指标——生育率（每个源标记生成的目标标记数量）和熵（生育率模式在不同上下文中的稳定性）——来量化词汇和句法层面的上下文敏感度。通过使用三种语言对（德语 $\leftrightarrow$ 英语，英语 $\rightarrow$ 印地语）在四种上下文条件下的参考翻译，我们证明了上下文在不改变整体生育率的情况下，有选择地将生成责任从源标记重新分配给了上下文标记。功能词表现出最大的生育率下降，而内容词则保持稳定，这表明上下文的作用是解决歧义，而不是添加新信息。我们的框架为人类翻译中选择性的上下文使用提供了基础事实特征，并为评估机器翻译模型建立了一个诊断基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于词对齐的框架，利用生育率和熵来量化人类翻译中不同词汇的上下文敏感度。研究发现，人类翻译通过上下文解决歧义，且这种依赖在功能词上表现得尤为明显，为评估机器翻译的上下文利用能力提供了基准。
AI.keywords: 机器翻译, 上下文敏感度, 词对齐, 生育率, 熵
AI.comments: 该研究通过一种新颖且与模型无关的框架，从词汇和句法层面量化了人类翻译中的上下文敏感度。其创新之处在于利用词对齐衍生出的生育率（Fertility）和熵（Entropy）作为度量指标，避开了对模型内部结构或特定语篇测试集的依赖。这为评估机器翻译系统是否以人类方式利用上下文提供了一个客观的诊断基准，具有很高的学术价值和实践意义。

title: Reported Confidence in LLMs Tracks Commitment More Than Correctness
summary: Confidence is an estimate of the probability that a chosen answer is correct. Verbal confidence reports are widely used as uncertainty measures in large language models, but whether they are best understood as estimates of correctness is unclear. We test this with a two-stage abstention paradigm from the neuroscience of perceptual decision making: a model first answers and reports its confidence, then decides whether to commit it to a user or abstain. Across four non-reasoning models, prompt framings, and confidence formats, verbal confidence predicted the commit/abstain decision substantially better than whether the answer was correct. Calibrated token log-probabilities showed the opposite profile, with abstention-prediction coupled to correctness discrimination, the signature of an answer-evidence signal. After removing the variance verbal confidence shared with log-probabilities, the residual stayed aligned with commitment while its link to correctness fell to near chance. The dissociation generalised to four reasoning models across four benchmarks of varying difficulty, from hard multiple-choice to frontier-level freeform questions. Mechanistic analyses in Gemma 3 and 4 were convergent: a post-answer state known to causally support verbal-confidence generation already encoded the future abstention decision before the abstention prompt, organised mainly by that decision rather than by correctness, the two lying in approximately orthogonal directions in activation space. Steering along a verbal-confidence-specific direction causally shifted abstention. Verbal and log-probability confidence are thus not interchangeable: log-probabilities track answer evidence and correctness, whereas verbal confidence is better understood as a behaviour-facing readout of an internal commit-readiness state, challenging the practice of treating verbal reports as proxies for reliability.

AI.title_translation: 报告显示：大语言模型的置信度更多反映了“承诺”而非“正确性”
AI.tldr: 大语言模型的口头置信度并不代表答案的正确性，它其实是模型内部“是否愿意提交答案”的行为信号。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究大语言模型中常见的“口头置信度报告”是否真正代表了模型对回答正确性的估计，或者其背后是否存在其他驱动机制。
AI.method: 采用了源自神经科学决策研究的“两阶段弃权范式”，对比了口头置信度与标记对数概率（token log-probabilities）在预测模型弃权行为上的表现；并利用激活空间分析和因果干预技术研究了Gemma模型内部的机制。
AI.result: 研究发现口头置信度在预测模型是否提交回答（弃权决策）方面表现优异，但与回答的正确性关联极弱；相比之下，标记对数概率与正确性紧密相关。机制分析表明，口头置信度反映的是模型内部的“承诺就绪”状态，而非对证据的理性评估。
AI.conclusion: 口头置信度并不是衡量模型回答正确性的可靠指标，它更多地反映了模型内部的“承诺就绪”状态。开发者在评估模型可靠性时，应区分口头置信度与基于概率的置信度。
AI.translation: 置信度是对所选答案正确的概率估计。口头置信度报告被广泛用作大语言模型的不确定性度量，但其是否能被理解为正确性的估计尚不清楚。我们利用源自感知决策神经科学的“两阶段弃权范式”进行了测试：模型首先回答并报告其置信度，然后决定是将答案提交给用户还是弃权。在四种非推理模型、多种提示词框架和置信度格式下，口头置信度在预测提交/弃权决策方面远优于预测答案正确性。校准后的标记对数概率表现出相反的特征，其弃权预测与正确性判别紧密耦合，这是答案证据信号的标志。在去除口头置信度与对数概率共享的方差后，剩余部分仍与提交决策保持一致，而其与正确性的联系降至接近随机水平。这种解离在四个推理模型和四个难度各异的基准测试（从困难的多项选择题到前沿水平的自由回答问题）中均得到了推广。在Gemma 3和4中的机制分析得出了趋同的结论：已知对口头置信度生成有因果支持作用的回答后状态，在弃权提示之前就已经编码了未来的弃权决策，且主要由该决策而非正确性组织，两者在激活空间中大致处于正交方向。沿着口头置信度特定方向的引导因果性地改变了弃权决策。因此，口头置信度和对数概率置信度不可互换：对数概率追踪答案证据和正确性，而口头置信度最好被理解为内部“承诺就绪”状态的行为导向读数，这挑战了将口头报告作为可靠性代理指标的做法。
AI.summary: 本文通过两阶段弃权范式和机制分析，揭示了大型语言模型的口头置信度报告主要反映了模型的内部“承诺状态”，而非对回答正确性的准确评估。研究表明，口头置信度与标记对数概率存在显著差异，前者在预测弃权行为上表现更好，而后者更适合作为正确性证据的指标。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 置信度报告, 承诺决策, 不确定性估计, 神经科学范式
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了大型语言模型中“口头置信度”与“正确性”之间存在本质脱节，这是一个重要的发现，挑战了目前将用户可读的置信度评分作为模型可靠性指标的普遍做法。其局限性在于主要通过特定的实验范式得出结论，未来需进一步探讨如何将这种“承诺状态”与实际正确性更紧密地结合。

title: Faults in Our Formal Benchmarking: Dataset Defects and Evaluation Failures in Lean Theorem Proving
summary: Benchmarks for LLM-assisted theorem proving in Lean are often treated as intrinsically reliable because every solved instance comes with a machine-checked proof. However, the kernel only checks that a proof establishes a \emph{formal} statement; it does not verify that the statement faithfully encodes the intended informal problem, nor that evaluation harnesses are robust to trivial or adversarial solutions. We audit five widely used Lean theorem-proving benchmarks and their forks, using corpus-scale static checkers to surface 4,833 findings, including 398 mechanically certified issues such as counterexamples, vacuous theorems, and unsound axioms. We also document semantic defects such as missing hypotheses, problem simplification, incomplete or incorrect translations, and Lean-specific specification hazards. Beyond dataset construction, we survey evaluation-time failure modes and show, on corrected subsets, that defects can both inflate and deflate reported prover scores. We propose a fault taxonomy, a suite of automated checkers and recall-oriented semantic audit prompts, and release standards to guide the creation of formal math datasets and to make evaluation more reproducible and trustworthy. Our checkers, audit prompts, and corrected dataset snapshots are available at https://github.com/Shashi456/atp-checkers.

title: VCS-SLAM: Geometry-Validated Semantic Evidence Fusion for 3D Gaussian SLAM
summary: Visual SLAM performance often deteriorates in complex real-world applications. Semantic 3D Gaussian SLAM commonly fuses 2D semantic priors into a persistent 3D map using uniform optimization weights. However, such priors are not equally reliable in online mapping: occlusions, unsupported semantic boundaries, and ambiguous ray geometry can introduce persistent semantic artifacts into the global Gaussian map. We propose VCS-SLAM, a geometry-validated semantic evidence fusion framework for RGB-D 3D Gaussian SLAM. Instead of treating all semantic observations as uniformly valid supervision, VCS-SLAM evaluates their geometric reliability through visibility consistency, surface-supported boundary evidence, and ray-level conflict uncertainty. The resulting reliability-aware objective suppresses occluded semantic updates, reduces unsupported semantic bleeding, and delays premature label assignment in ambiguous regions. Experiments on Replica demonstrate improved semantic consistency, boundary preservation, and reconstruction quality. Results on ScanNet further show that VCS-SLAM maintains competitive tracking performance under real RGB-D inputs

AI.title_translation: VCS-SLAM：用于3D高斯SLAM的几何验证语义证据融合方法
AI.tldr: VCS-SLAM通过几何可靠性评估优化语义融合，解决了3D高斯SLAM中语义伪影和边界模糊的问题，显著提升了地图质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的语义3D高斯SLAM在处理遮挡、语义边界不明确及射线几何模糊时，由于统一的权重分配，容易在全局地图中引入持久的语义伪影。
AI.method: 提出了一种几何验证语义证据融合框架，通过可视性一致性、表面支持的边界证据和射线级冲突不确定性来评估语义观测的可靠性，并据此调整优化目标。
AI.result: 在Replica数据集上实现了更好的语义一致性、边界保持和重建质量；在ScanNet数据集上验证了其在真实RGB-D输入下的竞争性追踪性能。
AI.conclusion: VCS-SLAM通过几何验证策略显著提升了语义3D高斯SLAM在复杂场景下的鲁棒性、边界清晰度和重建质量。
AI.translation: 视觉SLAM在复杂现实应用中性能往往会下降。语义3D高斯SLAM通常使用统一的优化权重将2D语义先验融合到持久的3D地图中。然而，这些先验在在线建图中的可靠性并不一致：遮挡、不支持的语义边界以及模糊的射线几何可能会将持久的语义伪影引入全局高斯地图。我们提出了VCS-SLAM，这是一个用于RGB-D 3D高斯SLAM的几何验证语义证据融合框架。VCS-SLAM不再将所有语义观测视为统一有效的监督，而是通过可视性一致性、表面支持的边界证据和射线级冲突不确定性来评估它们的几何可靠性。由此产生的感知可靠性的目标函数抑制了被遮挡的语义更新，减少了不支持的语义溢出，并延迟了模糊区域中过早的标签分配。在Replica上的实验证明了其在语义一致性、边界保持和重建质量方面的提升。在ScanNet上的结果进一步表明，VCS-SLAM在真实RGB-D输入下保持了具有竞争力的追踪性能。
AI.summary: VCS-SLAM是一种针对RGB-D 3D高斯SLAM的几何验证语义证据融合框架，通过评估语义观测的几何可靠性来优化更新过程，从而减少伪影并提高重建精度。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯SLAM, 语义融合, 几何验证, 鲁棒性, 场景重建
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入几何验证机制解决了语义3D高斯SLAM中语义先验不可靠的问题，创新性地将几何一致性与语义更新相结合，有效提升了语义分割精度和地图重建质量，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Cognitive World Models for Process-Level Social Influence Evaluation
summary: Social influence dialogue changes user behavior by altering internal cognitive states. The central evaluation question is whether the user's beliefs, desires, intentions, and emotions measurably change over the course of conversation, a process-oriented criterion that neither surface-level text metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) nor single-score LLM judgments can capture. We propose the \textbf{Cog}nitive \textbf{W}orld \textbf{M}odel \textbf{(CogWM)}, an LLM-based user model that reframes multi-turn dialogue evaluation from ``what did the user say'' to ``how did the user's internal cognitive state evolves.'' CogWM jointly predicts BDI/E cognitive states and user utterances and serves as both a user simulator and an evaluation platform, using a three-tier evaluation framework that covers turn-level fidelity, trajectory-level state dynamics, and task-level composite scoring. Trained via our \textbf{S}ummarize-\textbf{a}nd-\textbf{A}llocate \textbf{(SaA)} annotation pipeline on 150,454 user-turn samples across four social influence scenarios, CogWM achieves 77.6\% emotion accuracy (2.1$\times$ over GPT-5.5). In 3600 multi-agent discrimination trials, it distinguishes six commercial agents by their cognitive influence, with Llama-4-Scout ranking first (CTS +0.233). CogWM moves social influence dialogue evaluation from terminal judgment to process tracking. We have released our code\footnote{\scriptsize Code: https://github.com/lucianma05-create/CogWM} and models\footnote{Model: https://www.modelscope.cn/models/LucianMa/CogWM-14B}.

AI.title_translation: 用于过程级社交影响评估的认知世界模型
AI.tldr: CogWM通过追踪对话中用户内在认知状态（信念、欲望、意图、情感）的演变，而非仅仅关注话语本身，实现了对社交影响对话更深入、更准确的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估指标（如BLEU/ROUGE或单一LLM评分）无法捕捉社交影响对话中用户内在认知状态（信念、欲望、意图、情感）的动态演变过程。
AI.method: 提出了CogWM（认知世界模型），通过SaA（总结与分配）标注流程进行训练，能够联合预测BDI/E认知状态与用户话语，并采用包含转折级保真度、轨迹级状态动态和任务级综合评分的三层评估框架。
AI.result: CogWM在情感准确率上达到77.6%（是GPT-5.5的2.1倍），并在3600次多智能体辨别试验中成功区分了不同商业代理的认知影响力。
AI.conclusion: CogWM成功将社交影响对话评估从终点评价转变为过程追踪，证明了基于认知状态演变进行评估的可行性与优越性。
AI.translation: 社交影响对话通过改变内部认知状态来改变用户行为。核心评估问题是用户的信念、欲望、意图和情感在对话过程中是否发生了可测量的变化，这是一个表面文本指标（BLEU/ROUGE）和单一分数LLM判断都无法捕捉的过程导向标准。我们提出了认知世界模型（CogWM），这是一个基于LLM的用户模型，将多轮对话评估从“用户说了什么”重构为“用户的内部认知状态如何演变”。CogWM联合预测BDI/E认知状态和用户话语，并充当用户模拟器和评估平台，使用涵盖转折级保真度、轨迹级状态动态和任务级综合评分的三层评估框架。通过我们的总结与分配（SaA）标注流程在四个社交影响场景的150,454个用户转折样本上进行训练，CogWM实现了77.6%的情感准确率（是GPT-5.5的2.1倍）。在3600次多智能体辨别试验中，它通过认知影响力区分了六个商业代理，其中Llama-4-Scout排名第一（CTS +0.233）。CogWM将社交影响对话评估从终点判断转向过程追踪。我们已发布代码和模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CogWM模型，旨在通过追踪对话过程中用户内在认知状态（BDI/E）的变化来评估社交影响对话。该模型联合预测状态与话语，通过三层评估框架实现过程化分析，并在实验中展现出优于现有评估方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 认知世界模型, 社交影响, 对话评估, BDI/E状态, 用户模拟
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将社交影响对话的评估从关注表面文本转向关注用户内在认知状态的演变。通过构建CogWM模型，不仅实现了对BDI/E（信念、欲望、意图/情感）状态的建模，还提供了一个多维度的评估框架，弥补了传统文本指标的不足。其局限性可能在于对复杂心理状态建模的准确性仍受限于LLM的能力，且在不同文化背景下的泛化性有待验证。

title: Rectifying Mask via Entropy for Distractor-Free 3DGS in Ambiguous Scenarios
summary: We present RefineSplat, a systematic framework that effectively constructs transient masks to identify diverse ambiguous distractors. To do this, we qualitatively and quantitatively analyze issues and propose a novel entropy-aware adaptive masking method. Unlike existing approaches that struggle to distinguish transient elements from static scenes due to color or semantic ambiguity, RefineSplat captures ambiguous distractors leveraging entropy and instance masks. Furthermore, we propose a simple yet effective entropy-aware density control to align Gaussians in ambiguous scenarios considering Entropy-aware positional gradients. Additionally, to rigorously validate our method, we first create and release the Ambiguous wild dataset, including 18 scenes where distractors and static scenes are hard to distinguish due to color or semantic resemblances. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that RefineSplat shows state-of-the-art performance, showing distractor-free novel view synthesis.

AI.title_translation: 基于熵修正掩码的模糊场景下无干扰3D高斯喷洒方法
AI.tldr: RefineSplat通过引入熵感知掩码和密度控制，解决了3DGS在模糊场景中难以区分干扰项的问题，实现了更高质量的场景渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有的3DGS方法在处理与静态场景颜色或语义相似的瞬态干扰项时效果不佳，难以在模糊场景中实现高质量的新视角合成。
AI.method: 提出RefineSplat框架，利用熵和实例掩码构建瞬态掩码，并结合熵感知密度控制来调整高斯分布，以处理颜色或语义模糊的干扰项。
AI.result: 实验表明，RefineSplat在多个数据集上表现出最先进的性能，成功实现了无干扰的新视角合成，并发布了包含18个模糊场景的Ambiguous wild数据集。
AI.conclusion: RefineSplat通过熵感知掩码和密度控制策略，有效解决了3DGS在模糊场景中难以区分干扰项的问题，实现了高质量的无干扰新视角合成。
AI.translation: 我们提出了RefineSplat，这是一个通过构建瞬态掩码来识别多样化模糊干扰项的系统框架。为此，我们通过定性和定量分析，提出了一种新颖的熵感知自适应掩码方法。与现有方法在区分颜色或语义模糊的瞬态元素与静态场景时遇到的困难不同，RefineSplat利用熵和实例掩码捕获这些模糊干扰项。此外，我们提出了一种简单有效的熵感知密度控制方法，通过考虑熵感知位置梯度来对齐模糊场景中的高斯分布。为了严格验证我们的方法，我们创建并发布了Ambiguous wild数据集，其中包含18个因颜色或语义相似而难以区分干扰项与静态场景的场景。在各种数据集上的实验结果表明，RefineSplat表现出最先进的性能，实现了无干扰的新视角合成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RefineSplat框架，通过熵感知自适应掩码和密度控制技术，有效从3D高斯喷洒模型中剔除模糊场景下的瞬态干扰项，并发布了专门的Ambiguous wild数据集用于验证。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯喷洒, 干扰项剔除, 熵感知, 模糊场景, 新视角合成
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地引入了熵（Entropy）来解决3D高斯喷洒（3DGS）在处理颜色或语义模糊场景时的干扰项剔除难题。通过结合熵感知自适应掩码和密度控制，显著提升了复杂场景下的视图合成质量。此外，作者构建并开源了Ambiguous wild数据集，为该领域提供了重要的基准测试。

title: Position-Aware Target Speaker Extraction for Long-Form Multi-Party Conversations: A Diarization-Free Framework for ASR
summary: In long-form multi-party conversations, highly imbalanced speaker activity and frequent overlap make it difficult to identify "who spoke when and what". Sliding-window continuous speech separation (CSS) mitigates sparse supervision, but often suffers from cross-window speaker inconsistency and residual crosstalk, which in practice requires diarization for reliable speaker attribution. Motivated by the stability of speakers' directions of arrival (DOAs) in meetings, we propose PATSE, a multi-channel Position-Aware Target Speaker Extraction front-end that uses DOA as a spatial prior to directly extract the speech of each target speaker. PATSE combines a DOA-guided spatial encoder and conditioner to generate speaker-attributed streams, from which speaker activity can be inferred via simple post-processing (e.g., VAD) without explicit diarization. Experiments on both replayed and real conversations show consistent ASR gains outperforming CSS and diarization-based pipelines.

AI.title_translation: 面向长篇多方对话的位置感知目标说话人提取：一种无需说话人日志的ASR框架
AI.tldr: 通过利用空间DOA信息作为先验，PATSE框架无需复杂的说话人日志即可直接提取长篇多方对话中特定说话人的语音，显著提升了ASR性能。
AI.motivation: 长篇多方对话中说话人活动极度不平衡且重叠频繁，现有的连续语音分离（CSS）方法存在跨窗口不一致和残留串扰问题，且通常依赖复杂的说话人日志系统。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为PATSE的框架，利用到达方向（DOA）作为空间先验，结合DOA引导的空间编码器和调节器，直接从多通道输入中提取各目标说话人的语音流，并通过简单的VAD即可推断说话人活动。
AI.result: 在回放和真实对话数据集上的实验表明，PATSE在ASR性能上优于传统的CSS和基于日志的流水线方法。
AI.conclusion: PATSE框架通过引入DOA空间先验，成功实现了无需显式日志的说话人提取，在长篇多方对话任务中展现了优于传统CSS和日志辅助方案的性能。
AI.translation: 在长篇多方对话中，高度不平衡的说话人活动和频繁的重叠使得识别“谁在何时说了什么”变得困难。滑动窗口连续语音分离（CSS）缓解了稀疏监督问题，但往往遭受跨窗口说话人不一致和残留串扰的困扰，在实践中通常需要说话人日志（Diarization）来实现可靠的说话人归属。受会议中说话人到达方向（DOA）稳定性的启发，我们提出了PATSE，一种多通道位置感知目标说话人提取前端，利用DOA作为空间先验直接提取每个目标说话人的语音。PATSE结合了DOA引导的空间编码器和调节器来生成带说话人属性的音频流，从中可以通过简单的后处理（如VAD）推断说话人活动，而无需显式的说话人日志。在回放和真实对话上的实验表明，其ASR性能持续优于CSS和基于日志的流水线。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PATSE的面向长篇多方对话的目标说话人提取框架。该方法利用说话人到达方向（DOA）作为空间先验，通过空间编码器和调节器直接提取特定说话人的语音，从而避免了对复杂说话人日志系统的依赖，有效解决了长对话中说话人活动不平衡和重叠带来的识别难题。
AI.keywords: 目标说话人提取, 空间先验, 说话人日志, 语音识别, 多通道处理
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用空间信息（DOA）作为先验，巧妙地跳过了传统方法中复杂且容易出错的说话人日志（Diarization）步骤，直接生成带说话人属性的语音流，为长篇多方对话场景下的ASR提供了一种高效、鲁棒的新思路。

title: Learning Where and When: Patch-Based Spatiotemporal Localization in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD) has predominantly focused on temporal localization, identifying when anomalies occur while largely neglecting their spatial extent within frames. Yet, spatial localization is essential for interpretability and practical deployment in real-world settings. We introduce a patch-based spatiotemporal framework for weakly supervised anomaly localization that jointly models where and when anomalies occur. Our approach operates on grid-level patch features and learns region-level anomaly scores under a multiple instance learning paradigm. We further propose a Proximity-Aware Top-k spatiotemporal selection strategy that enables the model to generate fine-grained spatial anomaly maps without requiring bounding-box supervision during training. Our method surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches across multiple benchmarks, yielding substantial gains in spatiotemporal localization accuracy. In addition, we release frame-level bounding-box annotations for the test sets of two widely used datasets, along with our code and pretrained models, providing new resources to facilitate future research in spatially grounded WSVAD.

AI.title_translation: 学习“何处”与“何时”：弱监督视频异常检测中的基于补丁的时空定位
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需边界框标注的新型时空框架，通过多示例学习和补丁级特征分析，实现了弱监督视频异常的精准时空定位。
AI.motivation: 现有的弱监督视频异常检测主要关注时间定位，忽略了空间定位，这限制了模型在实际应用中的可解释性和部署能力。
AI.method: 提出一种基于补丁（patch-based）的时空框架，在多示例学习范式下联合建模时空异常；引入“邻近感知Top-k（Proximity-Aware Top-k）”时空选择策略，实现无需边界框监督的细粒度空间定位。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中超越了现有的最先进方法，并在时空定位准确率上取得了显著提升；同时发布了两个数据集的帧级边界框标注，为领域研究提供了新资源。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的时空定位框架能够有效解决弱监督视频异常检测中空间信息缺失的问题，显著提升了时空定位的准确性。
AI.translation: 弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）主要集中在时间定位上，即识别异常发生的时间，而很大程度上忽略了它们在帧内的空间范围。然而，空间定位对于实际应用中的可解释性和部署至关重要。我们引入了一种基于补丁的时空框架，用于弱监督异常定位，联合建模异常发生的位置和时间。我们的方法基于网格级补丁特征，并在多示例学习范式下学习区域级异常分数。我们进一步提出了一种邻近感知Top-k时空选择策略，使模型能够在训练过程中无需边界框监督的情况下生成细粒度的空间异常图。我们的方法在多个基准测试中超越了现有的最先进方法，在时空定位准确性方面取得了显著提升。此外，我们还发布了两个广泛使用的数据集的测试集帧级边界框标注，以及我们的代码和预训练模型，为促进空间基础的WSVAD研究提供了新资源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于补丁的时空弱监督视频异常检测框架，通过联合建模异常发生的时间和空间位置，配合邻近感知Top-k选择策略，在缺乏空间标注的情况下实现了精确的异常定位，并显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 弱监督视频异常检测, 时空定位, 多示例学习, 补丁特征, 异常可解释性
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入基于补丁（patch-based）的框架，成功将弱监督视频异常检测从单纯的时间定位扩展到了时空定位，并在无需边界框监督的情况下实现了细粒度的空间定位，这对提高异常检测的可解释性和实际应用价值具有重要意义。

title: Learning Transferable Dynamics Priors from Action to World Modeling
summary: We study action-conditioned world modeling as a scalable way to learn transferable dynamics priors for robot learning. By pretraining a model to predict how actions drive visual scene evolution, the resulting world model captures reusable interaction dynamics beyond appearance-level video generation. Concretely, we pretrain a multi-view interactive base diffusion world model, A2World, on large-scale robot manipulation data with real action annotations. We validate the learned dynamics priors from two complementary perspectives. First, we adapt A2World into a task- or scene-specialized real-world simulator, A2World-sim, whose long-horizon rollouts support simulator-based policy evaluation and scalable what-if analysis by replacing real-robot rollouts with world model rollouts. Second, starting from the same pretrained weights, we adapt A2World into a video-action joint prediction model, A2World-policy, that predicts actions under visual and instruction conditioning. Experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-robot settings demonstrate that action-conditioned world model pretraining yields transferable dynamics priors that benefit both simulator-centric and policy-centric robot learning.

title: UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation
summary: Skill memories can improve agentic reinforcement learning by reusing past experience as textual guidance, but retrieved skills are not oracular: they may help in one state while misleading the same policy in another. This makes the common privileged-teacher assumption fragile, namely that a skill-conditioned prompt can be treated as a fixed teacher for the no-skill prompt.
