We introduce UCOB, a framework for learning to utilize and evolve agentic skills via credit-aware on-policy bidirectional self-distillation. UCOB treats skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts as two on-policy context views of the same model, compares their return-to-go within the same task and anchor state, and uses the higher-return view as the local teacher. This local credit signal internalizes useful skill-conditioned behavior, corrects misleading skill usage, and guides task/state skill memory updates, utility-aware retrieval, and reflection self-training. Experiments on agentic tasks, including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, show that UCOB outperforms skill-free RL, skill-memory baselines, and self-distillation methods across model scales, with up to 23.5 and 18.0 point gains over SOTA baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop. Ablations and analyses further validate its core mechanisms and efficiency.

title: The Verbose Context Problem in Medical Records
summary: The verbose context problem occurs when structured concepts have token-inefficient textual representations. This bottleneck is acute in population health: cohort-level analysis of longitudinal patient records requires reasoning over thousands of medically-coded events, often exceeding 400K tokens in total. We present PopMedQA, a benchmark isolating this problem through computational tasks on groups of longitudinal patient records. We construct the benchmark using neopatient, a new library for language-controlled generation of artificial patient records. Through extensive ablations -- including prompting strategies, prompt compression, and agentic decomposition -- we find that domain-independent methods fail to alleviate the verbose context problem. There remains significant opportunity to exploit domain-specific structure in language model inputs for population-scale reasoning.

title: Empirical Evaluation of Multi-Modal Touch Detection in Over-the-Shoulder Video Surveillance
summary: Video Intelligence Surveillance (VIDINT) on over-the-shoulder footage is a proposed vector for monitoring human-computer interaction patterns without direct screen recording access. In this paper, we evaluate a Behavioral Intelligence (BEHINT) touch-detection framework designed to reconstruct keystroke events on mobile keypad interfaces from physical finger interactions. Our system integrates four parallel detection modalities: (1) anatomical hand landmarks via MediaPipe, (2) HSV skin color filtering, (3) temporal frame differencing for motion detection, and (4) shape-guided Canny edge analysis. We map relative touch coordinates to a reference screen layout to reconstruct typing sequences. Evaluation on a 120-frame first-person staged video of passcode entry reveals that while MediaPipe and Skin Detection fail to run autonomously due to partial hand occlusion and ambient noise, Motion-Only and Edge-Only configurations achieve F1-scores of 18.5% and 18.2%, respectively. The combined multi-modal configuration achieves an F1-score of 16.7% and a sequence similarity of 3.0% when mapped to the iOS passcode layout. We conduct ablation, resolution decay, noise sensitivity, and proximity threshold tuning to characterize the system's operational envelope. We then audit generalization on 5 real, publicly licensed third-person phone videos and find that the detector emits a median of 57 touch points per frame (peaking at 205), one to three orders of magnitude more than the rate of real taps, because the skin filter responds to the whole hand rather than to fingertip contact. The staged keystroke result does not survive contact with uncontrolled footage; the system does not achieve reliable keystroke reconstruction outside the calibrated staged setting.

AI.title_translation: 过肩视频监控中多模态触摸检测的实证评估
AI.tldr: 研究表明，利用过肩视频通过多模态视觉分析重建手机按键输入在实际环境中效果极差，存在严重的误报问题。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索在无法直接获取屏幕录制权限的情况下，通过分析过肩视频监控中的人机交互行为，实现对移动设备按键输入的远程重建。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为BEHINT的框架，集成四种并行检测模态：MediaPipe解剖手部标志、HSV肤色过滤、时间帧差分运动检测以及基于形状引导的Canny边缘分析，并将相对坐标映射至键盘布局。
AI.result: 在受控视频中，单一模态（运动、边缘）表现优于多模态组合；在真实场景中，系统产生大量误报，检测出的触摸点数量远超实际点击频率，无法实现可靠的按键重建。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态触摸检测系统在受控环境下表现有限，且无法在非受控的真实场景中实现可靠的按键重建，主要受限于皮肤检测对整个手部的误识别以及环境干扰。
AI.translation: 视频智能监控（VIDINT）被提出作为一种在无法直接获取屏幕录制权限的情况下，监测人机交互模式的手段。在本文中，我们评估了一个行为智能（BEHINT）触摸检测框架，旨在从物理手指交互中重建移动键盘接口上的按键事件。我们的系统集成了四种并行检测模态：（1）通过MediaPipe获取解剖手部标志，（2）HSV肤色过滤，（3）用于运动检测的时间帧差分，以及（4）形状引导的Canny边缘分析。我们将相对触摸坐标映射到参考屏幕布局以重建输入序列。对120帧第一人称密码输入阶段视频的评估显示，虽然MediaPipe和皮肤检测因手部遮挡和环境噪声无法自主运行，但仅运动和仅边缘配置分别达到了18.5%和18.2%的F1分数。多模态组合配置在映射到iOS密码布局时，达到了16.7%的F1分数和3.0%的序列相似度。我们进行了消融实验、分辨率衰减、噪声敏感性和接近阈值调整，以表征系统的运行包络。随后，我们审计了其在5段真实的、公开授权的第三人称手机视频上的泛化能力，发现该检测器每帧平均产生57个触摸点（峰值205个），比实际点击率高出1到3个数量级，因为皮肤过滤器响应的是整个手部而非指尖接触。阶段性的按键结果在非受控视频中无法维持，该系统在校准的阶段性设置之外无法实现可靠的按键重建。
AI.summary: 本文评估了一个旨在通过过肩视频监控重建移动设备按键输入的BEHINT框架。通过集成多种视觉模态，研究发现该系统在受控环境下表现不佳，且在真实非受控视频中因无法区分手指接触与手部整体运动而导致大量误报，未能实现可靠的按键检测。
AI.keywords: 视频监控, 触摸检测, 行为智能, 多模态分析, 计算机视觉
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证分析揭示了在非受控视频监控环境下，基于视觉的按键检测技术面临的严峻挑战。其重要贡献在于明确了现有方法在处理遮挡、噪声和泛化能力上的不足，为后续研究提供了明确的性能基准和局限性参考。

title: Benchmark AUC Is Not Deployable Reliability: A Cross-Dataset Audit of Off-the-Shelf Features for Surveillance Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Automated "suspicious behavior" flagging is a headline promise of AI surveillance, and the field reports high frame-level ROC-AUC on standard video anomaly detection benchmarks. Those numbers are measured by training and testing on the same camera and scene. We audit what happens when that assumption is dropped. We build an unsupervised normality model from the all-normal training frames of one dataset, using frozen off-the-shelf embeddings (CLIP, DINOv2, ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B0) and a nearest-neighbour distance, and score the test frames of the same and of other datasets. Across 4 real datasets (UCSD Ped1, UCSD Ped2, CUHK Avenue, ShanghaiTech) and 4 backbones, same-dataset AUC averages 0.704 but cross-dataset AUC averages 0.499, which is chance: a detector calibrated on one scene is no better than a coin flip on another, and in several pairs it is below chance. The strongest backbone makes this worse, not better: DINOv2 has the best same-dataset AUC (up to 0.901 on Ped2) and the largest cross-dataset drop. The collapse is not an artefact of the scoring rule: replacing the nearest-neighbour detector with a PaDiM-style Mahalanobis detector reproduces it almost exactly (cross-dataset gap 0.202 versus 0.208). Even at a favourable operating point the false-alarm rate is on the order of 31,931 per hour. We conclude that the benchmark numbers quoted for surveillance anomaly detection describe a calibrated laboratory setting and overstate deployable reliability by a wide margin, and we release the code that reproduces every number.

AI.title_translation: 基准AUC不等同于可部署的可靠性：对监控视频异常检测现成特征的跨数据集审计
AI.tldr: 视频异常检测在实验室基准测试中表现优异，但在实际跨场景部署时性能会跌至随机水平，现有的高AUC指标严重夸大了模型的实用可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前视频异常检测领域在单一场景数据集上表现出极高的ROC-AUC，但这种评估方式忽略了模型在不同场景下的泛化能力，作者旨在审计这种评估指标在实际部署环境中的真实可靠性。
AI.method: 构建了一个无监督正态性模型，利用冻结的预训练特征提取器（CLIP、DINOv2、ResNet-50、EfficientNet-B0）提取特征，并结合最近邻距离或PaDiM式马氏距离作为评分规则，在4个真实数据集上进行跨数据集测试。
AI.result: 在跨数据集测试中，平均AUC从同数据集的0.704下降至0.499（随机水平），甚至在某些场景下低于随机水平。更强的骨干网络（如DINOv2）反而导致了更严重的性能跌落，且误报率极高，达到每小时约31,931次。
AI.conclusion: 现有的视频异常检测基准测试结果仅反映了实验室环境下的校准性能，严重高估了其实际部署时的可靠性，且性能下降与特征提取器的强弱无关。
AI.translation: 自动标记“可疑行为”是人工智能监控领域的一个核心承诺，该领域在标准的视频异常检测基准测试中报告了较高的帧级ROC-AUC。这些数字是通过在同一摄像机和场景中进行训练和测试来衡量的。我们审计了当放弃这一假设时会发生什么。我们利用一个数据集的所有正常训练帧，使用冻结的现成嵌入（CLIP、DINOv2、ResNet-50、EfficientNet-B0）和最近邻距离构建了一个无监督的正态性模型，并对相同数据集和其他数据集的测试帧进行评分。在4个真实数据集（UCSD Ped1、UCSD Ped2、CUHK Avenue、ShanghaiTech）和4种骨干网络上，同数据集的平均AUC为0.704，但跨数据集的平均AUC为0.499，即随机水平：在一个场景中校准的检测器在另一个场景中并不比抛硬币好，在几对数据集的测试中甚至低于随机水平。最强的骨干网络使情况变得更糟，而不是更好：DINOv2在同数据集上的AUC最好（在Ped2上高达0.901），但跨数据集的下降幅度也最大。这种崩溃并非评分规则的产物：用PaDiM式的马氏距离检测器替换最近邻检测器几乎完全重现了这一结果（跨数据集差距为0.202对0.208）。即使在有利的操作点，误报率也达到了每小时31,931次。我们得出结论，监控异常检测中引用的基准数字描述的是一个经过校准的实验室环境，并大幅高估了可部署的可靠性，我们发布了可以重现每个数字的代码。
AI.summary: 本文审计了视频异常检测中基于预训练特征的无监督模型性能。研究发现，在同数据集上表现良好的模型在跨数据集场景下性能会崩溃至随机水平。这表明现有的基准测试指标无法衡量模型在实际监控部署中的真实可靠性。
AI.keywords: 视频异常检测, 跨数据集审计, AUC, 模型可靠性, 无监督学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过严谨的跨数据集实验，揭示了当前视频异常检测领域存在严重的“过拟合”问题。其创新点在于挑战了基于单一场景基准测试的评估模式，指出高AUC指标并不能代表实际部署中的可靠性，这对AI监控系统的落地评估具有重要的警示意义。

title: Reinforcement Learning in Super Mario Bros: Curriculum, Pedagogy, and Optimal Level Design in World 1-1
summary: World 1-1 of Super Mario Bros is widely celebrated as a masterclass in game design: its progressive structure is credited with teaching players core mechanics through the level itself. We ask whether that structure is empirically measurable using reinforcement learning. We implement World 1-1 from scratch as a fully discrete environment and compare four algorithms -- Q-Learning, SARSA, Monte Carlo, and Deep Q-Network (DQN) -- across three progressively complex versions of the same level. Monte Carlo emerges as the strongest agent (94.9% $\pm$ 1.5% win rate), outperforming DQN (76.4% $\pm$ 3.4%) by learning to maximize intermediate rewards along winning paths rather than taking the most direct route. We then use Monte Carlo in a curriculum experiment permuting World 1-1's six canonical segments across twelve conditions. Canonical ordering converges fastest, achieves the highest learning efficiency, and is the only condition with zero catastrophic failures; no random permutation matches all three criteria simultaneously. These results provide, to the best of our knowledge, the first empirical validation that World 1-1's canonical design encodes genuine pedagogical structure: one that measurably accelerates learning and cannot be replicated by chance.

AI.title_translation: 《超级马力欧兄弟》中的强化学习：1-1关卡的课程、教学法与最优关卡设计
AI.tldr: 研究证实《超级马力欧兄弟》1-1关卡的经典设计确实具有能够显著加速智能体学习的教学结构，且无法通过随机排列轻易复制。
AI.motivation: 探究《超级马力欧兄弟》1-1关卡被公认为“教学典范”的结构设计是否可以通过强化学习进行实证测量。
AI.method: 将1-1关卡实现为离散环境，对比Q-Learning、SARSA、Monte Carlo和DQN四种算法，并通过排列关卡片段进行课程学习实验以验证教学结构。
AI.result: Monte Carlo算法表现最佳（胜率94.9%）；实验证实原始关卡顺序在学习效率、收敛速度和稳定性上均优于其他随机排列组合。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了《超级马力欧兄弟》1-1关卡的原始设计不仅是游戏设计的典范，更确实编码了一种能显著加速学习的教学结构。
AI.translation: 《超级马力欧兄弟》的1-1关卡被广泛誉为游戏设计的典范：其渐进式结构被认为能够通过关卡本身教授玩家核心机制。我们探究这种结构是否可以通过强化学习进行实证测量。我们从零开始将1-1关卡实现为一个完全离散的环境，并比较了四种算法（Q-Learning、SARSA、Monte Carlo和深度Q网络（DQN））在三个复杂度递增的关卡版本中的表现。Monte Carlo算法表现最强（胜率94.9% ± 1.5%），优于DQN（76.4% ± 3.4%），因为它学会了通过最大化获胜路径上的中间奖励，而不是采取最直接的路线。随后，我们在一个课程学习实验中使用Monte Carlo算法，将1-1关卡的六个典型片段在十二种条件下进行排列。结果显示，原始顺序收敛最快，学习效率最高，且是唯一没有发生灾难性失败的条件；没有任何随机排列能同时满足这三个标准。据我们所知，这些结果提供了首个实证验证，证明1-1关卡的经典设计编码了真正的教学结构：该结构可测量地加速学习，且无法偶然复制。
AI.summary: 本文通过强化学习评估《超级马力欧兄弟》1-1关卡的教学结构。通过对比多种算法，发现Monte Carlo算法表现最优；进一步的课程学习实验证明，原始关卡设计具有独特的教学优势，能有效提升智能体学习效率并避免失败。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 游戏设计, 课程学习, 超级马力欧兄弟, 教学结构
AI.comments: 本文通过强化学习方法，从实证角度验证了《超级马力欧兄弟》1-1关卡设计的教学价值。其创新之处在于将经典游戏设计理论与机器学习算法相结合，证明了原始关卡设计在促进智能体学习效率和稳定性方面的优越性。局限性在于研究仅限于单个关卡，未能讨论更复杂环境下的泛化能力。

title: Scenes as Objects, Not Primitives: Instance-Structured 3D Tokenization from Unposed Views
summary: A 3D scene is understood through its objects, not the primitives that compose them. Yet feed-forward reconstruction methods output dense, unstructured sets of points or Gaussians, leaving object-level structure to be recovered after the fact. We propose a feed-forward framework that decomposes a scene into instance-structured 3D token groups directly from unposed multi-view images -- compact object-centric units from which reconstruction, segmentation, and manipulation all follow. Each token group pairs an instance token capturing entity-level identity with anchor tokens that encode local geometry and appearance, which are decoded into a set of 3D Gaussians. This two-level factorization decouples object identity from local appearance, making object instances a native interface of the representation rather than a derived product. The token groups are learned through differentiable rendering with joint reconstruction and segmentation supervision, requiring no 3D annotations. Our feed-forward model surpasses per-scene optimization baselines in class-agnostic instance segmentation while remaining competitive in novel view synthesis. Beyond these metrics, the same token groups directly unlock instance-level scene editing -- removing, translating, or inserting objects by operating on their groups -- as well as efficient open-vocabulary 3D instance retrieval, where retrieval complexity scales with the number of instances rather than primitives.

title: A Mathematical Optimization Approach for Expert-Informed Bayesian Best Subset Selection
summary: A central challenge in statistical modeling is identifying the subset of features that belong in the true regression model. The classical best subset selection problem, recently made tractable via mixed-integer optimization (MIO), finds the globally optimal sparse solution. It does not, however, make use of any information beyond the observed data. In many applied settings, domain experts can meaningfully rank or score the relevance of candidate predictors, yet no existing framework integrates such probabilistic expert assessments directly into the best-subsets objective. This paper presents Expert-Implied Bayesian Best Subsets (EBBS), a method that incorporates domain-expert probability estimates of feature relevance into the MIO best-subsets problem through a maximum a posteriori (MAP) framework. Expert views from multiple respondents are aggregated into a single prior probability per feature using the Poisson binomial distribution for marginal probability estimates, the pairwise win rate for pairwise comparisons, or the normalized mean rank for ordinal rankings. This probability enters the objective function as a log-odds penalty term that smoothly encourages or discourages the selection of each feature consistent with the expert consensus. This paper provides analytic derivations of the MAP formulation and characterizes its theoretical properties. The proposed model reduces to Best Subsets when experts all have no views. Empirical results on synthetic and real datasets are forthcoming.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于专家信息驱动的贝叶斯最佳子集选择的数学优化方法
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将领域专家意见集成到最佳子集选择模型中的方法，通过数学优化手段提升特征选择的准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统的最佳子集选择问题仅基于观测数据，未能利用领域专家对特征重要性的先验知识，导致在某些应用场景下无法获得最优的解释模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“专家暗示贝叶斯最佳子集”（EBBS）的方法，通过最大后验概率（MAP）框架将专家对特征相关性的概率评估转化为目标函数中的对数几率惩罚项，并利用泊松二项分布等方法聚合多位专家的意见。
AI.result: 推导了MAP公式并描述了其理论性质；证明了当专家没有意见时，该模型可退化为传统的最佳子集选择模型；实证评估部分尚在进行中。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种将专家概率评估集成到MIO最佳子集选择中的EBBS框架，通过MAP估计实现了数据驱动与专家知识的有机融合，在理论上具备完备性，并能退化为传统的最佳子集选择模型。
AI.translation: 统计建模中的一个核心挑战是确定属于真实回归模型的特征子集。传统的最佳子集选择问题最近通过混合整数优化（MIO）变得可行，能够找到全局最优的稀疏解。然而，它除了观测数据外没有使用任何信息。在许多应用场景中，领域专家可以有意义地对候选预测变量的相关性进行排序或评分，但现有的框架没有将这种概率性的专家评估直接整合到最佳子集目标中。本文提出了专家暗示贝叶斯最佳子集（EBBS），这是一种通过最大后验概率（MAP）框架将领域专家的特征相关性概率估计纳入MIO最佳子集问题的方法。来自多位受访者的专家观点通过泊松二项分布（用于边际概率估计）、成对胜率（用于成对比较）或归一化平均秩（用于序数排序）聚合为每个特征的单一先验概率。该概率作为对数几率惩罚项进入目标函数，从而与专家共识一致地平滑地鼓励或阻止每个特征的选择。本文提供了MAP公式的解析推导并描述了其理论性质。当专家没有任何观点时，所提出的模型会简化为最佳子集模型。关于合成数据集和真实数据集的实证结果即将发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种专家暗示贝叶斯最佳子集（EBBS）方法，旨在将领域专家对特征相关性的评估整合到混合整数优化（MIO）模型中。通过最大后验概率框架，将专家意见转化为目标函数中的惩罚项，从而在数据分析中实现专家知识与观测数据的深度结合。
AI.keywords: 最佳子集选择, 混合整数优化, 贝叶斯推断, 专家知识整合, 特征选择
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的方法将领域专家知识与数学优化（MIO）相结合，解决了传统最佳子集选择仅依赖数据而忽略先验知识的局限性。其核心贡献在于利用对数几率惩罚项灵活地整合专家意见，具有很强的实际应用潜力。

title: CORE: Common Outcome Regularities from Action-Free Visual Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot imitation learning often relies on costly robot demonstrations, while abundant action-free visual demonstrations, such as human videos, are difficult to use because they lack robot-executable actions and suffer from embodiment gaps. We propose CORE, a policy learning framework that extracts Common Outcome Regularities from visual demonstrations. Rather than transferring explicit actions across embodiments, CORE exploits a key observation: although successful trajectories for the same task can be diverse, their terminal states often share stable object configurations, spatial relations, and contact constraints. CORE first trains a terminal outcome encoder with contrastive and auxiliary temporal objectives, then aggregates successful terminal embeddings into visual goal prototypes, and finally injects these prototypes as global goal conditions into robot policies. Compared with language instructions, visual goal prototypes provide more concrete geometric and physical constraints for task completion. Across Meta-World, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation, CORE improves the average success rate of the corresponding policy backbones by up to +3.9, +11.1, and +17.0 percentage points, respectively, and outperforms text-conditioned variants under the evaluated settings.

title: Harvesting AI Computation at the Edge via Generic Approximation
summary: With the widespread adoption of AI in various IoT scenarios such as smart sensing and processing, AI chips have become a common component at the edge. These chips are typically specialized for structured neural network (NN) processing and are designed to meet peak workload demands. However, they are often underutilized and suffer from considerable computational waste due to temporal or spatial redundancy in processing. Conversely, general-purpose processing engines at the edge may struggle with compute-intensive tasks such as signal processing and complex numerical operations because of stringent resource constraints. To address this imbalance, we propose a framework that harvests unused AI computation resources using general-purpose approximation techniques. The core idea is to automatically convert traditional computing tasks into neural network models via a representative neural architecture search (NAS) method. These approximate versions of general-purpose tasks are then deployed on AI engines during their idle periods. Specifically, we introduce a runtime scheduler that offloads these tasks to AI chips without compromising the performance of primary AI workloads, thereby alleviating the burden on general-purpose processors. Experiments on a representative AIoT processor show that our proposed AI computation harvesting strategy delivers substantial performance improvements across a set of edge processing tasks.

AI.title_translation: 通过通用近似技术回收边缘AI算力
AI.tldr: 通过NAS将通用任务转化为神经网络，在AI芯片闲置时处理这些任务，有效提升了边缘设备的资源利用率和性能。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备中AI芯片通常为峰值负载设计，导致大量闲置浪费；而通用处理器在处理计算密集型任务时受资源限制严重。旨在通过利用AI芯片的闲置算力来减轻通用处理器的负担。
AI.method: 提出一个自动化框架，利用神经架构搜索（NAS）将通用计算任务转换为神经网络模型，并配合一个运行时调度器，在不影响原始AI负载的前提下，将这些任务卸载到闲置的AI芯片上执行。
AI.result: 在典型的AIoT处理器上的实验表明，该策略能够显著提升多种边缘处理任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功证明了利用AI加速器处理通用计算任务的可行性，通过资源共享显著提升了边缘设备的整体计算效率。
AI.translation: 随着AI在智能感知和处理等各种物联网场景中的广泛应用，AI芯片已成为边缘端的通用组件。这些芯片通常专门用于结构化神经网络（NN）处理，旨在满足峰值工作负载需求。然而，由于处理中的时间和空间冗余，它们往往未被充分利用，造成了相当大的计算浪费。相反，由于严格的资源限制，边缘的通用处理引擎在处理信号处理和复杂数值运算等计算密集型任务时可能会感到吃力。为了解决这种失衡，我们提出了一个利用通用近似技术回收未使用的AI计算资源的框架。其核心思想是通过代表性的神经架构搜索（NAS）方法自动将传统计算任务转换为神经网络模型。这些通用任务的近似版本随后被部署在AI引擎的空闲期间。具体而言，我们引入了一个运行时调度器，在不影响主要AI工作负载性能的情况下将这些任务卸载到AI芯片上，从而减轻了通用处理器的负担。在代表性AIoT处理器上的实验表明，我们提出的AI计算回收策略在多项边缘处理任务中带来了显著的性能提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过通用近似技术回收边缘AI计算资源的方法。该框架利用神经架构搜索将传统计算任务自动转换为神经网络，并由运行时调度器将其部署在闲置的AI芯片上，从而在不影响主任务的前提下有效提升了边缘设备的整体处理能力。
AI.keywords: 边缘计算, AI加速器, 神经网络架构搜索, 资源调度, 近似计算
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的资源重用范式，将AI芯片的闲置算力转化为通用计算资源。其核心贡献在于利用NAS自动实现通用任务到神经网络的转换，有效缓解了边缘设备资源分配不均的问题。局限性在于该方法对特定任务的近似精度及NAS的计算开销可能影响实际部署效果。

title: Anti-Collapse Dynamics and the Emergence of Multi-Time-Scale Learning in Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Long-range learning is hard for recurrent networks trained with stochastic gradient descent, because the influence of a past input fades with the lag $\ell$, and if it fades too fast the dependence cannot be learned from finite data. This fade is captured by an envelope $f(\ell)$. An exponential fade makes the data needed to learn a lag-$\ell$ dependence grow exponentially, putting long horizons out of reach; a power-law fade keeps the cost polynomial. We show that the asymptotic decay class of $f(\ell)$ is not fixed by the architecture. Instead, it emerges from the coupling between the state dynamics and parameter dynamics, settling into either a collapsed regime (fast, exponential forgetting) or an extended, anti-collapsed regime (slow, power-law forgetting). The intuition is a competition within these coupled dynamics. Training drives the network's effective time scales toward short ones, while rare, heavy-tailed fluctuations of the learning dynamics push a few of them to very long values. The extended regime survives only when these heavy-tailed pushes are strong enough to balance the pull. We make this mathematically precise with a coarse-grained stochastic process and prove exactly when the extended regime exists. A single exponent, the spectral exponent~$β$, then governs both the spread of time scales and how slowly the network forgets. Realizing the regime in practice needs one more ingredient: the joint action of the architecture and the optimizer must be able to hold such a broad spread. A network whose capacity to generate broad time-scale spectra is severely constrained still collapses, even when supplied with strong heavy-tailed forcing. Heavy-tailed fluctuations thus act not as noise to be suppressed, but as the mechanism that sustains long-range learning.

title: SAKE: Software Architectural Knowledge Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as assistants across the software development lifecycle, yet their ability to reason about software architecture remains largely unmeasured. Architectural decision-making depends on quality attribute trade-offs, design patterns, and system-level constraints, none of which are exercised by benchmarks that target syntactic or algorithmic tasks. We introduce SAKE (Software Architectural Knowledge Evaluation), a standardized and reproducible benchmark for assessing software architectural knowledge in LLMs. SAKE comprises 2154 expert-curated multiple-choice questions, each with four options, stratified across eight architectural categories and four context-length levels. We evaluate 11 proprietary and open-weight models in zero-shot and five-shot settings. Overall accuracy is high, but performance varies markedly across categories, revealing competency gaps in areas central to professional practice. SAKE, its evaluation scripts, and all results are released as open source to give the community a baseline for tracking architectural reasoning in LLMs.

AI.title_translation: SAKE：面向大语言模型的软件架构知识评估基准
AI.tldr: SAKE是一个新型基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在软件架构决策和系统设计方面的推理能力，揭示了现有模型在专业架构实践中的性能短板。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试多集中在语法或算法任务，无法衡量大模型在软件架构决策、质量属性权衡及系统约束方面的推理能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含2154道专家策划的多项选择题基准（SAKE），涵盖8个架构类别和4个上下文长度级别，并对11个专有及开源模型进行了零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（five-shot）评估。
AI.result: 研究发现模型整体准确率较高，但在不同架构类别间表现差异显著，显示出在专业实践核心领域存在明显的知识缺口。
AI.conclusion: SAKE基准测试成功揭示了大模型在软件架构领域的能力分布与短板，通过开源发布，为评估和提升LLM在复杂系统架构推理方面的能力提供了标准化路径。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作软件开发生命周期的助手，但它们在软件架构方面的推理能力在很大程度上尚未得到衡量。架构决策取决于质量属性权衡、设计模式和系统级约束，而针对语法或算法任务的基准测试并未涵盖这些内容。我们引入了SAKE（软件架构知识评估），这是一个用于评估LLMs中软件架构知识的标准化且可复现的基准。SAKE包含2154个由专家策划的多项选择题，每题四个选项，分层涵盖八个架构类别和四个上下文长度级别。我们在零样本和少样本设置下评估了11个专有和开源模型。总体准确率很高，但不同类别的表现差异显著，揭示了专业实践核心领域的竞争力差距。SAKE及其评估脚本和所有结果均以开源形式发布，旨在为社区追踪LLMs中的架构推理能力提供基准。
AI.summary: 本文推出了SAKE（软件架构知识评估）基准，旨在填补大模型在软件架构推理能力评估方面的空白。该基准包含2154道专家级选择题，通过对11个主流大模型进行测试，揭示了模型在处理复杂架构决策时的性能差异及专业能力短板。
AI.keywords: 软件架构, 大语言模型, 基准测试, 质量属性, 架构推理
AI.comments: 该研究填补了软件工程领域针对大模型架构推理能力评估的空白。其创新之处在于构建了一个包含2154道专家级选择题的标准化基准，不仅关注准确率，还通过分层评估揭示了模型在特定架构类别上的能力短板，为未来软件工程领域大模型的优化提供了重要的评估依据。

title: Not All Objectives Are Born Equal: Priority-Constrained Descent for Hierarchical Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: Deep learning problems rarely involve objectives that are equal in importance. A primary objective defines the goal, whilst secondary objectives, such as sparsity, compression, or robustness constrain the solution. While existing multi-objective methods have proven effective in practice, they have a clear symmetry problem and neglect the inherent objective hierarchy built into these objective spaces. We introduce Priority-Constrained Descent (PCD), a gradient-based optimization framework designed to explicitly exploit hierarchical objective structures. PCD preserves the direction of primary descent whilst allowing for the minimal distortion necessary to guarantee progress on secondary objectives, controlled by a single $τ\in [0, 1]$ that dictates the strength of the distortion. The resulting formulation is invariant to objective scaling and admits exact closed-form solutions for problems with two and three objectives. We evaluate PCD within structured network compression settings, unstructured sparsity and low-rankness, and across a variety of synthetic experiments, showing Pareto dominance and better per-objective performance with secondary progress guarantees over existing methods, further exhibiting the interpretable trade-off that $τ$ provides.

title: Do Models Read What They Write? Causal Registers in Scratchpad Reasoning
summary: A central hope behind process supervision is that models can expose intermediate variables that matter for their later behavior. For this to help with alignment, a scratchpad must be tied to the computation: when the model writes a state, later steps should compute from that state. To test this requirement, we use a controlled state-tracking task with a known update rule, comparing models trained to report only the final state with models trained to write intermediate states before giving the final answer. At evaluation, we edit the internal representation of one written state while leaving the visible scratchpad text fixed. Because the transition rule is known, the edit has a single correct downstream consequence. In Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, the state-writing model predicts the next phase bit implied by the edited state on 80% and 91% of held-out examples across the two task variants, while pretrained and final-answer-only controls remain near baseline. Additional controls rule out generic next-token steering and copying another continuation: the prediction depends on both the edited state and the current move. The same causal-use pattern replicates across model families. Together, these results suggest a sharper goal for scratchpad oversight: not just to make intermediate reasoning legible, but to train written states that the model uses as part of its computation.

title: Stable Positive Integral Deferred Correction Methods for Positive Dynamical Systems
summary: In this paper, we introduce the class of Stable Positive Integral Deferred Correction (SPIDeC) methods for the numerical integration of positive dynamical systems. The proposed framework embeds a deferred correction mechanism within an exponential-type Volterra reformulation of the underlying differential problem. The resulting multiplicative structure guarantees the unconditional preservation of both positivity and equilibria, independently of the integration stepsize. Arbitrarily high-order accuracy is systematically achieved through successive explicit-in-sweep corrections applied to a low-order base approximation. From a stability viewpoint, the SPIDeC integrators are L-stable and exactly reproduce the continuous semigroup generated by diagonal linear operators. Furthermore, when Gauss--Radau quadrature nodes are employed, the associated discrete flow asymptotically approaches a logarithmically contractive map as the number of sweeps increases, ensuring stability. Numerical experiments are provided to validate the theoretical analysis and illustrate the practical performance of the proposed methods.

title: The Mirage of Optimizing Training Policies: Monotonic Inference Policies as the Real Objective for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has gained growing attention in large language model (LLM) post-training, yet RL training remains fragile and can suffer from instability or collapse. One vital cause is training-inference mismatch: LLM adopts separate inference and training engines for generation efficiency and training precision, which in practice exhibits inconsistent probabilities for the same trajectories on training and inference sides, even with synchronized model parameters. This naturally induces a special type of off-policyness ever existing and poisoning the training. Prior works have made various efforts in addressing the off-policyness to stabilize the training policies under the mismatch. In this paper, we point out the objective misalignment neglected by existing works that an effective update to the policy in the training engine not necessarily ensures the improvement of the inference policy, i.e., the one used in deployment. To this end, we propose a new policy optimization objective for LLM RL, named Monotonic Inference Policy Improvement (MIPI). Following this principle, we introduce Monotonic Inference Policy Update (MIPU), a two-step LLM RL framework that constructs sampler-referenced candidate updates and selectively accepts synchronized candidates using an inference-side gap proxy. Experiments conducted on two model scales under high mismatch show that MIPU improves average reasoning performance and training stability.

title: Supervised Hebbian learning in Deep Counterstream Associative Networks
summary: Modern machine learning applications employ deep neural networks training with the error backpropagation algorithm. Although this algorithm is very effective, it lacks biological realism. For example, backpropagation requires symmetric connectivity, and a separate neural processing channel for error signals. Prior works have therefore proposed a number of more realistic alternatives for error backpropagation. However, most of them still suffer from demanding preassumptions that may be not fulfilled in the real brain, for example, they often still require either symmetric connectivity or two separate processing channels, and often require also special mathematical operations like subtractions or function inversions. Here I propose supervised counterstream learning in deep associative networks as a simpler approach that requires only recognition of errors during training, and then backpropagates correcting target activity through the same activity channel as used for forward propagation. For this, two activity waves are initiated at the same time in input and output layers and then traveling in opposite directions to meet in one of the hidden layers. By employing simple local Hebbian-type learning rules, the corresponding activity pattern sequences get linked bidirectionally, thereby decreasing error rates over time. Despite its simplicity and an incomplete hyperparameter optimzation, a high high test accuracy is achieved on the (binarized) MNIST data set that is comparable to more demanding architectures.

AI.title_translation: 深度联想网络中的监督式Hebbian学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种更具生物合理性的深度学习训练方法，利用简单的局部Hebbian规则通过单一通道进行反向传播，在MNIST上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习反向传播算法缺乏生物合理性（如要求对称连接、独立误差通道及特殊数学运算），作者旨在寻找一种更简单、更贴近大脑工作机制的训练替代方案。
AI.method: 提出监督式反向流学习（Supervised Counterstream Learning），在输入层和输出层同时启动两个活动波，在隐藏层相遇，并利用局部Hebbian型学习规则进行双向链接，通过同一活动通道反向传播修正目标活动。
AI.result: 在二值化MNIST数据集上实现了与更复杂架构相当的高测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: 监督式反向流学习在深度联想网络中提供了一种简单且更具生物合理性的训练替代方案，能够有效降低误差并实现与复杂架构相当的准确率。
AI.translation: 现代机器学习应用采用基于误差反向传播算法训练的深度神经网络。尽管该算法非常有效，但它缺乏生物合理性。例如，反向传播需要对称连接和用于误差信号的独立神经处理通道。因此，先前的研究提出了许多更具现实意义的反向传播替代方案。然而，它们大多数仍然受到可能无法在大脑中实现的严苛预设的困扰，例如，它们往往仍然要求对称连接或两个独立的处理通道，并且通常还需要特殊的数学运算，如减法或函数求逆。在此，我提出深度联想网络中的监督式反向流学习，这是一种更简单的方法，仅需要在训练期间识别误差，然后通过与前向传播相同的活动通道反向传播修正后的目标活动。为此，在输入层和输出层同时启动两个活动波，然后沿相反方向传播，并在其中一个隐藏层相遇。通过采用简单的局部Hebbian型学习规则，相应的活动模式序列被双向链接，从而随时间降低误差率。尽管其简单且超参数优化不完全，但在（二值化）MNIST数据集上仍获得了与更苛刻架构相当的高测试准确率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种深度联想网络中的监督式反向流学习方法。该方法摒弃了传统反向传播对对称连接和独立误差通道的需求，通过在同一通道内利用局部Hebbian学习规则进行双向活动模式链接，实现误差修正，在简化计算的同时保持了良好的学习性能。
AI.keywords: Hebbian学习, 深度联想网络, 生物合理性, 反向流学习, 机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种更具生物合理性的深度学习训练方法，创新之处在于仅利用局部Hebbian学习规则和单一活动通道进行反向传播。尽管其架构简单且超参数优化不完全，但在MNIST数据集上表现出的高准确率证明了其作为反向传播替代方案的潜力。该方法的局限性在于目前主要在简单数据集上进行了验证，其在更复杂任务中的扩展性仍有待观察。

title: MotionAtlas: Detailed Region Captioning for Motion-Centric Videos
summary: We propose MotionAtlas, a system for detailed captioning of motion-centric videos, comprising (1) a dedicated human-annotated benchmark, (2) a scalable, high-quality pipeline to construct training samples, and (3) a family of powerful Video-MLLMs. Unlike conventional global motion captioning datasets, we focus on region-aware motion captioning: given a video and a spatiotemporal mask, the model generates precise descriptions of motion within the target region, thereby alleviating visual clutter and motion entanglement and enabling reliable, quantifiable evaluation. Concretely, we first build MotionAtlas-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,073 multiple-choice questions, meticulously annotated for a curated set of high-quality, motion-centric videos, to evaluate fine-grained motion understanding of the objects in question. Second, we design a rigorous and scalable data pipeline that leverages self-bootstrap refinement to suppress fine-grained hallucinations, yielding 159k high-quality motion captioning data. Third, we design a tailored training data composition strategy, which achieves consistent and substantial performance gains across diverse baseline Video-MLLMs, including Molmo2 and Qwen3-VL. For instance, MotionAtlas-4B surpasses Qwen3-VL-4B by an average of 5.2 percentage points across general motion benchmarks. The benchmark, dataset, and code have been released.

AI.title_translation: MotionAtlas：面向以动作为中心的视频的细粒度区域描述系统
AI.tldr: MotionAtlas 通过引入区域感知动作描述框架和高质量训练数据，有效提升了视频模型对复杂场景中局部动作的精确理解与描述能力。
AI.motivation: 传统视频描述数据集多关注全局信息，难以处理复杂的动态场景，导致动作描述模糊且难以进行精确定量评估，因此需要一种能进行区域感知且细粒度的动作描述系统。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含2,073个选择题的MotionAtlas-Bench基准；2. 设计利用自引导（self-bootstrap）精炼机制的可扩展数据处理流水线，生成159k条高质量数据；3. 实施定制化的训练数据组合策略，以提升现有的Video-MLLM（如Molmo2, Qwen3-VL）性能。
AI.result: MotionAtlas-4B模型在通用动作基准测试中表现优异，平均性能比Qwen3-VL-4B高出5.2个百分点；该系统通过减少细粒度幻觉，实现了对视频内特定区域动作的精确描述。
AI.conclusion: MotionAtlas 通过引入区域感知动作描述框架、高质量基准测试及优化训练策略，显著提升了视频多模态大模型在细粒度动作理解方面的能力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 MotionAtlas，这是一个用于以动作为中心的视频进行详细描述的系统，包括 (1) 一个专门的人工标注基准，(2) 一个可扩展的、高质量的训练样本构建流水线，以及 (3) 一系列强大的 Video-MLLM。与传统的全局动作描述数据集不同，我们专注于区域感知动作描述：给定视频和时空掩码，模型能够生成目标区域内运动的精确描述，从而减轻视觉混乱和动作纠缠，并实现可靠、可量化的评估。具体而言，我们首先构建了 MotionAtlas-Bench，这是一个包含 2,073 个多项选择题的综合基准，针对一组精心挑选的高质量、以动作为中心的视频进行了细致标注，以评估相关对象的细粒度动作理解。其次，我们设计了一个严格且可扩展的数据流水线，利用自引导精炼来抑制细粒度幻觉，产生了 159k 条高质量的动作描述数据。第三，我们设计了一种定制的训练数据组合策略，在包括 Molmo2 和 Qwen3-VL 在内的多种基准 Video-MLLM 上实现了持续且显著的性能提升。例如，MotionAtlas-4B 在通用动作基准测试中平均超过 Qwen3-VL-4B 5.2 个百分点。目前基准、数据集和代码均已开源。
AI.summary: MotionAtlas 是一个专注于细粒度、区域感知动作描述的系统，包含专门的基准测试集、高质量数据构建流水线及高性能的 Video-MLLM 模型系列，旨在解决全局描述带来的视觉干扰问题，实现对视频中特定区域运动的精确解析。
AI.keywords: 视频多模态大模型, 区域感知动作描述, 动作理解, 基准测试, 自引导优化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将焦点从全局视频描述转向细粒度的区域感知动作描述，有效解决了视频分析中常见的视觉混乱和动作纠缠问题。其构建的基准测试集和可扩展的数据处理流水线为该领域提供了重要的基础设施，特别是通过自引导优化减少幻觉的方法具有很强的实践价值。

title: SemJoin: Semantic Join Optimization
comments: 7 pages, submitted to VLDB 2026 Workshop: NOVAS
summary: Integrating unstructured data into relational database systems is increasingly important as demand grows for natural language querying and analysis. A semantic join, joining two tables under a natural-language predicate, can be evaluated with a large language model (LLM), but comparing every pair of tuples requires O(M x N) LLM invocations and is cost-prohibitive at scale. Existing systems reduce this cost but typically commit to a single fixed strategy (e.g., embedding similarity or one batched scheme) regardless of the data or the join predicate. We propose an LLM-agent-based decision pipeline that optimizes semantic joins by matching the execution strategy to the characteristics of the underlying tables. An LLM advisor routes each join to one of two strategies: a Cluster Join, which prunes candidates via unsupervised embedding clustering and sample-based filtering, or a Classifier strategy for predicates that reduce to a shared discrete label set. Across three diverse datasets (IMDb reviews, email contradictions, and Stack Overflow tags), the advisor consistently identifies the optimal execution strategy for each workload. This dynamic routing proves decisive: it outperforms adaptive block join (ABJ) by 20-33 F1 points across all datasets while consuming fewer tokens on two of the three, and achieves higher F1 scores than featurized-decomposition join (FDJ) at one to two orders of magnitude lower token cost.
comment: 7 pages, submitted to VLDB 2026 Workshop: NOVAS

title: Improved Multi-Dimensional Forecasting for Swap Regret
comments: Accepted for presentation at the ACM Conference on Economics and Computation (EC) 2026
summary: We study the problem of forecasting for an arbitrary number of downstream agents with unknown objectives, each of whom best responds to the forecaster's predictions. We seek a single forecaster that guarantees sublinear swap regret for all downstream agents simultaneously. For two-dimensional outcome spaces, we give a polynomial time algorithm that guarantees $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{kT})$ swap regret for any downstream agent with $k$ actions. This improves over the previously known bound of $\tilde{O}(kT^{5/8})$ and avoids the exponential in $T$ runtime of prior algorithms in this setting. Our algorithm extends nicely to other low dimensional environments, retaining $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ downstream swap regret while the exponent of $k$ in the regret bound and the exponent of $T$ in the running time both grow with dimension. For arbitrary dimension $d$, we give a forecasting algorithm that guarantees $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{kT})$ swap regret, assuming the forecaster knows an upper bound $k$ on the number of actions available to any downstream agent, albeit with a much longer runtime. This improves upon previous high dimensional guarantees that had $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ dependence and required additional behavioral assumptions.
comment: Accepted for presentation at the ACM Conference on Economics and Computation (EC) 2026

title: Preference-ASR: A Preference-Aware Test Set for Benchmarking ASR in the Era of Speech LLMs
summary: Popular ASR test sets adopt inconsistent conventions for numbers, disfluencies, entities, and casing, while standard normalizers erase the format distinctions users care about. Current benchmarks therefore cannot measure whether a model follows user preferences for output style. We introduce PreferenceASR, a test set evaluating ASR systems on their ability to follow natural-language preference instructions across four categories: normalization, entities, disfluencies, and case. Built from seven open-source corpora via a two-stage LLM-assisted pipeline with human verification, it is evaluated with a preference-aware normalizer that selectively skips steps matching the active instruction. Benchmarking four models shows rankings shift across preference types, exposing quality differences traditional evaluation obscures. We publicly release the dataset.

AI.title_translation: Preference-ASR：语音LLM时代用于基准测试ASR的偏好感知测试集
AI.tldr: 本文推出了PreferenceASR，这是一个能评估语音识别模型是否遵循用户风格偏好（如格式和实体处理）的全新基准测试集，填补了传统评估方式的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR基准测试对格式规范缺乏统一标准，且传统归一化器抹去了用户关心的格式细节，导致无法准确评估模型遵循用户风格偏好的能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含Normalization、Entities、Disfluencies和Case四类偏好指令的测试集；采用两阶段LLM辅助流水线并结合人工验证构建数据集；开发了一种偏好感知归一化器，根据指令选择性跳过特定处理步骤。
AI.result: 通过对四个模型的基准测试，发现模型在不同偏好类型下的表现排名发生变化，揭示了传统评估指标所掩盖的质量差异。
AI.conclusion: PreferenceASR成功揭示了传统评估方法无法捕捉的模型质量差异，证明了在语音模型评估中纳入用户偏好指令的必要性。
AI.translation: 流行的ASR测试集在数字、非流利表达、实体和大小写方面采用了不一致的惯例，而标准的归一化器则抹去了用户关心的格式区别。因此，目前的基准测试无法衡量模型是否遵循用户对输出风格的偏好。我们引入了PreferenceASR，这是一个测试集，用于评估ASR系统在归一化、实体、非流利表达和大小写这四个类别中遵循自然语言偏好指令的能力。该数据集通过两阶段LLM辅助流水线并经人工验证从七个开源语料库构建而成，并使用一种偏好感知归一化器进行评估，该归一化器会选择性地跳过与当前指令匹配的步骤。对四个模型的基准测试显示，排名会随偏好类型的不同而变化，从而揭示了传统评估所掩盖的质量差异。我们已公开该数据集。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PreferenceASR，这是一个旨在评估ASR系统遵循自然语言风格偏好（如归一化、实体、非流利表达和大小写）能力的基准测试集。通过结合LLM辅助构建和偏好感知评估方法，该研究揭示了现有模型在不同偏好下的性能差异。
AI.keywords: 语音识别, 用户偏好, 大语言模型, 基准测试, 文本规范化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一个针对ASR模型偏好一致性的基准测试，填补了现有基准无法评估模型输出风格偏好的空白。其使用LLM辅助构建数据集的方法具有高效性，对推动语音大模型在实际应用中的用户体验具有重要意义。

title: GarmentZoom: Generating Zoomable Images from Garment Listings
summary: Online product listings for garments often include an overview photo and a close-up to show garment details. However, each photo focuses on either field of view or garment detail, forcing users to alternate between views and breaking browsing continuity. We present GarmentZoom, a system that enhances the full-view photo to match the fidelity of its accompanying close-up, enabling seamless zoom-and-pan exploration. Unlike standard reference-based super-resolution, our setting involves close-up references that are spatially unaligned with the full view, and scale factors that vary substantially across garments 3-20$\times$. Prior work typically relies on alignment to transfer details or requires per-instance fine-tuning to memorize them. Instead, we train a single model that supports a continuous range of scales across diverse garments. Our approach synthesizes details without requiring spatial alignment and matches the quality of per-instance methods with a fraction of the training cost.

AI.title_translation: GarmentZoom：从服装清单生成可缩放图像
AI.tldr: GarmentZoom 通过单一模型，无需空间对齐，即可将服装全景图增强至局部细节图的质量，实现无缝的缩放浏览。
AI.motivation: 现有的服装电商图片通常将全景图与局部细节图分离，导致用户在浏览时需要反复切换，破坏了浏览的连续性。
AI.method: 提出一种无需空间对齐的单一深度学习模型，通过学习在不同缩放比例（3-20倍）下将全景图与局部细节图进行融合，从而实现无缝的缩放和平移探索。
AI.result: 该方法在无需空间对齐的情况下，合成了高质量的细节信息，其效果媲美逐实例微调的方法，同时大幅降低了训练成本。
AI.conclusion: GarmentZoom 通过单一模型实现了无需空间对齐的高倍率服装图像细节增强，有效提升了电商平台的浏览体验。
AI.translation: 在线服装产品列表通常包含一张概览图和一张用于展示细节的近景图。然而，每张照片要么侧重于视野，要么侧重于服装细节，迫使用户在不同视图之间切换，从而中断了浏览的连续性。我们提出了 GarmentZoom，这是一个能够增强全景照片以匹配其随附近景图保真度的系统，从而实现无缝的缩放和平移探索。与标准的基于参考的超分辨率不同，我们的设置涉及与全景图空间不对齐的近景参考，且缩放比例在不同服装间差异巨大（3-20倍）。以往的研究通常依赖于对齐来传递细节，或者需要针对每个实例进行微调以记忆细节。相反，我们训练了一个单一模型，支持跨不同服装的连续比例范围。我们的方法在不需要空间对齐的情况下合成细节，并以极低的训练成本达到了逐实例方法的效果。
AI.summary: GarmentZoom 是一种能够将服装全景图增强至局部细节图质量的系统，支持 3-20 倍的连续缩放，旨在通过消除对图像空间对齐的需求，提供无缝的电商产品浏览体验。
AI.keywords: 服装图像, 超分辨率, 变倍探索, 图像细节增强, 计算机视觉
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于解决了一个实际的电商交互痛点，并避开了传统超分辨率方法对空间对齐的依赖。通过训练单一模型支持大范围变倍，显著降低了计算成本，具有很高的实用价值。

title: High-Probability ISS Tubes for Continuous-Time State Estimation
summary: This paper studies a probabilistic interpretation of input-to-state stability (ISS) bounds for estimation-error dynamics in continuous-time systems. We show that, if the aggregated disturbance satisfies a probabilistic envelope in an essential-supremum sense, then deterministic ISS bounds immediately induce high-probability error tubes. To make this interpretation constructive, we also provide explicit sufficient conditions based on quadratic Lyapunov inequalities and specialize them to positive and cooperative systems. The approach is illustrated on a positive compartment model with aggregated measurements, where ISS tubes are compared with nominal uncertainty bands produced by a Kalman--Bucy filter and by Gaussian and robust moving-horizon estimators. The examples show that ISS tubes provide a conservative but computationally light uncertainty baseline, while robust MHE is less sensitive to outlier contamination than Gaussian-based

AI.title_translation: 面向连续时间状态估计的高概率ISS管
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用输入到状态稳定性（ISS）理论构建连续时间系统高概率误差管的方法，提供了一种计算高效且鲁棒的状态估计不确定性分析工具。
AI.motivation: 旨在为连续时间系统的状态估计误差提供一种具有概率保证的分析框架，以弥补传统确定性界限在处理随机扰动时的不足。
AI.method: 利用确定性ISS界限结合概率包络，通过二次Lyapunov不等式推导显式充分条件，并针对正系统和协作系统进行了特化处理。
AI.result: 证明了满足特定概率包络的扰动可诱导出高概率误差管；在正室模型上的实验表明，该方法在计算上非常轻量，且在处理离群值污染时比高斯估计器更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于ISS的概率解释方法，通过二次Lyapunov不等式构建高概率误差管，为连续时间系统的状态估计提供了一种简单、有效且鲁棒的基准工具。
AI.translation: 本文研究了连续时间系统估计误差动力学中输入到状态稳定性（ISS）界限的概率解释。我们证明，如果聚合扰动在本质上确界意义上满足概率包络，那么确定性的ISS界限可以立即诱导出高概率误差管。为了使这种解释具有建设性，我们还提供了基于二次Lyapunov不等式的显式充分条件，并将其专门应用于正系统和协作系统。该方法通过一个带有聚合测量的正室模型进行了说明，其中将ISS管与卡尔曼-布西滤波器以及高斯和鲁棒移动视界估计器产生的名义不确定性带进行了比较。算例表明，ISS管提供了一个保守但计算量小的不确定性基准，而鲁棒MHE对离群值污染的敏感度低于基于高斯的方法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了连续时间系统状态估计误差的输入到状态稳定性（ISS）的概率解释。作者证明了当聚合扰动满足特定的概率包络时，确定性的ISS界限可转化为高概率误差管。文中给出了基于二次Lyapunov不等式的充分条件，并验证了该方法在正系统中的有效性，展示了其作为一种计算高效、鲁棒性强的估计基准的潜力。
AI.keywords: 输入到状态稳定性, 状态估计, 概率包络, Lyapunov不等式, 鲁棒估计
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将确定性的输入到状态稳定性（ISS）理论与概率框架相结合，为连续时间系统的状态估计提供了一种计算高效且具备鲁棒性的不确定性界限。其创新点在于证明了确定性ISS界限可直接转化为高概率误差管，特别适合对计算资源有限或对鲁棒性要求极高的场景。局限性在于ISS管通常比基于高斯假设的估计器更为保守。

title: OSWorld2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
comments: 68 pages, 42 figures. Equal contribution: Mengqi Yuan, Zilong Zhou, and Xinzhuang Xiong
summary: Existing computer-use benchmarks fail to capture the realism, complexity, and long-horizon demands of real-world computer use, limiting their ability to reveal the limitations of frontier agents. We introduce OSWorld 2.0, a benchmark of 108 long-horizon computer-use workflows across everyday and professional tasks, designed to capture complex and challenging real-world phenomena. Each task represents a realistic end-to-end workflow that takes human users a median of about 1.6 hours to complete and requires an average of 318 tool calls with Claude Opus 4.7 using maximum thinking, compared with about 30 in OSWorld 1.0. OSWorld 2.0 targets challenge phenomena that are common in real workflows yet underrepresented in prior benchmarks, spanning interaction-design challenges such as streaming interaction and dynamic environments, as well as agent-pattern challenges such as cross-source reasoning, implicit-state inference, and visual-spatial precision. Tasks are grounded in authentic input artifacts and cross-referenced against realistic stateful user profile data, and include separate safety reports auditing safety-sensitive execution. Under our primary binary-completion metric at 500 steps, Claude Opus 4.8 with maximum thinking and batched tool calls scores best but still completes only 20.6% of tasks at a 54.8% partial score; GPT-5.5 is far more token-efficient yet plateaus near 13%. These results show that current agents are still far from professional-level computer use: rather than stumbling on basic GUI control or coding, they lose track of constraints, miss information that arrives mid-task, guess rather than ask the user, and skip verification, struggling most when a task hinges on hidden state they must recover.
comment: 68 pages, 42 figures. Equal contribution: Mengqi Yuan, Zilong Zhou, and Xinzhuang Xiong

title: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
summary: Skills are a useful abstraction for software agents, turning human and agent experience into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet existing skill libraries are mostly hand-written, text-centric, or derived from agent traces, leaving tutorial videos and other multimodal human resources largely underused. We present RESOURCE2SKILL, a framework that distills multimodal resources, including tutorial videos, repositories, articles, and reference artifacts, into executable skills for software agents. RESOURCE2SKILL organizes these skills as a hierarchical multimodal Skill Wiki, where each entry combines structured text, code, visual examples, metadata, and provenance. This design preserves complementary signals from different resources: videos capture temporal operations and visual effects, code captures executable tool patterns, and articles or artifacts provide conceptual and stylistic grounding. At inference time, agents retrieve and compose relevant skills from the wiki; when coverage is insufficient, the same construction operator can acquire new skills online. Across seven practical authoring domains, RESOURCE2SKILL improves average overall score by +11.9 percentage points over no-skill agents and outperforms strong harness baselines in 26 of 28 main-aggregate model-domain cells. Ablations confirm the value of multimodal skill format, hierarchical organization, source diversity, selection strategy, and online acquisition.

AI.title_translation: RESOURCE2SKILL：从人类创建的多模态资源中提取可执行智能体技能
AI.tldr: RESOURCE2SKILL 框架能将视频、文章和代码等多种人类资源转化为结构化的智能体技能库，从而大幅提升智能体的任务执行效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体技能库多为人工编写或基于单一模态，导致海量的教程视频及其他多模态人类资源未被充分利用，限制了智能体获取可重用程序化知识的能力。
AI.method: 构建 RESOURCE2SKILL 框架，将教程视频、代码仓库、文章等异构资源转化为包含结构化文本、代码、视觉示例和元数据的层级化“多模态技能维基”；智能体在推理时检索并组合这些技能，并支持在线获取新技能。
AI.result: 在七个实际创作领域中，RESOURCE2SKILL 将智能体的平均总分提升了 11.9 个百分点，并在 28 个主要模型-领域测试单元中的 26 个中表现优于强基准模型。
AI.conclusion: RESOURCE2SKILL 提供了一种高效的方法，能够利用海量人类多模态资源构建可扩展、可执行的智能体技能库，显著优于现有基准。
AI.translation: 技能是软件智能体的一种有用抽象，它将人类和智能体的经验转化为可重用的程序化知识。然而，现有的技能库大多是手写的、以文本为中心的，或是从智能体轨迹中导出的，这使得教程视频和其他人类多模态资源在很大程度上未被利用。我们提出了 RESOURCE2SKILL，这是一个将包括教程视频、代码库、文章和参考资料在内的多模态资源蒸馏为软件智能体可执行技能的框架。RESOURCE2SKILL 将这些技能组织为层级化的多模态技能维基，其中每个条目都结合了结构化文本、代码、视觉示例、元数据和来源信息。这种设计保留了来自不同资源的互补信号：视频捕捉时间操作和视觉效果，代码捕捉可执行工具模式，文章或资料提供概念和风格基础。在推理时，智能体从维基中检索并组合相关技能；当覆盖范围不足时，相同的构建算子可以在线获取新技能。在七个实际创作领域中，RESOURCE2SKILL 的平均总分比无技能智能体提高了 11.9 个百分点，并在 28 个主要模型-领域测试单元中的 26 个中优于强基准模型。消融实验证实了多模态技能格式、层级组织、资源多样性、选择策略和在线获取的价值。
AI.summary: RESOURCE2SKILL 是一个将多模态人类资源（如视频、代码、文章）转化为智能体可执行技能的框架，通过构建层级化“多模态技能维基”，使智能体能够检索、组合已有技能并在线获取新技能，从而显著增强了智能体的执行性能。
AI.keywords: 智能体, 多模态技能蒸馏, 技能维基, 自动化知识获取, 程序合成
AI.comments: 该研究通过将非结构化的多模态资源（视频、代码、文章）转化为结构化的可执行技能，有效解决了现有智能体技能库依赖手动构建或单一模态的局限性。其创新点在于构建了“多模态技能维基”，显著提升了智能体在复杂任务中的执行能力。

title: Em-ergence of the em-dash: a population-level rise in em-dash frequency in medRxiv preprints at the dawn of the large-language-model era
comments: 22 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered on OSF (osf.io/HFT8C). Companion to a pre-registered audit of Unicode fidelity in biomedical bibliographic APIs (arXiv:2606.24897)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can leave subtle stylistic traces in assisted text; one of the most cited is the em-dash (Unicode U+2014). Yet no one has measured whether em-dash use has changed in the scientific literature. This study, pre-registered on the Open Science Framework (HFT8C), used the full set of medRxiv full-text XML preprints from the official Text-and-Data-Mining resource. The primary cohort was first, original versions deposited 2020-2025 with an extractable Discussion section of at least 500 characters (N = 69,632). The primary endpoint was the presence of at least one em-dash in the Discussion; the principal measure was the absolute change in its prevalence between the pre-ChatGPT era (before 30 November 2022) and the post-ChatGPT era, estimated with a logistic model with standard errors clustered by first author. The analysis plan (six supporting analyses, six sensitivity analyses, two falsification tests) was frozen before any confirmatory result was computed. Em-dash prevalence in Discussion sections rose from 4.23% before ChatGPT to 11.58% afterward, an absolute increase of 7.35 percentage points (95% CI 6.94-7.77; odds ratio 2.96, 95% CI 2.77-3.17). The rise was not a sharp jump but a gradual, delayed acceleration: near 4% through 2023, 8.0% in 2024, and 20.3% in 2025. The effect survived every feasible sensitivity analysis (7.35-7.60 pp) and both falsification tests; a placebo split within the pre-LLM era showed no meaningful change (+0.13 pp, 95% CI -0.33 to +0.58), and was essentially absent in boilerplate sections. Independent LLM-associated lexical markers and within-paper section comparisons pointed the same way. The em-dash is a population-level indicator, not a per-paper detector of LLM use, and the design cannot establish causality; it shows that something in how scientific literature is written changed markedly in the early 2020s, and roughly when.
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered on OSF (osf.io/HFT8C). Companion to a pre-registered audit of Unicode fidelity in biomedical bibliographic APIs (arXiv:2606.24897)

AI.title_translation: 破折号的涌现：大型语言模型时代初期medRxiv预印本中破折号频率的群体性上升
AI.tldr: 研究发现，随着ChatGPT的普及，科学论文中使用破折号的频率显著增加，这可能是LLM辅助写作留下的风格印记。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在辅助写作中留下了微妙的风格痕迹，其中破折号（em-dash）被认为是常见的特征之一，但目前尚无研究量化科学文献中破折号使用习惯是否因LLM的普及而发生了改变。
AI.method: 研究者分析了2020年至2025年间的69,632篇medRxiv预印本，对比了ChatGPT发布前后Discussion部分中破折号的使用率，采用了逻辑回归模型，并进行了多项敏感性分析、伪造测试及安慰剂测试以验证结果的稳健性。
AI.result: 破折号在Discussion部分的使用率从ChatGPT发布前的4.23%上升至发布后的11.58%，增长了7.35个百分点，且这种增长呈现出逐年加速的趋势（2025年达到20.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 在ChatGPT发布后，medRxiv预印本论文Discussion部分中破折号的使用率显著上升，这反映了科学文献写作风格在LLM时代出现了明显的群体性变化。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以在辅助生成的文本中留下微妙的风格痕迹；其中最常被提及的特征之一是破折号（Unicode U+2014）。然而，目前尚无人测量科学文献中破折号的使用是否发生了变化。本研究在开放科学框架（HFT8C）上进行了预注册，使用了来自官方文本与数据挖掘资源的全部medRxiv全文XML预印本。主要队列为2020-2025年间提交的第一版原始论文，且包含至少500个字符的可提取讨论部分（N=69,632）。主要终点是讨论部分中至少存在一个破折号；主要度量指标是ChatGPT时代前（2022年11月30日之前）与ChatGPT时代后破折号流行率的绝对变化，并使用以第一作者聚类标准误的逻辑模型进行估计。分析计划（六项支持性分析、六项敏感性分析、两项伪造测试）在计算任何验证性结果之前已冻结。讨论部分中破折号的流行率从ChatGPT之前的4.23%上升至之后的11.58%，绝对增长了7.35个百分点（95%置信区间6.94-7.77；优势比2.96，95%置信区间2.77-3.17）。这种上升并非突发性跳跃，而是一种缓慢的、延迟的加速：2023年全年接近4%，2024年为8.0%，2025年为20.3%。该效应在所有可行的敏感性分析（7.35-7.60个百分点）和两项伪造测试中均成立；LLM时代前的安慰剂分割显示没有意义的变化（+0.13个百分点，95%置信区间-0.33至+0.58），并且在样板文本部分中基本不存在。独立的LLM相关词汇标记和论文内部章节比较也指向相同结论。破折号是一种群体层面的指标，而非单篇论文的LLM使用检测器，且该设计无法确定因果关系；它表明科学文献的写作方式在2020年代初发生了显著变化，并大致确定了时间点。
AI.summary: 本研究通过分析约7万篇medRxiv预印本，量化了大型语言模型时代科学文献中破折号使用频率的变化。结果显示，ChatGPT发布后，论文讨论部分中破折号的使用率显著且持续上升，表明LLM的使用可能正在潜移默化地改变科学写作的风格。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 破折号, 学术写作, medRxiv, 风格特征
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了科学文献中的标点符号使用习惯作为LLM辅助写作的“指纹”。其创新之处在于通过大规模、预注册的实证分析，量化了AI工具对学术写作风格的影响，为评估生成式AI在科研领域的普及提供了客观数据。虽然无法直接证明因果关系，但这种人群层面的统计分析为追踪LLM在学术界的应用提供了重要方法论。

title: Learned Coordination Conventions in Cooperative MARL: Measuring the Translation Gap Between Theory-Informed Roles and Learned Routing
comments: 8 pages, 1 figures. Poster Accepted at NExT-Game 2026: New Frontiers in Game-Theoretic Learning, ICML 2026 Workshop
summary:
Role-semantic assignments provide priors over how heterogeneous agents may coordinate, but cooperative MARL systems instead settle on conventions through decentralized, non-stationary learning, with no guarantee that the resulting structure matches those priors. We study this translation gap between theory-informed role expectations and learned coordination structure through a diagnostic combining a role-routing matrix, formation sensitivity ($Δ_{\max}$), and gradient/occlusion attribution across three-role MiniGrid and SMACv2 (Terran) environments.
  We show that label-conditioned attention produces substantially more concentrated and role-specific routing than flat MLP baselines, remains stable under 3v3--9v9 scaling, transfers zero-shot across team sizes, and is invariant to ally-slot padding. A 5-seed re-evaluation shows partial alignment between learned conventions and designer-specified priors while revealing where small-n noise can manufacture apparent strategic divergence. We present these results as an empirical framework for measuring coordination structure in cooperative MARL rather than as a new equilibrium concept or causal explanation.
comment: 8 pages, 1 figures. Poster Accepted at NExT-Game 2026: New Frontiers in Game-Theoretic Learning, ICML 2026 Workshop

AI.title_translation: 协作多智能体强化学习中的习得协调惯例：衡量理论告知角色与习得路由之间的翻译鸿沟
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种诊断框架，用于评估多智能体强化学习中实际学到的协作模式与理论预期之间的差异，并验证了标签条件注意力机制在提升协调一致性方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体协作中，理论上的角色分配先验往往与实际去中心化学习出的协调习惯（conventions）存在差距，且缺乏有效的工具来衡量这种“翻译鸿沟”。
AI.method: 提出了一种诊断框架，包含角色路由矩阵、形成敏感度（Δmax）分析以及梯度/遮挡归因技术；并对比了标签条件注意力机制与扁平MLP基线在MiniGrid和SMACv2环境下的表现。
AI.result: 实验发现，标签条件注意力机制产生了更集中、更具角色特异性的路由；该方法在规模扩展（3v3至9v9）、零样本迁移及槽位填充方面表现出鲁棒性；同时发现习得的协调方式与设计者先验部分对齐，但也指出了小样本噪声可能导致虚假的策略差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过标签条件注意力机制可以有效引导智能体形成更具结构化的角色分配，并提供了一种评估MARL协调结构的实证框架。
AI.translation: 角色语义分配为异构智能体如何协作提供了先验，但合作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）系统通常通过去中心化、非平稳的学习过程来形成惯例，且无法保证所得结构与这些先验相匹配。我们通过一种结合了角色路由矩阵、形成敏感度（Δmax）以及梯度/遮挡归因的诊断方法，研究了理论告知的角色预期与习得的协调结构之间的这种“翻译鸿沟”，并在三角色MiniGrid和SMACv2（Terran）环境中进行了验证。我们表明，标签条件注意力机制比扁平MLP基线产生了更集中且更具角色特异性的路由，在3v3到9v9的规模扩展下保持稳定，实现了跨团队规模的零样本迁移，并且对盟友槽位填充具有不变性。5次种子的重新评估显示，习得的惯例与设计者指定的先验之间存在部分对齐，同时也揭示了小样本噪声可能导致明显的策略差异。我们将这些结果呈现为一个衡量合作MARL中协调结构的实证框架，而非一个新的均衡概念或因果解释。
AI.summary: 本文研究了多智能体强化学习中理论角色预期与实际习得协调结构之间的“翻译鸿沟”。作者提出了一套包含角色路由矩阵和形成敏感度分析的诊断框架，证明了标签条件注意力机制能有效促进更稳定的角色分配，并为衡量MARL中的协调结构提供了一种实证工具。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习, 角色分配, 协调机制, 可解释性, 诊断框架
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一套诊断框架（角色路由矩阵、形成敏感度等），用于量化分析多智能体强化学习（MARL）中“理论预期”与“实际习得”之间的鸿沟。这对于理解黑盒MARL策略的内部协调机制具有重要意义，克服了以往仅关注任务表现而忽略策略结构解释性的局限。

title: Proteus: Automated Adversarial Robustness Testing for Audio Deepfake Detectors
summary: We present Proteus, a framework developed at Resemble AI for automated robustness testing of our audio deepfake detection system. Given a detector, Proteus systematically searches over sequences of everyday audio transformations (codec transcoding, additive noise, reverberation, dynamic-range compression, and VoIP simulation) to find combinations that fool the detector while preserving speech quality. We propose two complementary search strategies: (1) a breadth-first search that exhaustively maps augmentation effectiveness across the parameter space, and (2) a Q-learning agent designed to efficiently discover deeper attack chains by exploiting structural patterns in the BFS data. We report findings from continuous deployment of Proteus against our production detector, showing that specific augmentation chains can reliably flip detection verdicts while preserving speech intelligibility and speaker identity. We discuss how these findings are used to harden the detector through targeted retraining.

AI.title_translation: Proteus：音频深度伪造检测器的自动化对抗鲁棒性测试
AI.tldr: Proteus框架通过自动化搜索音频变换组合，揭示了音频深度伪造检测器的安全漏洞，并指导了针对性的防御加固。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有音频深度伪造检测器在面对真实世界日常音频变换（如压缩、噪声等）时表现出的鲁棒性不足问题，以提升模型的安全性。
AI.method: 提出了Proteus框架，包含两种搜索策略：(1) 广度优先搜索（BFS），用于穷举音频变换参数空间；(2) Q-learning代理，用于高效发现更深层的攻击链。
AI.result: 实验表明，特定的音频变换链能够在保持语音清晰度和说话人身份的同时，可靠地绕过生产环境中的检测器。研究成果已成功应用于检测器的加固。
AI.conclusion: Proteus证明了通过自动化搜索音频变换链可以有效诱导深度伪造检测器失效，研究结果已被用于通过针对性重训练来增强检测器的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了Proteus，这是一个由Resemble AI开发，用于我们音频深度伪造检测系统自动化鲁棒性测试的框架。给定一个检测器，Proteus会系统地搜索各种日常音频变换序列（编解码转码、加性噪声、混响、动态范围压缩和VoIP模拟），以找到既能欺骗检测器又能保持语音质量的组合。我们提出了两种互补的搜索策略：（1）广度优先搜索，用于穷举参数空间内的增强有效性；（2）Q-learning代理，旨在通过利用BFS数据中的结构模式来高效发现更深层的攻击链。我们报告了Proteus在我们的生产检测器上持续部署的发现，表明特定的增强链可以在保持语音清晰度和说话人身份的同时，可靠地改变检测结果。我们讨论了这些发现如何被用于通过针对性重训练来加固检测器。
AI.summary: Proteus是一个用于评估音频深度伪造检测器鲁棒性的自动化框架。它通过组合多种常见的音频变换，利用广度优先搜索和Q-learning策略，自动寻找能够欺骗检测器且不影响语音质量的对抗性攻击链，并利用测试结果对检测器进行针对性优化。
AI.keywords: 音频深度伪造检测, 对抗性鲁棒性, 自动化测试, 强化学习, 音频变换
AI.comments: 该研究通过系统化的自动化测试框架，揭示了音频深度伪造检测器在处理常见音频变换时的脆弱性。其创新点在于结合了广度优先搜索与强化学习（Q-learning），不仅能发现单一攻击，还能利用攻击链（attack chains）进行更复杂的对抗。该研究对提升生产环境下的AI模型安全性具有重要参考价值。

title: AURORA: Asymmetry and Update-Induced Rotation for Robust Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of natural language processing tasks. However, their tendency to generate hallucinations, namely factually incorrect or unfaithful outputs, poses a critical obstacle to their deployment in high-stakes applications. Although recent hallucination detection methods have made encouraging progress, they typically rely on costly output-level consistency checks or static hidden-state probes that capture shallow dataset-specific patterns, leading to substantial degradation under cross-dataset evaluation. In this work, we propose AURORA, a novel hallucination detection framework that shifts the focus from static representations to the weight-gradient dynamics of LLMs. Our key insight is that hallucinated and faithful answers induce qualitatively different gradient update patterns on the model's parameters. Specifically, hallucinated samples trigger asymmetric and structurally misaligned gradients, which can be captured through two complementary features: (1) the skewness of the cosine similarity distribution between weight matrices and their gradient update directions, and (2) the rotation ratio, which quantifies how much the gradient update reorients the singular-vector basis of weight matrices via SVD. AURORA achieves strong hallucination detection performance across four model families and four benchmark datasets. Further analyses demonstrate that our method scales effectively across model sizes and transfers to out-of-domain tasks, including mathematical reasoning and vision-language scenarios.

AI.title_translation: AURORA：用于大型语言模型鲁棒幻觉检测的非对称与更新诱导旋转方法
AI.tldr: AURORA通过分析模型参数的梯度更新模式（而非输出或静态表征），提供了一种更准确、鲁棒且具备跨任务迁移能力的LLM幻觉检测新方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的幻觉检测方法多依赖昂贵的输出一致性检查或容易过拟合特定数据集的静态隐藏状态探针，在跨数据集评估时性能大幅下降。因此，需要一种能够捕捉模型内在真实性特征且更具鲁棒性的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出AURORA框架，通过分析模型在生成回答时的权重梯度更新动态进行幻觉检测。具体包含两个特征：(1)权重矩阵与梯度更新方向之间余弦相似度分布的偏度；(2)旋转比率，即通过SVD量化梯度更新对权重矩阵奇异向量基的重定向程度。
AI.result: AURORA在四个模型家族和四个基准数据集上表现优异，且在不同模型规模、数学推理及视觉语言任务中均展现出良好的可扩展性和跨域迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: AURORA通过利用梯度更新的非对称性和旋转特征，成功实现了高效、鲁棒且跨任务泛化的LLM幻觉检测，验证了参数更新动态在识别模型不忠实输出方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的自然语言处理任务中展现了卓越的能力。然而，它们生成幻觉（即事实错误或不忠实的输出）的倾向，构成了其在高风险应用中部署的关键障碍。尽管近期的幻觉检测方法已取得进展，但它们通常依赖昂贵的输出级一致性检查或捕获浅层数据集特定模式的静态隐藏状态探针，导致在跨数据集评估时性能大幅下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了AURORA，一个将重点从静态表征转移到LLM权重梯度动态的创新幻觉检测框架。我们的核心洞察是，幻觉和忠实的回答会在模型参数上诱导产生质量上截然不同的梯度更新模式。具体而言，幻觉样本会触发非对称且结构上失调的梯度，这可以通过两个互补特征来捕获：(1)权重矩阵与其梯度更新方向之间余弦相似度分布的偏度，以及(2)旋转比率，即通过SVD量化梯度更新如何重定向权重矩阵的奇异向量基。AURORA在四个模型家族和四个基准数据集上实现了强大的幻觉检测性能。进一步的分析表明，我们的方法可以有效地扩展到不同模型规模，并能迁移到包括数学推理和视觉语言场景在内的域外任务中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AURORA的幻觉检测框架，通过分析LLM在生成回答时的权重梯度更新动态来识别幻觉。该方法利用梯度更新的非对称性和旋转特征，克服了传统方法对数据集的依赖性，在保持高性能的同时实现了更好的跨域泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 幻觉检测, 梯度动态, 模型解释性, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文通过分析模型参数的梯度动态而非仅仅依赖输出一致性或静态隐藏状态，为幻觉检测提供了一个全新的视角。其创新点在于将幻觉识别转化为对梯度更新模式（非对称性和旋转）的量化，这使得该方法在跨数据集和跨任务场景下具有更强的泛化能力。这是一个非常具有启发性的研究方向，特别是对于理解LLM内部表征与事实准确性之间的联系。

title: VISTA-DZ: Visual Semantic Trajectory Adaptation for Personalized Dilemma Zone Prediction
comments: This manuscript is currently under review
summary: Driver decision making in the dilemma zone at signalized intersections is safety critical, as vehicles approaching a yellow signal must decide whether to stop or proceed within limited time and distance margins. Accurate prediction of both stop-go decisions and decision timing is important for adaptive signal control, advanced driver assistance systems, and human-centered intelligent transportation applications. However, dilemma zone behavior is strongly driver dependent. Similar approach trajectories may lead to different decisions across drivers because of differences in risk preference, braking habit, and decision threshold. Existing personalized models often rely on handcrafted scalar descriptors, which provide useful but limited summaries of individual behavior. This paper proposes VISTA-DZ, a semantic-profile-conditioned framework for personalized stop-go and decision-time prediction. Historical trajectories are converted into visual representations, interpreted by a vision-language model to generate behavioral profiles, and encoded as semantic embeddings to condition a dual-output prediction network. The final model combines a bidirectional GRU encoder, driver-conditioned multi-head cross-attention, and Feature-wise Linear Modulation for temporal evidence selection and feature adaptation. Experiments on the SDZ dataset and a newly collected FDZ dataset show that VISTA-DZ outperforms trajectory-only and handcrafted personalization baselines, achieving 93.26% in-domain simulation accuracy and 90.22% mean accuracy across 20 held-out simulation drivers. Cross-domain results further show feasible zero-shot simulation-to-real transfer and better real-world generalization when simulation data are combined with limited field data.
comment: This manuscript is currently under review

AI.title_translation: VISTA-DZ：用于个性化困境区预测的视觉语义轨迹适应模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用视觉语言模型提取驾驶语义特征的个性化困境区决策预测框架，显著提升了预测准确性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 驾驶员在信号交叉口困境区的决策具有高度的个性化差异（如风险偏好和刹车习惯），而现有模型多依赖于有限的人工标量描述符，难以准确捕捉复杂的个体行为特征。
AI.method: 提出VISTA-DZ框架：首先将历史轨迹转换为视觉表示，利用视觉语言模型提取行为语义特征，并将其编码为语义嵌入；随后结合双向GRU编码器、驾驶员条件化多头交叉注意力机制及特征线性调制（FiLM）对决策进行预测。
AI.result: 在SDZ数据集和FDZ数据集上，VISTA-DZ在预测准确性上超越了基准模型，模拟域准确率达93.26%，且在跨域零样本迁移和真实世界泛化方面表现出色。
AI.conclusion: VISTA-DZ框架通过语义特征条件化有效地提升了个性化困境区决策预测的准确性，并具备良好的跨域迁移能力，为智能交通系统中的驾驶行为建模提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 在信号交叉口，驾驶员在困境区（Dilemma Zone）的决策对安全至关重要，因为接近黄灯的车辆必须在有限的时间和距离内决定是停车还是通行。准确预测“停-走”决策和决策时间对于自适应信号控制、高级驾驶辅助系统及以人为本的智能交通应用具有重要意义。然而，困境区行为具有强烈的驾驶员依赖性。由于风险偏好、刹车习惯和决策阈值的差异，相似的接近轨迹可能导致不同驾驶员做出不同的决策。现有的个性化模型通常依赖于人工设计的标量描述符，这些描述符虽然有用，但对个体行为的总结能力有限。本文提出了VISTA-DZ，一个用于个性化“停-走”及决策时间预测的语义轮廓条件化框架。该方法将历史轨迹转换为视觉表示，通过视觉语言模型解读以生成行为轮廓，并编码为语义嵌入来调节双输出预测网络。最终模型结合了双向GRU编码器、驾驶员条件化多头交叉注意力机制以及特征线性调制（FiLM），用于时间证据选择和特征适应。在SDZ数据集和新收集的FDZ数据集上的实验表明，VISTA-DZ优于仅基于轨迹和人工个性化基准模型，在域内模拟中达到了93.26%的准确率，并在20个预留模拟驾驶员中达到了90.22%的平均准确率。跨域结果进一步显示了其在模拟到现实零样本迁移的可行性，以及在模拟数据与有限现场数据结合时更好的现实世界泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为VISTA-DZ的个性化困境区决策预测框架。该方法利用视觉语言模型将历史驾驶轨迹转化为语义行为特征，并结合深度学习模块对驾驶员的“停-走”决策及决策时间进行精准预测，有效解决了困境区行为的个性化差异建模难题。
AI.keywords: 困境区预测, 个性化建模, 视觉语言模型, 轨迹分析, 驾驶员行为
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了视觉语言模型将历史轨迹转化为语义特征，从而捕捉个性化的驾驶习惯。相较于传统的人工特征工程，这种方法能够更深入地理解驾驶员的风险偏好，在处理个体差异性和跨域迁移问题上展现了显著优势。

title: Deforking the World of Code: A Project-Provenance Map that Recovers Cross-Forge Fork Families that Platform Graphs Cannot See
summary: Forks share git history, so a commit surfaces in many repositories and any spread- or popularity-based measure over raw repositories is inflated by orders of magnitude. We release a curated deforking map for the World of Code (WoC) version V2604: p2PFull, which collapses every raw repository p into the deforked project P to which it belongs, built from the global shared-commit relation (51.79M shared-commit groups) via a hub-node star encoding and parallel Louvain clustering, plus capped variants (cap250/cap500) that bound mega-cluster size. The naive shared-history union over-merges: the project graph welds unrelated software into giant clusters (largest uncapped cluster 861,948 repositories, bridged by shared-commit groups as large as 267,200), for the same structural reason author-identity graphs do. A cheap size cap removes the boilerplate-hub bridges; a structural-bridge diagnostic, the cut that dissolved the analogous author mega-cluster, run here but deliberately not applied, shows the post-cap residual is genuine vendored history, robust to the cut, so we leave it intact. We validate the map against GitHub's declared fork graph reconstructed from GHArchive ForkEvents, finding 99.01% edge agreement conditional on both repositories being in WoC. Disagreements fall into two classes: a completeness byproduct (edges GitHub asserts but WoC has not ingested) and the central contribution, WoC-only fork families that GitHub's platform graph cannot represent, including 5.41% multi-forge families and 1.51% whose fork root is not on GitHub. We additionally release a refreshed fork-exclusion list (134.1M children, 3.4x the GHTorrent-era 39.5M) and a detached-fork inventory (455,550 hard-detached edges; 240,441 genuine independent origins). All artifacts are a self-contained, independently hosted replication package keyed to the WoC V2604 collection.

AI.title_translation: 代码世界的去分叉：一种能够恢复平台图谱无法识别的跨平台分叉家族的项目溯源图
AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析共享提交历史，构建了一个能够跨平台识别代码分叉关系的映射图，解决了传统平台统计方法中存在的重复计数和信息缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 由于分叉机制导致同一代码在多个仓库中重复出现，使得基于原始仓库的流行度或传播度量被严重高估，且单一平台（如GitHub）的图谱无法涵盖跨平台的代码分叉关系。
AI.method: 利用全局共享提交关系（51.79M个共享提交组），采用中心节点星型编码和并行Louvain聚类算法，将原始仓库聚合成去分叉项目，并引入规模上限（cap250/cap500）来优化聚类结果。
AI.result: 构建了WoC去分叉映射，与GitHub fork图谱的一致性达到99.01%；识别了GitHub无法覆盖的跨平台分叉家族（5.41%）及非GitHub源分叉（1.51%）；发布了包含1.34亿条记录的更新版分叉排除列表及独立分叉清单。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功构建并发布了WoC V2604版本的去分叉项目映射，证明了基于共享提交记录的方法能够比单一平台图谱更准确地识别跨平台分叉家族，为开源软件生态的定量分析提供了更可靠的基础数据。
AI.translation: 分叉共享git历史，因此一个提交会在许多仓库中出现，任何基于原始仓库的传播或流行度度量都会被放大几个数量级。我们发布了World of Code (WoC) V2604: p2PFull版本的策划去分叉映射，该映射将每个原始仓库p归并到其所属的去分叉项目P中。该映射基于全局共享提交关系（51.79M个共享提交组），通过中心节点星型编码和并行Louvain聚类构建，并辅以限制巨型聚类规模的上限变体（cap250/cap500）。朴素的共享历史并集会产生过度合并：项目图将不相关的软件焊接成巨大的聚类（最大的未限制聚类包含861,948个仓库，由多达267,200个共享提交组桥接），其结构原因与作者身份图相同。廉价的规模上限消除了样板中心桥接；结构桥诊断（曾用于溶解类似的作者巨型聚类）显示，上限后的残留部分是真实的供应商历史，对此我们予以保留。我们通过GHArchive ForkEvents重建的GitHub声明分叉图验证了该映射，发现当两个仓库都在WoC中时，边的一致性达到99.01%。分歧分为两类：一是完整性副产品（GitHub断言但WoC尚未摄入的边），二是本文的核心贡献，即GitHub平台图无法表示的仅存在于WoC中的分叉家族，包括5.41%的多平台家族和1.51%分叉根不在GitHub上的家族。我们还发布了更新的分叉排除列表（1.34亿个子节点，是GHTorrent时代的3.4倍）和分离分叉清单（455,550条硬分离边；240,441个真实的独立起源）。所有工件都是一个独立的、独立托管的复制包，针对WoC V2604集合。
AI.summary: 本文针对World of Code（WoC）数据集，提出了一种基于共享提交记录的去分叉映射方法。通过聚类分析，将重复的仓库归并为单一项目，有效解决了单一平台图谱无法捕捉跨平台分叉关系的问题，并提供了高精度、多维度的开源生态分析工具。
AI.keywords: World of Code, 代码分叉, 软件工程, 共享提交, 仓库聚类
AI.comments: 该研究通过解决代码仓库“分叉（Fork）”导致的重复统计问题，显著提升了对大规模代码库（World of Code）结构的理解。其创新点在于利用共享提交记录构建跨平台的项目溯源图，不仅弥补了单一平台（如GitHub）元数据的局限性，还通过聚类算法有效识别了被低估的跨平台分叉关系。该工作对于软件工程大数据的精准度量具有重要意义。

title: Optimizer Memory Makes Shuffle Order a First-Order Source of Fine-Tuning Noise
summary: Shuffle order can be a larger source of fine-tuning noise than a memoryless analysis predicts: fixed-clock optimizer memory makes local equal-multiset contrasts first order in the learning rate rather than second order, and the resulting order channel can be large enough for a single seed to flip a close A/B comparison. We isolate this mechanism and derive a fit-free way to size the noise it produces. For a memoryless optimizer, reordering an equal multiset has no first-order endpoint term; the leading local contrast is the $O(η^2)$ gradient bracket. Fixed-clock optimizers such as AdamW are different. Their moment buffers, preconditioner state, and de-biasing counters advance with the step index rather than with the learning-rate-scaled time $τ=ηk$, so the same gradient can receive a position-dependent endpoint weight. For any fixed finite measurement window, a lifted-state expansion gives an $O(η)$ equal-multiset contrast whenever the first-order replay coefficient is nonzero, while regular and clock-matched controls remain $O(η^2)$; a bare fixed-$β$ momentum buffer is already enough. A bitwise-deterministic replay from one warmed optimizer state isolates the mechanism, giving order-variance slopes 1.83 for AdamW, 2.00 for fixed-$β$ momentum, and 4.00 for SGD; matching the memory clock to $τ$ restores the regular exponent. For AdamW with a frozen preconditioner, the same impulse-weight kernel gives a closed-form asymptotic order-variance floor after the local potentials are measured, with no fitted coefficients. The result is local to the measurement window (independent reshuffling can average the channel across windows), but it yields order-noise error bars, positional attribution weights, and a seed-budget criterion for fine-tuning comparisons.

title: Persona-Trained Monte Carlo: Estimating Market-Outcome Distributions via Swarms of Persona-Conditioned Neural Policy Bots in a Limit Order Book
comments: 58 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables, 3 algorithms. Survey and proposed framework; no implementation or empirical results
summary: We propose Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC), a method for estimating distributions of market-outcome statistics by repeatedly simulating limit-order-book interaction among swarms of persona-conditioned neural-policy trading bots. Each run instantiates many bots sharing one trained policy network but conditioned on heterogeneous, individually sampled persona parameters drawn from a learned trader-heterogeneity distribution; the bots interact in a continuous double auction, and the resulting price path is one Monte Carlo sample. Repeating this over independent persona-population draws yields an ensemble from which a target market statistic is estimated. Randomness enters through persona draws, within-run action sampling, and optional exogenous shocks, not solely through price as in classical Monte Carlo. We distinguish PTMC from adjacent paradigms, including classical Monte Carlo, hand-coded agent-based models, single-agent reinforcement learning, and large-language-model-based generative agents. To justify the design, we survey cross-disciplinary foundations -- agent-based computational economics, market microstructure, behavioral finance, deep reinforcement learning, generative/LLM-based agents, news-driven trading, systemic risk, econophysics, and game theory -- connecting each literature to a specific design choice in the policy network, training data, or validation protocol. We formalize the PTMC estimator and its convergence properties, specify a candidate bot architecture and training objective, and propose a four-level validation methodology: stylized-fact matching, microstructure- and agent-level checks, and historical stress-test comparison against a zero-intelligence baseline. The framework is proposed but not implemented: we contribute a formal estimator, a cross-disciplinary design justification, and a validation roadmap, and conclude with open research questions.
comment: 58 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables, 3 algorithms. Survey and proposed framework; no implementation or empirical results

title: Coverage-Driven KV Cache Eviction for Efficient and Improved Inference of LLM
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex tasks like question answering and summarization, thanks to their ability to handle long-context inputs. However, deploying LLMs is costly, not only due to the high computational demands of quadratic complexity of self-attention and auto-regressive generation, but also because of the significant memory overhead required for storing the key-value (KV) cache during inference. To reduce the memory cost, existing KV-cache eviction strategies leverage the sparsity in attention to selectively store a subset of tokens. While reducing the memory footprint, such approaches show a considerable drop in performance, especially in tasks that require long-context reasoning. We identify that the drop in performance is linked to a reduction in the coverage of unique tokens. Additionally, we theoretically show that reduced coverage limits the mutual information between inputs and outputs, thereby impairing predictive accuracy. To this end, we introduce K-VEC, a novel coverage-aware KV-cache eviction strategy that prioritizes token coverage while evicting tokens in the cache. K-VEC introduces a cross-head and a cross-layer coverage module to enhance token retention across attention heads and model layers, mitigating performance degradation caused by low coverage. Evaluated on 16 LongBench subsets, K-VEC exhibit up to 10.35 points improvement over the existing methods under the same eviction rate and memory constraint. Comprehensive evaluations validate the effectiveness of our approach and demonstrate its potential for efficient LLM deployment in resource-constrained settings.

AI.title_translation: 用于高效且改进的大语言模型推理的覆盖驱动型KV缓存淘汰策略
AI.tldr: K-VEC通过在KV缓存淘汰中优先考虑令牌覆盖率，有效解决了现有方法在长上下文推理中性能下降的问题，实现了内存效率与推理精度的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的KV缓存淘汰策略虽然减少了内存开销，但会导致长上下文推理任务的性能显著下降。研究发现，该性能下降与令牌覆盖率的降低直接相关，因此需要一种能维持高覆盖率的淘汰机制。
AI.method: 提出K-VEC策略，通过引入跨头（cross-head）和跨层（cross-layer）覆盖模块，在淘汰令牌时优先考虑令牌的覆盖范围，以保持输入与输出之间的互信息。
AI.result: 在16个LongBench子集上的评估表明，在相同的淘汰率和内存约束下，K-VEC相比现有方法性能提升高达10.35个百分点。
AI.conclusion: K-VEC通过优化跨头和跨层的令牌覆盖率，有效地缓解了KV缓存淘汰带来的性能下降，为资源受限环境下的长上下文LLM部署提供了一种高效且准确的解决方案。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）凭借处理长上下文输入的能力，在问答和摘要等复杂任务中表现出色。然而，部署LLMs成本高昂，这不仅是因为自注意力机制的二次复杂度和自回归生成的计算需求，还因为推理过程中存储键值（KV）缓存所需的巨大内存开销。为了降低内存成本，现有的KV缓存淘汰策略利用注意力机制的稀疏性来选择性地存储部分令牌。虽然这些方法减少了内存占用，但性能却大幅下降，特别是在需要长上下文推理的任务中。我们发现性能下降与唯一令牌覆盖率的降低有关。此外，我们从理论上证明了覆盖率降低限制了输入和输出之间的互信息，从而损害了预测准确性。为此，我们引入了K-VEC，这是一种新颖的覆盖感知KV缓存淘汰策略，在淘汰缓存中的令牌时优先考虑令牌覆盖率。K-VEC引入了跨头和跨层覆盖模块，以增强跨注意力头和模型层的令牌保留，从而减轻由低覆盖率引起的性能退化。在16个LongBench子集上的评估显示，在相同的淘汰率和内存约束下，K-VEC比现有方法有高达10.35点的性能提升。全面的评估验证了我们方法的有效性，并展示了其在资源受限环境下进行高效LLM部署的潜力。
AI.summary: 针对大语言模型推理中KV缓存内存占用高且现有淘汰策略导致性能下降的问题，本文提出了K-VEC。该方法通过引入覆盖感知机制，优先保留具有代表性的令牌，并利用跨头与跨层模块增强令牌保留效果，在有效节省内存的同时显著提升了长上下文任务的推理质量。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, KV缓存, 令牌淘汰, 推理效率, 长上下文推理
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将“覆盖率（coverage）”概念引入KV缓存淘汰策略，并通过理论推导揭示了覆盖率与互信息、预测准确性之间的关系。相比于以往仅关注注意力稀疏性的方法，K-VEC在保持内存效率的同时，显著提升了长文本任务的推理性能。

title: Speculative Pre-Positioning: Decoding Stateful Sessions to the Next Decision Point Off the Critical Path
summary: A stateless inference server (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) idles between requests while the accelerator waits; a stateful session reclaims that idle time. Speculative pre-positioning decodes the session forward to its next decision point with the target model's own forward pass and no draft model, moving the cross-request prefill and entry-decode off the critical path: the next request resumes from a pre-paid entry on its delta, or, when a confidence gate fires, is answered from a cached distribution in one near-constant vocabulary scan with no decode, at a cost only of energy and a rare, bounded false accept. The payoff is conditional on capability: a capable model fires the gate at near-full coverage and about 87% precision (a smaller one never clears it), returning the first token in about 1.0 ms versus the 39 ms decode a prefix cache still pays.

AI.title_translation: 投机预定位：将状态化会话解码至关键路径之外的下一个决策点
AI.tldr: 通过利用模型空闲时间进行超前解码，将首字延迟从39毫秒缩短至1毫秒，无需额外草稿模型即可实现推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的无状态推理服务器在请求间存在空闲时间，导致加速器利用率低下，且首字延迟限制了系统性能。
AI.method: 利用目标模型自身的正向传递进行超前解码，将跨请求的预填充（prefill）和初始解码（entry-decode）移出关键路径；通过置信度门控机制，在满足条件时直接从缓存分布中获取结果，无需常规解码步骤。
AI.result: 在具备足够能力的模型上，该方法实现了近乎全覆盖的门控触发，精度达到约87%；首字延迟降至约1.0毫秒，相比传统前缀缓存的39毫秒解码有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 投机预定位技术通过利用模型自身的空闲计算能力进行预先解码，成功将首字延迟从39毫秒降低至约1.0毫秒，显著提升了状态化会话的推理效率。
AI.translation: 无状态推理服务器（如vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM）在请求处理间隙处于空闲状态，而状态化会话可以回收这些空闲时间。投机预定位（Speculative Pre-Positioning）利用目标模型自身的正向传递，在没有草稿模型的情况下，将跨请求的预填充和初始解码移出关键路径，从而将解码推进到下一个决策点：下一个请求可以从预先准备的条目继续，或者在置信度门控触发时，通过一次近乎常数的词汇扫描直接从缓存分布中得出结果，无需解码，仅消耗额外的能量和极少数的误报代价。该技术的收益取决于模型能力：能力强的模型可以实现近乎全覆盖的门控触发，精度约为87%（较小的模型则无法触发），将首字延迟从前缀缓存所需的39毫秒解码时间缩短至约1.0毫秒。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“投机预定位”的推理优化技术，通过在模型空闲期进行超前解码，将预填充和初始解码任务移出关键路径。该技术无需辅助草稿模型，通过置信度门控机制实现低延迟响应，大幅提升了状态化会话的推理性能。
AI.keywords: 推理服务器, 投机预定位, 首字延迟, 状态化会话, 模型加速
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的“投机预定位”方法，通过利用模型自身进行超前解码，成功将关键路径上的计算负担卸载。其核心亮点在于无需额外的草稿模型，且显著降低了首字延迟，为提升大模型推理效率提供了新思路。主要限制在于该方法的性能高度依赖于模型本身的推断能力，且存在一定的误报（false accept）风险。

title: Analyzing Uncertainty in the Spatial Representation of the Kinematic Bicycle Model
summary:
Locating a vehicle and determining its orientation in an uncertain environment is a critical challenge in autonomous vehicle navigation and path planning. To address these challenges, a vehicle estimates its pose while depending on sensor data that offer noisy measurements. These uncertainties in pose quantities are expressed mathematically as a covariance matrix. The real-time computation of the covariance matrix is critical because of the non-linearity involved in the kinematic model. The challenge is thus to evaluate the evolution of the covariance matrix of a vehicle's discretized stochastic kinematics.
  The purpose of this study is to obtain a near-accurate evolution of the covariance matrix of the rear-wheel bicycle kinematic model under uncertainties in wheel displacement and steering angle. We used Taylor's series to linearize the nonlinear trigonometric functions and provided closed-form expectations of random variables with the required accuracy. Our analytical findings are in good agreement with those obtained from Monte-Carlo simulations. Our contribution is probably the first detailed closed-form presentation of the covariance matrix constituents of the vehicle under evaluation, which were previously reported either incorrectly or incompletely. These findings aid in identifying the potential and constraints of the discretized kinematic model as well as its stochastic analysis. The techniques presented here are useful for the simultaneous localization and odometry self-calibration of certain mobile robots and autonomous vehicles.

title: SurrogateShield: Beyond Redaction for High-Utility, Privacy-Preserving LLM Interactions
comments: 14 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/sherwinvishesh/SurrogateShield
summary:
LLM-based assistants transmit user queries verbatim to third-party API endpoints that lie outside the user's audit or control. When those queries contain personally identifiable information (PII), the data persists on remote infrastructure subject to breach, subpoena, or policy change. Placeholder redaction (the prevailing mitigation) suppresses PII at the cost of semantic coherence, producing structurally degraded queries and correspondingly degraded responses.
