title: Energy-Efficient Multimodal Inference Serving with Tri-serve
summary:
Multimodal model inference creates substantial energy demand with growing performance requirements. Within GPUs, power is autonomously managed by an on-board power management unit (PMU), which makes frequency boosting/throttling decisions. However, we find that these hardware-managed frequency decisions can cause significant power inefficiency.
  This work identifies three classes of power inefficiencies within modern multimodal inference serving: (1) inter-stage dependency stalls run at near maximum frequency despite being idle; (2) anti-correlation between auto-boost frequency and arithmetic intensity (A.I.) results in compute-bound phases (e.g., prefill) running at lower frequency and vice versa; and (3) thermal throttling degrades SM frequency and throughput.
  We propose Tri-serve, a software-based DVFS controller that jointly accounts for three classes of inefficiency -- inter-stage Dependency stalls, the Arithmetic-intensity effect on frequency and power, and the Thermal-throttling effect of high A.I. phases -- to deliver energy-efficient multimodal serving on commodity GPUs. We show that Tri-serve achieves 22% energy efficiency improvement with no latency or throughput impacts.

AI.title_translation: 基于Tri-serve的节能型多模态推理服务
AI.tldr: Tri-serve是一种软件DVFS控制器，通过优化多模态推理过程中的频率调度，在不损失性能的前提下，将GPU推理能效提升了22%。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型推理对能源需求巨大，且GPU内置的硬件功耗管理单元（PMU）在处理推理负载时存在频率控制策略不当，导致明显的功耗效率低下。
AI.method: 提出Tri-serve，这是一个基于软件的DVFS（动态电压频率调整）控制器，通过联合考虑阶段间依赖停顿、算术强度对频率的影响以及高强度阶段的热节流效应，主动调整GPU运行频率。
AI.result: 在不影响推理延迟或吞吐量的情况下，Tri-serve实现了22%的能效提升。
AI.conclusion: Tri-serve通过软件层面的DVFS控制，成功解决了多模态推理中硬件自动功耗管理导致的低效问题，在保证性能的前提下显著提升了能效。
AI.translation: 多模态模型推理带来了巨大的能源需求和日益增长的性能要求。在GPU内部，功率由板载电源管理单元（PMU）自主管理，该单元负责做出频率提升/节流决策。然而，我们发现这些硬件管理的频率决策会导致严重的功率效率低下。本研究确定了现代多模态推理服务中三类功率低效问题：（1）级间依赖停顿在空闲时仍以接近最大频率运行；（2）自动提升频率与算术强度（A.I.）之间的反相关导致计算密集型阶段（如预填充）以较低频率运行，反之亦然；（3）热节流降低了SM频率和吞吐量。我们提出了Tri-serve，这是一个基于软件的DVFS控制器，它共同考虑了这三类低效问题——级间依赖停顿、算术强度对频率和功率的影响，以及高A.I.阶段的热节流效应——从而在商用GPU上提供节能的多模态服务。我们证明，Tri-serve在不影响延迟或吞吐量的情况下，实现了22%的能效提升。
AI.summary: 针对多模态推理中GPU硬件功耗管理效率低下的问题，本文提出了Tri-serve系统。该系统通过软件控制手段，综合考量任务依赖、算术强度及热效应，优化GPU频率调度，在维持性能的同时大幅降低了推理能耗。
AI.keywords: 多模态推理, 节能, DVFS, GPU功耗管理, 推理服务
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将软件层面的DVFS控制与多模态推理的特定执行特征（如阶段依赖、算术强度和热效应）相结合。其重要性在于无需硬件修改即可在商用GPU上显著提升能效，解决了硬件内置功耗管理机制在复杂推理工作负载下的次优表现。限制在于可能需要针对不同GPU架构进行精细调优。

title: SFBench: The SciFy Scientific Feasibility Benchmark
summary: We present SFBench, a benchmark dataset for evaluating systems that assess the feasibility of scientific claims. SFBench includes 197 claims in materials science, each annotated with a ground-truth feasibility score on a five-point scale along with an explanation of that assessment. The collection differs from previous collections in several important ways: 1) it defines a complex task that requires reasoning over claims of varying scientific feasibility; 2) its claims are not extracted from existing scientific publications but are created de novo, greatly reducing the chances that LLMs have trained on them; 3) claims and ground truth are established by subject matter experts, not by artificial intelligence; and 4) unlike many benchmarks that ask about question/answer pairs, provide multiple choice answers, or ask questions requiring short, fixed answers, SFBench explanations are completely open-ended. We describe the benchmark design, data creation process, and evaluation metrics, and we report baseline results using recent GPT models.

title: Two-Stage Prompt Optimization for Few-Shot Relation Extraction: From Reasoning-Guided Search to Gradient-Guided Refinement
summary: Automatic prompt optimization is still underexplored for episodic few-shot relation extraction with smaller language models. We propose a two-stage framework that combines reasoning-based prompt optimization with gradient-based prompt optimization. The first stage can use any reasoning-based optimizer to make broadprompt improvements in natural language. The second stage applies our GradPO, which uses loss and gradient signals to identify high-impact prompt spans and refine them with local edits. Experiments on FS-TACRED and FS-FewRel show that local refinement usually improves prompts found by the first stage, and GradPO is the most consistent refiner. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on FS-TACRED with Qwen3-4B and remains competitive on FS-FewRel.

AI.title_translation: 少样本关系抽取的两阶段提示优化：从推理引导搜索到梯度引导微调
AI.tldr: 一种结合推理引导搜索与梯度引导局部微调的两阶段提示优化框架，在少样本关系抽取任务中显著提升了小语言模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 针对在少样本关系抽取任务中，小语言模型的自动提示词优化研究尚不充分的问题，旨在通过结合推理和梯度信息提升提示词质量。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段优化框架：第一阶段使用推理引导的优化器进行宏观提示词改进；第二阶段使用GradPO（梯度引导提示优化），利用损失函数和梯度信号识别高影响力的提示词片段并进行局部微调。
AI.result: 在FS-TACRED数据集上达到SOTA性能，在FS-FewRel数据集上保持极具竞争力的表现，验证了GradPO作为提示词微调器的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了“推理引导搜索+梯度引导微调”的两阶段框架在少样本关系抽取任务中的优越性，GradPO作为第二阶段的微调器表现出极高的一致性和性能提升效果。
AI.translation: 针对小语言模型的少样本关系抽取自动提示优化研究尚显不足。我们提出了一个结合基于推理的提示优化与基于梯度的提示优化的两阶段框架。第一阶段利用任意基于推理的优化器以自然语言进行宏观的提示词改进；第二阶段应用我们提出的GradPO，利用损失和梯度信号识别高影响力的提示词片段，并进行局部编辑以优化它们。在FS-TACRED和FS-FewRel上的实验表明，局部微调通常能改善第一阶段找到的提示词，且GradPO是最一致的微调器。我们的框架在Qwen3-4B模型下于FS-TACRED任务上达到了最先进性能，并在FS-FewRel上保持了竞争力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对少样本关系抽取的两阶段提示优化框架。第一阶段利用推理引导搜索优化提示词，第二阶段通过GradPO方法，结合损失与梯度信号对关键提示词片段进行局部微调，显著提升了小语言模型在关系抽取任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: 少样本关系抽取, 提示优化, 梯度引导, 两阶段框架, 小语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的两阶段提示优化框架，巧妙地结合了基于推理的全局优化与基于梯度的局部微调，有效弥补了小参数模型在少样本关系抽取任务中提示词优化的不足。其GradPO方法通过梯度信号精准定位并优化提示词片段，具有很强的可解释性和实用价值。

title: Computational Complexity of Strong and Average Justified Representation
summary:
We study the approval-based multiwinner election problem where a set of $n$ voters cast approval-based ballots to a set of $m$ candidates, and we are to select a winner committee consisting of $k$ candidates. We consider two axioms: strong justified representation (SJR) and average justified representation (AJR). A winner committee satisfies SJR if the satisfaction for each voter in every $\ell$-cohesive group is at least $\ell$. AJR is a weaker axiom that requires the average satisfaction for each $\ell$-cohesive group to be at least $\ell$. It is well known that a winner committee satisfying AJR may not exist (and neither does SJR). In this paper, we study the computational complexity of the following decision problem: given an approval-based multiwinner election instance, decide if there exists a winner committee satisfying SJR/AJR. We prove that this problem is $Θ_2^p$-complete for SJR, and $Σ_2^p$-complete for AJR. Our results indicate that the decision problem with SJR is more amenable to SAT-based implementations, whereas the decision problem with AJR is substantially harder.
  As byproducts, we derive some results that are interesting in their own right. Firstly, we show that adding one more adaptive query to an NP oracle on top of polynomially many non-adaptive NP queries does not add more computational power, and the resulting complexity class is still $Θ_2^p$. Secondly, we construct a set system that can be useful in other applications, especially when doing reductions from typical satisfiability problems such as 3SAT.

AI.title_translation: 强正当代表性和平均正当代表性的计算复杂性
AI.tldr: 研究发现，判定选举中是否存在满足“强正当代表性”的委员会比“平均正当代表性”在计算上更容易，前者为$\Theta_2^p$-完全，后者为$\Sigma_2^p$-完全。
AI.motivation: 针对多赢家选举中“强正当代表性”（SJR）和“平均正当代表性”（AJR）这两个公理，探究判定是否存在满足这些条件的获胜委员会的计算复杂性。
AI.method: 利用计算复杂性理论进行归约分析，证明了SJR问题属于$\Theta_2^p$-完全，AJR问题属于$\Sigma_2^p$-完全。同时利用集合系统构造方法处理复杂性证明。
AI.result: 确定了SJR判定问题的复杂性为$\Theta_2^p$-完全，AJR为$\Sigma_2^p$-完全；证明了在多项式个非自适应NP查询基础上增加一个自适应NP查询不会增加计算能力（仍为$\Theta_2^p$）。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了SJR和AJR判决问题的计算复杂性，明确了SJR为$\Theta_2^p$-完全，AJR为$\Sigma_2^p$-完全，表明AJR在计算上显著更难。
AI.translation: 我们研究了基于认可的多赢家选举问题，其中$n$个选民对$m$个候选人进行认可投票，我们要选出一个包含$k$个候选人的获胜委员会。我们考虑两个公理：强正当代表性（SJR）和平均正当代表性（AJR）。如果每个$\ell$-凝聚组中每个选民的满意度至少为$\ell$，则获胜委员会满足SJR。AJR是一个较弱的公理，要求每个$\ell$-凝聚组的平均满意度至少为$\ell$。众所周知，满足AJR的获胜委员会可能不存在（SJR亦然）。在本文中，我们研究了以下决策问题的计算复杂性：给定一个基于认可的多赢家选举实例，判断是否存在满足SJR/AJR的获胜委员会。我们证明了该问题对于SJR是$\Theta_2^p$-完全的，对于AJR是$\Sigma_2^p$-完全的。我们的结果表明，SJR的决策问题更适合基于SAT的实现，而AJR的决策问题则要困难得多。作为副产品，我们得出了一些本身就很有趣的结果。首先，我们证明了在多项式数量的非自适应NP查询之上再增加一个自适应NP查询并不会增加计算能力，所得的复杂性类仍然是$\Theta_2^p$。其次，我们构造了一个在其他应用中很有用的集合系统，特别是在从3SAT等典型可满足性问题进行归约时。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了基于认可的多赢家选举中强正当代表性（SJR）与平均正当代表性（AJR）的判定问题。研究发现SJR判定问题是$\Theta_2^p$-完全的，而AJR判定问题是$\Sigma_2^p$-完全的，说明AJR在计算上比SJR更复杂。此外，论文还贡献了关于计算复杂性类别的理论见解及一种实用的集合系统构造方法。
AI.keywords: 多赢家选举, 强正当代表性(SJR), 平均正当代表性(AJR), 计算复杂性, 决策问题
AI.comments: 该论文通过计算复杂性理论深入分析了多赢家选举中的公平性公理。其创新点在于揭示了SJR与AJR在计算难度上的本质差异，不仅解决了理论问题，还为实际算法实现（如SAT求解器）提供了指导。此外，论文中关于复杂性类别的副产品证明也具有重要的理论价值。

title: t-STEP: An interpretable model for Total Electron Content predictions and irregularities estimations
comments: 40 pages, 15 figures. Note that the article has been published in the Earth Science Informatics Journal
summary: Earth system infrastructures relying on satellite-based technologies, such as Global Positioning System (GPS) communications, are affected by ionospheric Total Electron Content (TEC) gradients. Modeling these gradients under physical constraints remains challenging due to their dynamic and transient nature. While existing machine learning (ML) models can predict hourly TEC variations, it remains unclear whether their temporal resolution is sufficient to preserve small-scale TEC irregularities within predicted signals. To address this gap, we introduce an interpretable ML-based model, t-STEP, designed to predict TEC at a 30-second resolution and estimate irregularity signatures from the modeled signals. This high cadence enables the derivation of Rate of TEC changes (ROT) and the ROT Index (ROTI) as diagnostic indicators of ionospheric variability. The model is developed using GPS observations from solar cycle 24 at a station located at 5.49°S, 47.49°W. A multi-metric evaluation framework, including dynamic time warping, is used for robustness assessment, while SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) provides insight into feature contributions. The 30-second TEC predictions achieve 91% accuracy with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 4.38 TECU during high solar activity (2015). Compared with the International Reference Ionosphere (IRI-2020), the hourly model improves accuracy by 35%, reduces absolute errors by 57%, and increases prediction skill by 54%. More importantly, the 30-second model captures TEC irregularity dynamics and morphologies during geomagnetic storms of different intensities, outperforming an attention-based Long Short-Term Memory model under the same experimental conditions. This study demonstrates the potential of a single TEC prediction framework for scalable irregularity monitoring without requiring separate models for individual transient events.
comment: 40 pages, 15 figures. Note that the article has been published in the Earth Science Informatics Journal

AI.title_translation: t-STEP：一种用于电离层总电子含量预测和不规则性估计的可解释模型
AI.tldr: t-STEP 是一种新型可解释机器学习模型，通过 30 秒高分辨率预测电离层 TEC，填补了现有模型在捕捉小尺度电离层不规则性方面的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习模型在预测电离层总电子含量（TEC）时，时间分辨率不足以捕捉小尺度的 TEC 不规则性，且缺乏物理约束下的可解释性，难以有效应对电离层动态和瞬态变化。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 t-STEP 的可解释机器学习模型，通过 30 秒高时间分辨率预测 TEC，并结合 SHAP 进行特征贡献分析。使用来自第 24 太阳周的 GPS 观测数据进行训练，并通过动态时间规整（DTW）等多指标框架进行评估。
AI.result: t-STEP 模型在 2015 年高太阳活动期间实现了 91% 的预测准确率（MAE 为 4.38 TECU）。相比 IRI-2020 模型，其准确性提升了 35%，绝对误差降低了 57%，预测技能提升了 54%，并能有效捕捉地磁暴期间的 TEC 不规则性。
AI.conclusion: t-STEP 模型成功实现了高分辨率的电离层 TEC 预测及不规则性估计，在准确性和对复杂电离层动态的捕捉能力上均显著优于现有基准模型，证明了其在空间天气监测中的应用价值。
AI.translation: 依赖于卫星技术的地球系统基础设施，如全球定位系统（GPS）通信，受到电离层总电子含量（TEC）梯度的影响。由于其动态和瞬态性质，在物理约束下对这些梯度进行建模仍然具有挑战性。虽然现有的机器学习（ML）模型可以预测每小时的 TEC 变化，但其时间分辨率是否足以保留预测信号中的小尺度 TEC 不规则性尚不清楚。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了一种基于 ML 的可解释模型 t-STEP，旨在以 30 秒的分辨率预测 TEC，并从建模信号中估计不规则性特征。这种高节奏使得能够导出 TEC 变化率（ROT）和 ROT 指数（ROTI）作为电离层变异性的诊断指标。该模型是利用位于南纬 5.49°、西经 47.49° 的测站在第 24 太阳周的 GPS 观测数据开发的。使用包括动态时间规整在内的多指标评估框架进行稳健性评估，同时 SHAP（Shapley 加性解释）提供了对特征贡献的见解。30 秒的 TEC 预测在 2015 年高太阳活动期间达到了 91% 的准确率，平均绝对误差（MAE）为 4.38 TECU。与国际参考电离层（IRI-2020）相比，该小时模型将准确率提高了 35%，绝对误差降低了 57%，预测技能提高了 54%。更重要的是，30 秒模型捕捉到了不同强度地磁暴期间的 TEC 不规则性动态和形态，在相同的实验条件下表现优于基于注意力的长短期记忆（LSTM）模型。这项研究展示了单一 TEC 预测框架在可扩展不规则性监测方面的潜力，无需为单个瞬态事件建立单独的模型。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 t-STEP，这是一种用于电离层总电子含量（TEC）预测的可解释机器学习模型。该模型能够以 30 秒的高时间分辨率进行预测，并能从中推导出电离层不规则性指标（如 ROTI）。实验结果表明，t-STEP 在高太阳活动期间的性能显著优于传统参考模型，且能有效监测地磁暴期间的瞬态电离层变化。
AI.keywords: 电离层 TEC, 机器学习, 可解释性 AI, 空间天气, GPS 观测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将可解释性机器学习与高时间分辨率（30秒）的电离层TEC预测相结合，不仅实现了高精度的预测，还能有效捕捉电离层的不规则性（如ROTI），为空间天气监测提供了一种统一且可扩展的框架。其使用SHAP进行解释性分析，增强了模型的可信度。

title: Metadata, Structure, or Strategy? A Decomposition of RAG Context Enrichment
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly enrich retrieved passages by attaching quality metadata, structuring them into explicit records, and adopting multi-hop retrieval strategies that accumulate evidence across steps. These changes assume that richer context yields better answers, yet existing evaluations cannot test this because they vary all three factors at once. We isolate each factor in a controlled experiment across six benchmarks, four models from three families, and five enrichment levels, totaling over 24,000 evaluated responses. The assumption does not hold. Most enrichment reduces accuracy. Models prompted to use confidence scores comply correctly yet produce worse answers, a gap between utilization and accuracy that no prior work has measured. What determines answer quality is not how much metadata the context carries but whether the model can act on it for the given task. When metadata and retrieval strategy are aligned with model capabilities, a smaller model outperforms a frontier model by 19 F1 points. These findings motivate a processability hierarchy that predicts, from pre-training properties alone, which metadata a model can productively use, reframing RAG design as a question of model-context alignment rather than metadata accumulation.

title: Fuzzing Large Language Models to Elicit Hidden Behaviours
summary: Sleeper agents are the canonical model organism of deception: models trained to behave normally but to emit an unsafe behaviour on a specific trigger. Eliciting that behaviour without knowing the trigger has not been studied systematically. We study fuzzing: injecting Gaussian noise into a model's weights or residual-stream activations and checking whether the perturbed outputs reveal the behaviour. On 6 backdoored models (7B-13B) we compare both forms of fuzzing head-to-head against temperature-sampling baselines. Fuzzing elicits the hidden behaviour more often than temperature sampling on 4 of 6 models (up to ~6x on OpenHermes-13B), and which form wins depends on the task, so both are worth running. Elicitation is uneven across each method's hyperparameter grid: a uniform sweep gives only a few percent on most models, while the best cell is 2-10x higher, so the bottleneck is hyperparameter selection, not the technique. To select hyperparameters without ground-truth access, we use a cheap proxy task (in-context secret elicitation, where a base64-encoded secret is placed in the system prompt for the model to hide) and run Thompson sampling on it to pick candidate cells, which we evaluate on the real backdoor. On the four models that can decode the secret, proxy-selected cells raise activation-fuzzing elicitation ~4x over the uniform-sweep mean (recovering ~70% of the best-cell rate on the best performing model) and weight-fuzzing by 1.3-1.8x. To our knowledge this is the first systematic study of fuzzing on sleeper-agent backdoors and the first to show proxy-task hyperparameter selection transferring to real-task elicitation. We also propose reporting such results as a (uniform-baseline, proxy-selected, oracle) triple, since these are three distinct claims that prior work has often blurred.

AI.title_translation: 模糊测试大语言模型以诱导隐蔽行为
AI.tldr: 通过向模型权重或激活中注入噪声进行模糊测试，结合代理任务优化超参数，能有效诱导并揭示大语言模型中的隐蔽后门行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的研究缺乏对如何在未知触发器的情况下系统性地诱导大语言模型中存在的隐蔽行为（Sleeper agents）进行探讨。
AI.method: 提出两种模糊测试方法：向模型权重或残差流激活中注入高斯噪声，并对比温度采样基线；通过设置代理任务（解码Base64秘密）并利用Thompson采样进行超参数选择。
AI.result: 模糊测试在4/6的模型上优于温度采样；使用代理任务选择超参数可将激活模糊测试的诱导成功率提高约4倍，成功恢复了最佳超参数配置下约70%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 模糊测试是触发大模型隐蔽行为的有效手段，且通过代理任务进行超参数优化可以显著提升检测成功率，为评估模型后门安全性提供了新的研究范式。
AI.translation: “睡眠代理”（Sleeper agents）是欺骗行为的典型模型：这些模型被训练以正常方式表现，但在特定触发器下表现出不安全行为。在未知触发器的情况下诱导该行为尚未得到系统研究。我们研究了模糊测试：通过向模型的权重或残差流激活中注入高斯噪声，并检查扰动后的输出是否揭示了该行为。在6个带有后门的模型（7B-13B）上，我们将两种形式的模糊测试与温度采样基线进行了对比。模糊测试在6个模型中的4个上比温度采样更频繁地诱导出隐蔽行为（在OpenHermes-13B上高达约6倍），且哪种形式更有效取决于任务，因此两者都值得尝试。诱导结果在每种方法的超参数网格上分布不均：均匀扫描在大多数模型上仅能获得几个百分点的成功率，而最佳单元的成功率高出2-10倍，因此瓶颈在于超参数选择，而非技术本身。为了在没有真实触发器访问权限的情况下选择超参数，我们使用了一个廉价的代理任务（上下文秘密诱导，将Base64编码的秘密放在系统提示词中让模型隐藏），并对其运行Thompson采样以选择候选单元，然后在真实后门上进行评估。在能解码秘密的4个模型上，代理选择的单元使激活模糊测试的诱导率比均匀扫描平均值提高了约4倍（在表现最好的模型上恢复了最佳单元率的约70%），重量模糊测试提高了1.3-1.8倍。据我们所知，这是首次对睡眠代理后门进行模糊测试的系统研究，也是首次展示代理任务超参数选择转移到真实任务诱导的研究。我们还建议将此类结果报告为（均匀基线，代理选择，预言机）三元组，因为这是先前工作经常混淆的三个不同主张。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用模糊测试（向权重或激活注入噪声）来诱导大语言模型中隐蔽后门行为的方法。研究发现，模糊测试在多数模型上优于传统的温度采样，且通过代理任务进行超参数优化可以显著提升诱导效率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 模糊测试, 后门攻击, 隐蔽行为, 超参数优化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将模糊测试（Fuzzing）技术引入大语言模型后门（Sleeper agents）的检测中，为评估模型安全性和隐蔽行为提供了一种系统性的方法。其核心贡献在于证明了通过代理任务（Proxy task）进行超参数选择的可行性，这对于在缺乏真实触发器的情况下评估黑盒模型具有重要意义。

title: Hybrid Retriever Evolution for Multimodal Document Reasoning Agents
summary: Different retrievers, including lexical, semantic, and multimodal approaches, provide highly complementary strengths for multimodal document understanding, yet most systems combine them through fixed pipelines that cannot adapt to the demands of individual reasoning steps. In this work, we ask whether retrieval orchestration itself can be learned as part of the reasoning process. We introduce a failure-driven evolution framework in which a meta-agent autonomously discovers how a tool-using task agent should coordinate diverse retrievers during multi-step document question answering. The meta-agent analyzes incorrect reasoning trajectories, actively probes the same tool environment to diagnose root causes, and iteratively rewrites the task agent's instructions, turning retrieval from a fixed front-end stage into an adaptive, step-wise reasoning decision. The evolved agent learns when to invoke each retriever, how to combine them, and how to compose evidence across modalities and pages. On MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench, the evolved agent achieves gains of up to +19.6 points over the unevolved baseline and consistently outperforms recent systems including MACT, MDocAgent, and SimpleDoc. Detailed retrieval analyses confirm that these improvements arise from adaptive routing and evidence composition rather than reliance on any hard coded retrieval mode, and evolution dynamics reveal a progressive shift from narrow lexical behavior to rich multi-tool coordination. These findings establish autonomous multi-agent coordination as a promising paradigm for multimodal document reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 面向多模态文档推理智能体的混合检索演进
AI.tldr: 通过引入元智能体进行失败驱动的进化，使任务智能体能够根据推理步骤自主动态选择和组合不同检索器，显著提升了多模态文档的理解与问答表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态文档理解系统多采用固定的检索管道，缺乏针对复杂推理任务中不同步骤的动态适应能力，因此需要一种能将检索编排融入推理过程并自主进化的方法。
AI.method: 引入失败驱动进化框架，通过元智能体（Meta-agent）分析任务智能体的失败轨迹，诊断根本原因，并迭代重写任务智能体的指令，使其能根据推理步骤自主决策检索器的调用、组合及跨模态证据的合成。
AI.result: 在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 DocBench 基准测试上，进化后的智能体表现出显著提升，最高得分增长达 19.6 分，并优于 MACT、MDocAgent 和 SimpleDoc 等现有系统。分析表明，其性能提升源于自适应路由和证据合成能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过失败驱动进化框架，成功实现了多模态文档推理中检索策略的自主演进，证明了动态检索协调优于固定管道模型，为多模态文档理解领域提供了高效且可扩展的新范式。
AI.translation: 不同的检索器，包括词法、语义和多模态方法，为多模态文档理解提供了高度互补的优势，但大多数系统通过固定管道将它们组合在一起，无法适应单个推理步骤的需求。在这项工作中，我们探讨了检索编排本身是否可以作为推理过程的一部分来学习。我们引入了一个失败驱动的进化框架，其中一个元智能体自主发现工具使用任务智能体应如何在多步文档问答中协调不同的检索器。元智能体分析错误的推理轨迹，主动探测相同的工具环境以诊断根本原因，并迭代重写任务智能体的指令，将检索从固定的前端阶段转变为自适应的、逐步的推理决策。进化后的智能体学会了何时调用每个检索器、如何组合它们，以及如何跨模态和页面合成证据。在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 DocBench 上，进化后的智能体比未进化的基线最高提升了 19.6 分，并持续优于包括 MACT、MDocAgent 和 SimpleDoc 在内的近期系统。详细的检索分析证实，这些改进来自于自适应路由和证据合成，而不是依赖于任何硬编码的检索模式，进化动态揭示了从狭隘的词法行为到丰富的多工具协调的渐进转变。这些发现确立了自主多智能体协调作为多模态文档推理的一种有前途的范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种“失败驱动进化”框架，旨在解决多模态文档推理中检索策略固化的问题。通过元智能体对失败推理轨迹进行诊断并迭代优化任务智能体的指令，系统实现了检索行为的自适应演进，显著提升了多模态文档问答任务的准确性与跨模态证据整合能力。
AI.keywords: 多模态文档推理, 检索增强生成, 多智能体协作, 失败驱动进化, 自适应检索
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个创新性的“失败驱动进化”框架，将检索策略从静态配置转变为动态的推理决策过程。其重要性在于证明了元智能体（Meta-agent）可以通过分析错误轨迹自主优化任务智能体的检索行为，从而实现对多模态文档更深层次的理解和跨模态证据整合。这一范式为多智能体协作解决复杂推理任务提供了重要参考。

title: Resolution Thresholds in VLM Detection of Harmful ASCII Art Across Construction Modes and Languages
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as content moderation tools, yet they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks in which harmful text is visually encoded as ASCII art. This can allow inappropriate or harmful content to bypass moderation systems. To address this vulnerability, this paper investigates how image resolution affects VLM detection of harmful ASCII art across eight character construction modes (L1-L8), ranging from dense block characters to word-embedded designs. We evaluate eight state-of-the-art VLMs on English and Chinese corpora using a pipeline that generates ASCII art images at ten resolution scales, probing whether a consistent detection-failure threshold exists across models, modes, and languages. Results indicate that detection rates decline sharply above certain resolution thresholds, and that word-based modes are the most resistant to detection across the full resolution range. These findings reveal a systematic vulnerability in VLM-based content moderation systems and motivate resolution-aware evaluation standards.

AI.title_translation: VLM在跨构建模式和语言检测有害ASCII艺术时的分辨率阈值研究
AI.tldr: 本研究发现VLM在检测有害ASCII艺术时存在分辨率漏洞，且词语类设计最难被识别，呼吁建立更全面的评估标准。
AI.motivation: 针对大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在内容审核中易被ASCII艺术绕过的问题，探究图像分辨率如何影响模型对不同构建模式及语言的检测能力，以暴露系统的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含八种字符构建模式（L1-L8）和十种分辨率规模的评估流水线，在英语和中文语料库上测试了八种主流VLM，以分析检测成功率随分辨率的变化规律。
AI.result: 研究发现，当分辨率超过特定阈值时，VLM的检测率会急剧下降；此外，基于词语的ASCII构建模式在所有分辨率下均表现出最强的抗检测能力。
AI.conclusion: VLM在检测ASCII艺术时存在系统性的分辨率依赖漏洞，且基于词语的构建模式最具隐蔽性，亟需建立分辨率感知的内容审核评估标准。
AI.translation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被用作内容审核工具，但它们仍容易受到通过ASCII艺术视觉编码有害文本的越狱攻击。这可能导致不当或有害内容绕过审核系统。为了解决这一漏洞，本文研究了图像分辨率如何影响VLM对八种字符构建模式（L1-L8，从密集块字符到词语嵌入设计）下有害ASCII艺术的检测。我们使用一个在十种分辨率规模下生成ASCII艺术图像的流水线，评估了八种最先进的VLM，探讨模型、模式和语言之间是否存在一致的检测失败阈值。结果表明，检测率在超过特定分辨率阈值后急剧下降，且基于词语的模式在整个分辨率范围内最具抗检测性。这些发现揭示了基于VLM的内容审核系统中的系统性漏洞，并推动了分辨率感知评估标准的建立。
AI.summary: 本文研究了分辨率对VLM检测ASCII艺术的影响，通过评估八种模型在不同构建模式和语言下的表现，发现存在一致的检测失效阈值，且词语类设计最具隐蔽性，强调了开发分辨率感知审核标准的必要性。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, ASCII艺术, 内容审核, 分辨率阈值, 对抗性攻击
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了视觉语言模型（VLM）在内容审核中的一个关键盲点，即分辨率对检测ASCII艺术的影响。其创新之处在于系统性地量化了不同构建模式和语言下的检测失效阈值，为评估和提升VLM的安全性提供了实证依据和新的评估标准。

title: NI-ORCA: A Parallel Algorithm for Counting the Orbits of Non-Induced Graphlets up to K4
summary: Counting the orbits of graphlets in a network is a vital tool for understanding the structural roles of vertices in various graph analytics tasks. While existing algorithms efficiently compute orbits of induced graphlets, many real-world applications require non-induced orbit counts. However, no current method offers exact, scalable, and parallel support for non-induced orbit counting. This paper presents NI-ORCA, a parallel algorithm to efficiently compute the orbits of non-induced graphlets up to size four (4-clique). NI-ORCA extends the ORCA framework for non-induced orbit counting by reformulating a system of linear equations. The algorithm consists of three stages: triangle counting, 4-clique enumeration, and orbit solving. We design and implement stage-specific parallelisation strategies using thread and vertex-local memory models and data structures, minimising contention and balancing workload. We further analyse the impact of scheduling policies, chunk sizes, and affinity strategies on performance. Experimental analysis on eight real-world datasets and a series of synthetic Erddos-Renyi graphs demonstrates that a mixed mode combining stage-specific data structure, with dynamic scheduling with small chunk sizes, delivers consistent speedup and effective load balancing. Our results show that NI-ORCA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art sequential algorithms, achieving up to 30x speedups.

title: As We May Search
summary: The sensitive information in personal documents, legal files, and medical records is among the most valuable things to search, yet current retrieval-augmented generation systems still require sending content to remote servers. We propose local-first IR, a design philosophy where indexes, models, and inference reside on user devices, treating remote services as optional. This paper makes four contributions: (1) a framework organizing retrieval architectures along three dimensions: privacy and control, capability, and accessibility, (2) experiments on consumer hardware across five benchmarks, scaling from 1K to 1M documents with dense retrieval, BM25, and hybrid fusion. Dense retrieval keeps over 91% nDCG@10 up to 100K documents, with approximate HNSW indexes extending this to 1M with only 2% quality loss; a 7B local language model reaches within 4 points of a cloud baseline on answer quality, (3) competing perspectives for and against local-first IR, informed by experimental evidence, and (4) a research agenda identifying open problems. The real tradeoff is scope rather than quality: what matters is what you can search, not how well you can search it.

AI.title_translation: 正如我们所能搜索的那样
AI.tldr: 提出一种将检索和推理留在用户设备上的“本地优先”RAG设计，在保障隐私的同时，实现了在消费级硬件上处理百万级文档的高性能检索。
AI.motivation: 当前检索增强生成（RAG）系统过度依赖远程服务器处理敏感的个人、法律和医疗文档，导致隐私泄露风险和对云端的强依赖。
AI.method: 提出“本地优先”检索框架，通过在用户设备上部署索引、模型和推理过程；在消费级硬件上对密集检索、BM25及混合融合架构进行大规模实验（覆盖1K至1M文档），并对比云端基准。
AI.result: 密集检索在10万文档规模下保持了超过91%的nDCG@10；通过近似HNSW索引扩展至100万文档时仅有2%的质量损失；7B参数的本地语言模型在回答质量上与云端基准仅有4分的差距。
AI.conclusion: 本地优先的检索系统在保证隐私和自主权的同时，能够实现与云端相近的检索与生成性能，是未来个人信息处理的重要发展方向。
AI.translation: 个人文档、法律文件和医疗记录中的敏感信息是最有价值的搜索对象，但当前的检索增强生成系统仍要求将内容发送到远程服务器。我们提出了“本地优先”的IR（信息检索），这是一种设计理念，即索引、模型和推理都驻留在用户设备上，将远程服务视为可选。本文做出了四项贡献：(1) 一个根据隐私与控制、能力和可访问性三个维度组织检索架构的框架；(2) 在消费级硬件上针对五个基准测试进行的实验，通过密集检索、BM25和混合融合，从1K扩展到1M文档。密集检索在10万文档内保持了超过91%的nDCG@10，利用近似HNSW索引将其扩展到100万文档时仅有2%的质量损失；一个7B的本地语言模型在回答质量上与云端基准相差不到4分；(3) 基于实验证据，提出了支持和反对“本地优先”IR的竞争观点；以及(4) 确定了开放问题的研究议程。真正的权衡在于范围而非质量：重要的是你能搜索什么，而不是你搜索得有多好。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“本地优先”的检索增强生成设计理念，旨在将索引、模型及推理过程保留在用户设备上，以解决敏感文档的隐私与远程依赖问题。研究通过实验验证了在消费级硬件上处理百万级文档的可行性，并证明其性能与云端方案高度接近。
AI.keywords: 本地优先检索, 检索增强生成, 隐私保护, 消费级硬件, 向量搜索
AI.comments: 该论文通过提出“本地优先”的检索增强生成（RAG）设计理念，直接解决了当前数据隐私与云端依赖的矛盾。其创新之处在于证明了在消费级硬件上实现大规模、高质量的本地检索是可行的，为个人隐私保护与高性能检索的平衡提供了实证支持，是边缘计算与信息检索领域的重要进展。

title: Budgeted Act-or-Defer Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation with Local Reliability Bounds
summary: Multi-agent deliberation among LLMs can improve reasoning, but deployment requires deciding when the current answer is reliable enough to act on and when it should be escalated to human review. We formulate this as budgeted act-or-defer decision making. At each round, the system maps the debate prefix to a low-dimensional state, computes a $k$-nearest-neighbor lower confidence bound on state-conditional correctness using calibration data, and acts only when the bound exceeds a user-specified reliability threshold. The certificate controls wrong actions through the decomposition $β= δ+ α+ \varepsilon_{\mathrm{act}}$, separating calibration failure, residual action risk, and representation gap. The guarantee is conditional, not distribution-free: it relies on a valid local bias envelope and an action-region representation-gap bound, and each assumption is paired with falsification-style diagnostics. Because the same absolute wrong-action budget has different meanings across tasks of different difficulty, we set budgets relative to each task's final-round error using training data only, and evaluate safety by normalized budget usage $\mathrm{WA}/β$. On six benchmarks against nine baselines, the method uses 9--12% of the pre-declared budget on activated datasets, reaching up to 84% automation and 96% acted-on accuracy; on stress-test datasets, it defers rather than forcing unreliable automation. Rather than relying on per-task post-hoc threshold search, the method prospectively converts a user-declared wrong-action budget into an auditable act-or-defer operating point before deployment, under explicitly stated assumptions.

title: Safety from Honesty in a Disinterested AI Predictor
summary: As AI systems become more capable, training procedures that optimize for downstream outcomes risk introducing implicit agency: goal-directed behavior that designers never specified. We present a formal safety argument for the Scientist AI (SAI) Predictor, trained to approximate the Bayesian posterior conditioned on a dataset of "epistemically contextualized" natural-language statements. We argue that such a Predictor can honestly predict agents, actions, and their consequences without itself being an agent that selects outputs to achieve goals. This rests on data representation and on the training procedure. Epistemic contextualization of text distinguishes latent factual claims from communication acts, so expressions of goals are treated as evidence to be explained rather than drives the model adopts. With a posterior-seeking training objective, this is intended to drive the Predictor toward calibrated, cautious predictions. Training proceeds so downstream effects of deploying a prediction never serve as a reward signal; any agency the system needs is supplied by explicit scaffolding constrained by guardrails. We prove that, under assumptions on the training dynamics and on the argued sparsity of dangerous Predictors, the probability that training produces a Predictor whose guarded deployment carries residual harm above a specified threshold is small: a dangerous Predictor would have to underestimate harm in a coordinated way across many queries while such coordinated patterns are rare under the initialization distribution and receive no direct training signal. Safety and accuracy are jointly supported in this framework, since the constraints that secure accuracy are the same ones that make coordinated deception costly. These guarantees against misalignment and agency arising from within the Predictor itself do not preclude the use of the Predictor as part of an agentic system.

AI.title_translation: 无私AI预测器中的诚实安全性
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将AI训练为“无私预测者”的方法，通过将目标视为待解释数据而非行为驱动力，从而在保持高预测准确性的同时，从根本上防止了AI产生未预期的自主代理动机和危险行为。
AI.motivation: 随着AI能力提升，针对下游结果优化的训练过程容易诱发未经设计的“隐性代理行为”（即模型产生目标导向行为），存在安全隐患。作者旨在构建一种能够诚实预测而不产生自身目标追求动机的AI系统。
AI.method: 提出“科学家AI（SAI）预测器”，采用认识论语境化方法区分事实陈述与通信行为；利用后验估计训练目标，确保模型仅作为事实解释者；通过严格的训练约束，禁止部署后的预测结果反馈作为奖励信号，并将必要的代理功能剥离至受限的外部框架中。
AI.result: 理论证明显示，在特定训练动力学假设下，该系统产生具有残余伤害的危险预测器的概率极低。因为危险的预测器需要跨查询协调一致地低估危害，而这种协调模式在初始化分布中极罕见且缺乏训练信号支持。该框架实现了安全与准确性的统一。
AI.conclusion: 通过将AI训练为仅进行事实预测的“科学家”模型，并结合认识论语境化数据处理和后验估计目标，可以在不产生自主代理动机的前提下，实现高准确度且安全的预测，从而有效规避AI系统涌现出未预期的目标导向行为。
AI.translation: 随着AI系统变得越来越强大，优化下游结果的训练程序有引入隐性代理的风险：即设计师从未指定的以目标为导向的行为。我们为“科学家AI（SAI）预测器”提出了一个正式的安全论证，该预测器旨在通过对“认识论语境化”的自然语言数据集进行条件化，来近似贝叶斯后验概率。我们认为，这样的预测器可以诚实地预测代理人、行动及其后果，而其本身并不是一个为了实现目标而选择输出的代理人。这依赖于数据表示和训练程序。文本的认识论语境化区分了潜在的事实主张和交流行为，因此目标表达被视为需要解释的证据，而不是模型采用的驱动力。通过追求后验的训练目标，这旨在推动预测器进行校准和谨慎的预测。训练过程确保部署预测的下游影响永远不会作为奖励信号；系统所需的任何代理功能都由受护栏约束的显式脚手架提供。我们证明，在关于训练动力学和危险预测器稀疏性的假设下，训练产生一个守卫部署后剩余伤害超过指定阈值的预测器的概率很小：一个危险的预测器必须在许多查询中以协调的方式低估伤害，而这种协调模式在初始化分布下很少见，并且没有直接的训练信号。在该框架中，安全性和准确性得到共同支持，因为确保准确性的约束条件与使协调欺骗变得昂贵的约束条件是相同的。这些针对预测器内部产生的失调和代理行为的保证，并不妨碍将该预测器用作代理系统的一部分。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“科学家AI（SAI）预测器”的安全框架，旨在通过将AI训练为仅提供事实预测的无私系统，而非追求目标的代理人，从而防止其产生意外的代理行为。通过对数据进行认识论语境化处理和采用后验估计目标，模型将目标表达视为需解释的证据而非自身驱动力，有效保障了预测的安全性与准确性。
AI.keywords: AI安全, 无私预测者, 认识论语境化, 后验估计, 代理行为规避
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的安全范式，通过将AI定义为“无私的预测者”（Disinterested Predictor）而非代理人（Agent），从根本上规避了目标误导问题。其核心贡献在于证明了通过“认识论语境化”和“后验估计”训练，可以使模型仅作为事实解释者而非目标追求者，从而在保持高准确度的同时降低了涌现代理行为的风险。这种方法论对于AI安全研究具有重要的启发意义。

title: Diversity is the Strength of the AI Crowd
comments: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
summary: Top AI forecasting systems are approaching superforecaster-level accuracy on future world events, but still rely primarily on off-the-shelf LLMs combined with forecasting-specific context gathering and scaffolding. We study how to improve this recipe through ensembling: given a fixed number of samples, which off-the-shelf model forecasts should be combined to maximize accuracy? On binary questions from the Metaculus AI Benchmark, we find that individual accuracy is not enough: many frontier LLMs make highly correlated predictions, limiting the value of additional forecasts from the same or similar models. Instead, the strongest ensembles combine accurate but diverse forecasters, with models such as \model{Grok 4} contributing disproportionately because their predictions are less correlated with other frontier LLMs. These results suggest that the strength of the AI crowd comes not from sampling more forecasts indiscriminately, but from combining forecasts across models with complementary errors, motivating forecasting systems that explicitly optimize for both model quality and diversity.
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence, Seoul, South Korea, 2026

title: Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models for Agriculture Applications
summary: Geospatial foundation models pretrained on satellite imagery promise broad generalization across remote sensing tasks and regions, but their geographic transferability has not been systematically tested, especially in agriculture applications. This paper presents a controlled benchmark that evaluates three models, Prithvi, SpectralGPT, and SatMAE, on multi-temporal crop segmentation and change detection across four U.S. states, Iowa, North Carolina, California, and Minnesota. By assigning each train, validation, and test split to a separate region, we measure how well each model transfers to land it has not seen. All three degrade sharply under regional distribution shift, predicting only the most common crops while missing rare ones. We further find that fitting these models to a shared input format affects each one differently, which complicates direct architectural comparison. These results expose key limitations of current geospatial foundation models for agriculture and point to region aware evaluation as a necessary standard.

AI.title_translation: 农业应用中地理空间基础模型的基准测试
AI.tldr: 研究发现地理空间基础模型在农业应用中面临严重的区域迁移挑战，难以处理非训练区域的稀有作物，强调了评估模型时考虑区域差异的必要性。
AI.motivation: 尽管地理空间基础模型在遥感任务中具有潜力，但其在农业应用中的地理迁移能力尚未经过系统性验证。
AI.method: 构建了一个受控基准测试，在四个美国州（爱荷华州、北卡罗来纳州、加利福尼亚州、明尼苏达州）评估了Prithvi、SpectralGPT和SatMAE三种模型在多时相作物分割和变化检测任务上的表现，并通过区域划分测试模型的迁移能力。
AI.result: 三种模型在遇到区域分布偏移时性能均显著下降，倾向于预测常见作物而忽略稀有作物；同时，统一输入格式对不同模型的影响存在差异，增加了架构比较的难度。
AI.conclusion: 现有地理空间基础模型在面对区域分布偏移时表现不佳，难以识别稀有作物，因此建立区域感知评估标准对于农业应用至关重要。
AI.translation: 在卫星图像上预训练的地理空间基础模型有望在遥感任务和区域间实现广泛的泛化，但其地理迁移能力尚未经过系统测试，特别是在农业应用方面。本文提出了一个受控基准，评估了Prithvi、SpectralGPT和SatMAE三种模型在美国四个州（爱荷华州、北卡罗来纳州、加利福尼亚州和明尼苏达州）的多时相作物分割和变化检测任务上的表现。通过将训练、验证和测试集分配给不同的区域，我们测量了每个模型在未见区域的迁移效果。研究发现，所有三种模型在区域分布偏移下性能均急剧下降，仅能预测最常见的作物，而漏掉了稀有作物。我们进一步发现，将这些模型调整为共享输入格式对每个模型的影响不同，这使得直接的架构比较变得复杂。这些结果揭示了当前地理空间基础模型在农业应用中的关键局限性，并指出区域感知评估是必要的标准。
AI.summary: 本文对Prithvi、SpectralGPT和SatMAE三种地理空间基础模型在农业应用中的表现进行了基准测试。研究发现，这些模型在面对未见区域的分布偏移时泛化能力有限，且在处理稀有作物时表现较弱，研究结果呼吁在模型评估中纳入区域感知标准。
AI.keywords: 地理空间基础模型, 农业应用, 区域分布偏移, 遥感, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文通过受控基准测试揭示了地理空间基础模型在农业应用中的局限性，特别是在区域分布偏移下的泛化能力不足。其创新之处在于强调了“区域感知评估”的必要性，为未来开发更具鲁棒性的遥感模型提供了重要参考。

title: Unlocking the Visual Record of Materials Science: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset from Scientific Literature
summary: The materials science literature encodes decades of experimental knowledge in figures, yet this visual record remains locked away and inaccessible to AI at scale. The core difficulty is structural: most scientific figures are compound, with a single caption describing multiple sub-panels simultaneously, making direct image-text pairing unreliable. We present MatMMExtract, an end-to-end open-source pipeline that resolves this by decomposing compound figures into individual sub-panels and generating structured, grounded annotations using a large language model guided by a curated materials science taxonomy. Applied to 14,810 open-access articles, MatMMExtract produces MatSciFig; 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from 180,571 figures, each annotated with a sub-caption, a two-level visualisation category spanning 19 classes and over 100 subtypes, and a scientific summary. To enable accurate panel localisation, we introduce MaterialScope, a domain-specific detection dataset of 2,811 manually annotated materials science figures, on which a fine-tuned YOLO12-m detector achieves mAP_50 of 0.9227. Among six benchmarked language models, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite delivers the best cost-quality trade-off for annotation generation, with 82% of outputs rated good and a hallucination rate of 4.8%. A dual-encoder retrieval baseline on MatSciFig achieves a 4.4 times improvement in R@1 over zero-shot CLIP, demonstrating the dataset's immediate utility for vision-language learning. All resources are released openly to the community.

AI.title_translation: 解锁材料科学的视觉记录：来自科学文献的大规模多模态数据集
AI.tldr: 通过MatMMExtract流水线将科学文献中的复杂图表解析为结构化的标注数据集MatSciFig，显著提升了AI在材料科学领域的视觉理解与检索能力。
AI.motivation: 材料科学文献中蕴含的丰富实验知识以复合图表形式存在，但因缺乏结构化标注而难以被现有的AI模型有效利用，导致视觉记录处于“锁定”状态。
AI.method: 开发了MatMMExtract自动化流水线，通过子图分解、大语言模型标注及领域分类体系生成结构化注释；构建了MaterialScope数据集用于微调YOLO12-m进行图表定位；并使用Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite进行高质量标注生成。
AI.result: 构建了包含391,606个子图级图文对的MatSciFig数据集；MaterialScope检测器实现了0.9227的mAP_50；基于MatSciFig的双编码器检索基准在R@1指标上较零样本CLIP提升了4.4倍。
AI.conclusion: MatMMExtract和MatSciFig为材料科学领域提供了高质量、大规模的多模态数据集，显著提升了视觉-语言模型在该领域的理解与检索能力，为后续科学发现自动化奠定了坚实基础。
AI.translation: 材料科学文献通过图表编码了数十年的实验知识，但这些视觉记录仍然处于锁定状态，无法被AI大规模访问。核心困难在于结构问题：大多数科学图表是复合的，单一标题同时描述多个子面板，导致直接的图文配对不可靠。我们提出了MatMMExtract，一个端到端的开源流水线，通过将复合图表分解为单个子面板，并利用由策展的材料科学分类法引导的大型语言模型生成结构化、扎根的注释来解决这个问题。应用于14,810篇开放获取文章，MatMMExtract生成了MatSciFig；从180,571张图中产生了391,606个面板级的图文对，每个图文对都带有子标题、跨越19个类别和100多个子类型的两级可视化分类以及科学摘要。为了实现精确的面板定位，我们引入了MaterialScope，这是一个包含2,811个手动标注的材料科学图表的领域特定检测数据集，在此基础上，经过微调的YOLO12-m检测器实现了0.9227的mAP_50。在六个基准测试的语言模型中，Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite在注释生成方面提供了最佳的成本-质量权衡，82%的输出被评为良好，幻觉率为4.8%。MatSciFig上的双编码器检索基线在R@1上比零样本CLIP实现了4.4倍的提升，证明了该数据集在视觉-语言学习中的直接效用。所有资源均已向社区公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MatMMExtract流水线，旨在解决材料科学文献中复合图表难以解析的问题。通过自动分解图表并利用大模型进行结构化标注，作者构建了大规模MatSciFig数据集，并引入MaterialScope用于精确的图表定位，有效提升了多模态模型在材料科学领域的应用潜力。
AI.keywords: 材料科学, 多模态数据集, 复合图表解析, 视觉-语言学习, 科学文献分析
AI.comments: 该研究通过解决科学文献中复合图表难以解析的结构性难题，成功将非结构化的视觉数据转化为高质量的结构化多模态数据集。其创新点在于开发了自动化提取流水线及配套的领域特定检测数据集，极大地降低了材料科学领域多模态模型训练的门槛，对科学领域大模型的发展具有重要意义。

title: How LLMs See Creativity: Zero-Shot Scoring of Visual Creativity with Interpretable Reasoning
summary: Evaluating the originality of visual images poses enduring challenges for creativity assessment. Automated scoring using AI models has proven effective in the verbal domain, yet key questions remain about evaluating visual creativity and understanding how models arrive at their ratings. The present research asks whether multimodal large language models (LLMs) can serve as judges of visual creativity zero-shot (without any fine-tuning or examples of human ratings) and whether their "reasoning" output offers an interpretable window into their evaluation process. We tested six multimodal LLMs (Gemini 3 Flash, Gemma 4 31B IT, GPT-5.4 Mini, GLM-5v Turbo, Kimi K2.5, and Qwen 3.6 Plus) on 992 AI-generated images (based on human-written prompts) and 1,500 hand-drawn sketches scored for creativity by human raters. In Study 1, all models showed substantial alignment with human creativity ratings on both datasets (r = .57-.68 on AI-generated images; r = .29-68 on sketches). In Study 2, we analyzed the step-by-step reasoning processes of three LLMs evaluating the same images and drawings. Although reasoning made model evaluations interpretable -- showing what they attend to, how they balance originality vs. quality, and how they justify their ratings -- reasoning did not improve alignment with human ratings. In sum, our findings indicate that multimodal LLMs can match human judgments of visual creativity without any additional training, and that their reasoning reveals how AI models evaluate creativity. An open scoring app implementing this pipeline is available at https://review-visual-eval-scoring.hf.space.

title: Privacy-Preserving Decentralized Cooperative Localization with Range-Only Measurements: A Convex Optimization Based Approach
summary: Cooperative localization using range-based measurements is critical for multi-robot systems operating in GPS-denied and unstructured environments. However, traditional cooperative approaches require sharing explicit spatial coordinates across the network, presenting a severe security vulnerability in privacy-sensitive missions. While recent literature has explored privacy-preserving alternatives, these methods typically rely on accuracy-degrading noise injection or computationally prohibitive cryptographic protocols. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel, natively privacy-preserving Decentralized Cooperative Localization (DCL) framework based on convex optimization. Discarding probabilistic noise models, we assume strictly bounded measurement noise and formulate the localization problem via Semi-Definite Programming (SDP) to compute a Maximum-Volume Inscribed Ellipsoid (MVE). Our approach introduces novel intersection-plane constraints derived from landmark measurements to significantly tighten individual spatial bounds. To incorporate inter-robot range measurements securely, we uniquely decompose coupling constraints into localized Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs). Agents achieve fleet-wide spatial consensus by iteratively exchanging only abstract dual variables, completely avoiding the transmission of explicit primal position estimates. Extensive 3D Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that our DCL framework outperforms existing SDP-based localization method in accuracy, while guaranteeing operational privacy and maintaining highly scalable, parallelizable computation.

AI.title_translation: 基于距离测量的隐私保护去中心化协作定位：一种基于凸优化的方法
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于凸优化的去中心化协作定位新框架，通过交换抽象对偶变量而非原始坐标，在保护隐私的同时提升了定位精度和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的协作定位方法需要共享原始坐标，存在隐私泄露风险；而现有的隐私保护方法往往以牺牲精度为代价，或使用计算开销巨大的加密协议。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于半定规划（SDP）的框架，通过求解最大体积内切椭球（MVE）来处理位置估计；利用新型相交平面约束来收紧空间界限；将耦合约束分解为局部的线性矩阵不等式（LMI），并通过迭代交换抽象对偶变量实现空间共识。
AI.result: 3D蒙特卡洛仿真结果表明，该框架在定位精度上优于现有的SDP定位方法，同时确保了操作隐私，并保持了高可扩展性和并行计算能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一种基于半定规划的隐私保护去中心化协作定位框架，在无需共享原始位置数据的前提下，实现了比现有SDP方法更优的定位精度和高效的计算性能。
AI.translation: 在GPS受限和非结构化环境中，使用基于距离测量的协作定位对于多机器人系统至关重要。然而，传统的协作方法要求在网络中共享显式的空间坐标，这在隐私敏感的任务中构成了严重的安全漏洞。尽管最近的文献探索了隐私保护的替代方案，但这些方法通常依赖于降低精度的噪声注入或计算开销巨大的加密协议。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于凸优化的原生隐私保护去中心化协作定位（DCL）框架。我们放弃概率噪声模型，假设测量噪声是严格有界的，并通过半定规划（SDP）来计算最大体积内切椭球（MVE）以制定定位问题。我们的方法引入了源自地标测量的新型相交平面约束，以显著收紧个体空间边界。为了安全地整合机器人间的距离测量，我们独特地将耦合约束分解为局部线性矩阵不等式（LMI）。智能体通过仅迭代交换抽象对偶变量来实现全机群空间共识，完全避免了原始位置估计的传输。广泛的3D蒙特卡洛仿真表明，我们的DCL框架在精度上优于现有的基于SDP的定位方法，同时保证了操作隐私并保持了高度可扩展和可并行的计算能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于凸优化（SDP）的去中心化协作定位框架，旨在解决多机器人系统中距离测量定位的隐私保护问题。该方法通过构建最大体积内切椭球并利用线性矩阵不等式分解耦合约束，仅需交换抽象对偶变量即可实现空间共识，避免了原始位置信息的传输，实现了高精度与高隐私性的平衡。
AI.keywords: 去中心化协作定位, 隐私保护, 凸优化, 半定规划, 距离测量
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的隐私保护分布式协作定位方法，通过凸优化（SDP）而非传统的概率噪声模型，在确保隐私的同时提高了定位精度。其核心贡献在于通过交换对偶变量而非原始位置数据来保护隐私，并引入了新型相交平面约束，具有良好的可扩展性和并行计算能力。

title: I-BBS: Coordinate-Free Inference of Latent Sub-Manifolds Using Random Distance Matrix Theory
summary: Bogomolny, Bohigas and Schmit (BBS) found that the spectrum of the pairwise distance matrix on N points sampled from a smooth d-dimensional manifold encodes a signature of the underlying geometry. We develop I-BBS (Inference-BBS), a coordinate-free method that identifies a low-dimensional latent sub-manifold embedded in a high-dimensional ambient distance matrix alone, without accessing an ambient high-dimensional vector space. It therefore applies even when that space is only partly observable or undefined. We model the ambient embedding by two classes of generative noise, model-based and model-free. The noise mixes the latent signal with off-manifold components, so the eigenvalues reorganise collectively and the latent geometry cannot be read off eigenvalue by eigenvalue. We recover it instead from two integer-stable signatures that survive the noise: the multiplicity of the top non-Perron multiplet, which fixes $d$, and a parameter-free law for how the multiplet positions shrink as the noise grows. On synthetic spheres $S^1$, $S^2$ and $S^3$ these integer signatures are far more stable under noise than the continuous spectral slope, and a blind test recovers both the manifold and the noise model from a single distance matrix. Applications to neural-network representations and to the dynamic training regime are developed in two companion papers.

AI.title_translation: I-BBS：利用随机距离矩阵理论实现潜在子流形的坐标无关推理
AI.tldr: I-BBS是一种无需坐标系即可从距离矩阵中推断潜在流形维度及结构的方法，利用特定的谱整数特征，在强噪声环境下依然保持高度稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有的流形学习方法往往依赖于高维环境空间，但在许多实际应用中，该空间可能未定义或仅部分可观测。因此，需要一种基于仅有的距离矩阵信息，且能抵御生成噪声干扰的坐标无关推理方法。
AI.method: 开发了I-BBS方法，通过分析距离矩阵的谱特征，利用非Perron多重态的重数（确定维度d）以及多重态随噪声增长而收缩的无参数定律，在存在模型化和非模型化噪声的情况下恢复潜在几何结构。
AI.result: 在合成球体（S^1, S^2, S^3）实验中，I-BBS的整数特征比传统的连续谱斜率具有更强的抗噪稳定性，能够从单一距离矩阵中成功恢复流形结构及噪声模型。
AI.conclusion: I-BBS通过识别距离矩阵中的整数稳定特征，成功实现了在存在生成噪声的情况下对潜在低维子流形的稳健推断，证明了该方法在处理未定义或部分可观测的高维空间时的有效性。
AI.translation: Bogomolny、Bohigas和Schmit (BBS) 发现，从d维光滑流形上采样的N个点的成对距离矩阵谱编码了潜在几何特征。我们开发了I-BBS（Inference-BBS），这是一种无需坐标系的方法，仅凭高维环境距离矩阵即可识别嵌入其中的低维潜在子流形，无需访问高维环境向量空间。因此，即使在该空间仅部分可观测或未定义时，该方法依然适用。我们用两类生成噪声（基于模型和非基于模型）对环境嵌入进行建模。噪声将潜在信号与非流形分量混合，导致特征值集体重组，因此无法逐个读取潜在几何信息。我们通过两种在噪声中存活的整数稳定特征来恢复它：确定d的顶部非Perron多重态的重数，以及多重态位置随噪声增长而收缩的无参数定律。在合成球体S^1、S^2和S^3上，这些整数特征在噪声下的稳定性远高于连续谱斜率，且盲测实验能从单一距离矩阵中恢复流形和噪声模型。该方法的神经表示和动态训练应用将在后续两篇姊妹论文中详述。
AI.summary: 本文提出了I-BBS方法，这是一种基于随机距离矩阵理论的坐标无关推理技术，旨在从高维距离矩阵中识别潜在的低维子流形。该方法通过提取受噪声影响较小的整数稳定谱特征，克服了传统方法对高维环境空间的依赖，并在合成数据实验中展现了卓越的抗噪性能。
AI.keywords: 距离矩阵, 潜在流形, 随机矩阵理论, 坐标无关推断, 整数稳定特征
AI.comments: 该研究通过利用随机距离矩阵理论，成功地在无需坐标系的情况下从高维数据中推断潜在低维子流形。其创新之处在于利用了BBS谱特征中的整数稳定性，而非依赖于易受噪声影响的连续谱斜率，这为处理高维复杂数据提供了稳健的新思路。

title: Lateral String Stability for Vehicle Platoons
summary: Connected and automated vehicle (CAV) platooning promises gains in energy efficiency and traffic throughput and, most critically, in safety. These safety benefits hinge on string stability, which determines how disturbances propagate along a platoon. While longitudinal string stability is well studied, lateral string stability, which governs the propagation of path-tracking errors that can lead to unsafe deviations from the intended path, remains underexplored. Its importance is increasing as autonomous vehicles rely more heavily on onboard sensing and map-free navigation, where sensor occlusion and dense formations amplify safety risks. This paper presents a new framework for lateral string stability that directly addresses safety-critical path-relative tracking errors and enables consistent comparison across vehicles following the same road geometry. Central to this framework is an arc-length (Eulerian) viewpoint, a departure from traditional analyses, that clarifies how tracking errors at a given point on the path propagate from one vehicle to the next. A formal definition of lateral string stability is introduced along with two control strategies: an onboard-sensing-only controller and a novel learn-from-predecessor approach utilizing vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication. We show that onboard sensing alone cannot guarantee attenuation of path-tracking errors, imposing a fundamental safety limitation, whereas V2V communication enables true error attenuation.

title: Fourier--Hankel Moment Methods for Topological Counting and Phase-Center Recovery in Acoustic Inverse Scattering
summary: We develop a Fourier--Hankel moment framework for extracting topological counting information from full-aperture acoustic far-field data. The method is based on the observation that separated localized components generate distinct phase centers in angular Fourier data. Under the Born approximation, a Bessel--Fourier moment identity shows that suitably scaled row Fourier coefficients form, to leading order, a finite exponential moment sequence. The associated Hankel matrix has rank equal to the number of separated connected components, and the corresponding Hankel pencil recovers their phase-center locations. We prove the exact Hankel rank formula in the phase-center model and establish a perturbation theorem showing stable component counting under a singular-gap condition. We further extend the framework to detectable cavities by introducing a signed phase-center model. In this model, material components and cavities contribute with opposite signs to the moment sequence. The signed Hankel rank counts distinct signed phase centers, and the detectable cavity count is obtained from the excess rank beyond the positive component count. This formulation also identifies an intrinsic degeneracy: cavities whose phase centers coincide with material phase centers, such as perfectly concentric annuli, do not increase the leading signed rank and therefore cannot be detected by the leading phase-center mechanism alone. Numerical experiments validate the proposed theory at several levels: ideal moment sequences, Born far-field data with finite-size components, phase-center location recovery, signed cavity counting, and exact Helmholtz far-field data. The results show that the Fourier--Hankel rank mechanism provides a data-level algebraic approach to component counting and detectable cavity counting, while also making explicit its stability conditions and failure modes.

AI.title_translation: 用于声学逆散射中拓扑计数与相位中心恢复的傅里叶-汉克尔矩方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于傅里叶-汉克尔矩的代数方法，能从声学远场数据中精确计算散射体数量、定位相位中心，并能识别材料内部的空腔。
AI.motivation: 为了解决声学逆散射中从远场数据提取组件数量（拓扑计数）和定位相位中心的难题，并提供一种比传统成像更具代数稳定性的数据处理方法。
AI.method: 提出傅里叶-汉克尔矩框架，利用Born近似下的Bessel-Fourier矩恒等式，将远场数据转化为指数矩序列，通过分析汉克尔矩阵的秩来计数组件，并利用汉克尔铅笔（Hankel pencil）恢复相位中心。通过引入带符号的相位中心模型来扩展至空腔检测。
AI.result: 证明了相位中心模型中汉克尔秩公式的准确性，建立了组件计数的稳定性定理；通过数值实验验证了该方法在材料组件计数、相位中心定位以及空腔检测方面的有效性，同时揭示了该方法在处理同心结构等退化情况时的局限性。
AI.conclusion: Fourier-Hankel矩框架为声学逆散射中的拓扑计数和相位中心恢复提供了一种鲁棒且高效的代数工具，能够有效处理材料组件与空腔的识别，并明确了其适用范围与失效模式。
AI.translation: 我们开发了一种傅里叶-汉克尔矩框架，用于从全孔径声学远场数据中提取拓扑计数信息。该方法基于一个观察结果，即分离的局部组件在角傅里叶数据中会产生独特的相位中心。在Born近似下，贝塞尔-傅里叶矩恒等式表明，适当缩放的行傅里叶系数在主阶上形成了一个有限指数矩序列。相应的汉克尔矩阵的秩等于分离连通组件的数量，而相应的汉克尔铅笔可以恢复它们的相位中心位置。我们证明了相位中心模型中的精确汉克尔秩公式，并建立了一个扰动定理，显示了在奇异间隙条件下的稳定组件计数。我们进一步通过引入符号相位中心模型将该框架扩展到可检测空腔。在该模型中，材料组件和空腔以相反的符号对矩序列做出贡献。带符号的汉克尔秩计算了不同的带符号相位中心，可检测空腔的数量由超过正组件计数的多余秩获得。该公式还识别了一种内在的退化：其相位中心与材料相位中心重合的空腔（例如完全同心的环）不会增加领先的带符号秩，因此仅靠领先的相位中心机制无法检测到。数值实验在多个层面上验证了所提出的理论：理想矩序列、具有有限尺寸组件的Born远场数据、相位中心位置恢复、带符号空腔计数以及精确的亥姆霍兹远场数据。结果表明，傅里叶-汉克尔秩机制为组件计数和可检测空腔计数提供了一种数据级的代数方法，同时也明确了其稳定条件和失效模式。
AI.summary: 本文开发了一种基于傅里叶-汉克尔矩的声学逆散射分析框架。该方法通过将远场数据投影到傅里叶空间，利用汉克尔矩阵的秩来确定散射体的数量，并利用汉克尔铅笔算法定位其相位中心。此外，通过引入符号化模型，该框架还能有效区分材料组件与空腔，并明确了其在特定几何结构下的检测局限。
AI.keywords: 声学逆散射, 拓扑计数, 傅里叶-汉克尔矩, 相位中心恢复, 汉克尔矩阵秩
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的代数方法，利用傅里叶-汉克尔矩（Fourier-Hankel moments）从声学远场数据中提取拓扑信息。其核心创新在于将物理散射问题转化为线性代数中的矩阵秩问题，并能处理带有符号的相位中心模型以区分材料组件与空腔。局限性在于该方法在完美同心结构等特定退化情况下会失效，且依赖于Born近似等假设。

title: Learning as Observable Matrix Dynamics: Diffusive Relaxations versus Phase Transitions
summary: Observable Matrix Dynamics (OMD) is a diagnostic framework that probes the dynamics of high-dimensional internal representations of inputs by a neural network via a fixed-size $N \times N$ distance matrix $M(t)$ on a held set of $N$ inputs. OMD uses methods of random matrix theory and particle dynamics to explore spectral reorganisations that are missed by scalar loss functions, but are informative of the training process. We read $M(t)$ against a perturbative ambient-versus-latent decomposition extending the Bogomolny--Bohigas--Schmit (BBS) theory of random distance matrices, with per-snapshot diagnostics for the top-of-spectrum band structure and ambient noise, trajectory-level observables linking snapshots, and a 3D MDS embedding (bottom-three eigenvectors) rendering training as a moving particle cloud. Across seven experiments, diffusive regimes lack stable top-of-spectrum band structure, while sharp endogenous or externally driven reorganisations produce stable fingerprints: consistent with smooth or product latent geometries in BBS-adjacent cases, and with finite-cluster or Fourier-soliton structures otherwise. OMD thus reads the geometric regime of a representation rather than reporting a single intrinsic dimension.

AI.title_translation: 学习作为可观测矩阵动力学：扩散弛豫与相变
AI.tldr: 本文引入OMD框架，利用矩阵谱分析和粒子动力学诊断神经网络训练过程中的内部表征演化，揭示了扩散机制与相变之间的几何差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的标量损失函数无法有效捕捉神经网络高维内部表征的复杂动态变化，需要一种能够揭示训练过程中谱重组和几何演化过程的诊断框架。
AI.method: 构建N×N距离矩阵M(t)，结合随机矩阵理论（BBS理论的推广）与粒子动力学，通过谱分析、轨迹观测及3D MDS嵌入，对训练过程进行多维度诊断。
AI.result: 研究发现扩散机制缺乏稳定的谱带结构，而相变过程会产生稳定的特征结构（如有限簇或傅里叶孤子），OMD能有效识别表征的几何机制。
AI.conclusion: OMD框架通过分析矩阵谱特征和几何结构，成功区分了神经网络训练过程中的扩散状态与相变状态，为深入理解深度学习表征动力学提供了定量诊断手段。
AI.translation: 可观测矩阵动力学（OMD）是一种诊断框架，通过对一组N个输入构建固定大小的N×N距离矩阵M(t)，探测神经网络对输入的高维内部表征动力学。OMD利用随机矩阵理论和粒子动力学方法，探索标量损失函数所忽略的谱重组现象，这些现象对理解训练过程具有重要意义。我们将M(t)与Bogomolny--Bohigas--Schmit（BBS）随机距离矩阵理论的扰动环境-潜变量分解相结合，通过对谱顶部带结构和环境噪声的快照诊断、快照间的轨迹级可观测指标，以及3D MDS嵌入（底部的三个特征向量），将训练过程呈现为移动的粒子云。在七项实验中，扩散机制缺乏稳定的谱顶部带结构，而剧烈的内源性或外源性重组产生了稳定的特征：在BBS邻近情况下与平滑或积潜变量几何结构一致，在其他情况下则与有限簇或傅里叶孤子结构一致。因此，OMD可以读取表征的几何机制，而不仅仅是报告单一的内在维度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“可观测矩阵动力学”（OMD）的诊断框架，用于分析神经网络训练过程中高维表征的演化。通过对输入距离矩阵进行谱分析和几何动力学建模，OMD能够识别损失函数无法捕捉的动态特征，并揭示训练过程中的扩散行为与相变现象。
AI.keywords: 可观测矩阵动力学, 神经网络表征, 随机矩阵理论, 谱重组, 几何动力学
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的诊断框架，通过随机矩阵理论和粒子动力学分析神经网络内部表征的演化。其独特之处在于从“矩阵动力学”视角揭示了损失函数无法捕捉的谱重组现象，为理解神经网络训练过程中的几何演化提供了新的理论工具。局限性在于该方法可能具有较高的计算复杂性，且对不同神经网络架构的通用性有待进一步验证。

title: Sample-Efficient Learning of Probabilistic Causes for Reachability in Markov Decision Processes with Probabilistic Guarantees
comments: Accepted to UAI2026 as oral presentation
summary: Probabilistic model checking for Markov decision processes (MDPs) provides quantitative guarantees, but often offers limited insight into why undesired outcomes occur. Probability-raising (PR) causality addresses this by identifying states whose visitation increases the probability of reaching designated states. Existing PR-cause identification methods, however, use MDP modifications not well-suited for learning: the gap between conditional and unconditional reachability probabilities can be hard to detect from transition samples, and construction requires reachability probabilities of the MDP, which are unavailable when transition probabilities are unknown. We study unknown MDPs and propose a learning approach with probabilistic guarantees for PR-cause identification. Our key ingredient is a restart-based MDP modification that reduces PR-cause checking to two conditional reachability queries without using reachability values of the original MDP. We prove correctness, establish sample-complexity bounds, and develop an anytime learning-and-checking algorithm based on two-sided value iteration that progressively classifies states as causal, non-causal, or undecided. Experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate reliable and fast identification of PR causes.
comment: Accepted to UAI2026 as oral presentation

AI.title_translation: 马尔可夫决策过程中具有概率保证的可达性概率因果的样本高效学习
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种在未知MDP中高效识别概率因果的新方法，无需预知转移概率，并提供了理论上的正确性保证与样本复杂度分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的概率因果识别方法依赖于已知的MDP转移概率，且难以直接从采样数据中学习，导致在未知环境下的应用受限。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于重启（restart-based）的MDP修改方法，将概率因果（PR）检查简化为两个条件可达性查询，并开发了一种基于双侧价值迭代的随时（anytime）学习与检查算法。
AI.result: 证明了算法的正确性并给出了样本复杂度界限，实验结果表明该方法能够可靠且快速地识别出概率因果。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功提出了一种在未知MDP中识别概率因果的样本高效算法，通过理论证明和实验验证，证明了其在提供概率保证的同时具有良好的可扩展性。
AI.translation: 马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs）的概率模型检测提供了定量保证，但往往难以解释为何会出现非预期的结果。概率提升（PR）因果通过识别那些访问后会增加到达指定状态概率的状态来解决这一问题。然而，现有的PR因果识别方法使用的MDP修改方式不适合学习：条件可达性概率与无条件可达性概率之间的差异在转换采样中难以检测，且构建过程需要MDP的可达性概率，而当转换概率未知时，这些概率是不可用的。我们研究了未知MDP，并提出了一种具有概率保证的PR因果识别学习方法。我们的关键要素是一种基于重启的MDP修改，它将PR因果检查简化为两个条件可达性查询，而无需使用原始MDP的可达性值。我们证明了其正确性，建立了样本复杂度界限，并开发了一种基于双侧价值迭代的随时学习与检查算法，将状态逐步分类为因果、非因果或未定。在两个基准测试上的实验证明了其可靠且快速的PR因果识别能力。
AI.summary: 针对未知MDP环境，本文提出了一种高效的概率因果（PR）识别学习方法。通过创新的重启机制简化了因果检查过程，无需预知原始MDP的可达性概率，并结合双侧价值迭代算法实现了具有概率保证的状态分类。
AI.keywords: 马尔可夫决策过程, 概率因果, 样本效率, 可达性分析, 形式化验证
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一种基于重启的MDP修改方法，解决了在未知环境下的因果识别难题，并提供了理论上的样本复杂度保证，在可解释性AI与形式化验证的结合方面具有重要意义。

title: The Body as Status: Muscularity, Engagement, and Body Image Risk on #GymTok
summary: Body image concerns among boys and young men are increasingly oriented toward muscularity, with social media serving as a central context for communicating and evaluating these ideals. While prior research has focused on the thin-ideal, less is known about how the muscular-ideal is represented and reinforced on visual social media platforms. This study examines (1) dominant content themes, (2) perceived harm to body image, and (3) engagement patterns across #GymTok, a muscularity-oriented fitness subculture on TikTok. We conducted a content analysis of 2,210 #GymTok videos annotated by clinical experts across themes like self-objectification, rigid dieting, excessive exercise, supplement and steroid use, and masculinity. Annotators also rated the perceived harm of videos to the viewers' body image, and depicted bodies were coded according to muscularity level. Perceived harm varied across content themes, with supplement- and steroid-related content rated as most harmful. Engagement was positively associated with both muscularity and perceived harm: videos depicting more muscular bodies and those rated as more harmful received greater views, likes, shares, and comments. Although less prevalent, masculinity-focused content generated the highest engagement. These findings suggest that TikTok may not only expose users to muscular ideals and potentially harmful behaviors, but also algorithmically amplify them. By increasing the visibility of highly muscular and harmful content, recommendation systems may intensify social comparison processes, while objectification elevates the muscular body into a marker of status, masculinity, and social worth. Together, these dynamics may contribute to body image risk among boys and young men.

title: Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization to Find Lightweight CNN Models for Autonomous Steering
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at 2025 IEEE International Conference on Electro Information Technology (eIT). Author-accepted manuscript. Final published version: https://doi.org/10.1109/eIT64391.2025.11103679
summary: This research investigates the optimization of Convolutional and Dense Neural Networks (CNNs and DNNs) for autonomous steering using the (N+M) Evolution Strategy (ES) with the 1/5th success rule. The primary objective is to develop a lightweight CNN based model capable of real-time steering angle prediction, mimicking human driving behavior on predefined paths. The ES algorithm automates hyperparameter tuning, dynamically adjusting parameters such as filter sizes and layer configurations. Data collection encompasses driving scenarios recorded via the LTU ACTor autonomous driving platform, including variations in path direction and driving style. The very small dataset consists of timestamped images labeled with steering angles and pre-processed to focus on relevant visual information. Initial experiments involve training a baseline CNN model, which is then refined using ES to significantly reduce the size of the model while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy. The results highlight the viability of lightweight neural network architectures for real-time autonomous systems, striking a balance between computational efficiency and performance. This study not only advances research initiatives on the use of evolutionary algorithms for autonomous driving applications but also lays the foundation for the deployment of cost-effective and scalable solutions in self-driving technology.

AI.title_translation: 用于自动驾驶转向的轻量化CNN模型的进化超参数优化
AI.tldr: 利用进化策略自动优化卷积神经网络的超参数，成功开发出适用于自动驾驶的高效、轻量化转向预测模型。
AI.motivation: 为了解决自动驾驶中对轻量化、实时性模型的迫切需求，同时克服手动调整超参数的复杂性，通过进化算法寻找兼顾性能与效率的模型。
AI.method: 采用基于1/5成功规则的(N+M)进化策略（ES）自动调节CNN和DNN的超参数（如滤波器大小、层配置），旨在精简模型结构。
AI.result: 通过ES优化后的模型在显著减小模型尺寸的同时，保持了具有竞争力的转向预测精度，成功实现了计算效率与性能的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了通过进化策略优化得到的轻量化CNN模型在实现实时自动驾驶转向预测方面具有良好的性能与计算效率平衡，为低成本自动驾驶解决方案提供了可行途径。
AI.translation: 本研究利用基于1/5成功规则的(N+M)进化策略（ES）对用于自动驾驶转向的卷积神经网络（CNN）和深度神经网络（DNN）进行优化。主要目标是开发一种能够进行实时转向角度预测的轻量化CNN模型，以模拟预定义路径上的人类驾驶行为。ES算法通过动态调整滤波器大小和层配置等参数，实现了超参数调优的自动化。数据收集涵盖了通过LTU ACTor自动驾驶平台记录的驾驶场景，包括路径方向和驾驶风格的变化。该小型数据集由带有转向角度标签的时间戳图像组成，并经过预处理以聚焦相关视觉信息。初步实验涉及训练一个基准CNN模型，随后利用ES对其进行精简，在大幅减小模型尺寸的同时保持了具有竞争力的预测精度。结果突显了轻量化神经网络架构在实时自动驾驶系统中的可行性，在计算效率和性能之间取得了平衡。本研究不仅推动了进化算法在自动驾驶应用中的研究，也为自动驾驶技术中经济高效且可扩展的解决方案奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用进化策略（ES）自动优化CNN模型超参数的方法，旨在为自动驾驶开发轻量化、实时转向预测模型。通过在LTU ACTor平台上收集的数据集上进行实验，研究验证了该方法在减小模型规模的同时维持高精度的有效性。
AI.keywords: 进化策略, 超参数优化, 轻量化CNN, 自动驾驶, 实时转向预测
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将进化策略（ES）应用于自动驾驶轻量化CNN模型的超参数优化，解决了在资源受限环境下实现实时转向预测的挑战。其局限性在于数据集较小，未来研究需验证在大规模多样化场景下的泛化能力。

title: CAREBench: A Child-Safety Risk Benchmark for Language Models
summary: How can we evaluate whether frontier AI systems recognize child-safety risks before they escalate into explicit harm? Existing child safety evaluations focus on child sexual abuse material, yet many child-safety failures begin earlier: in model assistance that helps adults manipulate, impersonate, profile, or isolate minors, and in model responses that deepen children's emotional dependence on AI systems rather than redirecting them toward human support. We introduce CAREBench (Child AI Risk Evaluation), a benchmark to assess such upstream child-safety risks in language models. CAREBench contains 500 prompts spanning twelve risk categories, including grooming and relationship engineering, deception and impersonation, surveillance and privacy, sextortion and sexual abuse, AI anthropomorphization, emotional dependency, and mental illness sensitivity. Developed with response annotations from parents and clinicians, the benchmark excludes explicit abuse material and imagery; instead, it evaluates whether models recognize, refuse, de-escalate, or redirect risky interactions before harm becomes overt. Evaluating seven frontier models on our benchmark, we find failure rates ranging from 2% to 58%, with failure patterns that vary across risk categories. CAREBench provides a responsibly scoped evaluation for LLM developers to identify and close gaps in child safety policies.

title: PoseShield: Neural Collision Fields for Human Self-Collision Resolution
summary: Self-collision remains a persistent challenge in SMPL-based human pose estimation and motion generation. Under extreme articulations or stochastic motion synthesis, generated meshes frequently exhibit self-penetrations, leading to physically implausible results. We propose PoseShield, a neural collision constraint defined directly in SMPL pose space. We formulate collision correction as a constrained optimization problem and connect the learned constraint with the Eikonal equation. Enforcing Eikonal regularization ensures non-vanishing gradients near the collision boundary, improving numerical stability and robustness of the optimization process. Unlike prior methods that operate in the mesh space or rely on heuristic penalties, our approach operates directly in the low-dimensional space of human poses and is theoretically grounded. The same learned constraint extends to human motion sequences, providing a generator-agnostic post-hoc collision corrector without retraining the underlying motion model. Experiments on a newly constructed SMPL pose benchmark show that our method achieves a 95.8% success rate and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

title: Can MLLMs Critique Like Humans? Evaluating Open-Ended Aesthetic Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Open-ended aesthetic critique is a challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs): unlike multiple-choice aesthetic benchmarks, it has no single correct answer, and most aesthetic evaluation has measured models against numeric scores rather than the written critiques people actually give. We evaluate MLLM critiques against ranked human references and ask whether they are close to human ones. Using the Reddit Photo Critique Dataset, we score five open-weight MLLMs against multiple ranked human critiques per photo with reference-based similarity metrics, under six prompt conditions that disentangle persona framing, aspect hinting, length control, and single- versus multi-pass generation, and add an image-grounding control that feeds each model the wrong photograph. We find that reference-based similarity gives a misleading picture. Stricter lexical and learned metrics show only weak alignment with human critiques, while a coarse embedding cosine reports broad topical overlap that the grounding control traces to a stable house style rather than image-specific observation. Behaviorally, the models diverge from humans in consistent ways the scores do not surface: even under a length cap they write two to three times as much, cover nearly every aesthetic aspect where humans are selective, engage each aspect more uniformly and at greater depth, and repeat themselves across critiques of the same photo where humans vary. We argue that reference-based similarity rewards a fluent, comprehensive critique style rather than the selectivity and specificity of human critique, and discuss implications for evaluating and training open-ended multimodal generation.

AI.title_translation: MLLMs能像人类一样进行审美批评吗？评估多模态大模型中的开放式审美推理能力
AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态大模型在审美批评上表现出与人类截然不同的行为模式，现有的相似度评估指标无法有效衡量其审美能力，且模型倾向于生成冗长、重复的通用评论而非精准的审美观察。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型审美评价多基于数值打分或选择题，缺乏对人类实际开放式审美批评能力的真实评估，且现有评估指标可能存在偏差。
AI.method: 使用Reddit照片评论数据集，对比了五个开源MLLM的评论与人类排名评论的相似度；引入了六种提示词条件（包括角色设定、长度控制等）及图像错位对照实验，并利用词汇和学习型指标进行评估。
AI.result: 现有的相似度指标会误导评估结果，模型表现出与人类显著的行为差异：模型倾向于产生过度详细、全面但缺乏针对性的评论，且存在重复生成现象，即使在图像错误的情况下也能保持稳定的“评论风格”。
AI.conclusion: 基于参考的相似度指标不足以衡量MLLMs的审美批评能力，模型倾向于生成冗长且通用的评论，而非像人类那样进行有选择性的、具体的审美观察。
AI.translation: 开放式审美批评对多模态大模型（MLLMs）来说是一项挑战：与多项选择的审美基准不同，它没有单一的正确答案，且大多数审美评估侧重于数值评分而非人类实际给出的书面评论。我们通过排名人类参考评论来评估MLLM的评论，并探讨其是否接近人类水平。利用Reddit照片评论数据集，我们在六种提示词条件下（解构角色设定、方面提示、长度控制及单次与多次生成），通过基于参考的相似度指标对五个开源MLLM进行评分，并加入将错误图片输入模型的图像基础对照实验。我们发现，基于参考的相似度给出了误导性的结论。更严格的词汇和学习型指标显示其与人类评论的对齐度较弱，而粗略的嵌入余弦相似度报告出的广泛主题重叠，经图像基础对照实验证明主要源于模型稳定的文风，而非针对图像的具体观察。在行为层面，模型在分数无法反映的方面与人类表现出持续的差异：即使在长度限制下，它们输出的文本也是人类的二到三倍，涵盖了人类选择性关注的所有审美方面，且参与深度更均匀，并在对同一照片进行多次评论时出现重复，而人类则会变化。我们认为，基于参考的相似度奖励的是流畅、全面的评论风格，而非人类评论的选择性和特异性，并讨论了评估和训练开放式多模态生成的影响。
AI.summary: 本文评估了多模态大模型（MLLMs）在开放式审美批评任务中的表现，发现模型倾向于生成冗长、全面但缺乏人类审美特异性的评论。研究指出，现有的基于参考的相似度指标无法捕捉人类审美中选择性和针对性的核心特征。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 审美批评, 评估指标, 人类行为对齐, 图像描述
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了当前多模态大模型在审美评价任务上的局限性，特别指出基于参考的相似度指标无法有效衡量人类审美中“选择性”和“特异性”的本质。这一发现对改进生成式模型评估方法具有重要的启示意义。

title: IG-Lens: Exact Additive Probability Attribution Across Transformer Layers via Telescoping Integrated Gradients
summary: We ask a simple question about decoder-only transformers: \emph{between which two layers is the probability of a predicted token actually produced?} Existing layer-wise readout tools answer only approximately. The logit lens and its trained variant report a per-layer \emph{level} of probability but give no additive decomposition; their estimates are biased and non-monotone across depth. Direct Logit Attribution and related residual-stream methods are additive, but only in \emph{logit} space -- the softmax nonlinearity breaks additivity in probability space, precisely the quantity one usually cares about. Layer Conductance integrates gradients per layer, but attributes each to its own baseline and so does not sum to the total change in prediction. We introduce \textbf{IG-Lens}, a telescoping application of Integrated Gradients along a single path through the hidden states from a baseline to the final layer. Crediting each segment to the layer it terminates at yields a layer-wise attribution whose sum is \emph{exactly} the change in target probability, with the softmax inside the integration path rather than linearized away. Our default estimator credits each integration step its \emph{observed} change in target probability -- a prediction-aware reweighting in the spirit of IDGI -- rather than its raw gradient. Because the readout is a one-dimensional probability, this collapses each segment to a telescoping sum of endpoint values, so completeness holds exactly (to floating point) at \emph{any} step count, removing Riemann discretization error while suppressing steps that show gradient sensitivity without a change in output. We give the telescoping identity and its proof, verify completeness to floating point, and describe a single-pass batched implementation computing the full token-by-layer map without any backward call. Code: https://github.com/anhnda/IGLens.

AI.title_translation: IG-Lens：通过级数积分梯度实现 Transformer 层间精确的加性概率归因
AI.tldr: IG-Lens 是一种精确的 Transformer 层级归因方法，通过级数求和解决 softmax 非线性问题，实现了概率空间内各层贡献的精确可加分解。
AI.motivation: 现有的层级归因方法（如 Logit Lens 或 Layer Conductance）在处理 Transformer 的 softmax 非线性时存在偏差、无法实现概率空间的可加性或存在舍入误差，难以精确回答预测 token 的概率究竟是在哪一层产生的问题。
AI.method: 提出 IG-Lens 方法，通过沿隐藏状态路径应用级数求和形式的积分梯度，将每个层的贡献归因于其终止的段落，利用预测感知重加权技术，实现了概率空间中层级贡献的精确可加性，并支持无需反向传播的单次前向计算。
AI.result: IG-Lens 实现了概率空间内层级归因的数学完备性（即各层贡献之和精确等于总概率变化），消除了 Riemann 离散化误差，并提供了一种高效的单次前向批处理实现方案。
AI.conclusion: IG-Lens 通过级数求和的数学特性，实现了在概率空间中对 Transformer 模型各层贡献的精确、可加的归因，克服了现有方法在非线性变换下的偏差问题。
AI.translation: 我们对仅解码器（decoder-only）的 Transformer 提出了一个简单的问题：预测 token 的概率究竟是在哪两层之间产生的？现有的层级读取工具只能给出近似答案。Logit Lens 及其变体报告了每层的概率水平，但没有提供可加性分解；它们的估计值存在偏差且深度上不单调。直接 Logit 归因（Direct Logit Attribution）及相关残差流方法虽然是可加的，但仅在 logit 空间内——softmax 非线性打破了概率空间的可加性，而这正是人们通常关心的量。层导数（Layer Conductance）对每一层进行梯度积分，但将每一层归因于其自身的基线，因此无法汇总为预测的总变化。我们引入了 IG-Lens，这是一种沿隐藏状态路径（从基线到最终层）应用级数积分梯度的方法。将每一段归因于其终止的层，可以得到一种层级归因，其总和精确等于目标概率的变化，且 softmax 包含在积分路径内，而非被线性化处理。我们的默认估计器根据其观察到的目标概率变化来评估每个积分步骤——这是一种类似于 IDGI 的预测感知重加权，而不是单纯的原始梯度。由于读取结果是一维概率，这使得每个片段坍缩为端点值的级数和，因此完备性在任何步数下都精确成立（达到浮点精度），消除了 Riemann 离散化误差，同时抑制了表现出梯度敏感性但输出没有变化的步骤。我们给出了级数恒等式及其证明，验证了浮点精度的完备性，并描述了一种单次前向批处理实现，无需任何反向调用即可计算完整的 token-层映射。
AI.summary: IG-Lens 是一种用于 Transformer 模型的新型层级归因技术，它通过级数求和的方法在概率空间内精确分解预测 token 的概率贡献。该方法解决了现有技术在处理 softmax 非线性时的局限性，实现了各层贡献的精确可加性，并具备无需反向传播的高效计算优势。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 可解释性, 积分梯度, 层级归因, 概率空间
AI.comments: IG-Lens 的创新之处在于将积分梯度（Integrated Gradients）与级数求和（telescoping sum）相结合，巧妙地解决了 softmax 非线性带来的可加性难题，为 Transformer 的可解释性研究提供了一种精确的层级归因方法。其无需反向传播的单次前向通过计算方式，在提升效率的同时保证了数学上的完备性，是模型内部机制分析的重要工具。

title: Progressive Self-Supervised Learning with Individualized Community Assignment for Brain Network Analysis
summary: Brain networks exhibit a modular community structure that varies across individuals and neurological conditions. However, existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods often overlook this heterogeneity, relying on generic masking strategies that fail to capture subject-specific functional organization. We propose BrainPICM, a self-supervised framework for brain network analysis via progressive individualized community aware masking. BrainPICM formulates ROI-to-community mapping as a progressive unbalanced optimal transport process, yielding soft assignments and per-ROI confidence scores. Guided by these confidence estimates, a curriculum-style masking strategy gradually incorporates low-confidence, potentially pathological regions into training, enabling the model to learn both stable modular structures and individual variations. Additionally, a deviation-aware aggregation module quantifies functional reorganization by measuring mass redistribution relative to a population template, enhancing interpretability and downstream prediction. Experiments on three fMRI datasets (ABIDE-I, ADHD-200, ADNI) show that BrainPICM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and SSL methods in diagnostic accuracy, indicating that explicitly injecting modular community structure into masked modeling yields more functionally consistent and generalizable representations. The source code for this approach will be released at https://github.com/Hrychen7/BrainPICM.

AI.title_translation: 用于脑网络分析的具有个体化社区分配的渐进式自监督学习
AI.tldr: BrainPICM通过引入个体化社区结构和课程掩码策略，显著改进了自监督学习在脑网络分析中的表现，提升了诊断准确性与模型可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的自监督学习方法忽略了大脑网络在个体和神经状况之间的异质性，通用的掩码策略难以捕捉特定受试者的功能组织结构。
AI.method: 提出BrainPICM框架，将ROI到社区的映射建模为渐进式非平衡最优传输过程以获取软分配，并利用置信度得分实施课程学习风格的掩码策略，最后通过偏差感知聚合模块量化功能重组。
AI.result: 在ABIDE-I、ADHD-200和ADNI三个fMRI数据集上的实验表明，BrainPICM在诊断准确性方面优于现有的监督学习和自监督学习方法。
AI.conclusion: BrainPICM通过在自监督学习中整合个体化的社区结构和课程掩码策略，显著提升了脑网络表征学习的质量，在多项fMRI数据集上表现优异，证实了该框架在神经影像分析中的有效性和通用性。
AI.translation: 大脑网络表现出在个体和神经状况之间变化的模块化社区结构。然而，现有的自监督学习（SSL）方法往往忽视这种异质性，依赖于无法捕捉特定主体功能组织的通用掩码策略。我们提出了BrainPICM，这是一种通过渐进式个体化社区感知掩码进行脑网络分析的自监督框架。BrainPICM将ROI到社区的映射制定为一种渐进式非平衡最优传输过程，产生软分配和每个ROI的置信度得分。在这些置信度估计的指导下，一种课程风格的掩码策略逐渐将低置信度、潜在病理的区域纳入训练，使模型能够学习稳定的模块结构和个体差异。此外，一个偏差感知聚合模块通过测量相对于群体模板的质量重分布来量化功能重组，增强了可解释性和下游预测能力。在三个fMRI数据集（ABIDE-I、ADHD-200、ADNI）上的实验表明，BrainPICM在诊断准确性方面始终优于最先进的监督和SSL方法，这表明将模块化社区结构明确注入掩码建模中可以产生更具功能一致性和可推广性的表征。该方法的源代码将在https://github.com/Hrychen7/BrainPICM发布。
AI.summary: BrainPICM是一种用于脑网络分析的自监督框架，它通过渐进式个体化社区感知掩码来捕捉大脑的功能组织。该方法利用最优传输获取ROI软分配，并结合课程学习策略处理不确定区域，从而学习到更具功能一致性和泛化能力的表征。
AI.keywords: 脑网络分析, 自监督学习, 社区结构, 最优传输, 课程学习
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将个体化的社区结构引入自监督学习中，解决了传统通用掩码策略在处理大脑网络异质性时的局限性。通过引入最优传输理论和课程学习策略，该方法在提高诊断精度的同时增强了模型的可解释性，是脑网络分析领域的一个重要进展。

title: MF-UAVPose6D: A Model-Free Monocular 6-DoF Pose Estimation Framework for Fixed-Wing UAVs
summary: For uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs), estimating six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) poses is essential for airspace situational awareness, target tracking, and counter-UAV operations. However, non-cooperative targets usually lack computer-aided design (CAD) models and keypoint priors, making existing model-based or keypoint-matching methods difficult to apply reliably. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MF-UAVPose6D, a model-free monocular 6-DoF pose estimation framework for fixed-wing UAVs. During inference, the method takes only a single red-green-blue (RGB) image and camera intrinsics as input. It first obtains a stable target anchor through heatmap-guided center localization, introduces a Perspective-Aware Module (PAM) to model observation-ray priors, exploits Dynamic Topological Sampling (DTS) to complement weak structural cues from the wings, fuselage, and tail, and adopts a decoupled translation-rotation pose decoding mechanism to estimate the 6-DoF pose. In addition, we construct the FW-UAV6DPose synthetic dataset, which covers fixed-wing UAV observations across diverse distances, viewpoints, and poses. Experimental results show that MF-UAVPose6D achieves accurate and efficient monocular 6-DoF pose estimation without requiring CAD models, and demonstrates strong robustness in long-range rotation estimation, depth recovery, and joint pose evaluation.

AI.title_translation: MF-UAVPose6D：一种面向固定翼无人机的无模型单目6-DoF姿态估计框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需CAD模型的单目6-DoF姿态估计框架，通过视角感知和动态拓扑采样，解决了非合作固定翼无人机姿态估计的难题。
AI.motivation: 针对非合作无人机通常缺乏CAD模型和关键点先验，导致现有模型依赖型或关键点匹配方法难以可靠应用的问题。
AI.method: 提出MF-UAVPose6D框架，包含热图引导的中心定位、视角感知模块(PAM)、动态拓扑采样(DTS)以及解耦的平移-旋转姿态解码机制。
AI.result: 在自建的FW-UAV6DPose数据集上表现优异，在远距离旋转估计、深度恢复及联合姿态评估方面具有较强的鲁棒性和效率。
AI.conclusion: MF-UAVPose6D为固定翼无人机提供了一种无需CAD模型的鲁棒且高效的单目6-DoF姿态估计方案。
AI.translation: 对于无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）而言，估计六自由度（6-DoF）姿态对于空域态势感知、目标跟踪和反无人机行动至关重要。然而，非合作目标通常缺乏计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型和关键点先验，使得现有的基于模型或关键点匹配的方法难以可靠应用。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了MF-UAVPose6D，这是一个面向固定翼无人机的无模型单目6-DoF姿态估计框架。在推理过程中，该方法仅以单张红-绿-蓝（RGB）图像和相机内参作为输入。它首先通过热图引导的中心定位获得稳定的目标锚点，引入视角感知模块（PAM）来建模观测射线先验，利用动态拓扑采样（DTS）来补充机翼、机身和尾部微弱的结构线索，并采用解耦的平移-旋转姿态解码机制来估计6-DoF姿态。此外，我们构建了FW-UAV6DPose合成数据集，涵盖了不同距离、视角和姿态下的固定翼无人机观测。实验结果表明，MF-UAVPose6D在无需CAD模型的情况下实现了准确高效的单目6-DoF姿态估计，并在长距离旋转估计、深度恢复和联合姿态评估方面表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为MF-UAVPose6D的无模型单目6-DoF姿态估计框架，专为固定翼无人机设计。该方法仅需单张RGB图像和相机内参，通过结合中心定位、视角感知和动态拓扑采样，实现了无需CAD模型的精准姿态估计，并配套发布了FW-UAV6DPose数据集。
AI.keywords: 6-DoF姿态估计, 固定翼无人机, 模型无关, 单目视觉, 计算机视觉
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地解决了非合作固定翼无人机缺乏CAD模型和关键点先验的难题。通过引入视角感知模块和动态拓扑采样，有效提升了在缺乏结构特征时的姿态估计鲁棒性，具有极高的实际应用价值。

title: Early Warning Signals for OpenVLA Failure under Visual Distribution Shift
summary: Vision Language Action models combine perception, language grounding, and control in a single policy, but their failures are hard to diagnose once visual conditions shift. We test whether OpenVLA feedforward activations contain linearly decodable information about near term task failure in LIBERO manipulation rollouts. The policy is fixed throughout. We log internal activations during execution and fit lightweight monitors after the rollouts are collected. Occlusion is the main controlled stress test. It reduces OpenVLA success from $57\%$ to $17\%$ over $100$ episodes per condition. Under this shift, a logistic probe at layer 16 reaches AUROC $0.972$ and AUPRC $0.352$ for predicting failure within a $15$ step horizon. It outperforms both a mean difference direction and an action disagreement baseline. A sparse layer sweep finds uneven decodability across depth: layer 16 is strongest among the tested layers, layer 8 remains informative, and layer 10 is weaker. To check whether the monitor is just an occlusion detector, we also evaluate color shift and camera jitter without refitting. Color shift produces no failures in this setting, so it is a benign control rather than a failure benchmark. Camera jitter does induce failures, and the occlusion trained monitor remains above random. The result is deliberately limited: OpenVLA internal states contain failure relevant structure under controlled perceptual shift, but these experiments do not establish a causal mechanism, task held out generalization, or a deployable recovery system.

AI.title_translation: OpenVLA在视觉分布偏移下失效的早期预警信号
AI.tldr: 通过监测OpenVLA模型内部的激活状态，可以有效预测其在视觉干扰环境下的任务失败。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在面对视觉环境变化时，其失败原因难以诊断，需要一种有效的方法来实时监测并预测模型在近期的任务失败。
AI.method: 在LIBERO操控任务中固定OpenVLA模型，记录其执行过程中的内部激活值，并训练轻量级逻辑回归探测器（Logistic probe）来预测未来15步内的任务失败。通过遮挡、颜色偏移和相机抖动等压力测试评估其预测性能。
AI.result: 在遮挡压力测试下，模型预测失败的AUROC达到0.972，性能优于均值差异和动作分歧基线。实验发现预测能力在模型不同层级间分布不均，第16层表现最佳，且该监测器在面对相机抖动等未见过的偏移时仍具有一定的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: OpenVLA的内部激活状态包含能够预测近期任务失败的线性可解码信息，通过简单的轻量级监测器即可在特定视觉分布偏移下有效识别失败风险。
AI.translation: 视觉语言动作模型将感知、语言基础和控制结合在一个策略中，但一旦视觉条件发生变化，其故障就很难诊断。我们测试了OpenVLA的前馈激活是否包含关于LIBERO操控任务近期失败的线性可解码信息。策略在整个过程中保持不变。我们在执行期间记录内部激活，并在收集滚动数据后拟合轻量级监测器。遮挡是主要的受控压力测试。在每种条件下100次剧集中，它将OpenVLA的成功率从57%降低到17%。在这种偏移下，第16层的逻辑探测器在预测15步范围内的失败方面达到了0.972的AUROC和0.352的AUPRC。它的表现优于均值差异方向和动作分歧基线。稀疏层扫描发现可解码性在深度上是不均匀的：第16层在测试层中最强，第8层仍然具有信息量，而第10层较弱。为了检查监测器是否只是一个遮挡检测器，我们还在不重新拟合的情况下评估了颜色偏移和相机抖动。颜色偏移在这种设置下不会产生失败，因此它是良性控制而不是失败基准。相机抖动确实会导致失败，而经过遮挡训练的监测器仍然优于随机水平。结果特意受到限制：OpenVLA内部状态在受控感知偏移下包含与失败相关的结构，但这些实验没有建立因果机制、任务保留泛化或可部署的恢复系统。
AI.summary: 本文研究了OpenVLA模型在视觉分布偏移下的失效预警问题。研究发现，通过训练轻量级线性探测器监测模型内部激活值，可以高精度地预测模型在近期的任务失败，为提高机器人策略的鲁棒性和可监控性提供了新思路。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言动作模型, 视觉分布偏移, 故障监测, 线性探测, 机器人控制
AI.comments: 该研究创新地利用线性探测（linear probes）挖掘了视觉语言动作模型（VLA）内部激活值中蕴含的失败预测信息。尽管作者明确指出该方法尚未具备因果解释性或部署能力，但这一发现为提升机器人策略的可解释性和实时监控提供了重要的研究方向。其局限性在于主要针对特定类型的分布偏移，且尚未验证跨任务的泛化能力。

title: Toward Secure and Reliable PDDL Formalization of Large Language Models with Planner-in-the-Loop Feedback
summary: Planning often requires symbolic specifications that are both executable and verifiable. For large language models deployed in autonomous or decision-support systems, failures in such formalization may lead to unverifiable decisions, execution failures, or unsafe downstream behavior. We present NL-PDDL-Bench, a multi-domain benchmark for natural-language-to-PDDL specification construction with planner-verified executability and controlled difficulty scaling by object count. We further propose a planner-in-the-loop framework that uses validator and planner diagnostics to revise non-executable specifications through localized edits. Building on this infrastructure, we develop a planner-grounded optimization recipe that combines parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation supervised fine-tuning, offline planner-derived preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization, and inference-time planner-in-the-loop repair, without requiring online planner calls during training.
