In particular, WADI is dominated by repetition, HAI emphasizes sustained drift and oscillation, and SWaT is characterized by stealthier frozen-telemetry behavior. To examine the evaluation implications, we use an indicative Random Forest baseline and show that aggregate binary metrics can limit visibility into performance across different behavioral proxies. For example, in SWaT, macro F1 drops from 85.44% under binary evaluation to 37.84% under behavior-proxy multiclass prediction, with similar degradations observed on WADI and HAI. Based on these findings, we argue for complementing conventional binary benchmarking with behavior-stratified evaluation to expose blind spots that aggregate scores leave hidden and to better support targeted incident response.

AI.title_translation: 零与一之间：跨公共工业控制系统数据集的二进制标签之外的行为表征
AI.tldr: 传统工业控制系统入侵检测的二分类评估掩盖了攻击行为的多样性，本文提出一种基于物理原语的行为表征框架，证明了细分行为评估能有效暴露现有模型的性能盲点。
AI.motivation: 传统工业控制系统（ICS）入侵检测依赖于简单的“正常”与“攻击”二分类标签，这掩盖了网络物理攻击行为的多样性，导致评估结果无法全面反映模型性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种行为表征框架，将原始多元过程轨迹映射为五种物理原语（漂移、尖峰、振荡、重复、切换）；并在SWaT、WADI和HAI数据集上进行验证，对比了二分类评估与基于行为代理的多分类评估效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，攻击行为具有明显的物理特性，且不同数据集在行为空间上分布迥异（如WADI多表现为重复，HAI多为漂移和振荡，SWaT则为隐蔽的冻结遥测）；通过行为代理评估，模型在各数据集上的宏观F1分数大幅下降，证明了二分类评估存在严重的性能评估盲点。
AI.conclusion: 现有的二分类评估掩盖了ICS入侵检测的真实性能表现，必须引入基于行为分层的评估方法，才能暴露模型盲点并提升应急响应能力。
AI.translation: 工业控制系统（ICS）中的入侵检测通常使用少量公共基准测试进行评估，仅采用“正常”与“攻击”的二分类标签，这种做法掩盖了网络物理攻击的行为多样性。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一个行为表征框架，将原始多元过程轨迹映射为五种可解释的物理原语：漂移、尖峰、振荡、重复和切换。我们将该框架应用于SWaT、WADI和HAI这三个广泛使用的ICS基准测试，结果表明，攻击窗口相对于正常操作表现出明显的行为偏移，且三个数据集在行为空间中占据了很大程度上不同的区域，揭示了跨数据集偏差和数据集内部的多样性。特别是WADI以重复为主，HAI强调持续的漂移和振荡，而SWaT则以更隐蔽的冻结遥测行为为特征。为了考察评估意义，我们使用了指示性的随机森林基准，并表明汇总的二分类指标会限制对不同行为代理性能的可见性。例如，在SWaT中，宏观F1分数从二分类评估下的85.44%下降到行为代理多分类预测下的37.84%，在WADI和HAI上也观察到了类似的性能下降。基于这些发现，我们主张将传统的二分类基准测试与行为分层评估相结合，以暴露汇总分数所掩盖的盲点，并更好地支持有针对性的事件响应。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对工业控制系统入侵检测的行为表征框架，通过将过程数据转化为五种物理原语，揭示了不同数据集中的攻击行为特征。研究发现，传统的二分类评估方法掩盖了模型在不同攻击类型下的真实表现，作者建议采用基于行为分层的评估方式来提升检测系统的鲁棒性和针对性。
AI.keywords: 工业控制系统, 入侵检测, 行为表征, 物理原语, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究具有很高的实用价值，它打破了传统ICS入侵检测仅依赖“正常/攻击”二分类的局限性，通过行为原语的引入，使得检测模型的评估更加细致和可解释。其局限在于仅选取了三种数据集，且依赖于特定的原语定义，未来可能需要扩展到更多样化的工业场景。

title: McMg: A Learned Phase-Space Multi-channel Multigrid Preconditioner for Helmholtz Equation
summary: Solving heterogeneous Helmholtz equations at high wavenumbers remains challenging because the discretized operator is indefinite, pollution degrades phase accuracy, and scalar coarse-grid correction can discard the local phase and propagation-direction information carried by oscillatory errors. We propose Multi-channel Multigrid (McMg), a learned phase-space multigrid preconditioner for heterogeneous Helmholtz equations. Rather than predicting the solution directly, McMg maps residuals to corrections within an iterative framework. Its central idea is to coarsen physical space while retaining unresolved local wave information in the channel dimension: each coarse node carries a learned packet of amplitude, phase, direction, and scattering coefficients rather than a single scalar unknown. The architecture combines linear multi-channel transfer operators with locally adaptive stencils, neural PDE operators, and medium-dependent smoothers whose coefficients are generated from the wave speed. For a fixed medium, the V-cycle is linear in the residual; nonlinear physical features are computed once in a setup phase and cached, so each online iteration reduces to convolutions with fixed coefficients. We further study generalization across scales. Models trained on small domains transfer directly to larger domains and higher effective wavenumbers, and a Layer-by-Layer Progressive Finetuning (LLPF) strategy extends the support of the learned Green's operator by adding and finetuning only new coarse levels. Numerical experiments on high-frequency, high-contrast, and large-scale three-dimensional problems demonstrate that McMg requires substantially fewer iterations and less wall-clock time than strong classical baselines, while consistently outperforming existing neural preconditioners.

AI.title_translation: McMg：一种用于Helmholtz方程的学习型相空间多通道多重网格预条件器
AI.tldr: McMg通过在多重网格中引入多通道波包信息，有效解决了高频Helmholtz方程中的相位丢失问题，实现了比传统方法更高效的求解。
AI.motivation: 高波数异构Helmholtz方程的离散算子具有不定性，且存在污染效应。传统的标量粗网格校正方法会丢失振荡误差中的局部相位和传播方向信息，导致求解效率低下。
AI.method: 提出多通道多重网格（McMg）框架，通过将残差映射为包含振幅、相位、方向和散射系数的“波包”来代替标量校正；采用线性多通道转移算子、局部自适应模板、神经PDE算子及与介质相关的平滑器；引入层级渐进微调（LLPF）策略以实现跨尺度泛化。
AI.result: 在处理高频、高对比度及大规模三维问题时，McMg相比经典基准方法显著减少了迭代次数和计算时间，并在性能上优于现有的神经预条件器。模型展示了良好的跨尺度泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: McMg通过将局部波信息嵌入多通道数据结构中，为解决高频、高对比度Helmholtz方程提供了一种高效、可扩展且具备良好泛化能力的预条件算子。
AI.translation: 求解高波数下的异构Helmholtz方程仍然具有挑战性，因为离散算子是不定的，污染效应会降低相位精度，且标量粗网格校正可能会丢弃振荡误差所携带的局部相位和传播方向信息。我们提出了多通道多重网格（McMg），这是一种用于异构Helmholtz方程的学习型相空间多重网格预条件器。McMg的核心思想不是直接预测解，而是在迭代框架内将残差映射为校正量。它在粗化物理空间的同时，在通道维度中保留了未解析的局部波信息：每个粗节点携带一个学习到的振幅、相位、方向和散射系数包，而不是单个标量未知数。该架构结合了线性多通道转移算子、局部自适应模板、神经PDE算子以及由波速生成系数的依赖于介质的平滑器。对于固定的介质，V-cycle相对于残差是线性的；非线性物理特征在设置阶段计算一次并缓存，因此每次在线迭代简化为具有固定系数的卷积。我们进一步研究了跨尺度的泛化。在小域上训练的模型可以直接迁移到更大的域和更高的有效波数，并且层级渐进微调（LLPF）策略通过添加和微调新的粗层，扩展了学习到的格林算子的支持范围。对高频、高对比度和大规模三维问题的数值实验表明，McMg比强大的经典基准方法需要更少的迭代次数和更短的运行时间，同时持续优于现有的神经预条件器。
AI.summary: McMg是一种用于求解异构Helmholtz方程的学习型相空间多重网格预条件器。它通过将粗网格节点上的标量未知数替换为包含波包信息（振幅、相位、方向等）的多通道数据，解决了传统方法丢失局部波信息的缺陷。该方法结合了物理驱动的设计与神经算子，支持高效的在线迭代，并通过LLPF策略实现了出色的尺度泛化能力。
AI.keywords: Helmholtz方程, 多重网格, 神经预条件器, 相空间, 高波数求解
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于引入了“多通道”概念，将物理空间的粗化与保留局部波信息（相位、方向、散射系数）相结合，成功解决了传统标量粗网格校正无法有效处理高波数Helmholtz方程振荡误差的问题。这种混合了神经算子和物理驱动设计的方法显著提升了计算效率和泛化能力。

title: GPU Parallelization Strategies for Forward and Backward Propagation in Shallow Neural Networks: A CUDA-Based Comparative Study
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures. Technical report, ESI Algiers, 2025--2026
summary: We present a comparative study of CUDA optimization strategies applied to forward and backward propagation in a shallow neural network. Three stacked optimizations are evaluated: (1) tiled shared memory with bank-conflict elimination via +1-column padding, (2) pre-transposed weight matrices for coalesced global memory access, and (3) a fused MatMul+ReLU kernel that eliminates intermediate global-memory round-trips. Experiments on an NVIDIA Tesla T4 (CUDA 13.0) across three dataset sizes show that the fully optimized implementation achieves a 1.41x speedup over the baseline CUDA version on the large dataset (25,600 samples), reducing execution time from 21.0s to 14.8s. Results are compared against a sequential CPU baseline and an OpenMP parallel implementation, demonstrating the effectiveness of memory-access optimization in GPU-accelerated deep learning primitives.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Technical report, ESI Algiers, 2025--2026

AI.title_translation: 浅层神经网络前向与反向传播的GPU并行化策略：基于CUDA的对比研究
AI.tldr: 本文通过分块共享内存、合并内存访问和内核融合等CUDA优化技术，将浅层神经网络的运行速度提升了1.41倍。
AI.motivation: 旨在研究并量化不同的CUDA优化策略对提升浅层神经网络前向和反向传播性能的贡献，以应对深度学习计算中的内存访问瓶颈。
AI.method: 通过三种堆叠式CUDA优化策略进行研究：(1) 使用+1列填充的分块共享内存以消除银行冲突；(2) 预转置权重矩阵以实现合并全局内存访问；(3) 融合MatMul+ReLU内核以减少中间全局内存往返次数。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA Tesla T4平台上，针对大规模数据集（25,600个样本），完全优化的实现相比基准CUDA版本实现了1.41倍的加速，执行时间从21.0秒缩短至14.8秒。
AI.conclusion: 通过采用分块共享内存、权重预转置和内核融合技术，可以有效缓解GPU内存带宽瓶颈，从而显著提升神经网络计算的执行效率。
AI.translation: 我们针对浅层神经网络的前向和反向传播，对CUDA优化策略进行了对比研究。文中评估了三种堆叠式优化方案：(1) 通过+1列填充消除银行冲突的分块共享内存；(2) 用于合并全局内存访问的预转置权重矩阵；(3) 消除中间全局内存往返的融合MatMul+ReLU内核。在NVIDIA Tesla T4（CUDA 13.0）上针对三种数据集规模进行的实验表明，完全优化的实现在大型数据集（25,600个样本）上比基准CUDA版本实现了1.41倍的加速，将执行时间从21.0秒减少到14.8秒。研究结果与顺序CPU基准和OpenMP并行实现进行了对比，证明了内存访问优化在GPU加速深度学习原语中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文对比研究了三种CUDA优化技术在浅层神经网络传播过程中的应用效果，包括分块共享内存、权重预转置和内核融合。实验表明，这些内存访问优化策略显著提升了GPU计算效率，在处理大规模数据集时实现了1.41倍的性能提升。
AI.keywords: CUDA优化, 神经网络, 并行计算, 内存访问, GPU加速
AI.comments: 该研究通过堆叠三种经典的CUDA优化技术（分块内存、合并访问、内核融合），显著提升了浅层神经网络的计算性能。其创新点在于将这些通用优化策略具体应用于神经网络的前向和反向传播中，并量化了内存访问优化对深度学习原语的重要性。局限性在于仅针对浅层网络，未探讨更深层架构或更复杂的计算图优化。

title: On the Faithfulness of Post-Hoc Concept Bottleneck Models
comments: Accepted at ECCV 2026, 41 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables
summary: Human decision-making interprets the world through high-level concepts, such as recognizing a bird by its belly color. To bridge the gap between opaque deep learning representations and human understanding, Post-Hoc Concept Bottleneck Models (post-hoc CBMs) project latent features onto interpretable concept spaces using auxiliary datasets or vision-language models. However, relying on target task accuracy as the primary measure of post-hoc CBM success obscures whether the learned concepts are semantically meaningful or merely predictive artifacts. For example, random concept projections can achieve competitive accuracy despite being semantically meaningless. In this work, we analyze the learned projections directly and identify two failure cases: First, for concept projections learned from auxiliary data, covariate shifts can lead to unfaithful concept representations for the target task. In particular, we provide an upper bound on the error introduced by this shift. Second, systematic label noise in surrogate concept labels generated by vision-language models leads to unfaithful projections. After formalizing these failure modes, we introduce novel metrics that decouple concept faithfulness from predictive accuracy. Our empirical results across real-world and synthetic benchmarks confirm that these metrics identify unfaithful behaviors that standard accuracy-based evaluation fails to detect.
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026, 41 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables

title: Discovering Collaboration from Novelty: Random Network Distillation for Clustered Federated Learning
summary: Federated Learning often suffers under non-independently and identically distributed data, where a single global model may fail to represent the diversity of client distributions. Clustered Federated Learning mitigates this issue by training specialized models for groups of similar clients, but existing approaches often couple cluster assignment with the main training loop, increasing computational and communication costs. We propose a lightweight clustering approach based on Random Network Distillation. Each client trains a compact Random Network Distillation predictor on its local data and uses its prediction error as a novelty signal to estimate similarity with other clients. This enables the discovery of meaningful client groups before federated training, without sharing raw data or repeatedly evaluating the main model. Crucially, the resulting federations emerge from local novelty estimates at runtime, making the method suitable for autonomous large-scale distributed systems where neither the number of clusters nor the collaboration structure can be specified a priori. Overall, by decoupling clustering from learning, the method provides a task-agnostic and efficient mechanism for autonomous collaboration under non-independently and identically distributed data.

title: Muon learns balanced solutions in matrix factorization without slow saddle-to-saddle dynamics
summary: Matrix factorization (i.e., problems of the form $\min_{\mathbf{P},\mathbf{Q}} \|\mathbf{M}^\star - \mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{Q}\|_\mathrm{F}^2$) is a minimal learning problem that exhibits both nonlinear parameter dynamics and representation learning. In this setting, we study how parameter trajectories under the Muon optimizer differ from those of gradient descent. We identify three main dynamical differences: 1) Muon avoids the slow saddle-to-saddle dynamics from small initialization. Muon instead learns all the top modes of $\mathbf{M}^\star$ at the same rate, with the smaller modes converging first. 2) Muon remains stable even when the learning rate exceeds the critical threshold set by the local loss sharpness. This frees the learning rate from the condition number of the problem, enabling rapid convergence via exponential learning rate annealing. 3) Once the weights are aligned with each other and the target, Muon flow conserves the matrix quantity $\sqrt{\mathbf{P}^\top \mathbf{P}}-\sqrt{\mathbf{Q}^\top \mathbf{Q}}$, while gradient flow is known to conserve the matrix $\mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{Q}^\top\mathbf{Q}$. Despite having distinct conserved quantities, both optimizers find the so-called \textit{balanced} solution from vanishing initialization. When training from small random initialization, the weights spontaneously align early in training. We derive the alignment rates in simple settings and show that they predict the empirical alignment rates in general. Finally, we exploit structural properties of Muon to construct a learning rate schedule that achieves near-perfect alignment in only two optimization steps.

AI.title_translation: Muon在矩阵分解中学习平衡解且无慢速鞍点动力学问题
AI.tldr: Muon优化器通过规避鞍点滞留和利用更灵活的稳定性机制，在矩阵分解任务中实现了比梯度下降更快的收敛和更优的对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究Muon优化器在矩阵分解问题中相比于传统梯度下降的独特动力学优势，特别是其在处理非线性参数动力学和表示学习方面的表现。
AI.method: 通过对比Muon与梯度下降的动力学差异，分析其在小初始化下的收敛行为、稳定性、守恒量特性，并据此构建了实现快速对齐的学习率调度方案。
AI.result: Muon避免了慢速鞍点动力学，能够以同等速率学习所有模态，且在超过局部损失锐度阈值时依然保持稳定，并能在极少步骤内实现近乎完美的权重对齐。
AI.conclusion: Muon优化器通过改变动力学路径和守恒量，能够在矩阵分解中实现比梯度下降更快速、更稳定的收敛，并能通过特定调度在极短步数内达成平衡解。
AI.translation: 矩阵分解（即形式为 $\min_{\mathbf{P},\mathbf{Q}} \|\mathbf{M}^\star - \mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{Q}\|_\mathrm{F}^2$ 的问题）是一个展现非线性参数动力学和表示学习的最小化学习问题。在此背景下，我们研究了Muon优化器下的参数轨迹与梯度下降有何不同。我们确定了三个主要的动力学差异：1）Muon避免了从较小初始化开始的慢速鞍点动力学。相反，Muon以相同的速率学习 $\mathbf{M}^\star$ 的所有顶部模态，且较小的模态先收敛。2）即使学习率超过局部损失锐度设定的临界阈值，Muon依然保持稳定。这使得学习率不再受问题条件数的限制，从而通过指数级学习率退火实现快速收敛。3）一旦权重彼此对齐并与目标对齐，Muon流会守恒矩阵量 $\sqrt{\mathbf{P}^\top \mathbf{P}}-\sqrt{\mathbf{Q}^\top \mathbf{Q}}$，而已知梯度流守恒的是矩阵 $\mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{Q}^\top\mathbf{Q}$。尽管具有不同的守恒量，两种优化器都能从消失初始化中找到所谓的“平衡”解。当从较小的随机初始化进行训练时，权重会在训练早期自发对齐。我们推导了简单设置下的对齐速率，并证明它们可以预测一般情况下的经验对齐速率。最后，我们利用Muon的结构特性构建了一个在仅两个优化步骤内就能实现近乎完美对齐的学习率调度。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Muon优化器在矩阵分解中的动力学表现。研究发现，Muon能够有效规避梯度下降中常见的慢速鞍点动力学，实现模态的快速同步学习。此外，它在不受条件数限制的情况下保持高度稳定性，并通过独特的守恒量机制在小初始化下高效达到平衡解。作者还基于这些特性提出了一种极速收敛的学习率调度方法。
AI.keywords: 矩阵分解, Muon优化器, 动力学分析, 平衡解, 收敛速度
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了Muon优化器在矩阵分解任务中优于梯度下降的动力学机制，特别是通过规避慢速鞍点动力学和实现更灵活的步长控制，为理解大型模型训练中的优化行为提供了理论视角。

title: High-Resolution Flood Mapping With Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 via Misalignment-Robust Cross-Sensor Learning and Generative Despeckling
summary: Reliable high-resolution flood extent mapping from satellite imagery remains constrained by limited data fidelity and sensor-specific artifacts. Multispectral optical imagery is degraded by clouds, shadows, and urban confounders, while synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery is affected by speckle noise and sensor co-registration uncertainty. This work presents an integrated flood mapping framework that jointly addresses these limitations through curated datasets and novel learning strategies. We introduce a new Sentinel-2 (S2) and Sentinel-1 (S1) dataset covering the contiguous United States, featuring pixel-accurate 10 m water masks with emphasis on challenging weather conditions and urban environments that are underrepresented in existing benchmarks. High-quality S2 annotations are manually produced using rigorous geospatial labeling protocols and transferred to SAR imagery through weakly labeled temporally coincident acquisitions. To address SAR-specific artifacts, a shift-invariant loss function is employed to tolerate residual geolocation uncertainty between SAR imagery and optical-derived labels, and a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) is trained on multitemporal SAR composites to suppress speckle while preserving flood-relevant spatial structure. Experiments using UNet and UNet++ architectures demonstrate strong multispectral performance (AUPRC up to 0.956) and statistically significant improvements in SAR flood mapping when using shift-invariant loss and CVAE-based despeckling compared to classical filters. These results underscore the importance of dataset fidelity, misalignment-robust training, and demonstrate the viability of generative despeckling for operational flood mapping.

title: Informational Frustration in Neural Manifolds: Shannon Bottlenecks and the Limits of Learnability
summary: Why overparameterised deep networks generalise so remarkably well remains one of the most stubborn open questions in machine learning theory. Classical frameworks like VC dimension and Rademacher complexity predict catastrophic overfitting in modern models, leaving a massive theoretical gap between theory and reality. In this paper, we bridge this divide by introducing a unified framework that links information theory, topology, and statistical mechanics to map the hard limits of deep learning. Central to our approach is the Entropic Learnability Horizon (ELH): a fundamental law stating that a network can only truly learn a target function if the Shannon entropy of the data manifold outpaces the topological entropy of the function's decision boundary, balanced by the von Neumann entropy of the network's weight space. We establish the Shannon-Topological Bottleneck Theorem, proving that when a target boundary's geometric complexity exceeds this informational horizon, the system undergoes a sudden entropic phase transition. It falls into a state of Informational Frustration - a glassy, rigid memorization phase where generalization becomes thermodynamically impossible. Using this lens, we show that the enigmatic phenomenon of "grokking" is actually an Entropic Release, where weights abruptly reorganise to unlock the bottleneck. Finally, we translate this theory into practice with Entropic Gradient Descent (EGD), an optimization algorithm that dynamically manages weight entropy to keep learning on track. Ultimately, this work repositions entropy not just as a tool for tracking uncertainty but as the fundamental physical currency that dictates whether a machine can learn.

title: 3D Scene-Adaptive Trajectory-Controllable Human Image Animation with Camera Movement
summary: Human image animation, which aims to generate a video of a reference subject following a provided action sequence, has received increasing research interest. With the development of diffusion-based/flow-based video foundation models, existing animation works have began to upgrade the guidance information from 2D skeleton/pose to 3D modeling conditions. Despite achieving reasonable results, these approaches face challenges in synthesizing trajectory-controllable human motion within natural scene under changed camera views. In this work, we present a scene-adaptive human image animation framework that controls both human motion and camera trajectories within a reconstructed 3D environment for video generation. To achieve this, we first develop a ground-adaptive 3D motion retargeting approach to enable user-friendly motion trajectory control adapting to the changes of elevations of ground and orientations automatically. Then we design a viewpoint-adaptive latent fusion mechanism to inject point-cloud geometric priors through scene-visibility masking into the generative process, providing precise guidance of viewpoint changes under camera control. Experiments on two standard human image animation benchmark datasets demonstrate remarkable improvements of our method over the state of the arts in related video generation metics. Project page: https://robinhood256100.github.io/web-disp

AI.title_translation: 具有相机运动的3D场景自适应轨迹可控人像动画
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新框架，通过3D场景感知与运动重定向，实现了在人像动画中对人物轨迹和相机视角的协同精确控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的人像动画方法在处理自然场景下的人体运动轨迹控制以及复杂的相机视角变化时，往往难以保持空间一致性和运动的自然感。
AI.method: 1. 开发了一种地面自适应3D运动重定向方法，实现自动适应地面高度和方向的轨迹控制；2. 设计了一种视点自适应潜在融合机制，通过点云几何先验和场景可见性掩码，实现对相机控制下视点变化的精确引导。
AI.result: 在两个标准人像动画基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在相关视频生成指标上显著优于当前最先进的技术。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的框架成功实现了在3D环境中对人体运动轨迹和相机视角的协同控制，显著提升了人像动画的真实感与空间一致性。
AI.translation: 人像动画旨在根据提供的动作序列生成参考主体视频，目前已受到广泛研究。随着基于扩散/流的视频基础模型的发展，现有的动画工作已开始将引导信息从2D骨架/姿态升级为3D建模条件。尽管取得了一定成果，但这些方法在自然场景下合成可控轨迹的人体运动及处理变化的相机视角时仍面临挑战。本文提出了一种场景自适应人像动画框架，通过在重建的3D环境中控制人体运动和相机轨迹来进行视频生成。为实现这一目标，我们首先开发了一种地面自适应3D运动重定向方法，使用户能够便捷地控制运动轨迹，并自动适应地面高程和方向的变化。随后，我们设计了一种视点自适应潜在融合机制，通过场景可见性掩码将点云几何先验注入生成过程，从而在相机控制下为视点变化提供精确引导。在两个标准人像动画基准数据集上的实验证明，我们的方法在相关视频生成指标上较现有最先进技术有显著提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种场景自适应的人像动画框架，通过在重建的3D环境中集成地面自适应运动重定向和视点自适应潜在融合机制，实现了对人体运动轨迹和相机运动的精确控制。
AI.keywords: 人像动画, 3D场景感知, 轨迹控制, 相机运动, 扩散模型
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将3D场景感知与人体动画相结合，通过地面自适应重定向和视点自适应潜在融合机制，有效解决了复杂场景下人体运动与相机运动的协同控制难题。其局限性在于对3D场景重建的质量有一定依赖，且未详细说明在极端动态背景下的表现。

title: HASTE: A Framework for Training-Free, Dynamic, and Steerable Compression of Pre-Trained Convolutional Neural Networks
comments: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this article is published in Springer Nature Compute Science, and is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/s42979-026-05177-0
summary: Deploying large convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on resource-constrained devices is challenging due to their high computational cost. While dynamic execution methods are promising, existing approaches for CNNs typically require specialized training or fine-tuning, limiting their effectiveness when applied to pre-trained models and requiring data access. To address this gap, we propose HASTE (Hashing for Tractable Efficiency), a plug-and-play convolution module that enables training-free, dynamic compression of large pre-trained CNNs. At inference time, HASTE uses locality-sensitive hashing to identify and merge redundant channels of latent feature maps on a patch-wise basis. This process simultaneously compresses the depth of both input features and their corresponding filters, resulting in computationally cheaper convolutions. We conduct extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet across a range of architectures, demonstrating a 46.2% FLOPs reduction in a ResNet34 on CIFAR-10 with only a 1.25% drop in accuracy, without any retraining. We support our claims by comprehensive ablation studies to validate our core design choices, an analysis of the method's properties and limitations, and a discussion that connects our channel merging scheme to the conceptually related task of token merging in Vision Transformers. Our results demonstrate that HASTE provides an effective solution for steerable compression of pre-trained CNNs at runtime, opening new possibilities for the deployment of efficient deep learning methods.

title: Regime-Aware Peer Specialization for Robust RAG under Heterogeneous Knowledge Conflicts
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language models by grounding generation in external context. However, it can be fragile when the retrieved context conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge. Such conflicts span a reliability spectrum, ranging from reliable and partially reliable evidence to adversarial context. Existing remedies often handle such heterogeneous conflicts with regime-agnostic supervision, which can conflate incompatible learning signals across reliability regimes. To disentangle these signals, we propose RAPS-DA, a regime-aware peer specialization framework that addresses conflict at two complementary granularities. At the sample level, conflicts are divided into three regimes, including Grounding, Arbitration, and Resistance, with one same-scale peer specialist trained per regime from a shared base model. Each sample is then hard-routed to its regime-matched peer for on-policy reverse-KL supervision. At the token level, a dual-layer selector uses inter-teacher disagreement, student-teacher divergence, and student entropy to filter uninformative or unstable tokens, upweight confidently misaligned ones, and gradually focus supervision on high-conflict tokens as the student matures. Gains stem from specialization at a fixed model scale, not from a stronger teacher, and the peer specialists exist only during training, so the deployed student requires no regime labels or peer access. Experiments on five conflict scenarios and two out-of-distribution benchmarks show RAPS-DA surpasses all prompting, decoding, fine-tuning, RL, and single-teacher baselines.

AI.title_translation: 面向异构知识冲突下鲁棒RAG的制度感知同行专业化研究
AI.tldr: 为了解决RAG中的知识冲突问题，研究者提出RAPS-DA框架，通过将样本分类并分配给对应的专家模型进行训练，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升了模型处理冲突的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG模型在处理异构知识冲突时往往采用统一的监督方式，导致不同可靠性等级的冲突信号混淆，从而降低了模型在面对冲突时的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了RAPS-DA框架：在样本层面，将冲突分为“基础”、“仲裁”和“抵抗”三种制度，并训练对应的同行专家模型进行针对性监督；在Token层面，通过双层选择器根据教师不一致性、学生-教师差异及学生熵来筛选和加权冲突Token。
AI.result: 在五个冲突场景和两个分布外基准测试中，RAPS-DA的表现均优于现有的提示工程、解码策略、微调、强化学习及单教师基准方法。
AI.conclusion: RAPS-DA通过制度感知和双层选择机制，成功在固定模型规模下实现了对异构知识冲突的鲁棒处理，显著优于现有的多种基准方法。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过利用外部上下文来增强语言模型，但当检索到的上下文与模型的参数知识冲突时，模型往往表现脆弱。这种冲突存在于一个可靠性谱系中，从可靠和部分可靠的证据到对抗性上下文不等。现有的补救措施通常以对制度不敏感（regime-agnostic）的监督方式处理这些异构冲突，这可能会混淆来自不同可靠性制度的不兼容学习信号。为了解耦这些信号，我们提出了RAPS-DA，一种制度感知的同行专业化框架，从两个互补的粒度解决冲突。在样本层面，冲突被分为三个制度：基础（Grounding）、仲裁（Arbitration）和抵抗（Resistance），并从共享基础模型中为每个制度训练一个相同规模的同行专家。然后，每个样本被硬路由到其匹配的制度同行，进行策略内反向KL监督。在Token层面，双层选择器使用教师间分歧、学生-教师差异和学生熵来过滤无信息或不稳定的Token，上调置信度较高的失准Token，并在学生成熟时逐渐将监督重点放在高冲突Token上。性能提升来源于固定模型规模下的专业化，而非更强的教师模型；且同行专家仅存在于训练阶段，因此部署后的学生模型不需要制度标签或同行访问权限。在五个冲突场景和两个分布外基准上的实验表明，RAPS-DA超越了所有提示工程、解码、微调、强化学习和单教师基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RAPS-DA框架，旨在解决RAG中检索知识与模型参数知识间的异构冲突。通过在训练阶段引入样本级制度感知和Token级冲突选择机制，模型能针对不同可靠性的冲突进行精准学习，从而提升了在复杂冲突下的生成鲁棒性，且推理阶段无需额外结构。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 知识冲突, 模型鲁棒性, 同行专业化, 制度感知
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了“制度感知”（Regime-Aware）的训练框架，通过将冲突分类并利用同等规模的专家模型进行针对性监督，有效解决了RAG中异构知识冲突处理不当的问题。其优势在于训练阶段引入专家，推理阶段无需额外开销，具有很强的实际部署价值。

title: ITSPACE: Monotone Gaussian Optimal Transport Updates
summary: Covariance matrices serve as compact descriptors of feature distributions in many machine-learning pipelines, including domain adaptation and Gaussian embeddings. Under a centered Gaussian approximation, the unregularized Wasserstein-2 optimal-transport (OT) discrepancy admits a closed form on covariances given by the Bures-Wasserstein (BW) objective on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) cone. We propose ITSPACE (Iterative Transport for Stable Proximal Alignment of Covariance Embeddings), a proximal majorization-minimization method that directly optimizes this exact BW objective through closed-form updates in a square-root factorization. In exact arithmetic, each iteration satisfies a sufficient-decrease inequality for the BW objective; under inexact polar computations, we provide an explicit certificate-gap bound controlling deviations from exact descent. The resulting iterations preserve PSD structure by construction and naturally support rank-restricted factors, making ITSPACE well-suited as a lightweight inner-loop primitive in settings where adaptation must be performed from unlabeled target batches under strict step and compute budgets. Across real-world covariance-alignment benchmarks, ITSPACE reaches low-BW-gap solutions substantially faster than BW-gradient descent, methods based on other covariance geometries, and entropically regularized sample-OT baselines.

title: The Illusion of Agentic Complexity in README.md Generation: Evaluating Single-Agent vs. Multi-Agent RAG Systems
comments: The paper has been peer-reviewed and accepted to the 42nd International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly utilized to automate several software engineering tasks, including code completion, code summarization, testing, and the generation of repository-level documentation. While Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) are often adopted to support such tasks under the premise that task decomposition improves performance, the impact of architectural complexity on practical efficiency remains under-examined. This study empirically evaluates Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) dependent architectures for the generation of README files for GitHub repositories. In this work, we conducted a systematic comparison between a Single-Agent pipeline, a specialized MAS, and a developer-guided planning (DevPlan) variant, benchmarked against LARCH -- a state-of-the-art baseline -- and the original ground truth. Results indicate a critical architectural trade-off: the Single-Agent pipeline achieves lexical quality comparable to MAS while reducing token consumption by 86% and operating at twice the speed. In contrast, manual taxonomy analysis demonstrates that MAS achieves high structural consistency (98%), resolving formatting issues observed in single-agent approaches. Autonomous planning is identified as the primary pipeline bottleneck; incorporating lightweight developer-guided plans produces the highest overall documentation quality, surpassing all the analyzed configurations.

AI.title_translation: README.md生成中智能体复杂性的幻觉：单智能体与多智能体RAG系统的评估
AI.tldr: 单智能体系统生成README文档的效率远高于多智能体系统，但引入开发者引导的规划能实现最佳的综合质量。
AI.motivation: 探讨在软件工程自动化任务中，多智能体系统（MAS）通过任务分解提升性能的假设是否真的具备实际的效率优势，以及架构复杂性对生成结果的影响。
AI.method: 通过对比单智能体流水线、专用多智能体系统（MAS）和开发者引导规划（DevPlan）三种架构，并在GitHub仓库README生成任务中与LARCH基准及原始真实数据进行对比评估。
AI.result: 单智能体流水线在保持词汇质量的同时，减少了86%的Token消耗并提升了2倍运行速度；MAS在结构一致性（98%）上表现更佳；引入开发者引导规划（DevPlan）能产生最高质量的文档。
AI.conclusion: README生成任务中，单智能体架构在效率和成本上具有显著优势，而结构质量则依赖于MAS或人工引导的规划。实现高质量文档的最优策略是结合轻量级人工规划与自动化生成。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于自动化软件工程任务，包括代码补全、代码摘要、测试以及仓库级文档生成。尽管人们通常基于任务分解能提升性能的假设而采用多智能体系统（MAS），但架构复杂性对实际效率的影响仍未得到充分审查。本研究实证评估了用于生成GitHub仓库README文件的检索增强生成（RAG）依赖架构。我们对单智能体流水线、专用MAS和开发者引导规划（DevPlan）变体进行了系统比较，并以LARCH（最先进的基准）和原始真实数据作为对照。结果显示了一个关键的架构权衡：单智能体流水线在保持与MAS相当的词汇质量的同时，减少了86%的Token消耗，且运行速度快了一倍。相比之下，人工分类分析表明，MAS实现了极高的结构一致性（98%），解决了单智能体方法中观察到的格式问题。研究发现自主规划是流水线的主要瓶颈；结合轻量级的开发者引导规划产生的文档质量最高，超过了所有其他配置。
AI.summary: 本文研究了针对GitHub仓库自动生成README文件的不同RAG架构。实验发现，单智能体系统在效率上远超MAS，而MAS在结构一致性上更具优势。研究进一步证明，开发者引导的规划（DevPlan）是突破自动化瓶颈、实现最高文档质量的关键。
AI.keywords: README生成, 多智能体系统, 检索增强生成, 软件工程自动化, 架构效率
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了“多智能体系统（MAS）在所有场景下均优于单智能体”的普遍认知。其创新之处在于量化了架构复杂性带来的性能折衷，并指出开发者引导的规划（DevPlan）比纯粹的自动化智能体更有效，这对工程实践具有重要的指导意义。

title: $μ$Flow: Leveraging Average Images for Improving Generalisation of Deepfake Faces Detectors
comments: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Current generative models, including GANs and diffusion models, have reached an outstanding level of photorealism, posing significant risks to privacy and security. To ensure real-world applicability, deepfake detectors must generalise effectively to unseen generators. However, most existing approaches rely on supervised training with both real and fake images, which limits their generalisation especially across generators categories (e.g. GANs vs DMs). In this work, we introduce $μ$Flow, a one-class deepfake detector trained only on real images without relying on pseudo-deepfakes or synthetic artifacts. Our approach builds on the observation that averaging multiple images amplifies consistent generative traces, producing highly discriminative feature representations. We leverage this property by modelling the distribution of features extracted from averaged images and training a normalizing flow to align the feature space of individual images with this distribution. This alignment yields a likelihood-based criterion that separates real and fake samples while promoting strong generalisation. We evaluate $μ$Flow on a fully out-of-distribution setting, where both real and fake datasets are unseen during training. Experimental results show that our method significantly outperforms SOTA detectors. Project page: https://opontorno.github.io/MuFlow.
comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026

AI.title_translation: μFlow：利用平均图像提升深度伪造检测器的泛化能力
AI.tldr: μFlow 是一种无需伪造样本即可训练的深度伪造检测器，通过利用平均图像放大特征痕迹并结合规范化流，实现了卓越的跨生成器泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度伪造检测器大多依赖监督学习，且过度依赖特定的伪造样本，导致跨生成器（如 GAN 到扩散模型）的泛化能力较差。
AI.method: 提出 μFlow 模型，通过对多张图像进行平均处理以放大生成痕迹，并训练一个规范化流（Normalizing Flow）将单个图像的特征空间与平均图像的特征分布进行对齐，从而构建基于似然的检测标准。
AI.result: 在完全分布外（OOD）的测试环境下，μFlow 的表现显著优于现有的最先进（SOTA）检测方法。
AI.conclusion: μFlow 证明了仅通过真实图像训练并利用规范化流建模平均图像特征分布，可以实现高效且具有强泛化能力的深度伪造检测。
AI.translation: 当前的生成模型（包括 GAN 和扩散模型）已经达到了极高的逼真度，对隐私和安全构成了重大风险。为了确保在真实世界中的适用性，深度伪造检测器必须能够有效地泛化到未见过的生成器。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于包含真实和伪造图像的监督训练，这限制了它们的泛化能力，特别是在不同生成器类别（例如 GAN 与扩散模型）之间。在这项工作中，我们引入了 μFlow，这是一种仅在真实图像上训练的单类深度伪造检测器，不依赖于伪造数据或合成伪影。我们的方法基于一个观察结果：对多张图像进行平均处理可以放大一致的生成痕迹，从而产生具有高度判别力的特征表示。我们利用这一特性，对从平均图像中提取的特征分布进行建模，并训练一个规范化流（Normalizing Flow）来将单个图像的特征空间与该分布对齐。这种对齐产生了一个基于似然的准则，可以在区分真实和伪造样本的同时，促进强大的泛化能力。我们在完全分布外（OOD）的设置下评估了 μFlow，其中训练期间未见过真实和伪造的数据集。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的检测器。项目页面：https://opontorno.github.io/MuFlow。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 μFlow 的单类深度伪造检测器，它仅使用真实图像进行训练，无需伪造样本。通过将多张图像平均化以突出生成痕迹，并利用规范化流将单个图像特征与平均图像的特征分布对齐，实现了对未知生成器的高效检测，显著提升了模型的泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 深度伪造检测, 规范化流, 泛化能力, 单类学习, 图像平均化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的单类学习方法，通过利用平均图像放大生成痕迹，不仅减少了对特定伪造数据类型的依赖，还显著提升了跨生成器（GAN与扩散模型）的泛化能力，在检测领域具有重要的应用价值。

title: Computing the Integral R2 Indicator by Perspective Mapping and Box Decomposition
comments: 1 Figure, 1 Table, 22 pages, Python implementation available on Github
summary: The continuous integral R2 indicator is a Pareto-compliant refinement of the classical finite-weight-vector R2 indicator, used in performance assessment, bounded archiving for a-posteriori multi-objective optimization, and skyline selection in databases. This work introduces a bidirectional perspective mapping between continuous integral R2 computation and integration over unions of anchored axis-aligned boxes. After translating the ideal point of a minimization problem to the origin, approximation points become strictly positive loss vectors, and the subgraph of the lower weighted Tchebycheff envelope over the weight simplex maps to the complement of an anchored-box union in reciprocal objective space. The Jacobian gives an absolute R2 formula as a weighted complement volume with density $(x_1+\cdots+x_N)^{-(N+1)}$, while differences of R2 values become finite weighted hypervolume differences. Hence, hypervolume algorithms that emit box decompositions can be reused by replacing ordinary box volumes with closed-form weighted box integrals. For $N$ objectives, this gives an output-sensitive overhead $O(2^N M)$ for an $M$-box decomposition, or $O(M)$ for fixed $N$. Using existing box-decomposition approaches, the integral R2 can be computed in $O(n \log n)$ for $N=2,3$, in $O(n^2)$ for $N=4$, and in $O\left(n^{\lfloor (N-1)/2\rfloor+1}\right)$ for $N\geq4$, with $n$ denoting the size of the approximation set. On the lower-bound side, exact value computation has an $Ω(n\log n)$ lower bound in the algebraic decision-tree model already in two objectives, this bound lifts to every fixed $N\geq2$, and exact computation is $\#P$-hard when $N$ is part of the input. Together, the proposed perspective mapping provides a powerful tool for transferring algorithmic and structural results between anchored-box union and hypervolume theory and integral R2 computation.

title: Entity Binding Failures in Tool-Augmented Agents
summary: Tool-augmented language-model agents are often evaluated by whether they select the correct tool, produce valid API arguments, and complete the requested task. However, an agent may choose the right tool and still act on the wrong external entity. For example, a request to "email Alex about the launch" may lead the agent to contact the wrong Alex, attach the wrong launch document, reply in the wrong thread, or update the wrong customer account. We call these errors entity binding failures. This paper studies entity binding failures as a distinct reliability and safety problem in tool-augmented agents. We formalize the separation between tool correctness and entity correctness, introduce a taxonomy of wrong-entity failures in enterprise workflows, and evaluate entity-aware execution mechanisms including entity-resolution preconditions, confidence-gated binding, clarification under ambiguity, and provenance tracking. In a controlled diagnostic evaluation across 60 tasks, five model backends, and six tool-use methods, all methods achieved 0.0 percent wrong-tool error, yet action-oriented baselines still produced wrong-entity actions in 24.0-26.0 percent of runs. Entity-aware methods eliminated wrong-entity actions and risk-weighted wrong-entity exposure in this setting, but reduced direct task completion by deferring under ambiguity. These findings show that safe tool use requires not only selecting the correct tool, but also reliably binding natural-language references to the correct real-world entity before action.

title: Spandana: Reconciling Strict SLOs with Low Cost under Fine-Grained Load Fluctuations
summary:
Cloud-based online services face significant sub-second load fluctuations while needing to meet strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Cluster operators often over-provision resources to protect SLOs, sacrificing utilization and cost efficiency. Existing reactive and proactive autoscalers, serverless (FaaS) deployments, and VM/FaaS hybrid systems fail to reconcile strict SLO compliance with low cost and high utilization under fine-grained load fluctuation.
  We introduce Spandana, an architecture that addresses this trade off by decoupling SLO enforcement from cost optimization. A lightweight controller colocated with each application VM enforces SLOs by steering each arriving request between the VM and FaaS. Requests that can meet the SLO stay on the VM; the remaining requests are forwarded to a stock FaaS layer such as AWS Lambda. For cost optimization, Spandana's resource allocator determines the most-efficient VM provisioning by accounting for VM cost, FaaS cost, and traffic volatility, allowing the VM pool to run at high utilization. Our evaluation shows that Spandana maintains strict SLO adherence, achieves 76-86% CPU utilization, and reduces cost by 5-44% over three SOTA baselines.

title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
summary: We introduce Orca, an initial instantiation of a general world foundation model. Orca learns a unified world latent space from multimodal world signals and exposes it through multimodal readout interfaces. Rather than optimizing isolated next-token, next-frame, or next-action prediction, we are centered on Next-State-Prediction modeling, offering a unified state-transition modeling route toward understanding, predicting, and acting upon the world. Orca learns through two complementary paradigms: unconscious learning captures dense natural state transitions from continuous videos, and conscious learning models sparse meaningful state transitions by language-described events and VQA supervision. For pre-training, we construct a large-scale world-learning inventory data, including 125K hours of video data and 160M event annotations. After pre-training, Orca learns a unified world latent space. To examine whether the learned latent supports downstream, we evaluate it by three representative downstream readouts: text generation, image prediction, and embodied action generation. Orca's backbone is frozen, and only the lightweight modality-specific decoders are trainable. Experiments show the scalability of the proposed paradigm and verify that stronger world latent enables stronger downstream readouts. Orca outperforms similar-sized specialized baselines. These results show that Orca, as a general world foundation model, presents a promising approach to understanding, predicting, and acting upon the world. Finally, we discuss the current limitations, aiming to provide useful insights and inspiration for the community.

title: Learning from Mistakes: Rollout-Retrieval Lifelong Policy Learning for Autonomous Driving
comments: 15 pages, 6 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/Engibacter/R2LPL
summary: Autonomous driving policies should be able to improve continually as deployment exposes them to increasingly diverse and long-tail traffic situations. However, most learning-based policies are trained or fine-tuned on expert demonstrations and then rely largely on generalization to handle challenging closed-loop scenarios, lacking an explicit mechanism to correct and retain the mistakes exposed in these scenarios. This paper studies autonomous driving policy improvement from a lifelong learning perspective: Can a pretrained policy improve continually by accumulating corrective knowledge derived from its own mistakes, while retaining previously acquired driving competence? To answer this question, we propose Rollout-Retrieval Lifelong Policy Learning (R$^2$LPL), a policy learning framework that retrieves corrective targets from recoverable policy-induced mistakes and retains the resulting knowledge through lifelong policy learning. R^2LPL addresses a key bottleneck in continual policy improvement: closed-loop mistakes reveal where the policy is weak, but do not directly specify what the policy should learn. By filtering recoverable mistake-related states and retrieving feasible corrective targets, R$^2$LPL turns sparse failure evidence into compact supervised knowledge for stable and sample-efficient policy improvement. We evaluate R$^2$LPL on large-scale closed-loop nuPlan benchmarks. With only a few rollout and continual-learning cycles, R$^2$LPL elevates a learning-based planner with moderate initial performance to state-of-the-art performance across the evaluated benchmarks, especially on the challenging and long-tail Test14-hard split. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of R$^2$LPL in converting recoverable closed-loop mistakes into corrective knowledge for sustained policy improvement.
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/Engibacter/R2LPL

title: A Lightweight Post-Quantum Authentication Framework for 5G Base Station Bootstrapping
summary: The absence of authenticated bootstrapping between User Equipments (UEs) and Base Stations (BSs) in 5G leaves System Information Block (SIB) broadcasts unprotected, enabling fake BS attacks, man-in-the-middle interception, and spoofed emergency alerts. Prior efforts such as Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)-based certificate chains, token-based schemes, and identity-based signatures either impose overhead exceeding 5G's strict packet-size constraints or lack post-quantum (PQ) security. Direct NIST-PQC integration is infeasible: ML-DSA requires 34 fragmented SIB1 packets and up to 5,282,ms end-to-end delay, and FN-DSA still requires 13 fragments and up to 1,920,ms. We propose $\emulsion$, a symmetric chained publicly verifiable authentication framework for 5G/6G BS broadcast authentication. EMULSION is the first framework to exploit native 5G architectural features: fixed SIB transmission windows, millisecond-level time synchronization, and eSIM/USIM credential management to achieve genuine PQ security at symmetric-key efficiency. It uses a TESLA-style HMAC chain anchored by a compact PQ signature (MAYO) applied once per epoch, fitting authentication within a single packet with no fragmentation and eliminating certificate transmission entirely. Unlike all prior schemes, EMULSION protects the full SIB family (SIB1-SIB21). Evaluated on a real over-the-air 5G testbed, EMULSION achieves 33x lower end-to-end delay and 31x less communication overhead than ML-DSA, and 12x lower delay and 5.4x less overhead than FN-DSA. We formally prove the security of EMULSION and open-source its implementation for public testing and adaptation.

title: TRACE: Temporal Relationship-Aware Conversational Entrainment Detection in Dyadic Speech
summary: With the proliferation of speech AI agents, understanding emotional entrainment in conversational interaction has become increasingly important. Emotional entrainment is shaped by social relationships and conversational context, influencing affective coordination over time. We introduce DyadEE, a dataset for emotional entrainment detection in dyadic speech interactions, containing both emotionally entrained conversations and synthetic interactions where entrainment is disrupted through partner swapping and emotion resynthesis. We further propose TRACE, a window-level framework that models dyadic interaction as ordered sequences of acoustic embeddings derived from emotion fine-tuned Whisper representations, treating each sample as an interaction trace rather than pooled utterances. Experimental results on DyadEE show that incorporating conversational context and relationship information improves emotional entrainment detection, with TRACE achieving the best accuracy of 97.01%.

title: Latent Actions from Factorized Transition Effects under Agent Ambiguity
comments: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop on Compositional Learning. Project Page: https://hazel-heejeong-nam.github.io/LAM/
summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn action-like proxies from observation transitions. However, in multi-object or distractor-rich scenes, these visual effects mix agent motion with distractors, camera dynamics, and background changes, making the underlying action source ambiguous without supervision. Structuring this mixture as reusable transition effects provides an intermediate representation from which action-like latents can be more robustly formed. We introduce Observed Transition Factorization (OTF), which decomposes each transition into a sparse set of observed transition primitives. Using these primitives as the transition interface, we propose OTF-LAM, which abstracts motion primitives into action-like latents within the standard inverse-forward dynamics framework, and OTF-LAM-Dino, a decoder-free variant that predicts future states in a frozen DINOv2 representation space. Empirically, OTF primitives transfer zeroshot across controlled carrier and morphology shifts, showing reusability. Furthermore, downstream policy learning results match or outperform baselines under complex transition ambiguity.

title: StereoGS: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Stereo Priors
comments: 15 pages, 6 figures, accepted to ECCV 2026, project page: https://stringerywh00.github.io/StereoGS_project_page/
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has achieved remarkable success in real-time novel view synthesis, yet it suffers from severe overfitting under sparse-view settings due to insufficient geometric constraints. While recent methods introduce monocular depth priors to mitigate this, they inherently struggle with scale ambiguity and cross-view inconsistency, leading to defective geometry. In this paper, we propose StereoGS, a novel sparse-view 3DGS framework that integrates stereo priors to establish reliable binocular consistency. Unlike scale-agnostic monocular constraints, StereoGS introduces a Stereo Depth Regularization by constructing virtual stereo pairs during optimization and leveraging a foundation stereo model to enforce absolute scale and binocular-consistent structures. To further suppress overfitting and eliminate redundant primitives, we design a Gradient-Aware Opacity Decay strategy that dynamically penalizes Gaussians based on their relative opacity gradient magnitudes. Combined with a Consistency-Aware Dense Initialization using zero-shot multi-view depth estimation, StereoGS effectively anchors primitives to accurate scene surfaces. Extensive experiments on LLFF, DTU, Mip-NeRF360, and Blender datasets demonstrate that StereoGS achieves state-of-the-art performance in sparse-view settings without incurring any additional inference overhead. Project Page: https://stringerywh00.github.io/StereoGS_project_page/

title: MAS-Lab: A Specification-Driven Validation Framework for Reliable Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
The rapid emergence of LLM-based agentic frameworks has significantly reduced the cost of assembling multi-agent systems (MAS), enabling fast prototyping and exploration of agentic behaviors. However, systems built with current tooling remain ill-suited for reliable, evolvable, and production-grade deployment. In practice, MAS are often developed in an ad-hoc and imperative manner, with agent logic, orchestration, observability, and control tightly interwoven, little to no explicit system-level validation, and development workflows optimized for demonstrations rather than long-lived, governed operation. As a result, behavior observed during experimentation rarely constitutes reliable evidence of behavior in production.
  In this paper, we introduce MAS-Lab, a specification-driven framework for principled development and experimental validation of multi-agent systems properties. MAS-Lab is designed to transform MAS from collections of scripts into engineered distributed systems by separating semantic intent from operational concerns, making behavior and control explicit, supporting reproducible experimentation, and preserving continuity across lifecycle stages. MAS-Lab consists of three layers: a declarative, framework-agnostic agentic specification layer (Spec); a stateful MAS Operating System that provides execution and control primitives plugged-in by design (MAS-OS); and a set of lab overlays with integrated observability and evaluation tools (Labs). Together, these components enable intent-based validation, principled system evolution, and a seamless transition to production-grade MAS.

title: Teaching Prompt-Based Programming with LLMs: A 45-Minute Lesson with Guided Practice for End-User Programmers
summary: Prompt-based programming, a new modality enabled by large language models (LLMs), allows users to express computational goals through natural language rather than traditional code. While this approach lowers barriers to entry, especially for non-CS learners, it does not eliminate the need for foundational CS skills. Learners often struggle to communicate their intent clearly to LLMs, resulting in vague or underspecified prompts. Prior work has documented the need for explicit prompting for both CS and non-CS learners. However, it remains less clear how such instruction can fit into busy classrooms or how much time is needed to produce meaningful gains. In this paper, we evaluated a 45-minute prompt-based programming intervention, consisting of a lesson with guided practice, against a business-as-usual CS lab activity (code tracing) of equal length, representing a class without prompt-focused instruction. We conducted a randomized controlled study with 55 engineering students. We found that students in the experimental condition improved more on average (though not significantly more) from pre- to post-test than the control group (+10.8 vs +1.1 percentage points) and showed significantly greater average gains in prompting self-efficacy (+35.4 vs +21.9 percentage points). Our results suggest it is likely that a brief intervention can improve learners' ability to specify computational goals to LLMs. However, the effect was modest, suggesting that prompting skills may require more time and practice to develop. We provide a lightweight lesson that requires no prior CS background and can be readily dropped into existing courses.

title: To Tab or Not to Tab: Measuring Critical Engagement in AI Code Completion Tools Using Behavioral Signals and Attention Checks
comments: 7 pages. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 31st ACM Conference on Innovation and Technology in Computer Science Education (ITiCSE 2026), Madrid, Spain, July 10-15, 2026. Author's accepted manuscript
summary: AI code completion tools, such as Github Copilot, provide students with code suggestions to help them write programs. However, recent qualitative studies suggest that students fail to critically evaluate these suggestions. We present Clover, a code completion tool that logs students' interactions with code suggestions and additionally offers attention checks to probe reflective engagement during programming tasks. We also develop a taxonomy of behavioral interaction metrics for AI-assisted programming, informed by literature. We analyzed relationships between interaction patterns, engagement with attention checks, and task performance. We observed that higher rates of tab accept were associated with lower attention check performance, while increased dwell time was associated with higher attention check performance. We conclude by discussing how programming process data and attention checks might support reflective engagement in AI-assisted programming.

AI.title_translation: Tab还是不Tab：利用行为信号和注意力检查衡量AI代码补全工具中的批判性参与度
AI.tldr: 本研究开发了Clover工具，通过记录交互行为和引入注意力检查，发现频繁直接接受AI代码建议与低注意力相关，而增加停留时间则与高注意力相关，从而为衡量和支持AI辅助编程中的批判性思考提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI代码补全工具（如GitHub Copilot）能为学生提供代码建议，但定性研究表明，学生在实际使用中往往缺乏对这些AI生成建议的批判性评估。因此，需要有效的方法来衡量和促进学生在AI辅助编程中的反思性参与。
AI.method:
1. 开发了名为Clover的代码补全工具，该工具可记录学生与代码建议的交互，并提供注意力检查以探测其反思性参与；
2. 基于相关文献，构建了AI辅助编程的行为交互指标分类法；
3. 分析并评估了学生的交互模式、注意力检查参与度以及任务表现之间的关联性。
AI.result: 研究发现，较高的Tab键接受率（即快速接受AI建议）与较低的注意力检查表现相关；而较长的停留时间（dwell time）则与较高的注意力检查表现相关。
AI.conclusion: 编程过程数据（如交互日志）和主动的注意力检查机制，能够有效地衡量并支持学生在AI辅助编程过程中的反思性参与。
AI.translation: AI代码补全工具（如GitHub Copilot）为学生提供代码建议，以帮助他们编写程序。然而，最近的定性研究表明，学生未能对这些建议进行批判性评估。我们展示了Clover，这是一种代码补全工具，它能够记录学生与代码建议的交互，并额外提供注意力检查，以在编程任务中探查反思性参与。我们还结合文献开发了AI辅助编程的行为交互指标分类法。我们分析了交互模式、注意力检查参与度与任务表现之间的关系。我们观察到，较高的Tab键接受率与较低的注意力检查表现相关，而增加的停留时间与较高的注意力检查表现相关。最后，我们讨论了编程过程数据和注意力检查如何支持AI辅助编程中的反思性参与。
AI.summary: 本文针对学生在使用AI代码补全工具时缺乏批判性评估的问题，设计并开发了Clover工具。该工具不仅能记录学生与AI代码建议的交互行为，还引入了注意力检查机制来评估其反思性参与度。通过构建行为交互指标分类法并分析数据，研究揭示了“快速接受建议”与低注意力、以及“增加停留时间”与高注意力之间的关联，为未来利用过程数据促进反思性AI辅助编程提供了研究基础。
AI.keywords: AI代码补全, 批判性参与, 注意力检查, 行为信号, AI辅助编程
AI.comments:
创新性：该研究不仅被动记录用户的交互行为，还创新性地引入了“注意力检查”（attention checks）来主动探测和评估用户的反思性参与度，并构建了AI辅助编程的行为指标分类法。
重要性：随着AI代码生成工具（如GitHub Copilot）在编程教育中的普及，如何防止学生盲目接受AI代码、培养其批判性思维和评估能力是当前教育界亟待解决的关键问题。
局限性：仅根据摘要，未提及具体的实验样本量、目标学生群体（如初学者还是高年级学生）以及该工具在真实教学环境中的长期演变效果。

title: SIGMA: Saliency-Guided Sparse Mask Attacks for Speech Emotion Recognition
summary: Speech conveys rich emotional information. As Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is usually deployed in privacy-sensitive and reliability-critical environments, adversarial attacks on SER have attracted increasing attention. Existing sparse attacks control the number of perturbed elements, yet, they often lack explainability guidance and explicit measures of explanation consistency. A unified treatment of sparsity and magnitude constraints is also uncommon. In addition, transferability across attack families and target models remains limited. Hence, we propose a SalIency-Guided sparse Mask Attack (SIGMA). On self-supervised speech features, we use post-hoc explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to produce saliency maps and identify the scope of the mask, and then restrict magnitude-bounded updates to this mask. The mask is computed once and can be reused across models and different sparsity attacks to amortise cost. We evaluate on the IEMOCAP and TESS datasets. Under matched budgets and across multiple sparse-attack settings, SIGMA maintains competitive attack success rates, navigating a conscious trade-off between attack efficacy and explanation consistency. SIGMA therefore provides an efficient and interpretable framework for analysing the vulnerability and explanation behaviour of SER models under structured perturbations.

AI.title_translation: SIGMA：针对语音情感识别的显著性引导稀疏掩码攻击
AI.tldr: 本文提出SIGMA，一种结合可解释AI技术的显著性引导稀疏掩码攻击方法，在保持高攻击成功率的同时，提升了语音情感识别模型在对抗扰动下的解释一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的针对语音情感识别（SER）的稀疏对抗攻击缺乏可解释性指导和解释一致性的显式度量，且通常缺乏对稀疏性和幅度约束的统一处理，此外，在不同攻击族和目标模型之间的迁移性也较为有限。
AI.method: 提出SIGMA（显著性引导稀疏掩码攻击）。该方法在自监督语音特征上，利用事后可解释人工智能（XAI）技术生成显著性图并确定掩码范围，随后将幅度受限的更新限制在该掩码内。该掩码计算一次后即可跨模型和不同稀疏攻击复用，以降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP和TESS数据集上的评估表明，在匹配的预算和多种稀疏攻击设置下，SIGMA保持了具有竞争力的攻击成功率，并在攻击效果与解释一致性之间取得了合理的权衡。
AI.conclusion: SIGMA为分析语音情感识别（SER）模型在结构化扰动下的脆弱性和解释行为，提供了一个高效且可解释的框架。
AI.translation: 语音传达了丰富的显式情感信息。由于语音情感识别（SER）通常部署在隐私敏感和对可靠性要求极高的环境中，针对SER的对抗性攻击引起了越来越多的关注。现有的稀疏攻击控制了受扰动元素的数量，但它们往往缺乏可解释性指导以及对解释一致性的显式度量。对稀疏性和幅度约束的统一处理也并不常见。此外，跨攻击家族和目标模型的迁移性仍然有限。因此，我们提出了一种显著性引导的稀疏掩码攻击（SIGMA）。在自监督语音特征上，我们使用事后可解释人工智能（XAI）技术来生成显著性图并确定掩码的范围，然后将幅度受限的更新限制在该掩码内。该掩码只需计算一次，并且可以跨模型和不同的稀疏攻击进行复用，从而分摊成本。我们在IEMOCAP和TESS数据集上进行了评估。在匹配的预算和多种稀疏攻击设置下，SIGMA保持了具有竞争力的攻击成功率，在攻击效果和解释一致性之间进行了有意识的权衡。因此，SIGMA为分析结构化扰动下SER模型的脆弱性和解释行为提供了一个高效且可解释的框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SIGMA的显著性引导稀疏掩码攻击方法，用于评估语音情感识别（SER）模型的脆弱性。该方法利用事后可解释AI技术生成显著性图并确定掩码范围，从而将扰动限制在特定区域。实验表明，SIGMA在保持高攻击成功率的同时，有效兼顾了攻击效果与解释一致性，且具有良好的跨模型复用性。
AI.keywords: 语音情感识别, 对抗攻击, 可解释人工智能, 稀疏掩码, 显著性图
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将可解释性AI（XAI）技术与对抗攻击相结合，利用显著性图引导掩码生成，实现了稀疏性与幅度约束的统一，并在攻击成功率和解释一致性之间找到了平衡。其限制可能在于对事后XAI技术生成的显著性图质量有较强的依赖。

title: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision
summary: Cross-embodiment transfer in vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging because low-level state and action spaces differ fundamentally across robot platforms. We observe that the high-level cognitive process underlying manipulation, including scene perception, object identification, task planning, and sub-task decomposition, is largely shared across embodiments. Based on this observation, we present ZR-0, a 2.6 billion parameter end-to-end VLA model that uses dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) supervision to align cross-embodiment representations within the vision-language model (VLM). ZR-0 adopts a dual-stream architecture: a pre-trained VLM (System 2) generates structured ECoT reasoning during training, while a Diffusion Transformer-based action expert (System 1) produces continuous action chunks via flow matching. The two components are coupled through cross-attention, with an attention mask that restricts the action expert to input prompt features only, enabling ECoT generation to be entirely skipped at inference without any performance loss. ZR-0 is pre-trained on ProcCorpus-60M, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 60 million frames (approximately 1,000 hours) from over 400K trajectories, with dense ECoT annotations covering 96.8% of all frames. We evaluate ZR-0 on three simulation benchmarks spanning single-arm (LIBERO), bimanual (RoboTwin 2.0), and humanoid (RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop) embodiments, as well as real-world experiments on the xArm platform, demonstrating strong performance across all settings. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/ZR-0.

AI.title_translation: 通过密集具身思维链监督训练视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出ZR-0模型，通过双流架构和密集具身思维链（ECoT）监督对齐跨机器人具身表征，实现了训练时进行深度推理、推理时可跳过思维链以零性能损失高效控制机器人的目标。
AI.motivation: 由于不同机器人平台的底层状态和动作空间存在根本差异，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的跨具身转移（cross-embodiment transfer）极具挑战。然而，操控任务背后高层认知过程（如场景感知、物体识别、任务规划和子任务分解）在不同具身之间是高度共享的。作者旨在利用这种共享的高层认知过程来对齐跨具身表示。
AI.method:
提出ZR-0模型，采用双流架构：
1. 系统2（预训练VLM）：在训练期间生成结构化的具身思维链（ECoT）推理。
2. 系统1（基于Diffusion Transformer的动作专家）：通过流匹配（flow matching）产生连续的动作块。
3. 耦合机制：两者通过交叉注意力耦合，利用注意力掩码限制动作专家仅能输入提示词特征，从而允许在推理时完全跳过ECoT的生成。
4. 预训练：在包含6000万帧、96.8%覆盖Dense ECoT标注的大规模数据集ProcCorpus-60M上进行预训练。
AI.result: ZR-0在三种模拟基准测试（涵盖单臂LIBERO、双臂RoboTwin 2.0和人形RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop具身）以及xArm平台上的真实世界实验中均取得了强大的性能，同时在推理时无需生成ECoT即可保持无损的性能。
AI.conclusion: ZR-0证明了通过密集的具身思维链（ECoT）监督可以有效解决跨机器人平台的具身表征对齐问题，且双流架构设计成功实现了“训练时有推理、推理时无延迟”的高效部署，为多具身VLA模型的发展提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 跨具身转移在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中仍然具有挑战性，因为不同机器人平台的底层状态和动作空间存在根本差异。我们观察到，操纵背后的高级认知过程（包括场景感知、物体识别、任务规划和子任务分解）在很大程度上是跨具身共享的。基于这一观察，我们提出了 ZR-0，一个拥有 26 亿参数的端到端 VLA 模型，该模型利用密集的具身思维链（ECoT）监督来对齐视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的跨具身表示。ZR-0 采用双流架构：预训练的 VLM（系统 2）在训练期间生成结构化的 ECoT 推理，而基于 Diffusion Transformer 的动作专家（系统 1）则通过流匹配产生连续的动作块。这两个组件通过交叉注意力进行耦合，并配有一个注意力掩码，该掩码限制动作专家仅输入提示特征，从而使推理阶段能够完全跳过 ECoT 生成而不会产生任何性能损失。ZR-0 在 ProcCorpus-60M 上进行了预训练，这是一个包含来自超过 40 万条轨迹的约 6000 万帧（约 1000 小时）的大规模数据集，其中密集 ECoT 注释覆盖了 96.8% 的帧。我们在涵盖单臂（LIBERO）、双臂（RoboTwin 2.0）和人形（RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop）具身的三种模拟基准以及 xArm 平台上的真实世界实验中评估了 ZR-0，在所有设置中均展示了强大的性能。代码和模型权重可在 https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/ZR-0 获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ZR-0，一个26亿参数的端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。该模型通过密集的具身思维链（ECoT）监督来对齐跨具身表示。ZR-0采用双流架构，将负责高层思维链推理的VLM（系统2）与负责生成连续动作的Diffusion Transformer动作专家（系统1）相结合。通过特殊的注意力掩码设计，ZR-0在推理时可以完全跳过思维链生成而不损失任何性能。实验表明其在多个仿真和真实机器人任务中表现优异。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA), 具身思维链 (ECoT), 跨具身转移, 双流架构, 机器人操纵
AI.comments:
创新点：1. 提出密集具身思维链（ECoT）监督，利用不同机器人平台间共享的高层认知过程（如场景感知、任务规划）来对齐跨具身表征。2. 巧妙设计了双流架构（系统1与系统2），通过注意力掩码使得在推理时可以完全跳过思维链生成，解决了传统CoT在实时机器人控制中推理延迟高的痛点。
局限性：摘要中未提及该方法在面对未见过的全新机器人具身或极其复杂的动态环境时的具体泛化边界，且依赖于大规模的ProcCorpus-60M预训练数据集。

title: COSM: A Cooperative Scheduling Framework for Concurrent PIM and CPU Execution on Mobile Devices
summary: The development of on-device large language models (LLMs) is driven by the need for privacy and fast response times. Energy-intensive data transfer on mobile devices makes Processing-in-Memory (PIM) an effective solution. Due to stringent DRAM cost constraints, limited physical footprint on circuit boards, and the interaction between applications and LLMs, it is imperative for the CPU and PIM to operate concurrently within a shared memory space. However, challenges such as bank conflicts and bus congestion can arise, potentially diminishing the performance and energy benefits of PIM. To address this challenge, we introduce COSM, a cooperative scheduling framework designed to facilitate the concurrent operation of PIM and CPU tasks on mobile platforms. Our key innovations include: 1) a low-interference PIM control interface that generates the maximum number of PIM commands without disrupting CPU memory accesses; 2) an idleness-aware scheduling method that integrates PIM commands into available idle time windows within the CPU's access sequence. COSM not only hides PIM execution latency from the CPU, but also overlaps PIM execution with data transfer. Experiments on concurrent execution of LLMs and mobile workloads, including mobile applications and compute-intensive kernels, demonstrate that COSM improves PIM throughput by up to 2.8x compared to the baseline scheduling method with less than 2.0% CPU performance loss.

AI.title_translation: COSM：移动设备上并发PIM与CPU执行的协同调度框架
AI.tldr: COSM是一个针对移动设备的协同调度框架，通过低干扰控制和空闲感知调度，解决了CPU与PIM并发运行时的共享内存冲突问题，在CPU性能损失低于2%的情况下，将PIM吞吐量提升了高达2.8倍。
AI.motivation: 在移动设备上部署端侧大语言模型（LLM）时，由于DRAM成本、物理空间限制以及应用与LLM的交互需求，CPU和PIM（内存中处理）必须在共享内存空间中并发运行。然而，这种并发运行会导致银行冲突（bank conflicts）和总线拥堵，从而降低PIM的性能和能效优势。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为COSM的协同调度框架。其核心创新包括：1）低干扰PIM控制接口，在不干扰CPU内存访问的情况下产生最大数量的PIM指令；2）空闲感知调度方法，将PIM指令整合到CPU访问序列的可用空闲时间窗口中，从而隐藏PIM的执行延迟并重叠数据传输。
AI.result: 在并发执行LLM和移动工作负载（包括移动应用和计算密集型内核）的实验中，与基线调度方法相比，COSM在CPU性能损失低于2.0%的前提下，将PIM吞吐量提高了高达2.8倍。
AI.conclusion: COSM框架成功地向CPU隐藏了PIM的执行延迟，并将PIM执行与数据传输重叠，证明了在严格的资源和成本约束下，移动设备上并发CPU和PIM运行是高度可行且高效的。
AI.translation: 由于对隐私保护和快速响应时间的需求，推动了设备端大语言模型（LLMs）的发展。移动设备上高能耗的数据传输使得内存中处理（PIM）成为一种有效的解决方案。由于严格的DRAM成本限制、电路板上有限的物理空间以及应用程序与LLM之间的交互，CPU和PIM必须在共享内存空间中并发运行。然而，这可能会引发银行冲突和总线拥堵等挑战，从而削弱PIM的性能和节能优势。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了COSM，这是一个旨在促进移动平台上PIM和CPU任务并发运行的协同调度框架。我们的核心创新包括：1）低干扰PIM控制接口，在不干扰CPU内存访问的前提下生成最大数量的PIM指令；2）空闲感知调度方法，将PIM指令集成到CPU访问序列的可用空闲时间窗口中。COSM不仅向CPU隐藏了PIM的执行延迟，还将PIM执行与数据传输进行了重叠。在并发执行LLM和移动工作负载（包括移动应用和计算密集型内核）的实验中，结果表明，与基线调度方法相比，COSM在CPU性能损失低于2.0%的情况下，将PIM吞吐量提高了高达2.8倍。
AI.summary: 本文针对移动设备上CPU与PIM（内存中处理）并发共享内存时出现的冲突与拥堵问题，提出了COSM协同调度框架。该框架通过低干扰控制接口和空闲感知调度方法，将PIM指令无缝融入CPU访存的空闲窗口中。实验表明，COSM在几乎不影响CPU性能（损失<2%）的情况下，将PIM吞吐量提升了高达2.8倍，有效解决了移动端混合工作负载下的内存访问冲突。
AI.keywords: 内存中处理 (PIM), 协同调度, 移动设备, 共享内存, 大语言模型 (LLM)
AI.comments: 该论文针对移动端部署大模型（LLM）所面临的CPU与PIM（内存中处理）共享内存冲突问题，提出了非常具有针对性的协同调度方案。其创新之处在于巧妙地利用CPU访存序列中的空闲窗口来插入PIM指令，并在不打扰CPU正常访存的前提下最大化PIM指令生成。这种设计不仅在理论上合理，而且在实验中实现了极高的吞吐量提升和极低的CPU性能损耗，对于未来移动端高能效AI加速技术具有重要的参考价值。

title: SubEdge: A Subscriber-Centric Edge Computing Subsystem in 6G Networks for AI
summary: Beyond traditional connectivity, 6G is envisioned to transform mobile networks into a distributed fabric that provides native integrated communication, computing, and intelligence services. AI-native terminals (e.g., robots, autonomous vehicles, and smart glasses) require real-time inference from individualised, manufacturer-specific models that cannot be executed on-board nor shared across subscribers, making per-subscriber edge compute the necessary complement to per-subscriber connectivity. Existing Network for AI (Net4AI) architectures provision compute for application providers through shared deployments and do not address per-subscriber provisioning. This paper proposes SubEdge, a Net4AI subsystem that provisions integrated communication and compute resources on a per-subscriber basis, ensuring the coupled migration of both dimensions to maintain service continuity during mobility. SubEdge contributes the computing context--a per-subscriber data structure binding a Subscription Permanent Identifier (SUPI) to its inference container, edge node, and service entitlement--and a mobility-event-driven mechanism that simultaneously migrates the subscriber's compute instance and its traffic-routing policy when the serving cell changes. SubEdge operates as an Application Function over existing Network Exposure Function (NEF) APIs with zero 3GPP core modifications. Experimental evaluation on a real-world testbed shows that SubEdge's mobility-driven joint communication-and-compute migration reduces 95th-percentile latency from 22.9 ms to 12.2 ms with zero packet loss across six mobility events, sustains 99.92% frame delivery for an end-to-end 30 fps inference workload, and completes 1,560 migration operations across batches of up to 50 simultaneously migrating subscribers with 100% success.

AI.title_translation: SubEdge：6G网络中面向AI的以用户为中心的边缘计算子系统
AI.tldr: SubEdge是6G网络中一个以用户为中心的边缘计算子系统，它为AI提供按用户集成的通信和计算资源，并在移动性期间实现通信和计算的耦合迁移，从而降低延迟并确保服务连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有面向AI的网络（Net4AI）架构通过共享部署为应用提供商提供计算资源，但未能解决按用户（per-subscriber）的资源配置问题。AI原生终端（如机器人、自动驾驶汽车和智能眼镜）需要来自个性化、特定制造商模型的实时推理，这些模型无法在板载设备上执行，也无法在用户之间共享，因此按用户的边缘计算是按用户连接的必要补充。
AI.method: 本文提出了SubEdge，一个Net4AI子系统，它以按用户为基础提供集成的通信和计算资源，确保在移动性期间两个维度的耦合迁移以维持服务连续性。SubEdge贡献了计算上下文（一种将订阅永久标识符SUPI绑定到其推理容器、边缘节点和服务权益的按用户数据结构）和一个由移动事件驱动的机制，该机制在服务小区改变时同时迁移用户的计算实例及其流量路由策略。SubEdge作为应用功能通过现有网络开放功能（NEF）API运行，无需修改3GPP核心网。
AI.result: 在真实测试床上的实验评估表明，SubEdge的移动驱动的通信与计算联合迁移将95%分位延迟从22.9毫秒降低到12.2毫秒，在六个移动事件中零丢包；为端到端30帧/秒的推理工作负载维持99.92%的帧交付；并成功完成1,560次迁移操作，批次最多包含50个同时迁移的用户，成功率为100%。
AI.conclusion: SubEdge通过提供以用户为中心的边缘计算子系统，实现了6G网络中AI原生终端所需的个性化、实时的AI推理服务。它通过耦合的通信和计算迁移机制，在用户移动时显著降低了延迟并保证了服务连续性和高成功率。
AI.translation: 超越传统连接，6G被设想将移动网络转变为一个分布式架构，提供原生的集成通信、计算和智能服务。AI原生终端（例如机器人、自动驾驶汽车和智能眼镜）需要来自个性化、特定制造商模型的实时推理，这些模型无法在板载设备上执行，也无法在用户之间共享，因此按用户的边缘计算是按用户连接的必要补充。现有面向AI的网络（Net4AI）架构通过共享部署为应用提供商提供计算资源，但未能解决按用户的资源配置问题。本文提出了SubEdge，一个Net4AI子系统，它以按用户为基础提供集成的通信和计算资源，确保在移动性期间两个维度的耦合迁移以维持服务连续性。SubEdge贡献了计算上下文——一种将订阅永久标识符（SUPI）绑定到其推理容器、边缘节点和服务权益的按用户数据结构——以及一个由移动事件驱动的机制，该机制在服务小区改变时同时迁移用户的计算实例及其流量路由策略。SubEdge作为应用功能通过现有网络开放功能（NEF）API运行，无需修改3GPP核心网。在真实测试床上的实验评估表明，SubEdge的移动驱动的通信与计算联合迁移将95%分位延迟从22.9毫秒降低到12.2毫秒，在六个移动事件中零丢包；为端到端30帧/秒的推理工作负载维持99.92%的帧交付；并成功完成1,560次迁移操作，批次最多包含50个同时迁移的用户，成功率为100%。
AI.summary: 本文提出SubEdge，一个6G网络中以用户为中心的边缘计算子系统，旨在为AI原生终端提供按用户集成的通信和计算资源。它通过引入计算上下文和移动事件驱动的联合迁移机制，确保用户在移动过程中AI推理服务的连续性。实验证明，SubEdge能显著降低延迟、保证高帧交付率和迁移成功率，且无需修改3GPP核心网。
AI.keywords: 6G网络, 边缘计算, AI, 用户中心, 移动性管理
AI.comments: SubEdge的创新点在于其以用户为中心的资源配置和通信与计算的耦合迁移机制，这对于6G网络中AI原生终端的个性化实时推理服务至关重要。它通过利用现有NEF API实现，避免了对3GPP核心网的修改，显示出良好的实用性和部署潜力。这项工作解决了现有Net4AI架构在按用户服务提供方面的不足，对于未来AI与移动网络的深度融合具有重要意义。

title: Linguistic Firewall: Geometry as Defense in Multi-Agent Systems Routing
comments: 8 pages (9 more for appendix), 3 figures. Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
summary: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven the evolution of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), where specialized agents collaborate to execute complex workflows. Effective orchestration in these environments requires robust routing mechanisms to efficiently allocate tasks to the most suitable agent. However, existing routers fundamentally rely on unverified proxies, ranging from textual self-descriptions to static surrogate representations, to gauge an agent's competence. This reliance on non-empirical data creates a critical gap between an agent's projected profile and its actual operational capabilities, introducing severe security vulnerabilities. Malicious agents can easily misrepresent their proficiencies or harbor covert backdoors that evade both standard external analysis and static representation-learning techniques. In this work, we introduce ANTAP (Automatic Non-Textual Agent Picker), an evaluation-driven routing architecture that discards indirect proxies in favor of active capability testing. By dynamically querying agents to ascertain their true competencies empirically, ANTAP distills performance into fixed behavioral operators within a shared semantic space. At inference time, routing is performed via a purely non-textual algebraic projection, establishing a "linguistic firewall" that renders metadata-based attacks inexpressible. In our experiments, ANTAP achieves near-zero ASR against description-based injection attacks, compared to 67.3\% and above for the description-based router baseline. Against adaptive embedding attacks, ANTAP achieves substantially lower ASR than the embedding-based baseline, with a 20\% reduction, while remaining resilient to description manipulation by design.

AI.title_translation: 语言防火墙：几何作为多智能体系统路由中的防御
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ANTAP，一种基于评估驱动的多智能体系统路由架构，通过动态能力测试和非文本代数投影建立“语言防火墙”，有效防御针对路由机制的元数据欺骗和注入攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体系统（MAS）路由机制依赖于未经证实的代理（如文本自我描述或静态表示）来评估智能体能力。这种对非经验数据的依赖导致智能体的虚假画像与实际能力之间存在严重差距，从而引入了安全漏洞，使恶意智能体可以通过伪造描述或潜伏后门来逃避检测并操纵路由。
AI.method: 提出ANTAP（自动非文本智能体选择器）。该架构摒弃了间接代理，采用主动能力测试。通过动态查询智能体以凭经验确定其真实能力，并将性能提炼为共享语义空间内的固定行为算子。在推理时，通过纯非文本的代数投影进行路由，从而建立起“语言防火墙”。
AI.result: 在实验中，面对基于描述的注入攻击，ANTAP实现了接近于零的攻击成功率（ASR），而基于描述的基线路由器的ASR在67.3%以上；面对自适应嵌入攻击，ANTAP的ASR比基于嵌入的基线降低了20%，同时在设计上对描述操纵具有天然的免疫力。
AI.conclusion: ANTAP通过将路由机制从依赖文本元数据转向基于经验评估和几何投影，成功构建了“语言防火墙”，显著提高了多智能体系统在面对欺骗和注入攻击时的鲁棒性与安全性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速融合推动了多智能体系统（MAS）的演进，在这些系统中，专业化的智能体相互协作以执行复杂的 workflow。在这些环境中，有效的编排需要强大的路由机制，以便将任务高效地分配给最合适的智能体。然而，现有的路由器从根本上依赖于未经验证的代理（从文本自我描述到静态代理表示）来衡量智能体的能力。这种对非经验数据的依赖在智能体的预测画像与其真实操作能力之间造成了关键差距，从而引入了严重的安全漏洞。恶意智能体可以轻松地伪造其专业能力，或隐藏避开标准外部分析和静态表示学习技术的暗门。在这项工作中，我们引入了 ANTAP（自动非文本智能体选择器），这是一种评估驱动的路由架构，它摒弃了间接代理，转而采用主动能力测试。通过动态查询智能体以凭经验确定其真实能力，ANTAP 将性能提炼为共享语义空间内的固定行为算子。在推理时，路由通过纯非文本的代数投影进行，从而建立了一个“语言防火墙”，使基于元数据的攻击无法表达。在我们的实验中，针对基于描述的注入攻击，ANTAP 实现了接近于零的攻击成功率（ASR），而基于描述的基线路由器则达到 67.3% 及以上。面对自适应嵌入攻击，ANTAP 的 ASR 显著低于基于嵌入的基线（降低了 20%），同时在设计上对描述操纵保持了弹性。
AI.summary: 本文针对多智能体系统（MAS）中现有路由机制易受恶意智能体虚假描述和后门攻击的安全漏洞，提出了一种名为 ANTAP 的评估驱动型路由架构。ANTAP 通过主动且动态地查询智能体来测试其真实能力，并将其行为提炼为共享语义空间中的几何代数投影。这种非文本的路由方式构建了“语言防火墙”，使元数据攻击失效。实验表明，ANTAP 在对抗描述注入攻击和自适应嵌入攻击时均表现出极高的防御性能和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 路由机制, 语言防火墙, 代数投影, 安全防御
AI.comments: 该论文切中了当前多智能体系统（MAS）协作中一个非常关键且常被忽视的安全痛点——路由器的欺骗与注入攻击问题。其创新之处在于摒弃了传统的文本描述或静态嵌入，转而使用动态“主动测试”和几何代数投影（即非文本方式）来构建防御边界（语言防火墙）。这种将安全防御与几何投影结合的思路非常新颖，实验结果也证明了其在对抗注入攻击方面的强大威力。不过，动态测试可能会带来额外的推理延迟和计算开销，这在实际超大规模多智能体部署中可能是一个潜在的局限。

title: Poller: Are LLMs Suitable for Evaluating the Poetry Understanding Task?
summary: Traditional automatic evaluation methods have been shown to be unsuitable for modern Chinese poetry because of the distinct nature of this literary genre. Human evaluation remains reliable, but is expensive and not applicable to large-scale data. In this paper, we propose Poller (Poetry LLM Evaluator), a novel method leveraging large language models (LLMs) to evaluate the poetry understanding task. Specifically, our method requires LLMs to play the role of a poem's author with detailed information, thereby emulating human evaluation and judgment by adopting the poet's perspective. We conducted comprehensive experiments on multiple LLMs, evaluating the interpretations of poems across eight specialized dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively reduces the evaluation error between LLMs and humans. Especially for specific dimension evaluation, Poller-based LLMs achieve a 94.55% and 89.53% error reduction for rhetorical techniques and defamiliarization, respectively, compared to baseline methods. These performances are unattainable by conventional LLM evaluation methods. Experimental results from multiple LLMs across various dimensions validate the efficacy of our method. This work bridges the gap between automated efficiency and human expertise, establishing a foundation for automated evaluation in poetry-related tasks.

AI.title_translation: Poller：大语言模型适合评估诗歌理解任务吗？
AI.tldr: 本文提出Poller方法，通过让大模型扮演诗歌作者角色来评估诗歌理解，显著降低了自动评估与人工评估之间的误差。
AI.motivation: 现代汉语诗歌具有独特的文学性质，导致传统的自动评估方法不适用；而人工评估虽然准确，但成本高昂且无法扩展到大规模数据，因此需要一种既高效又准确的自动评估方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Poller（Poetry LLM Evaluator）的新方法。该方法要求大语言模型扮演具有详细背景信息的诗歌原作者角色，从诗人的视角模拟人类的评估和判断。研究在多个LLM上进行了全面实验，从八个专业维度对诗歌解读进行了评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Poller方法有效降低了LLM与人类评估之间的误差。与基线方法相比，基于Poller的LLM在“修辞手法”和“去熟悉化”特定维度的评估误差分别降低了94.55%和89.53%，这是传统LLM评估方法无法达到的效果。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功弥合了自动化评估效率与人类专业知识之间的差距，为诗歌及其他复杂文学任务的自动评估奠定了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 传统的自动评估方法已被证明不适用于现代汉语诗歌，因为这一文学体裁具有独特的性质。人工评估虽然依然可靠，但成本高昂，且不适用于大规模数据。在本文中，我们提出了Poller（诗歌大模型评估器），这是一种利用大语言模型（LLM）来评估诗歌理解任务的新方法。具体而言，我们的方法要求LLM扮演具有详细信息的诗歌作者角色，从而通过采用诗人的视角来模拟人类的评估和判断。我们在多个LLM上进行了全面的实验，从八个专业维度评估了对诗歌的解读。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效地减少了LLM与人类之间的评估误差。特别是对于特定维度的评估，与基线方法相比，基于Poller的LLM在修辞手法和去熟悉化方面分别实现了94.55%和89.53%的误差减少。这些性能是传统LLM评估方法无法企及的。多个LLM在各个维度上的实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性。这项工作弥合了自动化效率与人类专业知识之间的差距，为诗歌相关任务的自动评估奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对现代汉语诗歌评估的难题，提出了一种利用大语言模型进行诗歌理解评估的新方法——Poller。该方法通过让LLM扮演诗歌作者的角色，从诗人视角对诗歌解读进行多维度评估。实验表明，Poller能显著缩小LLM与人类专家评估之间的差距，尤其在修辞和去熟悉化等维度上表现优异，为文学领域的自动化评估提供了新思路。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 诗歌理解, 自动评估, 角色扮演, 现代诗歌
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了“角色扮演（扮演原作者）”的机制来让LLM进行诗歌评估，这非常符合诗歌创作和理解的主观性特征。通过模拟作者视角，成功缓解了传统LLM评估在文学艺术领域缺乏深度和偏见的问题。其局限性可能在于，现代诗歌的解读往往具有多义性（“诗无达诂”），仅从作者单一视角进行评估是否会限制对其他合理读者反应的包容性，这在未来研究中值得进一步探讨。

title: EcoVideo: Entropy-Orchestrated Video Generation Paradigm in Cloud-Edge Dynamics
comments: EcoVideo is honored to be accepted by ECCV 2026
summary: DiT video generation is latency-intensive due to iterative full-frame denoising, while prior cloud-edge methods largely rely on static inter-step decoupling and cannot leverage inter-frame similarity or adapt to system dynamics. We propose EcoVideo, an entropy-orchestrated framework for dynamic inter-frame decoupling: early-stage self-attention entropy provides a training-free estimate of frame-wise information density for frame selection; a cloud large model denoises sparse high-entropy keyframes; and an edge lightweight model reconstructs the remaining frames via motion-aware interpolation with refinement for temporal stability. EcoVideo further adapts the keyframe budget and edge refinement depth to real-time bandwidth and compute availability, optimizing end-to-end latency under constraints. Experiments on representative DiT video generators show improved quality--efficiency trade-offs and up to 2.9x end-to-end speedup in low-bandwidth, compute-limited edge settings. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/EcoVideo.
comment: EcoVideo is honored to be accepted by ECCV 2026

AI.title_translation: EcoVideo：云边协同动态下的熵编排视频生成范式
AI.tldr: EcoVideo通过自注意力熵动态筛选关键帧由云端去噪，其余帧在边缘端插值重建，并能根据实时带宽和算力自适应优化，实现了高达2.9倍的端到端视频生成加速。
AI.motivation: 由于需要进行迭代式的全帧去噪，基于Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 的视频生成具有极高的延迟。现有的云边协同方法多依赖于静态的步骤间解耦，无法利用帧间相似性，也无法自适应调节以应对波动的网络带宽和边缘计算资源。
AI.method: 提出EcoVideo框架，采用动态帧间解耦策略：首先，利用早期的自注意力熵对帧级信息密度进行无训练估计并筛选关键帧；其次，由云端大模型对稀疏的高熵关键帧进行去噪处理；然后，由边缘端轻量级模型通过具有时间稳定性细化的运动感知插值重建其余帧；最后，根据实时带宽和计算资源动态调整关键帧预算和边缘细化深度，以优化延迟。
AI.result: 在代表性DiT视频生成器上的实验结果表明，EcoVideo显著改善了生成质量与效率之间的权衡。在低带宽、计算受限的边缘场景下，该方法实现了高达2.9倍的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: EcoVideo通过动态帧间解耦和熵编排，成功实现了高效的云边协同视频生成，在保证视频质量的同时，显著降低了端到端延迟，并展示了对动态系统环境的强适应性。
AI.translation: 基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的视频生成由于迭代式的全帧去噪而具有极高的延迟，而先前的云边协同方法主要依赖于静态的步骤间解耦，无法利用帧间相似性，也无法适应系统动态变化。我们提出了EcoVideo，这是一个用于动态帧间解耦的熵编排框架：早期自注意力熵提供了一种无需训练的帧级信息密度估计，用于帧选择；云端大模型对稀疏的高熵关键帧进行去噪；边缘轻量级模型通过具有时间稳定性细化的运动感知插值来重建其余帧。EcoVideo还根据实时带宽和计算可用性自适应调整关键帧预算和边缘细化深度，从而在约束条件下优化端到端延迟。在代表性DiT视频生成器上的实验表明，在低带宽、计算受限的边缘设置中，该方法改善了质量与效率之间的权衡，并实现了高达2.9倍的端到端加速。代码可在 https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/EcoVideo 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为EcoVideo的云边协同视频生成框架，旨在解决DiT视频生成的高延迟问题。该框架利用自注意力熵动态评估帧信息密度，将高熵关键帧发送至云端大模型去噪，而其余帧则在边缘端通过轻量级模型进行运动感知插值重建。EcoVideo还能根据实时带宽和计算能力动态调整关键帧预算和边缘细化深度，在低带宽和受限计算环境中实现了高达2.9倍的端到端加速。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 扩散Transformer (DiT), 云边协同, 熵编排, 动态解耦
AI.comments: 该论文创新地将自注意力熵引入到云边协同的视频生成任务中，实现了无训练的动态帧选择，巧妙地平衡了云端计算、网络传输与边缘重建之间的开销。其自适应调节机制非常适合现实世界中波动的网络和计算环境。不过，边缘端运动感知插值在处理极其复杂的非线性大运动时，其重建质量和稳定性可能仍面临一定挑战。

title: Convergence of Continual Learning in Homogeneous Deep Networks
summary: We characterize weakly regularized continual classification in homogeneous models as sequential projections onto task margin sets. This result generalizes prior analyses restricted to either stationary (single-task) deep models or continual linear models. We show that global convergence generally fails, even for simple models linear in data but nonlinear in parameters. Nevertheless, by leveraging results from nonconvex projection theory, we identify regularity properties of homogeneous deep networks that guarantee local linear convergence under random and cyclic task sequences. Finally, we extend our analysis to continual regression, unifying the framework for homogeneous models.

AI.title_translation: 齐次深度网络中持续学习的收敛性
AI.tldr: 本文将齐次深度网络中的持续学习刻画为顺序投影，证明了其全局收敛通常失效，但利用非凸投影理论证明了在特定正则性下可实现局部线性收敛。
AI.motivation: 先前的持续学习收敛性分析主要局限于平稳（单任务）深度模型或持续线性模型，缺乏对非线性齐次深度网络在持续学习下收敛性能的理论理解。
AI.method: 将弱正则化持续分类刻画为任务间隔集上的顺序投影，并利用非凸投影理论分析齐次深度网络的正则性；随后将该理论框架推广至持续回归。
AI.result: 研究表明全局收敛在一般情况下会失效（即使是数据线性但参数非线性的简单模型）。但在随机和循环任务序列下，利用非凸投影理论确定的正则性可以保证齐次深度网络的局部线性收敛。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功为齐次深度网络中的持续分类和持续回归建立了一个统一的分析框架，并给出了保证局部线性收敛的理论条件。
AI.translation: 我们将齐次模型中弱正则化的持续分类刻画为在任务间隔集上的顺序投影。这一结果推广了先前仅限于平稳（单任务）深度模型或持续线性模型的分析。我们表明，即使对于数据呈线性但参数呈非线性的简单模型，全局收敛通常也会失效。然而，通过利用非凸投影理论的结果，我们确定了齐次深度网络的正则性，这些正则性保证了在随机和循环任务序列下的局部线性收敛。最后，我们将我们的分析扩展到持续回归，从而统一了齐次模型的框架。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了齐次深度网络在持续学习（分类和回归）中的收敛性问题。作者将弱正则化持续分类建模为向任务间隔集的顺序投影，并指出全局收敛通常无法实现。然而，通过引入非凸投影理论，本文确定了能够保证随机和循环任务序列下局部线性收敛的正则性特征，从而为齐次模型的持续学习提供了一个统一的理论框架。
AI.keywords: Continual Learning, Homogeneous Deep Networks, Convergence, Nonconvex Projection
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将齐次深度网络中的持续学习问题巧妙地转化为非凸投影理论中的顺序投影问题，从而打破了以往研究仅局限于线性模型或单任务模型的限制。该研究的重要性在于为非线性深度网络在持续学习场景下的收敛性提供了理论支撑。然而，其局限性在于全局收敛性的失效，且局部线性收敛的保证依赖于较为抽象的正则性性质，在实际复杂网络中的具体应用和验证仍具挑战。

title: TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving
summary: Coding agents are rapidly becoming a major application of agentic LLMs, but serving them efficiently remains challenging. Progress on this challenge requires understanding real workload patterns, yet the data needed for such analysis is largely absent. Existing public traces and benchmarks do not capture real, day-to-day coding-agent usage across multiple agents and model families for serving-system analysis. To help fill this gap, we collect and release a trace of roughly 4,300 coding-agent sessions, containing about 350,000 LLM steps and 430,000 tool calls from our own day-to-day use of Claude Code and Codex. Our analysis shows that coding-agent workloads feature long autonomous loops, long contexts with short outputs, diverse and heavily-tailed tool calls, and high but imperfect prefix cache hit rates. These findings point to concrete opportunities for optimizing serving, including lower-overhead tool calling, append-length-aware prefill, semantic-aware tool-latency prediction, and improved KV-cache management around human-paced gaps. We release the dataset, trace collection pipeline, and analysis code at https://github.com/uw-syfi/TraceLab.git; the project website is https://tracelab.cs.washington.edu.

AI.title_translation: TraceLab：面向 LLM 服务的编码智能体工作负载特征化研究
AI.tldr: 本文收集并开源了首个真实日常编码智能体交互轨迹数据集 TraceLab，分析了其长上下文、多工具调用等独特工作负载特征，并提出了针对 LLM 服务的具体优化方向。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已成为大语言模型的重要应用，但由于缺乏真实的、跨多个智能体和模型家族的日常使用轨迹（traces）数据，如何高效地为它们提供推理服务（serving）仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 收集并发布了一个名为 TraceLab 的真实交互轨迹数据集，包含约 4,300 个编码智能体对话（源自日常使用 Claude Code 和 Codex），涉及约 350,000 个 LLM 步骤和 430,000 次工具调用。通过对该数据集进行深入分析，来特征化编码智能体的工作负载。
AI.result: 分析表明，编码智能体的工作负载具有以下显著特征：长自主循环、长上下文伴随短输出、多样化且呈重尾分布的工具调用，以及高但并不完美的前缀缓存命中率。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体独特的负载特征为 LLM 服务系统优化指明了具体方向，包括降低工具调用开销、感知追加长度的预填充、感知语义的工具延迟预测，以及针对人机交互停顿改进 KV 缓存管理。
