AI.title_translation: 迈向基于模仿学习的无需生物信号的自主假肢控制
AI.tldr: 通过视觉感知和模仿学习，实现无需肌电信号的自主假肢抓取控制，显著减轻用户认知负担。
AI.motivation: 传统的肌电信号（sEMG）控制方式对用户而言既费力又需要高认知负荷，研究旨在开发一种完全自主的控制系统，通过视觉感知减轻用户使用假肢时的身心负担。
AI.method: 利用安装在手腕上的摄像头捕捉视觉信息，通过遥操作收集人类示范数据，并使用模仿学习算法训练假肢控制模型，使其能够根据环境自动执行抓取和释放动作。
AI.result: 实验表明，该模型即使在仅使用有限对象数据集进行训练的情况下，也能实现较高的抓取成功率，并能有效地泛化到新用户以及先前未见过的不同重量物体上。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功开发了一种基于视觉的自主假肢控制系统，证明了通过模仿学习，假肢可以在无需用户产生生物信号的情况下，实现对不同形状和重量物体的有效抓取与放置，为假肢控制技术提供了一种更自然、低负担的新方向。
AI.translation: 肢体缺失影响着全球数百万人，损害了身体功能并降低了生活质量。大多数传统的表面肌电图（sEMG）和半自主控制方法要求用户为每个动作产生肌电信号，这给用户带来了沉重的身体和心理负担。本研究旨在开发一种全自主控制系统，仅利用安装在手腕上的摄像头，使假肢能够自动抓取和释放各种形状的物体。将手靠近物体时，系统会根据手部动作和环境自动执行具有适当抓力的抓取动作。要释放被抓取的物体，只需自然地将物体靠近桌面，系统就会自动张开手。这样的系统将为肢体缺失者提供一种非常易于使用的假肢控制界面，并有助于减少使用时的精神消耗。为了实现这一目标，我们开发了一个遥操作系统来收集人类示范数据，用于通过模仿学习训练假肢控制模型，使其模仿人类动作。通过在单一参与者演示的有限对象集数据上训练模型，我们证明了模仿学习算法可以实现高成功率，并能有效地泛化到新用户和以前未见过的不同重量物体上。演示视频可在 https://sites.google.com/view/autonomous-prosthetic-hand 查看。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于模仿学习的自主假肢控制系统，通过腕部摄像头识别物体并自动执行抓取与释放操作，无需用户输入肌电信号，从而降低了假肢使用的身心负担，并在新对象和新用户上表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 自主假肢控制, 模仿学习, 视觉感知, 无生物信号, 机器人抓取
AI.comments: 该研究通过模仿学习实现无需生物信号的假肢控制，创新性地将视觉感知与模仿学习结合，显著降低了用户的认知负担。其局限性在于目前仅基于单一参与者的数据进行训练，未来需验证在更广泛群体和复杂环境下的鲁棒性。

title: Modeling Earth-Scale Human-Like Societies with One Billion Agents
summary: Understanding the dynamic evolution of complex social phenomena requires both high-fidelity modeling of human behavior and large-scale simulations. Traditional agent-based models (ABMs) have been employed to study these dynamics, but are constrained by simplified agent behaviors. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable agents to exhibit sophisticated social behaviors, yet face significant scaling challenges. We present Light Society, an agent-based simulation framework that advances both fronts. Light Society formalizes social processes as structured transitions of agent and environment states, governed by a set of LLM-powered simulation operations. Joint algorithmic and system optimizations, particularly a mixture-of-models engine that combines full LLMs with distilled surrogates, enable Light Society to efficiently simulate societies with over one billion agents. Grounded in real-world demographic profiles from the World Values Survey, simulations of Trust Games and opinion diffusion at up to one billion agents demonstrate Light Society's high fidelity and efficiency in modeling diverse social phenomena, providing researchers with a practical foundation for hypothesis testing and the study of emergent collective behaviors at planetary scale.

AI.title_translation: 利用十亿级代理建模地球规模的人类社会
AI.tldr: Light Society框架通过混合模型引擎优化，实现了十亿级AI代理的高效社会模拟，为行星级社会科学研究奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 传统代理人模型（ABM）行为过于简单，而基于大语言模型（LLM）的复杂代理模拟面临严重的扩展性挑战，难以模拟大规模社会现象。
AI.method: 提出了Light Society框架，将社会过程形式化为状态转换；采用联合算法与系统优化，特别是混合模型引擎（结合完整LLM与蒸馏代理）来提升计算效率。
AI.result: 成功模拟了高达十亿个代理的信任博弈和观点扩散过程；实验表明该框架在处理大规模社会现象时兼具高保真度和高效性。
AI.conclusion: Light Society证明了结合LLM与系统级优化能够有效实现十亿级代理的高保真、高效社会模拟，为大规模社会科学研究提供了强有力的工具。
AI.translation: 理解复杂社会现象的动态演化需要高保真的人类行为建模与大规模模拟。传统的代理人建模（ABM）常用于研究此类动态，但受限于简单的代理行为。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使代理能够表现出复杂的社会行为，但面临巨大的扩展挑战。我们提出了Light Society，一个在上述两个方面均有突破的代理人模拟框架。Light Society将社会过程形式化为代理和环境状态的结构化转换，并由一组基于LLM的模拟操作控制。通过联合算法与系统优化，特别是结合完整LLM与蒸馏替代模型的混合模型引擎，Light Society能够高效模拟超过十亿个代理的社会。基于世界价值观调查的真实人口统计资料，通过对十亿级代理的信任博弈和观点扩散模拟，验证了Light Society在建模多样化社会现象方面的高保真度和高效性，为研究人员进行假设检验和行星规模的涌现集体行为研究提供了实践基础。
AI.summary: Light Society是一个新型代理人模拟框架，通过形式化社会过程及采用混合模型引擎（LLM与蒸馏代理），克服了大规模社会模拟的扩展性难题，成功实现了十亿级代理的高保真社会现象模拟。
AI.keywords: 代理人建模, 大语言模型, 十亿级模拟, 社会动力学, 系统优化
AI.comments: 该研究通过创新的模型混合引擎（LLM与蒸馏代理结合）突破了大规模社会模拟的算力瓶颈，是实现行星级社会科学模拟的重要里程碑。其局限性可能在于蒸馏模型在处理极端复杂社会行为时的保真度，以及模拟环境对现实世界复杂性的简化。

title: MGDFIS: Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy for Small Object Detection
summary: Small-object detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery requires preserving weak local evidence while using broader context to separate tiny foreground targets from cluttered backgrounds. Existing multi-scale fusion methods improve feature aggregation, but they often add computation or blur fine details during repeated cross-scale fusion. The central challenge is to balance low-SNR target preservation, clutter suppression, and efficient cross-scale context exchange. To address this challenge, we propose the Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy (MGDFIS), a neck-level feature-fusion strategy that couples global context exchange, local-detail recovery, and pixel-level foreground-background recalibration. MGDFIS integrates three coordinated modules: FusionLock-TSS Attention for stabilizing spectral-spatial responses, Global-detail Integration for combining long-range mixing with local detail capture, and Dynamic Pixel Attention for reweighting compact foreground regions. On the controlled VisDrone setting, YOLO26m + MGDFIS improves AP50:95 from 25.7 to 30.2 and AP50 from 37.2 to 44.2 over the YOLO26m baseline, with 96.1 GFLOPs. Additional dataset-specific evaluations report 38.9 AP50 and 21.9 AP50:95 on UAVDT and 97.4 AP50 on CARPK. The code is available at: https://github.com/JackBaixue/MGDFIS.

AI.title_translation: MGDFIS：用于小目标检测的多尺度全局-细节特征集成策略
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的特征融合策略MGDFIS，通过全局上下文与局部细节的有效集成，显著提升了无人机影像中小目标的检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机小目标检测方法在多尺度融合时存在计算量大或细节丢失问题，难以平衡低信噪比目标保留、背景噪声抑制和上下文信息交换。
AI.method: 提出MGDFIS策略，包含三个协同模块：FusionLock-TSS注意力机制（稳定谱空响应）、全局细节集成模块（结合长距离混合与局部细节捕获）以及动态像素注意力模块（重加权紧凑前景区域）。
AI.result: 在VisDrone数据集上，YOLO26m + MGDFIS将AP50:95从25.7提升至30.2，AP50从37.2提升至44.2；并在UAVDT和CARPK数据集上取得了显著的检测性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的MGDFIS策略通过耦合全局上下文交换与局部细节恢复，在无人机影像小目标检测中实现了性能与效率的良好平衡。
AI.translation: 无人机（UAV）影像中的小目标检测需要保留微弱的局部证据，同时利用更广泛的上下文信息将微小的前景目标与杂乱的背景分离开来。现有的多尺度融合方法虽然改善了特征聚合，但往往会增加计算负担，或在重复的跨尺度融合过程中模糊了精细细节。其核心挑战在于平衡低信噪比（SNR）目标的保留、杂波抑制和高效的跨尺度上下文交换。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了多尺度全局-细节特征集成策略（MGDFIS），这是一种颈部特征融合策略，耦合了全局上下文交换、局部细节恢复和像素级前景-背景重新校准。MGDFIS集成了三个协同模块：用于稳定谱空响应的FusionLock-TSS注意力机制、结合长距离混合与局部细节捕获的全局-细节集成模块，以及用于重加权紧凑前景区域的动态像素注意力模块。在受控的VisDrone设置下，YOLO26m + MGDFIS的AP50:95从25.7提高到30.2，AP50从37.2提高到44.2（YOLO26m基线），计算量为96.1 GFLOPs。针对特定数据集的评估显示，在UAVDT上达到38.9 AP50和21.9 AP50:95，在CARPK上达到97.4 AP50。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MGDFIS，一种用于无人机小目标检测的颈部特征融合策略。通过集成FusionLock-TSS注意力、全局细节融合和动态像素注意力三个模块，该策略在有效抑制背景干扰的同时，增强了对小目标的细节捕获能力，在多个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.keywords: 小目标检测, 无人机影像, 特征融合, 全局上下文, 细节恢复
AI.comments: 该论文针对无人机影像中小目标检测的关键挑战，提出了一种平衡全局上下文与局部细节的有效策略。其创新点在于通过三个协同模块（FusionLock-TSS、全局细节集成、动态像素注意力）在保持计算效率的同时，显著提升了对低信噪比目标的检测性能。该方法在多个主流数据集上的表现证明了其通用性和有效性。

title: Stimulus Motion Perception Studies Imply Specific Neural Computations in Human Visual Stabilization
summary: Even during fixation the human eye is constantly in low amplitude motion, jittering over small angles in random directions at up to 100Hz. This motion results in all features of the image on the retina constantly traversing a number of cones, yet objects which are stable in the world are perceived to be stable, and any object which is moving in the world is perceived to be moving. A series of experiments carried out over a dozen years revealed the psychophysics of visual stabilization to be more nuanced than might be assumed, say, from the mechanics of stabilization of camera images, or what might be assumed to be the simplest solution from an evolutionary perspective. The psychophysics revealed by the experiments strongly implies a specific set of operations on retinal signals resulting in the observed stabilization behavior. The presentation is in two levels. First is a functional description of the action of the mechanism that is very likely responsible for the experimentally observed behavior. Second is a more speculative proposal of circuit-level neural elements that might implement the functional behavior.

title: Code Reasoning for Software Engineering Tasks: A Survey and A Call to Action
comments: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (06/2026) 40 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables
summary: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has led to dramatic improvements across a wide range of natural language tasks. Their performance on certain tasks can be further enhanced by incorporating test-time reasoning techniques. These inference-time advances have been adopted into the code domain, enabling complex software engineering (SWE) tasks such as code generation, test generation and issue resolution. However, the impact of different reasoning techniques on code-centric SWE tasks has not been systematically explored. In this work, we survey code reasoning techniques that underpin these capabilities, with a focus on test-time compute and inference-time reasoning paradigms. We examine a variety of code-specific reasoning methods and progressively build up to SWE agents, which combine planning, tool use, and multi-step interaction. We also compare the impact of different techniques on coding tasks, highlighting their relative importance and outlining open challenges and future research directions. Across commonly used models and benchmarks, we find that approaches exploiting code-specific signals (e.g., structure and execution feedback) are frequently associated with improved performance, motivating a dedicated study of code reasoning beyond natural-language reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 软件工程任务的代码推理：综述与行动呼吁
AI.tldr: 本文综述了面向软件工程的代码推理技术，指出利用代码结构和执行反馈的推理方法能显著提升模型性能，并为该领域的未来研究指明了方向。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在代码领域取得了进展，但不同推理技术对软件工程任务的影响缺乏系统性探索，且代码特有的推理需求（如结构和执行反馈）亟需从通用自然语言推理中区分出来进行深入研究。
AI.method: 对现有的代码推理技术进行分类调查，涵盖测试时计算（test-time compute）和推理时推理（inference-time reasoning）范式，分析了从基础推理方法到结合规划、工具使用和多步交互的软件工程智能体（SWE agents）的演进。
AI.result: 研究发现，利用代码结构和执行反馈等特定信号的方法在软件工程任务中表现更优；明确了代码推理技术在代码生成、测试和问题解决中的关键作用，并指出了当前面临的开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用代码特有信号的推理方法能显著提升软件工程任务性能，超越了通用的自然语言推理范畴，未来应进一步深化代码逻辑与推理机制的融合。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的兴起在广泛的自然语言任务中带来了显著的性能提升。通过引入测试时推理技术，这些任务的性能可以进一步增强。这些推理时的进步已被引入代码领域，支持了代码生成、测试生成和问题解决等复杂的软件工程（SWE）任务。然而，不同推理技术对以代码为中心的软件工程任务的影响尚未得到系统探索。在本文中，我们调查了支撑这些能力的代码推理技术，重点关注测试时计算和推理时推理范式。我们研究了各种代码特定的推理方法，并逐步扩展到结合了规划、工具使用和多步交互的软件工程智能体。我们还比较了不同技术对编码任务的影响，突出了它们的相对重要性，并概述了开放性挑战和未来研究方向。通过对常用模型和基准测试的分析，我们发现利用代码特定信号（如结构和执行反馈）的方法通常与性能提升相关，这促使我们对超越自然语言推理的代码推理进行专门研究。
AI.summary: 本文调查了代码推理技术在软件工程任务中的应用，重点关注推理时计算和推理范式。通过分析从基础推理方法到复杂软件工程智能体的演进，研究指出利用代码结构和执行反馈等特定信号对提升任务性能至关重要，并为未来的研究方向提出了建议。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 代码推理, 软件工程, 推理范式, 智能体
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地填补了代码推理领域的研究空白，强调了代码特有属性（结构和执行反馈）对于提升软件工程任务性能的重要性，为该领域的研究者提供了明确的参考框架和未来方向。

title: ChatModel: Automating Reference Model Design and Verification with LLMs
summary: As the complexity of integrated circuit designs continues to escalate, functional verification becomes increasingly challenging. Reference models, critical for accelerating the verification process, are themselves becoming more intricate and time-consuming to develop. Despite the promise shown by large language models (LLMs) in code programming, effectively generating complex reference models remains a significant hurdle. Therefore, we introduce ChatModel, an LLM-aided agile reference model generation and verification platform. ChatModel streamlines the transition from design specifications to fully functional reference models by integrating design standardization and hierarchical agile modeling. Employing a building-block generation strategy, it not only enhances the design capabilities of LLMs for reference models but also significantly boosts verification efficiency. We evaluated ChatModel on 300 designs of varying complexity, demonstrating substantial improvements in both efficiency and quality of reference model generation. ChatModel achieved a peak performance improvement of 58.99% compared to alternative methods, with notable enhancements in generation stability, and delivered a 9.18x increase in its capacity to produce reference model designs. Moreover, ChatModel accelerates the reference model design and validation cycles by an average of 7.11x over traditional manual approaches. These results highlight the potential of ChatModel to significantly advance the automation of reference model generation and validation.

title: Dependability of UAV-Based Networks and Computing Systems: A Survey
summary: Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) computing and networking are becoming a fundamental computation infrastructure for diverse cyber-physical application systems. UAVs can be empowered by AI on edge devices and can communicate with other UAVs and ground stations via wireless communication networks. Dynamic computation demands and heterogeneous computing resources are distributed in the system and need to be controlled to maintain the quality of services and to accomplish critical missions. With the evolution of UAV-based systems, dependability assurance of such systems emerges as a crucial challenge. UAV-based systems confront diverse sources of uncertainty that may threaten their dependability, such as software bugs, component failures, network disconnections, battery shortages, and disturbances from the real world. In this paper, we conduct systematic literature reviews on the dependability of UAV-based networks and computing systems. The survey report reveals emerging research trends in this field and summarizes the literature into comprehensive categories by threat types and adopted technologies. Based on our literature reviews, we identify eight research fields that require further exploration in the future to achieve dependable UAV-based systems.

title: GeNeRT: A Physics-Informed Approach to Intelligent Wireless Channel Modeling via Generalizable Neural Ray Tracing
summary: Neural ray tracing (RT) has emerged as a promising paradigm for channel modeling by integrating physical propagation principles with neural networks. However, existing neural RT methods remain limited by strong spatial dependence and weak adherence to electromagnetic laws. We propose GeNeRT, a generalizable neural RT framework that improves generalization and accuracy through relative geometric features, scatterer semantics, and a Fresnel-inspired polarization-driven architecture. GeNeRT is trained through a three-stage strategy: polarization-specific module-wise pre-training captures general ray-surface interaction behavior; system-wise end-to-end training uses only receiver-side channel impulse responses to learn site-specific propagation characteristics; and measurement-based fine-tuning employs sparse measured multipath components (MPCs) to adapt polarization-related modules to real-world environments. Extensive outdoor simulations demonstrate robust intra-scenario transferability and inter-scenario zero-shot generalization. In an unseen scenario, GeNeRT achieves an overall error of $-35.36$ dB and an average-delay error of 4.91 ns, compared with $-10.85$ dB and 32.38 ns for the best baseline. With only 75 measured reflected MPCs, fine-tuning further reduces the overall error from $-14.48$ to $-22.90$ dB and the average-delay error from 6.28 to 3.58 ns. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of the proposed architecture and training strategy.

AI.title_translation: GeNeRT：一种通过通用神经射线追踪实现智能无线信道建模的物理驱动方法
AI.tldr: GeNeRT 是一种创新的物理驱动神经射线追踪框架，通过结合电磁学原理与多阶段训练，显著提升了无线信道建模的泛化能力与预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有神经射线追踪方法存在严重的空间依赖性，且在遵循电磁传播物理定律方面表现较弱，限制了其在不同场景下的泛化能力和准确性。
AI.method: 提出一种名为 GeNeRT 的通用神经射线追踪框架，采用相对几何特征、散射体语义以及受菲涅尔方程启发的极化驱动架构；并使用三阶段训练策略：极化特定模块预训练、系统端到端训练以及基于测量数据的微调。
AI.result: 在未见场景中，GeNeRT 的整体误差达到 -35.36 dB，平均延迟误差为 4.91 ns，远优于最佳基线模型；通过少量测量数据微调，模型在真实环境中的表现得到进一步显著提升。
AI.conclusion: GeNeRT 通过结合物理驱动的架构与多阶段训练策略，显著提升了无线信道建模的泛化性能、准确性以及对实际环境的适配能力。
AI.translation: 神经射线追踪 (RT) 通过将物理传播原理与神经网络集成，已成为信道建模的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有的神经 RT 方法仍然受到强空间依赖性和对电磁定律遵循较弱的限制。我们提出了 GeNeRT，这是一个通用的神经 RT 框架，通过相对几何特征、散射体语义和受菲涅尔启发的极化驱动架构来提高泛化能力和准确性。GeNeRT 通过三阶段策略进行训练：极化特定模块预训练以捕获通用的射线-表面交互行为；系统级端到端训练仅使用接收端信道脉冲响应来学习特定地点的传播特性；以及基于测量的微调，利用稀疏测量的多径分量 (MPCs) 使极化相关模块适应真实环境。广泛的户外模拟证明了其稳健的场景内迁移能力和场景间零样本泛化能力。在未见场景中，GeNeRT 的总体误差为 -35.36 dB，平均延迟误差为 4.91 ns，而最佳基准分别为 -10.85 dB 和 32.38 ns。仅使用 75 个测量的反射 MPC，微调将总体误差从 -14.48 进一步降低到 -22.90 dB，并将平均延迟误差从 6.28 降低到 3.58 ns。消融研究证实了所提架构和训练策略的有效性。
AI.summary: GeNeRT 是一种融合物理原理的通用神经射线追踪框架，通过引入极化驱动架构及三阶段训练策略，克服了现有模型在空间泛化和物理一致性上的局限，实现了高效、高精度的无线信道建模。
AI.keywords: 神经射线追踪, 无线信道建模, 物理驱动机器学习, 零样本泛化, 电磁传播
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将物理电磁学原理（如菲涅尔方程）嵌入到神经网络中，通过相对几何特征和散射体语义增强了模型的泛化能力。其三阶段训练策略有效解决了传统神经射线追踪方法在空间依赖性强和物理一致性弱方面的痛点，在无线通信信道建模领域具有重要的应用价值。

title: Efficient Black-Box Fault Localization for System-Level Test Code Using Large Language Models
summary: Fault localization (FL) is a critical step in debugging, which typically relies on repeated executions to pinpoint faulty code regions. However, repeated executions can be impractical in the presence of non-deterministic failures or high execution costs. While recent efforts have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to aid execution-free FL, these have primarily focused on identifying faults in the system-under-test (SUT) rather than in the often complex system-level test code. However, the latter is also important, as in practice, many failures are triggered by faulty test code. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a fully static, LLM-driven approach for system-level test code fault localization (TCFL) that does not require executing the test case. Our method uses a single failure execution log to estimate the test's execution trace through three novel algorithms that identify only code statements likely involved in the failure. This pruned trace, combined with the error message, is used to prompt the LLM to rank potential faulty locations. Our black-box, system-level approach requires no access to the SUT source code and is applicable to complex test scripts that assess full system behavior. We evaluate our technique at the function, block, and line levels using an industrial dataset of faulty Python test cases that were not used in pre-training LLMs. Results show that our best-estimated traces closely match the actual traces, with an F1 score of around 90%. Additionally, pruning the complex system-level test code reduces the LLM's inference time by up to 34% without any loss in FL performance. Our method achieves equal or higher FL accuracy, requiring over 85% less average inference time per test case and 93% fewer tokens than the latest LLM-guided FL method.

title: Leveraging Phase Polynomials for Quantum Circuit Optimization
summary: Quantum circuits on resource-limited hardware require optimizing regions dominated by $\{\mathrm{CNOT}, R_z\}$, which account for a large fraction of operations and often dominate execution cost. This optimization can be challenging because phase-polynomial blocks are fragmented by basis-changing gates such as $H$, and optimizing phase parities alone may increase the cost of downstream basis transformations. Existing phase-polynomial approaches are limited to single-block or phase-only optimization, while subcircuit rewriting approaches are local and scale poorly beyond small rewrite windows. We introduce \emph{PhasePoly}, a compiler optimization pass that jointly optimizes phase-parity and output-parity networks and employs a cross-block intermediate representation to reuse parities across phase-polynomial block barriers. This approach is effective because its unified parity-matrix representation exposes long-range $\{\mathrm{CNOT}, R_z\}$ structure that local rewriting and single-block methods cannot capture. \emph{PhasePoly} reduces total gate count by up to 50.00\% (34.70\% on average) and CNOT count by up to 48.57\% (26.83\% on average), while scaling to large circuits and improving both fault-tolerant compilation and near-term hardware execution. \emph{PhasePoly} is available at https://github.com/ruadapt/PhasePoly.

AI.title_translation: 利用相位多项式进行量子电路优化
AI.tldr: PhasePoly 是一种新型量子编译器优化工具，通过全局奇偶校验矩阵表示跨越块障碍，显著降低了量子电路的门数量。
AI.motivation: 资源受限的量子硬件对 {CNOT, Rz} 门序列的优化需求迫切，但现有方法受限于局部块优化或无法有效处理基变换门带来的碎片化问题，导致难以进行大规模全局优化。
AI.method: 引入了 PhasePoly 编译器优化方案，通过联合优化相位奇偶校验和输出奇偶校验网络，并采用跨模块中间表示来实现在相位多项式块之间复用奇偶校验。
AI.result: PhasePoly 将总门数平均减少了 34.70%（最高 50.00%），CNOT 门数平均减少了 26.83%（最高 48.57%），且具备良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: PhasePoly 提供了一种高效的全局优化策略，通过统一的奇偶校验表示跨越电路模块障碍，显著降低了量子电路的门计数，尤其是在资源受限的硬件场景下表现出色。
AI.translation: 在资源受限的硬件上运行量子电路需要对以 {CNOT, Rz} 为主的区域进行优化，因为这些操作占据了大部分开销。然而，由于基变换门（如 H 门）将相位多项式块碎片化，且仅优化相位奇偶性可能增加后续基变换的成本，这种优化极具挑战性。现有的相位多项式方法仅限于单块或仅相位优化，而子电路重写方法则是局部的，在小重写窗口之外扩展性较差。我们介绍了 PhasePoly，这是一种编译器优化过程，它联合优化相位奇偶性和输出奇偶性网络，并采用跨块中间表示来在相位多项式块障碍之间复用奇偶性。该方法之所以有效，是因为其统一的奇偶校验矩阵表示揭示了局部重写和单块方法无法捕获的远程 {CNOT, Rz} 结构。PhasePoly 将总门数减少了高达 50.00%（平均 34.70%），CNOT 计数减少了高达 48.57%（平均 26.83%），同时扩展到大型电路并改进了容错编译和近期硬件执行。PhasePoly 可在 https://github.com/ruadapt/PhasePoly 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 PhasePoly 的量子电路编译器优化技术，通过统一的奇偶校验矩阵表示，突破了传统相位多项式方法在处理基变换门时的碎片化限制，实现了对跨模块 {CNOT, Rz} 结构的全局优化。
AI.keywords: 量子电路优化, 相位多项式, 奇偶校验矩阵, 编译器优化, CNOT门优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个跨模块的统一奇偶校验矩阵表示法，成功打破了传统方法中相位多项式块的局限性。其重要性在于大幅提升了资源受限量子硬件上的编译效率，通过全局视角优化了CNOT和Rz门序列，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Stochastic and Non-local Closure Modeling for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems via Latent Score-based Generative Models
summary: We propose a latent score-based generative AI framework for learning stochastic, non-local closure models and constitutive laws in nonlinear dynamical systems of computational mechanics. This work addresses a key challenge of modeling complex multiscale dynamical systems without a clear scale separation, for which numerically resolving all scales is prohibitively expensive, e.g., for engineering turbulent flows. While classical closure modeling methods leverage domain knowledge to approximate subgrid-scale phenomena, their deterministic and local assumptions can be too restrictive in regimes lacking a clear scale separation. Recent developments of diffusion-based stochastic models have shown promise in the context of closure modeling, but their prohibitive computational inference cost limits practical applications in many real-world settings. This work addresses this limitation by jointly training convolutional autoencoders with conditional diffusion models in latent space, significantly reducing the dimensionality of the sampling process while preserving essential physical characteristics. Numerical results demonstrate that the joint training approach helps discover a proper latent space that not only guarantees small reconstruction errors but also ensures good performance of the diffusion model in the latent space. When integrated into numerical simulations, the proposed stochastic modeling framework via latent conditional diffusion models achieves significant computational acceleration while maintaining comparable predictive accuracy to standard diffusion models in physical space.

title: Room Scene Discovery and Grouping in Unstructured Vacation Rental Image Collections
comments: Presented at the Two-sided Marketplace Optimization Workshop, KDD 2026
summary: The rapid growth of vacation rental (VR) platforms has led to an increasing volume of property images, often uploaded without structured categorization. This lack of organization poses significant challenges for travelers attempting to understand the spatial layout of a property, particularly when multiple rooms of the same type are present. To address this issue, we introduce an effective approach for solving the room scene discovery and grouping problem, as well as identifying bed types within each bedroom group. This grouping is valuable for travelers to comprehend the spatial organization, layout, and the sleeping configuration of the property. We propose a computationally efficient machine learning pipeline characterized by low latency and the ability to perform effectively with sample-efficient learning, making it well-suited for real-time and data-scarce environments. The pipeline integrates a supervised room-type detection model, a supervised overlap detection model to identify the overlap similarity between two images, and a clustering algorithm to group the images of the same space together using the similarity scores. Additionally, the pipeline maps each bedroom group to the corresponding bed types specified in the property's metadata, based on the visual content present in the group's images using a Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM) model. We evaluate the aforementioned models individually and also assess the pipeline in its entirety, observing strong performance that significantly outperforms established approaches such as contrastive learning and clustering with pretrained embeddings.

title: The Future is Agentic: Definitions, Perspectives, and Open Challenges of Multi-Agent Recommender Systems
comments: Added controlled experiments to illustrate the points of the paper. Also edited for more clarity in conveying the concepts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are evolving from passive text generators into agentic systems that can plan, maintain state, invoke tools, and coordinate with other agents. This perspective paper examines what this shift means for recommender systems (RS). We define agentic recommender systems as pipelines in which one or more stateful agents observe, plan, call tools, and verify, rather than score in a single shot, while operating over users, item catalogs, candidate sets, and recommendation objectives. Their value is strongest when this machinery measurably improves recommendation-layer outcomes such as relevance, constraint satisfaction, bundle coherence, grounding, explanation faithfulness, or user effort, rather than merely because a pipeline contains an LLM or several modules. We introduce a recommender-specific formalism that models an agent by its state (user, context, history, candidate set), a reasoning core, tools, a hierarchical memory, and explicit policy constraints, and casts a multi-agent recommender as a triple of agents, a shared environment, and a communication protocol. Within this framework we develop four representative task families and an agenda tying five recurring challenge families to measurable RS signals. Finally, we run a controlled study comparing single-shot and multi-agent pipelines under shared histories, candidate sets, prompts, and metrics. A pilot next-item ranking study on Amazon-2023 shows multi-agent systems are not uniformly superior: on representative samples the single-shot baseline is Pareto-efficient, whereas decomposition and ensemble agents help mainly on high-diversity histories. This supports a conditional design principle: agentic complexity should be routed to cases where its marginal quality gain justifies the added latency, cost, and governance risk. Code: https://github.com/RezaYM/agenticrecsys.git

AI.title_translation: 未来是代理化的：多代理推荐系统的定义、视角与开放挑战
AI.tldr: 论文定义了“代理推荐系统”，并通过实验证明多代理架构并非总是优于单次生成模型，建议应根据质量增益与成本权衡来选择性应用代理复杂性。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从被动文本生成向具备规划、状态维护和工具调用能力的代理系统演进，亟需探讨这种范式转变如何重塑推荐系统，并明确其在提升推荐质量方面的实际价值。
AI.method: 1. 定义代理推荐系统框架：包含状态、推理核心、工具、分层记忆和策略约束；2. 建立多代理交互模型：定义为代理、共享环境和通信协议的三元组；3. 提出四类代表性任务及五类挑战；4. 实证研究：在Amazon-2023数据集上对比单次生成与多代理流水线的性能。
AI.result: 实证研究表明，多代理系统并非普遍优于单次生成基准。单次生成在部分场景下更具帕累托效率，而分解和集成代理仅在处理高多样性历史记录时表现出明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 多代理推荐系统并非在所有场景下都优于单次生成模型。设计原则应遵循“按需使用”：仅在复杂性带来的质量增益足以抵消延迟、成本和治理风险时，才引入代理架构。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正从被动的文本生成器演变为能够规划、维护状态、调用工具并与其他代理协作的代理系统。本文探讨了这一转变对推荐系统（RS）的意义。我们将代理推荐系统定义为：一个或多个有状态的代理在用户、物品目录、候选集和推荐目标上进行观察、规划、调用工具和验证的流水线，而非单次评分。其核心价值在于能否显著提升推荐结果（如相关性、约束满足、捆绑连贯性、依据性、解释忠实度或减少用户工作量），而非仅仅因为流水线中包含了LLM或多个模块。我们引入了一种推荐系统特定的形式化方法，通过状态（用户、上下文、历史、候选集）、推理核心、工具、分层记忆和明确的策略约束来建模代理，并将多代理推荐系统建模为由代理、共享环境和通信协议组成的三元组。在此框架内，我们开发了四个代表性任务系列，并制定了将五个挑战系列与可衡量推荐信号挂钩的议程。最后，我们进行了一项受控研究，比较了在共享历史、候选集、提示词和指标下的单次生成与多代理流水线。在Amazon-2023上的下一项排序试点研究表明，多代理系统并非统一优于单次生成系统：在代表性样本上，单次生成基准是帕累托最优的，而分解和集成代理主要在处理高多样性历史时有帮助。这支持了一个有条件的设计原则：应将代理复杂性引导至其边际质量增益足以证明增加延迟、成本和治理风险合理性的场景中。代码：https://github.com/RezaYM/agenticrecsys.git
AI.summary: 本文探讨了代理系统在推荐系统中的应用，定义了代理推荐系统架构，并构建了其形式化模型。通过对比实验，作者揭示了多代理系统与单次生成基准的性能差异，强调了代理复杂性应根据具体的质量增益、延迟和成本权衡来选择性应用。
AI.keywords: 代理推荐系统, 大语言模型, 多代理系统, 推荐系统形式化, 复杂性权衡
AI.comments: 该论文通过定义和实证研究，为Agentic Recommender Systems（代理推荐系统）这一新兴领域提供了重要的理论框架。其最大的创新在于提出了基于代理的推荐系统形式化定义，并强调了“代理复杂性”并非总是优于单次生成（single-shot）模型，这种批判性的视角对于避免AI领域盲目追求代理复杂化具有重要的指导意义。

title: PLOT: Pseudo-Labeling via Object Tracking for Monocular 3D Object Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection is crucial for scalable perception across fields like autonomous driving, robotics, and surveillance. However, progress is hindered by limited 3D annotations and the inherent ambiguity of single-image geometry. Existing methods often rely on strong geometric assumptions or carefully curated datasets, which limit their applicability to real-world scenarios. In this paper, we present PLOT (Pseudo-Labeling via Object Tracking), a framework that generates 3D annotations from monocular videos without auxiliary sensors or model retraining. PLOT tracks object and background trajectories to estimate camera motion and perform object association in pose-unknown settings. These trajectories provide point correspondences that align frame-wise pseudo-LiDARs, which are then fused via simple optimization into a unified object shape robust to occlusion and viewpoint shifts. Recognizing temporal coherence as a fundamental requirement for reliable shape fusion and video perception, we design a global object memory that preserves consistent object identities across frames. PLOT achieves robust annotation quality and strong generalization on both M3OD video benchmarks and in-the-wild videos, proving its effectiveness across diverse and unconstrained domains. Project page: https://plot-eccv.github.io.

AI.title_translation: PLOT：通过物体跟踪进行伪标注的单目 3D 目标检测方法
AI.tldr: PLOT 是一种无需额外传感器即可从单目视频中生成高质量 3D 标注的新框架，通过跟踪和多帧融合显著提升了 3D 物体感知的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 单目3D目标检测受限于3D标注数据的匮乏以及单图像几何结构的模糊性，现有方法往往依赖强几何假设或特定数据集，泛化能力较差。
AI.method: 提出了 PLOT 框架，通过跟踪物体和背景轨迹来估计摄像机运动及进行物体关联；利用轨迹点对应关系对齐逐帧伪 LiDAR，并通过优化算法融合为统一的物体形状；构建全局物体记忆库以保持时间一致性。
AI.result: PLOT 在 M3OD 视频基准和野外视频中均实现了鲁棒的标注质量和强大的泛化能力，证明了其在多样化和非受限领域中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PLOT 提供了一种高效且鲁棒的单目视频3D标注方案，显著降低了数据标注成本，并提升了在复杂场景下的感知能力。
AI.translation: 单目 3D 目标检测对于自动驾驶、机器人和监控等领域的扩展性感知至关重要。然而，3D 标注的局限性和单图像几何结构的固有模糊性阻碍了其进展。现有方法通常依赖于强几何假设或精心挑选的数据集，这限制了它们在现实场景中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了 PLOT（通过物体跟踪进行伪标注），这是一个无需辅助传感器或模型重训练即可从单目视频生成 3D 标注的框架。PLOT 通过跟踪物体和背景轨迹来估计摄像机运动，并在位姿未知的情况下执行物体关联。这些轨迹提供了点对应关系，用于对齐逐帧伪 LiDAR，然后通过简单的优化将其融合为对遮挡和视角变化具有鲁棒性的统一物体形状。认识到时间相干性是可靠形状融合和视频感知的基本要求，我们设计了一个全局物体记忆库，在帧之间保持一致的物体身份。PLOT 在 M3OD 视频基准和野外视频中均实现了稳健的标注质量和强大的泛化能力，证明了其在多样化和非受限领域中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 PLOT 框架，通过利用单目视频中的物体跟踪技术生成高质量的 3D 伪标签。该方法无需辅助传感器，通过融合多帧轨迹信息构建统一的物体形状，并结合全局记忆库确保时间一致性，有效缓解了数据标注稀缺和几何模糊问题。
AI.keywords: 单目3D目标检测, 伪标签, 物体跟踪, 视频感知, 3D标注
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用多帧跟踪来解决单目3D检测中标签稀缺和几何模糊的问题。通过无需辅助传感器或模型重训练的方法，实现了高质量的伪标签生成，具有很强的实际应用价值。其局限性可能在于对视频连续性和物体跟踪准确性的依赖。

title: Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning with Diverse Solving Perspective
summary: Recent progress in large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) has notably enhanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), especially in mathematical domains. However, current multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for mathematical reasoning often rely on one-to-one image-text pairs and single-solution supervision, overlooking the diversity of valid reasoning perspectives and internal reflections. In this work, we introduce MathV-DP, a novel dataset that captures multiple diverse solution trajectories for each image-question pair, fostering richer reasoning supervision. We further propose Qwen-VL-DP, a model built upon Qwen-VL, fine-tuned with supervised learning and enhanced via group relative policy optimization (GRPO), a rule-based RL approach that integrates correctness discrimination and diversity-aware reward functions. Our method emphasizes learning from varied reasoning perspectives and distinguishing between correct yet distinct solutions. Extensive experiments on the MathVista's minitest and Math-V benchmarks demonstrate that Qwen-VL-DP significantly outperforms prior base MLLMs in both accuracy and generative diversity, highlighting the importance of incorporating diverse perspectives and reflective reasoning in multimodal mathematical reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 具有多样化解题视角的多模态数学推理
AI.tldr: 通过引入包含多种解题路径的数据集及基于GRPO的强化学习训练，显著提升了多模态大模型在数学推理中的表现与解题多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型在数学推理中往往局限于单一的解题路径和监督方式，忽略了解决数学问题的多样化视角及模型内部的反思能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含多种解题轨迹的MathV-DP数据集；基于Qwen-VL模型，采用监督微调与群组相对策略优化（GRPO）算法进行训练，并引入了正确性判别与多样性感知奖励函数。
AI.result: 在MathVista minitest和Math-V基准测试中，Qwen-VL-DP在准确率和生成多样性方面均显著优于现有的基准多模态大模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入多样化解题路径数据集和基于GRPO的强化学习训练方法，Qwen-VL-DP模型在多模态数学推理任务中实现了准确性与生成多样性的双重提升。
AI.translation: 大规模强化学习（RL）的最新进展显著增强了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，特别是在数学领域。然而，当前用于数学推理的多模态大模型（MLLM）往往依赖于一对一的图文对和单一解题监督，忽略了有效推理视角的多样性和内部反思。在这项工作中，我们引入了MathV-DP，这是一个为每个图文问题对捕获多种多样解题轨迹的新数据集，旨在促进更丰富的推理监督。我们进一步提出了Qwen-VL-DP，这是一个基于Qwen-VL构建的模型，通过监督学习进行微调，并利用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行增强。GRPO是一种基于规则的强化学习方法，集成了正确性判别和多样性感知奖励函数。我们的方法强调学习不同的推理视角，并区分正确但不同的解决方案。在MathVista minitest和Math-V基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Qwen-VL-DP在准确性和生成多样性方面均显著优于先前的基准MLLM，突显了在多模态数学推理中纳入多样化视角和反思性推理的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态大模型在数学推理中缺乏多样性监督的问题，提出了MathV-DP数据集和Qwen-VL-DP模型。通过集成多种解题视角和基于GRPO的强化学习策略，模型在保持高准确性的同时，显著提升了推理过程的丰富性与反思能力。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 数学推理, 强化学习, 多样化视角, 数据集构建
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于不仅关注数学推理的准确性，还引入了多样化解题视角（Diverse Solving Perspectives），通过构建包含多种解题路径的数据集并结合GRPO强化学习算法，弥补了当前多模态大模型在推理灵活性和反思能力上的不足，具有很高的研究价值。

title: Efficient Unlearning with Privacy Guarantees
summary: Privacy protection laws, such as the GDPR, grant individuals the right to request the forgetting of their personal data not only from databases but also from machine learning (ML) models trained on them. Machine unlearning has emerged as a practical means to facilitate model forgetting of data instances seen during training. Although some existing machine unlearning methods guarantee exact forgetting, they are typically costly in computational terms. On the other hand, more affordable methods do not offer forgetting guarantees and are applicable only to specific ML models. In this paper, we present \emph{efficient unlearning with privacy guarantees} (EUPG), a novel machine unlearning framework that offers formal privacy guarantees to individuals whose data are being unlearned. EUPG involves pre-training ML models on data protected using privacy models, and it enables {\em efficient unlearning with the privacy guarantees offered by the privacy models in use}. Through empirical evaluation on four heterogeneous data sets protected with $k$-anonymity and $ε$-differential privacy as privacy models, our approach demonstrates utility and forgetting effectiveness comparable to those of exact unlearning methods, while significantly reducing computational and storage costs. Our code is available at https://github.com/najeebjebreel/EUPG.

title: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions
comments: Y. Hu and Y. Wang contribute equally
summary: Recent benchmarks for Large Language Model (LLM) agents primarily focus on evaluating reasoning, planning, and execution capabilities, while another critical component-memory, encompassing how agents memorize, update, and retrieve long-term information-is under-evaluated due to the lack of benchmarks. We term agents with memory mechanisms as memory agents. In this paper, based on classic theories from memory science and cognitive science, we identify four core competencies essential for memory agents: accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting. Existing benchmarks either rely on limited context lengths or are tailored for static, long-context settings like book-based QA, which do not reflect the interactive, multi-turn nature of memory agents that incrementally accumulate information. Moreover, no existing benchmarks cover all four competencies. We introduce MemoryAgentBench, a new benchmark specifically designed for memory agents. Our benchmark transforms existing long-context datasets and incorporates newly constructed datasets into a multi-turn format, effectively simulating the incremental information processing characteristic of memory agents. By carefully selecting and curating datasets, our benchmark provides comprehensive coverage of the four core memory competencies outlined above, thereby offering a systematic and challenging testbed for assessing memory quality. We evaluate a diverse set of memory agents, ranging from simple context-based and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems to advanced agents with external memory modules and tool integration. Empirical results reveal that current methods fall short of mastering all four competencies, underscoring the need for further research into comprehensive memory mechanisms for LLM agents.

title: LoRAShield: Data-Free Editing Alignment for Secure Personalized LoRA Sharing
summary: The proliferation of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) models has democratized personalized text-to-image generation, enabling users to share lightweight models (e.g., personal portraits) on platforms like Civitai and Liblib. However, this "share-and-play" ecosystem introduces critical risks: benign LoRAs can be weaponized by adversaries to generate harmful content (e.g., political, defamatory imagery), undermining creator rights and platform safety. Existing defenses like concept-erasure methods focus on full diffusion models (DMs), neglecting LoRA's unique role as a modular adapter and its vulnerability to adversarial prompt engineering. To bridge this gap, we propose LoRAShield, the first data-free editing framework for securing LoRA models against misuse. Our platform-driven approach dynamically edits and realigns LoRA's weight subspace via adversarial optimization and semantic augmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRAShield achieves remarkable effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness in blocking malicious generations without sacrificing the functionality of the benign task. By shifting the defense to platforms, LoRAShield enables secure, scalable sharing of personalized models, a critical step toward trustworthy generative ecosystems.

AI.title_translation: LoRAShield：面向安全个性化LoRA共享的数据无关编辑对齐方法
AI.tldr: LoRAShield提供了一种无需训练数据即可编辑LoRA模型权重的方法，能够有效防止其被用于生成恶意内容，同时保持模型的正常功能。
AI.motivation: LoRA模型在个性化生成领域的广泛应用带来了安全风险，现有的概念擦除方法多针对完整扩散模型，不适用于LoRA的模块化特性，且无法有效应对对抗性提示词攻击。
AI.method: 提出了一种数据无关的编辑框架，通过对抗性优化和语义增强，动态编辑并重对齐LoRA的权重子空间，从而在平台端实现对恶意生成的阻断。
AI.result: 实验表明，LoRAShield在不损害模型原有功能的前提下，能够有效、高效且稳健地拦截恶意内容生成，实现了安全且可扩展的个性化模型共享。
AI.conclusion: LoRAShield通过数据无关的编辑与重对齐技术，为LoRA模型提供了一种高效、稳健的防御手段，有效降低了恶意生成风险，促进了个人化模型的安全共享。
AI.translation: 低秩自适应（LoRA）模型的普及使得个性化文本生成图像变得民主化，用户可以在Civitai和Liblib等平台上共享轻量级模型（如个人肖像）。然而，这种“共享即用”的生态系统引入了严重风险：良性LoRA可能被攻击者利用来生成有害内容（如政治、诽谤性图像），损害创作者权利和平台安全。现有的概念擦除方法主要关注完整扩散模型（DM），忽略了LoRA作为模块化适配器的独特作用及其在对抗性提示工程下的脆弱性。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了LoRAShield，这是第一个用于保护LoRA模型免受滥用的数据无关编辑框架。我们的平台驱动方法通过对抗性优化和语义增强，动态编辑并重对齐LoRA的权重子空间。实验结果表明，LoRAShield在不牺牲良性任务功能的前提下，在拦截恶意生成方面表现出卓越的有效性、效率和稳健性。通过将防御机制转移到平台端，LoRAShield实现了个性化模型的安全、可扩展共享，这是迈向可信生成生态系统的关键一步。
AI.summary: LoRAShield是一个专为LoRA模型设计的安全框架，通过无需原始数据的动态权重子空间编辑与重对齐，有效防御了针对LoRA的恶意提示词攻击，保障了生成式AI平台的安全与可信度。
AI.keywords: LoRA, 内容安全, 对抗性优化, 模型编辑, 文本生成图像
AI.comments: LoRAShield填补了LoRA模型安全共享领域的空白，提出了针对特定适配器结构的防御机制。其创新之处在于无需原始训练数据即可进行编辑，且能够有效平衡安全性和模型功能，对于构建可信的生成式AI生态具有重要意义。

title: StarDojo: Benchmarking Open-Ended Behaviors of Agentic Multimodal LLMs in Production-Living Simulations with Stardew Valley
comments: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project website: https://weihaotan.github.io/StarDojo
summary: Autonomous agents navigating human society must master both production activities and social interactions, yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate these skills simultaneously. To bridge this gap, we introduce StarDojo, a novel benchmark based on Stardew Valley, designed to assess AI agents in open-ended production-living simulations. In StarDojo, agents are tasked to perform essential livelihood activities such as farming and crafting, while simultaneously engaging in social interactions to establish relationships within a vibrant community. StarDojo features 1,000 meticulously curated tasks across five key domains: farming, crafting, exploration, combat, and social interactions. Additionally, we provide a compact subset of 100 representative tasks for efficient model evaluation. The benchmark offers a unified, user-friendly interface that eliminates the need for keyboard and mouse control, supports all major operating systems, and enables the parallel execution of multiple environment instances, making it particularly well-suited for evaluating the most capable foundation agents, powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art MLLMs agents demonstrate substantial limitations, with the best-performing model, GPT-4.1, achieving only a 12.7% success rate, primarily due to challenges in visual understanding, multimodal reasoning and low-level manipulation. As a user-friendly environment and benchmark, StarDojo aims to facilitate further research towards robust, open-ended agents in complex production-living environments.
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project website: https://weihaotan.github.io/StarDojo

AI.title_translation: StarDojo：在《星露谷物语》生产生活模拟中对代理式多模态大语言模型开放式行为的基准测试
AI.tldr: StarDojo通过《星露谷物语》构建了一个综合基准，揭示了当前最强多模态智能体在处理复杂生产与社交任务时仅有12.7%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试难以同时评估智能体在生产活动与社会互动方面的综合能力，缺乏针对开放式生产生活模拟的全面评估工具。
AI.method: 构建基于《星露谷物语》的StarDojo基准测试，包含1,000个涵盖农业、工艺、探索、战斗和社交的任务，并提供统一的API接口供多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行评估。
AI.result: 对最先进的MLLM智能体进行评估，结果显示即使是表现最好的GPT-4.1，成功率也仅为12.7%，主要受限于视觉理解、多模态推理及底层操作能力。
AI.conclusion: StarDojo为评估智能体在复杂仿真环境中的综合能力提供了基准，研究表明当前最先进的MLLM智能体在处理此类开放式任务时仍面临严峻挑战。
AI.translation: 自主智能体在人类社会中导航时，必须同时掌握生产活动和社会互动，但现有的基准测试很少同时评估这些技能。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了StarDojo，这是一个基于《星露谷物语》的新型基准测试，旨在评估开放式生产生活模拟中的AI智能体。在StarDojo中，智能体的任务是执行耕作和制作等基本的生计活动，同时进行社交互动以在充满活力的社区中建立关系。StarDojo在农业、工艺、探索、战斗和社交互动五个关键领域中拥有1,000个精心策划的任务。此外，我们提供了一个包含100个代表性任务的精简子集，用于高效的模型评估。该基准测试提供了一个统一、用户友好的接口，无需键盘和鼠标控制，支持所有主流操作系统，并支持多个环境实例的并行执行，非常适合评估由多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）驱动的最强基础智能体。对最先进的MLLM智能体进行的广泛评估表明，它们存在重大局限性，表现最好的模型GPT-4.1的成功率仅为12.7%，这主要是由于在视觉理解、多模态推理和底层操作方面存在挑战。作为一个用户友好的环境和基准测试，StarDojo旨在促进对复杂生产生活环境中稳健、开放式智能体的进一步研究。
AI.summary: StarDojo是一个基于《星露谷物语》的全新基准测试，旨在评估多模态大语言模型在开放式生产生活模拟环境中的综合表现，涵盖了从农业生产到社区社交的广泛任务。
AI.keywords: 智能体, 多模态大语言模型, 基准测试, 开放式模拟, 星露谷物语
AI.comments: 该论文填补了评估智能体在开放式、生产生活模拟环境中综合能力的空白。其创新之处在于利用《星露谷物语》作为高维仿真平台，并构建了涵盖生产与社交的综合性基准测试。局限性在于目前的MLLM智能体表现极差，揭示了当前多模态模型在复杂任务规划与底层操作上的巨大瓶颈。

title: SCREP: Scene Coordinate Regression and Evidential Learning-based Perception-Aware Trajectory Generation
summary: Autonomous flight in GPS-denied indoor spaces requires trajectories that keep visual-localization error tightly bounded across varied missions. Map-based visual localization methods such as feature matching require computationally intensive map reconstruction and have feature-storage scalability issues, especially for large environments. Scene coordinate regression (SCR) provides an efficient learning-based alternative that directly predicts3D coordinates for every pixel, enabling absolute pose estimation with significant potential for onboard roboticsapplications. We present a perception-aware trajectory planner that couples an evidential learning-based SCR poseestimator with a receding-horizon trajectory optimizer. The optimizer steers the onboard camera toward reliablescene coordinates with low uncertainty, while a fixed-lag smoother fuses the low-rate SCR pose estimates with high-rate IMU data to provide a high-quality, high-rate pose estimate. In simulation, our planner reduces translationand rotation RMSE by at least 4.9% and 30.8% relative to baselines, respectively. Hardware-in-the-loop experiments validate the feasibility of our proposed trajectory planner under close-to-real deployment conditions.

AI.title_translation: SCREP：基于场景坐标回归与证据学习的感知感知轨迹生成
AI.tldr: 一种通过主动优化飞行路径以最小化视觉定位不确定性的无人机轨迹规划新方法。
AI.motivation: 在无GPS室内环境中，传统基于地图的视觉定位方法计算开销大且难以扩展；现有的定位方法往往忽略了感知不确定性对轨迹生成的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一种感知感知轨迹规划器，结合了基于证据学习的场景坐标回归（SCR）位姿估计器和后退视界轨迹优化器；利用固定滞后平滑器融合低频SCR位姿估计与高频IMU数据。
AI.result: 在仿真中，该规划器将平移和旋转的RMSE分别至少降低了4.9%和30.8%；硬件在环实验证实了其在实际部署条件下的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，SCREP框架能有效降低室内自主飞行中的位姿估计误差，并在复杂的硬件在环测试中验证了其可行性。
AI.translation: 在无GPS的室内空间进行自主飞行需要确保视觉定位误差在各种任务中受到严格限制。基于地图的视觉定位方法（如特征匹配）需要计算密集型的地图重建，且在大规模环境中存在特征存储可扩展性问题。场景坐标回归（SCR）提供了一种高效的基于学习的替代方案，可直接预测每个像素的3D坐标，从而实现绝对位姿估计，在机载机器人应用中具有巨大潜力。我们提出了一种感知感知轨迹规划器，将基于证据学习的SCR位姿估计器与后退视界轨迹优化器相结合。优化器引导机载摄像头朝向具有低不确定性的可靠场景坐标，同时固定滞后平滑器融合低速率SCR位姿估计与高速率IMU数据，以提供高质量、高速率的位姿估计。在仿真中，我们的规划器将平移和旋转RMSE分别比基准线至少降低了4.9%和30.8%。硬件在环实验验证了我们提出的轨迹规划器在接近真实部署条件下的可行性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SCREP的感知感知轨迹生成框架，旨在解决室内自主飞行中的视觉定位误差。该方法利用证据学习进行场景坐标回归以估计位姿，并将其不确定性反馈给轨迹优化器，引导无人机避开定位不可靠的区域，从而实现更高精度的飞行。
AI.keywords: 自主飞行, 场景坐标回归, 证据学习, 轨迹规划, 视觉定位
AI.comments: 该论文通过将场景坐标回归（SCR）与证据学习相结合，解决了自主飞行中视觉定位的不确定性问题。其创新点在于将定位不确定性显式地整合到轨迹规划中，使无人机能够主动避开定位不可靠区域，在资源受限环境下具有很高的实用价值。

title: Beer Path Problems in Temporal Graphs
summary:
Computing paths in graph structures is a fundamental operation in a wide range of applications, from transportation networks to data analysis. The beer path problem, which captures the option of visiting points of interest, such as gas stations or convenience stops, prior to reaching the final destination, has been recently introduced and extensively studied in static graphs. However, existing approaches do not account for temporal information, which is often crucial in real-world scenarios. For instance, transit services may follow fixed schedules, and shops may only be accessible during certain hours.
  In this work, we introduce the notion of beer paths in temporal graphs, where edges are time-dependent and certain vertices (beer vertices) are active only at specific time instances. We formally define the problems of computing earliest-arrival, latest-departure, fastest, and shortest temporal beer paths and propose efficient algorithms for these problems under both edge stream and adjacency list representations. The time complexity of each of our algorithms is aligned with that of corresponding temporal pathfinding algorithms, thus preserving efficiency.
  Additionally, we present preprocessing techniques that enable efficient query answering under dynamic conditions, for example new openings or closings of shops. We achieve this through appropriate precomputation of selected paths or by transforming a temporal graph into an equivalent static graph.

AI.title_translation: 时间图中的啤酒路径问题
AI.tldr: 本文将啤酒路径问题引入时间图，解决了在考虑时间限制（如营业时间）的情况下，如何高效寻找最早到达、最晚出发、最快及最短路径的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的啤酒路径问题研究仅限于静态图，忽略了现实场景中关键的时间信息（如交通时刻表、商店营业时间等），因此需要将该问题扩展到时间依赖的图结构中。
AI.method: 正式定义了时间图中的啤酒路径问题，并针对边流和邻接表两种表示形式，提出了计算最早到达、最晚出发、最快和最短时间啤酒路径的高效算法；同时引入了预处理技术（如路径预计算或图转换）以支持动态条件下的快速查询。
AI.result: 提出的算法在计算复杂度上与传统的时间路径规划算法保持一致，确保了处理大规模时间图时的效率；预处理技术进一步提升了在商店营业状态动态变化场景下的响应速度。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功定义了时间图中的啤酒路径问题，并为四种主要路径类型（最早到达、最晚出发、最快、最短）提供了高效算法，证明了该方法在处理复杂时间约束下的可行性与高效性。
AI.translation:
在图结构中计算路径是交通网络到数据分析等广泛应用中的一项基本操作。啤酒路径问题捕捉了在到达最终目的地之前访问兴趣点（如加油站或便利店）的选择，最近被引入并已在静态图中得到广泛研究。然而，现有的方法并未考虑时间信息，而这在现实场景中通常至关重要。例如，交通服务可能遵循固定的时间表，商店可能仅在特定时间段内开放。
在本文中，我们引入了时间图中的啤酒路径概念，其中边是时间依赖的，且某些顶点（啤酒顶点）仅在特定的时间实例处于活动状态。我们正式定义了计算最早到达、最晚出发、最快和最短时间啤酒路径的问题，并针对边流和邻接表表示法提出了这些问题的有效算法。我们每个算法的时间复杂度都与相应的时间路径查找算法保持一致，从而保持了效率。
此外，我们提出了预处理技术，能够实现动态条件（例如商店的新开或关闭）下的高效查询响应。我们通过对选定路径进行适当的预计算，或将时间图转换为等效的静态图来实现这一点。
AI.summary: 本文将“啤酒路径”问题从静态图扩展至时间图，定义了时间依赖边和特定时间激活的顶点。作者提出了针对四种路径优化目标的有效算法，并结合预处理技术，实现了在动态时间图中的高效路径查询。
AI.keywords: 时间图, 啤酒路径, 路径规划, 算法效率, 动态环境
AI.comments: 该研究将静态图中的“啤酒路径”问题扩展到了时间图领域，考虑了时间依赖性和顶点的激活时间窗口，具有很强的实际应用价值。其创新点在于将时间约束引入路径规划，并保持了与传统时间路径算法相当的计算效率，同时提出的预处理技术增强了在动态环境下的查询灵活性。

title: Finite Pinwheel Scheduling: the k-Visits Problem
summary:
Pinwheel Scheduling is a fundamental scheduling problem, in which each task $i$ is associated with a positive integer $d_i$, and the objective is to schedule one task per time slot, ensuring each task perpetually appears at least once in every $d_i$ time slots. Although conjectured to be PSPACE-complete, it remains open whether Pinwheel Scheduling is NP-hard (unless a compact input encoding is used) or even contained in NP.
  We introduce k-Visits, a finite version of Pinwheel Scheduling, where given n deadlines, the goal is to schedule each task exactly k times. While we observe that the 1-Visit problem is trivial, we prove that 2-Visits is strongly NP-complete through a surprising reduction from Numerical 3-Dimensional Matching (N3DM). As intermediate steps in the reduction, we define NP-complete variants of N3DM which may be of independent interest. We further extend our strong NP-hardness result to a generalization of k-Visits $k\geq 2$ in which the deadline of each task may vary throughout the schedule, as well as to a similar generalization of Pinwheel Scheduling, thus making progress towards settling the complexity of Pinwheel Scheduling.
  Additionally, we prove that 2-Visits can be solved in linear time if all deadlines are distinct, rendering it one of the rare natural problems which exhibit the interesting dichotomy of being in P if their input is a set and NP-complete if the input is a multiset. We achieve this through a Turing reduction from 2-Visits to a variation of N3DM, which we call Position Matching. Based on this reduction, we also show an FPT algorithm for 2-Visits parameterized by a value related to how close the input deadlines are to each other, as well as a linear-time algorithm for instances with up to two distinct deadlines.

title: Inexact calculus of variations on the hyperspherical tangent bundle with connections to the attention mechanism
summary: We offer a theoretical mathematical background through Lagrangian optimization on the unit hyperspherical manifold and its tangential structure. Our methods can be categorized as inexact since our methods are projection-based and since we will perturb the functional optimization with epsilon-type quantities. We draw connections to the attention mechanism and the Transformer since it exists as a flow map in the tangent fiber for each token along the high-dimensional unit sphere. Our motivation for this work is primarily twofold: we study the attention mechanism under its flow map and its relations to traditional calculus of variations and Lagrangian optimization; and we study a range of calculus of variations on the unit hypersphere that appeal to a broader mathematical lens in approximating, variational contexts.

AI.title_translation: 超球切丛上的不精确变分法及其与注意力机制的联系
AI.tldr: 本文将Transformer的注意力机制建模为超球切丛上的变分流映射，为理解其动态演化提供了几何理论框架。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索注意力机制作为流映射（flow map）与传统变分法及拉格朗日优化之间的深层联系，并研究超球面上变分法在近似与变分背景下的广泛应用。
AI.method: 基于投影的近似方法，通过在泛函优化中引入epsilon量进行扰动，并在单位超球流形及其切丛结构上进行拉格朗日优化。
AI.result: 建立了注意力机制与单位超球切丛上流映射之间的数学联系，并提出了一套处理超球面上不精确变分问题的理论框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过将注意力机制建模为单位超球切丛上的不精确变分问题，该研究为理解Transformer的动态演化提供了一个坚实的几何数学框架。
AI.translation: 我们通过单位超球流形及其切向结构上的拉格朗日优化，提供了一个理论数学背景。由于我们的方法是基于投影的，并且我们用epsilon型量扰动泛函优化，因此我们的方法可以归类为不精确的。我们将注意力机制和Transformer联系起来，因为它们作为高维单位球上每个token在切纤维中的流映射而存在。我们这项工作的动机主要有两个：我们研究了注意力机制及其流映射，以及它与传统变分法和拉格朗日优化的关系；我们研究了单位超球上的一系列变分法，这些变分法在近似和变分背景下诉诸于更广泛的数学视角。
AI.summary: 本文提出了单位超球切丛上的不精确变分法，旨在为Transformer中的注意力机制提供数学建模。作者将注意力机制解释为高维单位超球上每个token在切纤维中的流映射，并利用基于投影的近似与扰动方法进行优化分析。
AI.keywords: 变分法, 超球切丛, 注意力机制, 变换器, 流形优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过变分法与流形几何的视角重新审视了Transformer中的注意力机制，具有很高的理论创新性。其局限性在于主要侧重于数学建模与理论推导，缺乏在实际大规模训练任务中的性能评估或实验验证。

title: Beyond Correlation: Learning Supervised, Sample-Distinct, and Eigenimage-Interpretable Representations
summary: Conventional dimensionality reduction methods mainly optimize variance or correlation, leaving statistical dependence, data diversity, contrast, and interpretability under addressed. We propose three new independence criteria for designing supervised and unsupervised dimensionality reduction (DR) methods, aiming to improve feature extraction and representation quality. Our framework combines linear and nonlinear formulations and is evaluated using contrast, classification accuracy, and interpretability measures. The interpretability of eigenfaces helps to effectively summarize dominant class-specific structures and trends within representative images. Evaluated on MNIST and a Gender face dataset for classification and reconstruction, our methods achieve significant improvements in contrast (up to $+$20.1\%), accuracy (up to $+$17.4\%), and interpretability (up to $+$120.0\%) over Principal Component Analysis (PCA), t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE), Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), and Variational Autoencoder (VAE) baselines, while also improving VAE reconstruction performance by 9.5\%. These results suggest a promising direction for interpretable representation learning based on statistical dependence and independence criteria.

AI.title_translation: 超越相关性：学习监督式、样本区分度高且特征脸可解释的表示方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于统计独立性准则的新型降维框架，在提升分类准确率的同时，显著增强了特征的可解释性和图像对比度。
AI.motivation: 传统降维方法主要关注方差或相关性，忽略了统计依赖性、数据多样性、对比度和可解释性，导致特征提取质量有限。
AI.method: 提出了三种新型独立性准则，结合线性与非线性公式构建降维框架，并利用特征脸（eigenfaces）技术增强图像结构的可解释性。
AI.result: 在MNIST和Gender人脸数据集上，相比PCA、t-SNE、LDA和VAE，对比度提升达20.1%，分类准确率提升达17.4%，可解释性提升达120.0%，且VAE重构性能提升9.5%。
AI.conclusion: 基于统计独立性准则的降维方法在对比度、分类准确率和可解释性方面均优于PCA、t-SNE、LDA和VAE等传统基准，证明了该框架在表示学习中的有效性和广阔前景。
AI.translation: 传统的降维方法主要优化方差或相关性，而对统计依赖性、数据多样性、对比度和可解释性关注不足。我们提出了三种新的独立性准则，用于设计监督和非监督降维（DR）方法，旨在改善特征提取和表示质量。我们的框架结合了线性和非线性公式，并通过对比度、分类准确率和可解释性指标进行评估。特征脸（eigenfaces）的可解释性有助于有效总结代表性图像中占主导地位的类特定结构和趋势。在MNIST和Gender人脸数据集上的分类和重构评估显示，我们的方法在对比度（最高+20.1%）、准确率（最高+17.4%）和可解释性（最高+120.0%）方面比主成分分析（PCA）、t-分布随机邻域嵌入（t-SNE）、线性判别分析（LDA）和变分自编码器（VAE）基准有显著提高，同时将VAE重构性能提高了9.5%。这些结果表明，基于统计依赖性和独立性准则的可解释表示学习是一个有前景的方向。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于三种新型独立性准则的降维框架，旨在解决传统方法在统计依赖和可解释性方面的不足。该方法通过线性与非线性结合，在分类和重构任务中展现了显著优于主流基准的性能，特别是在增强特征的可解释性方面表现突出。
AI.keywords: 降维, 独立性准则, 特征提取, 可解释性, 表示学习
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入新的独立性准则，成功平衡了监督学习任务中的分类性能与特征的可解释性。其核心价值在于证明了统计依赖性度量能够显著提升模型在对比度、准确率和可解释性方面的表现，为构建更透明的表示学习模型提供了新思路。

title: Model Directions, Not Words: Mechanistic Topic Models Using Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Traditional topic models are effective at uncovering latent themes in large text collections. However, due to their reliance on bag-of-words representations, they struggle to capture semantically abstract features. While some neural variants use richer representations, they are similarly constrained by expressing topics as word lists, which limits their ability to articulate complex topics. We introduce Mechanistic Topic Models (MTMs), a class of topic models that operate on interpretable features learned by sparse autoencoders (SAEs). By defining topics over this semantically rich space, MTMs can reveal deeper conceptual themes with expressive feature descriptions. Moreover, uniquely among topic models, MTMs enable controllable text generation using topic steering vectors. To properly evaluate MTM topics against word list approaches, we propose \textit{topic judge}, an LLM-based pairwise comparison evaluation framework. Across eight datasets, MTMs match or exceed traditional and neural baselines on coherence metrics, are consistently preferred by topic judge, and enable effective LLM steering.

title: A Conditional GAN for Tabular Data Generation with Probabilistic Sampling of Latent Subspaces
summary: The tabular form constitutes the standard way of representing data in relational database systems and spreadsheets. But, similarly to other forms, tabular data suffers from class imbalance, a problem that causes serious performance degradation in a wide variety of machine learning tasks. One of the most effective solutions dictates the usage of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in order to synthesize artificial data instances for the under-represented classes. Despite their good performance, none of the proposed GAN models takes into account the vector subspaces of the input samples in the real data space, leading to data generation in arbitrary locations. Moreover, the class labels are treated in the same manner as the other categorical variables during training, so conditional sampling by class is rendered less effective. To overcome these problems, this study presents ctdGAN, a conditional GAN for alleviating class imbalance in tabular datasets. Initially, ctdGAN executes a space partitioning step to assign cluster labels to the input samples. Subsequently, it utilizes these labels to synthesize samples via a novel probabilistic sampling strategy and a new loss function that penalizes both cluster and class mis-predictions. In this way, ctdGAN is trained to generate samples in subspaces that resemble those of the original data distribution. We also introduce several other improvements, including a simple, yet effective cluster-wise scaling technique that captures multiple feature modes without affecting data dimensionality. The exhaustive evaluation of ctdGAN with 14 imbalanced datasets demonstrated its superiority in generating high fidelity samples and improving classification accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于表格数据生成的、具有潜在子空间概率采样的条件GAN
AI.tldr: ctdGAN通过引入空间划分和概率采样策略，解决了表格数据生成中子空间分布被忽略和类别不平衡的问题，有效提升了合成数据的质量与分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GAN模型在处理表格数据时忽略了输入样本的潜在子空间分布，导致生成数据分布不准确；同时，处理类别标签的方式使得条件采样效果欠佳，难以有效解决类别不平衡导致的机器学习性能下降问题。
AI.method: 提出ctdGAN模型，首先对输入样本进行空间划分以分配聚类标签，随后采用一种新的概率采样策略和损失函数（惩罚聚类和类别预测错误），并引入聚类缩放技术来捕捉多特征模态。
AI.result: 在14个不平衡数据集上的评估表明，ctdGAN在生成高保真度样本方面表现优越，并显著提升了后续分类任务的准确性。
AI.conclusion: ctdGAN通过空间划分、概率采样策略及改进的损失函数，有效地解决了表格数据中的类别不平衡问题，在保持数据高保真度的同时显著提升了分类任务的准确性。
AI.translation: 表格形式是关系数据库和电子表格中表示数据的标准方式。但与其他形式一样，表格数据也存在类别不平衡问题，这在各种机器学习任务中会导致严重的性能下降。最有效的解决方案之一是使用生成对抗网络（GAN）为代表性不足的类别合成人工数据实例。尽管性能良好，但目前提出的GAN模型都没有考虑真实数据空间中输入样本的向量子空间，导致在任意位置生成数据。此外，在训练过程中，类别标签的处理方式与其他分类变量相同，因此按类别进行的条件采样效果较差。为了克服这些问题，本研究提出了ctdGAN，一种用于缓解表格数据集中类别不平衡的条件GAN。首先，ctdGAN执行空间划分步骤，为输入样本分配聚类标签。随后，它利用这些标签通过一种新颖的概率采样策略和一种惩罚聚类和类别误预测的新损失函数来合成样本。通过这种方式，ctdGAN被训练以在类似于原始数据分布的子空间中生成样本。我们还引入了其他几项改进，包括一种简单而有效的聚类缩放技术，它可以在不影响数据维度的情况下捕捉多个特征模态。对14个不平衡数据集的详尽评估证明了ctdGAN在生成高保真样本和提高分类准确性方面的优越性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ctdGAN，这是一种专门用于缓解表格数据类别不平衡问题的条件GAN。该模型通过空间划分和概率采样策略，确保生成的样本能够分布在与原始数据分布相似的潜在子空间中，并引入了新的损失函数和聚类缩放技术，有效提升了生成数据的质量和分类任务的表现。
AI.keywords: 表格数据生成, 类别不平衡, 生成对抗网络, 空间划分, 概率采样
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将空间划分（space partitioning）引入表格数据生成任务，通过聚类标签和概率采样策略，解决了传统GAN在生成数据时忽略输入样本潜在子空间分布的问题。这种方法不仅提升了合成数据的保真度，还通过改进的损失函数和缩放技术增强了对多特征模态的捕捉能力，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Reconsidering Overthinking: Penalizing Internal and External Redundancy in CoT Reasoning
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often exhibit overthinking, producing verbose Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces that increase inference cost and obscure the underlying reasoning process. Existing CoT compression methods mainly rely on global length rewards, which conflate necessary intermediate reasoning with redundant text and may therefore compromise reasoning fidelity. This paper revisits overthinking from a semantic-efficiency perspective and decomposes CoT redundancy into two distinct forms: internal redundancy, defined as informational stagnation before the first correct answer, and external redundancy, defined as superfluous continuation after the first correct answer. Based on this decomposition, we propose a dual-penalty reinforcement learning framework that separately optimizes reasoning progress and termination behavior. Specifically, a sliding-window semantic similarity metric penalizes low-progress reasoning segments, while a normalized external-redundancy metric discourages post-answer continuation. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH500, and AIME24 across different model scales show that our method reduces average reasoning length by 41.3% on the 1.5B model and 40.1% on the 7B model, while preserving competitive accuracy and achieving the best overall accuracy-efficiency score among evaluated baselines. The learned compression behavior further transfers to out-of-domain reasoning tasks, including GPQA and LiveCodeBench. More importantly, our analysis reveals a clear asymmetry between the two redundancy types: external redundancy can be largely removed with little performance loss, whereas internal redundancy compression follows a sensitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off. These results suggest that effective CoT compression should optimize semantic efficiency rather than sequence length alone, offering a principled route toward more concise, efficient, and interpretable LRMs.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: Multi-Class Human/Object Detection on Robot Manipulators using Proprioceptive Sensing
comments: 2025 IEEE 21st International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), Los Angeles, CA, USA
summary: In physical human-robot collaboration (pHRC) settings, humans and robots collaborate directly in shared environments. Robots must analyze interactions with objects to ensure safety and facilitate meaningful workflows. One critical aspect is human/object detection, where the contacted object is identified. Past research introduced binary machine learning classifiers to distinguish between soft and hard objects. This study improves upon those results by evaluating three-class human/object detection models, offering more detailed contact analysis. A dataset was collected using the Franka Emika Panda robot manipulator, exploring preprocessing strategies for time-series analysis. Models including LSTM, GRU, and Transformers were trained on these datasets. The best-performing model achieved 91.11\% accuracy during real-time testing, demonstrating the feasibility of multi-class detection models. Additionally, a comparison of preprocessing strategies suggests a sliding window approach is optimal for this task.
