AI.title_translation: 注意力Transformer中用于间接宾语识别的最小化电路的涌现
AI.tldr: 研究通过训练极简Transformer模型，揭示了间接宾语识别任务中仅需两个注意力头即可实现完美推理的最小化计算电路。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型过于复杂，难以直接观察到特定推理任务所需的最小化计算机制，因此需要通过简化模型和任务来深入理解Transformer的推理本质。
AI.method: 从头训练仅包含注意力层的微型Transformer模型，并通过残差流分解、谱分析及嵌入干预等技术手段解析模型内部的逻辑电路。
AI.result: 发现单层仅含两个注意力头的模型即可完美实现间接宾语识别（IOI），且这两个头分别专门负责加性与对比性子电路；同时验证了多层模型主要通过查询-键交互进行信息组合。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过特定任务训练可以诱导出高度可解释的最小化电路，从而为理解Transformer推理的计算基础提供了清晰的视角。
AI.translation: 机制可解释性旨在将大型语言模型（LLM）逆向工程为人类可理解的计算电路。然而，预训练模型的复杂性往往掩盖了特定推理任务所需的最小化机制。在这项工作中，我们从头训练了小型、纯注意力Transformer模型，并使用间接宾语识别（IOI）任务的符号版本进行训练，该任务是研究Transformer中类指代推理的基准。令人惊讶的是，尽管缺乏MLP和归一化层，一个仅有两个注意力头的单层模型实现了完美的IOI准确率。通过残差流分解、谱分析和嵌入干预，我们发现这两个头专门化为加性和对比性子电路，共同实现了IOI解析。此外，我们展示了一个两层、单头的模型主要通过查询-键交互来组合来自前一层的信息。这些结果表明，特定任务的训练诱导出了高度可解释的最小化电路，为探索Transformer推理的计算基础提供了一个受控的测试平台。
AI.summary: 本文通过从头训练简化的注意力Transformer模型，成功揭示了间接宾语识别（IOI）任务背后的最小化计算电路，验证了特定任务训练能诱导出高度可解释的结构。
AI.keywords: 机制可解释性, 间接宾语识别 (IOI), 注意力机制, 电路分析, Transformer架构
AI.comments: 该研究通过简化模型和任务，成功揭示了Transformer在处理特定推理任务时的最小化计算电路。这种“从头训练”的方法论为理解LLM的黑盒机制提供了一个极佳的受控实验环境，具有很高的可解释性研究价值。

title: Accelerated decomposition of bistochastic kernel matrices by low rank approximation
summary: We develop an accelerated algorithm for the approximate eigenvalue decomposition of symmetrically normalized kernel matrices, focusing on a bistochastic normalization. Our approach constructs a low rank approximation of the original kernel matrix by the pivoted partial Cholesky algorithm, and uses it to compute an approximate decomposition of its normalization without requiring the formation of the full kernel matrix. The cost of the proposed algorithm depends linearly on the size of the employed training dataset and quadratically on the rank of the low rank approximation, offering a significant cost reduction compared to the naive approach. We derive trace norm error bounds for the approximation of two classes of normalized kernel matrices. We apply the proposed algorithm to the kernel based extraction of spatiotemporal patterns from chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 通过低秩近似加速双随机核矩阵的分解
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过低秩近似加速双随机归一化核矩阵特征值分解的高效算法，显著降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 原始的核矩阵分解方法计算成本高昂，无法有效处理大规模数据集，需要开发一种能够降低计算复杂度的方法。
AI.method: 使用枢轴部分Cholesky算法构建原始核矩阵的低秩近似，并在不显式生成完整核矩阵的前提下，计算其双随机归一化的近似分解。
AI.result: 算法的计算成本与训练集大小呈线性关系，与低秩近似的秩呈二次方关系，相比朴素方法成本显著降低；同时推导出了两种归一化核矩阵的迹范数误差界。
AI.conclusion: 该算法成功实现了双随机归一化核矩阵的加速近似分解，在保持计算效率的同时具备良好的理论保证，并成功应用于复杂动力系统的模式提取。
AI.translation: 我们开发了一种用于对称归一化核矩阵近似特征值分解的加速算法，重点关注双随机归一化。我们的方法通过枢轴部分Cholesky算法构建原始核矩阵的低秩近似，并利用它来计算其归一化的近似分解，而无需形成完整的核矩阵。所提算法的成本取决于训练数据集大小的线性关系和低秩近似秩的二次方关系，与朴素方法相比显著降低了成本。我们推导了两种归一化核矩阵近似的迹范数误差界。我们将所提算法应用于从混沌Kuramoto-Sivashinsky动力学中提取时空模式的核方法中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于对称归一化核矩阵（特别是双随机归一化）的加速近似特征值分解算法。通过利用枢轴部分Cholesky分解构建低秩近似，该方法避免了计算完整核矩阵，实现了计算复杂度的显著降低，并验证了其在复杂动力系统模式提取中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 双随机核矩阵, 低秩近似, 特征值分解, 部分Cholesky算法, 计算效率
AI.comments: 该方法通过避免显式计算完整的核矩阵，显著降低了计算复杂度，为大规模数据集上的核方法应用提供了高效的近似求解方案。其创新点在于将枢轴部分Cholesky分解与双随机归一化相结合，并给出了理论上的误差界。

title: AERMANI-VLM: Structured Prompting and Reasoning for Aerial Manipulation with Vision Language Models
summary: The rapid progress of vision--language models (VLMs) has sparked growing interest in robotic control, where natural language can express the operation goals while visual feedback links perception to action. However, directly deploying VLM-driven policies on aerial manipulators remains unsafe and unreliable since the generated actions are often inconsistent, hallucination-prone, and dynamically infeasible for flight. In this work, we present AERMANI-VLM, the first framework to adapt pretrained VLMs for aerial manipulation by separating high-level reasoning from low-level control, without any task-specific fine-tuning. Our framework encodes natural language instructions, task context, and safety constraints into a structured prompt that guides the model to generate a step-by-step reasoning trace in natural language. This reasoning output is used to select from a predefined library of discrete, flight-safe skills, ensuring interpretable and temporally consistent execution. By decoupling symbolic reasoning from physical action, AERMANI-VLM mitigates hallucinated commands and prevents unsafe behavior, enabling robust task completion. We validate the framework in both simulation and hardware on diverse multi-step pick-and-place tasks, demonstrating strong generalization to previously unseen commands, objects, and environments.

AI.title_translation: AERMANI-VLM：用于空中操作的视觉语言模型结构化提示与推理框架
AI.tldr: AERMANI-VLM 通过结构化提示将 VLM 的高层推理与预定义的飞行安全技能库相结合，解决了无人机操控中动作不稳定和安全性差的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 VLM 直接部署于空中机器人时存在动作不一致、易产生幻觉以及动力学不可行等安全与可靠性问题，难以满足飞行任务的需求。
AI.method: 提出 AERMANI-VLM 框架，将自然语言指令、任务上下文和安全约束编码为结构化提示；利用 VLM 生成分步推理轨迹，并从中选择预定义的、飞行安全的离散技能进行执行，实现了高层推理与底层控制的解耦。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实硬件实验中，该框架在多种多步抓取任务中表现出强大的泛化能力，能够有效抑制幻觉指令，确保了任务的稳健完成。
AI.conclusion: AERMANI-VLM 证明了通过结构化推理与离散技能库的结合，无需微调即可实现预训练 VLM 在空中操作任务中的安全、稳健部署。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的飞速发展激发了人们对机器人控制的浓厚兴趣，即利用自然语言表达操作目标，并通过视觉反馈将感知与动作联系起来。然而，直接将 VLM 驱动的策略部署在空中机械臂上仍然是不安全且不可靠的，因为生成的动作往往不一致、容易产生幻觉，且对于飞行来说在动力学上是不可行的。在这项工作中，我们提出了 AERMANI-VLM，这是首个通过将高层推理与底层控制分离来适应预训练 VLM 进行空中操作的框架，且无需任何特定任务的微调。我们的框架将自然语言指令、任务上下文和安全约束编码为结构化提示，引导模型生成自然语言的分步推理轨迹。此推理输出用于从预定义的离散、飞行安全技能库中进行选择，从而确保可解释且时间上一致的执行。通过将符号推理与物理动作解耦，AERMANI-VLM 减轻了幻觉指令并防止了不安全行为，从而实现了稳健的任务完成。我们在仿真和硬件上针对多样的多步抓取任务验证了该框架，证明了其对未见过的指令、物体和环境的强大泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 AERMANI-VLM 框架，旨在解决视觉语言模型在无人机操控中面临的安全与可靠性问题。通过结构化提示引导模型进行推理，并将其映射到预定义的飞行安全技能库，该方法实现了高层逻辑与底层控制的解耦，无需微调即可在复杂空中操作任务中实现稳健表现。
AI.keywords: 空中操作, 视觉语言模型, 结构化提示, 机器人控制, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文通过结构化提示词（Structured Prompting）成功将大模型应用于对安全性要求极高的无人机操控领域，其创新点在于将推理与执行解耦，利用预定义的技能库规避了直接生成动作带来的不可控风险，为具身智能在复杂动态环境中的部署提供了新思路。

title: CostBench: Evaluating Multi-Turn Cost-Optimal Planning and Adaptation in Dynamic Environments for LLM Tool-Use Agents
summary: Current evaluations of Large Language Model (LLM) agents primarily emphasize task completion, often overlooking resource efficiency and adaptability. This neglects a crucial capability: agents' ability to devise and adjust cost-optimal plans in response to changing environments. To bridge this gap, we introduce CostBench, a scalable, cost-centric benchmark designed to evaluate agents' economic reasoning and replanning abilities. Situated in the travel-planning domain, CostBench comprises tasks solvable via multiple sequences of atomic and composite tools with diverse, customizable costs. It also supports four types of dynamic blocking events, such as tool failures and cost changes, to simulate real-world unpredictability and necessitate agents to adapt in real time. Evaluating leading open-sourced and proprietary models on CostBench reveals a substantial gap in cost-aware planning: agents frequently fail to identify cost-optimal solutions in static settings, with even GPT-5 achieving less than 75% exact match rate on the hardest tasks, and performance further dropping by around 40% under dynamic conditions. By diagnosing these weaknesses, CostBench lays the groundwork for developing future agents that are both economically rational and robust.

AI.title_translation: CostBench：评估LLM工具使用智能体在动态环境中的多轮成本最优规划与适应能力
AI.tldr: CostBench是一个评估LLM智能体在动态环境中进行成本最优规划和适应能力的新型基准，研究表明当前模型在经济推理方面表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估主要关注任务完成度，忽视了资源效率和在动态环境中进行成本优化规划与适应的能力。
AI.method: 开发了CostBench基准测试，涵盖旅行规划领域，包含多种工具组合与可变成本，并引入四种动态阻塞事件（如工具故障和成本变化）来测试智能体的实时规划与适应能力。
AI.result: 研究发现模型在成本感知规划方面存在巨大差距，即使是顶尖模型在静态任务中的最优解准确率不足75%，在动态条件下性能进一步下降约40%。
AI.conclusion: CostBench揭示了当前LLM智能体在成本优化和动态适应方面的显著不足，强调了未来研究需在任务完成度之外，加强对智能体经济理性与鲁棒性的培养。
AI.translation: 当前的各种大语言模型（LLM）智能体评估主要强调任务完成情况，往往忽略了资源效率和适应性。这忽视了一个关键能力：智能体在应对不断变化的环境时制定和调整成本最优计划的能力。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了CostBench，这是一个可扩展的、以成本为中心的基准，旨在评估智能体的经济推理和重新规划能力。CostBench以旅行规划为应用领域，包含可通过多种具有不同且可定制成本的原子和组合工具序列解决的任务。它还支持四种类型的动态阻塞事件，如工具故障和成本变化，以模拟现实世界的不确定性，并要求智能体进行实时适应。在CostBench上对领先的开源和专有模型进行评估显示，智能体在成本感知规划方面存在巨大差距：智能体经常无法在静态设置中识别成本最优解决方案，即使是GPT-5在最困难的任务上的精确匹配率也低于75%，而在动态条件下性能进一步下降了约40%。通过诊断这些弱点，CostBench为开发未来既经济理性又稳健的智能体奠定了基础。
AI.summary: CostBench是一个专注于评估LLM智能体在动态环境中经济规划和实时适应能力的基准测试。通过模拟具有不同成本结构和突发事件的旅行规划任务，该研究揭示了当前模型在成本优化方面的普遍弱点，旨在推动开发更具经济理性和鲁棒性的智能体。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 成本优化, 动态环境, 基准测试, 规划能力
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入CostBench填补了LLM智能体在经济理性评估方面的空白，强调了在动态环境中资源效率的重要性。研究揭示了当前顶尖模型在成本优化和适应性方面的严重不足，为未来开发更具经济效率和鲁棒性的智能体提供了重要的基准和方向。

title: Caption Injection for Optimization in Generative Search Engine
summary: Generative Search Engine (GSE) leverages the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technique and the Large Language Model (LLM) to integrate multi-source information and provide users with accurate and comprehensive responses. Unlike traditional search engines that present results in ranked lists, GSE shifts users' attention from sequential browsing to content-driven subjective perception, not only driving a paradigm shift in information retrieval but also highlighting the importance of enhancing the subjective visibility of content in generative search. In this context, Generative Search Engine Optimization (G-SEO) methods have emerged as a new research focus. With the rapid advancement of Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) techniques, GSE can now efficiently integrate text, images, audio, and video, producing richer responses that better satisfy complex information needs. Existing G-SEO methods, however, remain limited to text-based optimization and fail to fully exploit multimodal data. To address this gap, we propose Caption Injection, the first multimodal G-SEO approach, which extracts captions from images and injects them into textual content, integrating visual semantics to enhance the subjective visibility in generative search. We systematically evaluate Caption Injection on MRAMG, a benchmark for MRAG, under both unimodal and multimodal settings. Experimental results show that Caption Injection significantly outperforms text-only G-SEO baselines under the G-EVAL metric, effectively improving the subjective visibility of content perceived by users, and demonstrating the practical benefits of multimodal information in G-SEO. The source code for this work is openly available at https://github.com/GrayChan04/Caption-Injection.

AI.title_translation: 生成式搜索引擎中用于优化的标题注入技术
AI.tldr: 本文提出Caption Injection方法，通过将图像描述注入文本，填补了生成式搜索引擎优化中多模态利用的空白，显著提升了内容的主观可见性。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）方法大多局限于文本层面，未能充分利用多模态数据（如图像、音频、视频）来增强搜索结果的主观可见性。
AI.method: 提出一种名为Caption Injection的方法，通过从图像中提取描述信息并将其注入到文本内容中，从而整合视觉语义以优化搜索可见性。
AI.result: 在MRAMG基准测试中，Caption Injection在单模态和多模态设置下均显著优于纯文本G-SEO基线，有效提升了用户感知到的内容主观可见性。
AI.conclusion: Caption Injection方法通过将图像描述注入文本，有效提升了生成式搜索中内容的主观可见性，证明了多模态数据在G-SEO中的重要作用。
AI.translation: 生成式搜索引擎（GSE）利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术和大型语言模型（LLM）整合多源信息，为用户提供准确全面的回答。与传统排名列表式的搜索引擎不同，GSE将用户注意力从顺序浏览转向内容驱动的主观感知，这不仅推动了信息检索的范式转变，也凸显了增强生成式搜索中内容主观可见性的重要性。在此背景下，生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）方法成为新的研究焦点。随着多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）技术的快速发展，GSE现在能够高效整合文本、图像、音频和视频，产生更丰富、更能满足复杂信息需求的回答。然而，现有的G-SEO方法仍局限于文本优化，未能充分挖掘多模态数据。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了Caption Injection，这是第一个多模态G-SEO方法，它通过提取图像描述并将其注入文本内容，整合视觉语义以增强生成式搜索中的主观可见性。我们在MRAG的基准测试MRAMG上，对Caption Injection在单模态和多模态设置下进行了系统评估。实验结果表明，Caption Injection在G-EVAL指标下显著优于纯文本G-SEO基线，有效提升了用户感知到的内容主观可见性，并证明了多模态信息在G-SEO中的实际效益。本研究源代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）中多模态利用不足的问题，提出了一种Caption Injection方法。该方法通过将图像描述融入文本内容，成功增强了生成式搜索结果的主观可见性，并在实验中验证了其相比纯文本基线的优越性。
AI.keywords: 生成式搜索引擎, G-SEO, 多模态检索增强生成, 图像描述注入, 主观可见性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多模态信息（图像描述）引入生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）领域，填补了现有仅关注文本优化的研究空白，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Automatic Extraction of Road Networks by using Teacher-Student Adaptive Structural Deep Belief Network and Its Application to Landslide Disaster
summary: An adaptive structural learning method of Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) and Deep Belief Network (DBN) has been developed as one of prominent deep learning models. The neuron generation-annihilation algorithm in RBM and layer generation algorithm in DBN make an optimal network structure for given input during the learning. In this paper, our model is applied to an automatic recognition method of road network system, called RoadTracer. RoadTracer can generate a road map on the ground surface from aerial photograph data. A novel method of RoadTracer using the Teacher-Student based ensemble learning model of Adaptive DBN is proposed, since the road maps contain many complicated features so that a model with high representation power to detect should be required. The experimental results showed the detection accuracy of the proposed model was improved from 40.0\% to 89.0\% on average in the seven major cities among the test dataset. In addition, we challenged to apply our method to the detection of available roads when landslide by natural disaster is occurred, in order to rapidly obtain a way of transportation. For fast inference, a small size of the trained model was implemented on a small embedded edge device as lightweight deep learning. We reported the detection results for the satellite image before and after the rainfall disaster in Japan. This version of the article was improved the search algorithm at the border around image.

AI.title_translation: 基于师生自适应结构深度信念网络的道路网络自动提取及其在滑坡灾害中的应用
AI.tldr: 通过一种新型的师生集成自适应深度信念网络，显著提高了道路识别精度，并实现了在边缘设备上对灾后可用道路的快速检测。
AI.motivation: 现有的道路网络提取模型在处理复杂特征时表现不足，且在灾后等需要快速响应的场景下，缺乏高精度且适合边缘设备部署的轻量化识别方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于教师-学生集成学习的自适应深度信念网络（DBN），利用受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）的神经元生成-湮灭算法和DBN的层生成算法自动优化网络结构，并针对边缘设备实现了模型轻量化。
AI.result: 在测试数据集的七个主要城市中，道路检测准确率从40.0%提升至89.0%；并在日本降雨灾害后的卫星图像中成功实现了灾后可用道路的快速识别与部署。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的基于教师-学生自适应DBN的RoadTracer模型，在道路网络识别精度上取得了显著提升，并成功应用于灾后道路连通性检测，证明了其在边缘计算环境下的高效性与实用性。
AI.translation: 作为一种突出的深度学习模型，受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）和深度信念网络（DBN）的自适应结构学习方法已得到发展。RBM中的神经元生成-湮灭算法和DBN中的层生成算法在学习过程中为给定输入构建了最优网络结构。本文将我们的模型应用于一种名为RoadTracer的道路网络系统自动识别方法。RoadTracer可以从航空摄影数据中生成地面道路图。由于道路地图包含许多复杂特征，需要具有高表示能力的模型来进行检测，因此本文提出了一种使用基于师生集成学习的自适应DBN的RoadTracer新方法。实验结果表明，在测试数据集的七个主要城市中，所提模型的检测准确率平均从40.0%提高到89.0%。此外，为了在自然灾害（如滑坡）发生时快速获得交通路径，我们尝试将该方法应用于可用道路的检测。为了实现快速推理，我们将训练好的小尺寸模型作为轻量级深度学习模型部署在小型嵌入式边缘设备上。我们报告了日本降雨灾害前后卫星图像的检测结果。此版本文章改进了图像边界处的搜索算法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种改进的RoadTracer方法，利用教师-学生集成学习的自适应深度信念网络（DBN）进行自动道路网络提取。该模型通过自动优化网络结构提高了特征表达能力，显著提升了在复杂地形下的道路检测精度，并成功将其轻量化部署于边缘设备，用于灾后道路交通状况的快速评估。
AI.keywords: 深度信念网络, 道路提取, 教师-学生学习, 边缘计算, 滑坡灾害
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入教师-学生集成学习框架，显著提升了自适应深度信念网络（DBN）在复杂道路网络提取任务中的表现。其创新点在于结合了神经元生成-湮灭算法的结构自适应性与模型压缩技术，使其能够部署在资源受限的边缘设备上，这对于灾后应急响应具有极高的实用价值。

title: Policy Stability for Measuring Operational Performance in Task Assignment with Time-Windows Under Internal Adversarial Influence
summary: We study autonomous pickup-and-delivery routing problems in which internal adversarial agents spoof their locations to attract request assignments and then intentionally leave those requests unserviced. Such attacks disrupt the centralized scheduler, causing delays, cancellations, and routing instability. A routing policy is stable if its cost remains uniformly bounded over time. Existing policy-cost formulations typically characterize cost through the work required to service outstanding requests. Such a formulation requires analyzing agent-specific route execution and is therefore not well suited to adversarial settings, where non-cooperative agents may arbitrarily deviate from assigned routes or fail to service requests altogether. We introduce a new policy-cost formulation based only on observable system signals, namely the numbers of outstanding and canceled requests. Under bounded arrivals and finite request time windows, we show that stability under this formulation is equivalent to keeping the expected cumulative number of canceled requests uniformly bounded over time, an important operational metric in both cooperative and adversarial settings. We also extend cooperative fleet-sizing guarantees to finite time-window settings and highlight that request time windows are not merely a modeling detail, but are essential for ruling out \emph{degenerate stability}, a regime in which policies are certified as stable despite undesirable large request backlogs.

title: Can Fine-Tuning Erase Your Edits? On the Fragile Coexistence of Knowledge Editing and Adaptation
summary: Knowledge editing (KE) offers a lightweight alternative to retraining for updating large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, fine-tuning remains the default operation for adapting LLMs to new domains and tasks. Despite their widespread adoption, these two post-training interventions have been studied in isolation, leaving open a crucial question: if we fine-tune an edited model, do the edits survive? This question is motivated by practical objectives: removing covert or malicious edits, and preserving beneficial edits. If fine-tuning impairs edits (Fig.1), current KE methods become less efficient, as a newly fine-tuned model requires re-editing; if edits persist, fine-tuned models risk propagating hidden malicious edits, raising serious safety concerns. To this end, we systematically quantify edit decay after fine-tuning across 254 experimental configurations. Our results show that in general, edits decay substantially after subsequent fine-tuning. AlphaEdit exhibits the greatest decay on the zsRE benchmark when applied to GPT-J, where 25.27% of previously successful edits become unsuccessful after fine-tuning. We further find that fine-tuning only the edited layers is sufficient to effectively remove edits, while incurring only modest degradation in downstream performance. Surprisingly, fine-tuning non-edited layers leads to greater edit decay than all-layer fine-tuning. Besides, our activation space analysis reveals that fine-tuning produces a larger and more coherent representational shift, both in magnitude and direction, than KE. Overall, our study underscores the necessity of evaluating KE within the broader LLM application pipeline.

AI.title_translation: 微调会抹除你的编辑吗？论知识编辑与模型适应的脆弱共存
AI.tldr: 微调通常会抹除之前的知识编辑，这一发现对LLM的知识更新与安全维护提出了重要挑战。
AI.motivation: 探讨知识编辑（KE）与模型微调（Fine-tuning）在实际应用中并存时的相互影响，以解决如何移除恶意编辑以及如何保持有益编辑的实际问题。
AI.method: 通过254种实验配置，系统地量化了微调后的编辑衰减情况，并利用激活空间分析法研究了微调产生的表示偏移。
AI.result: 微调通常会导致编辑内容大幅衰减；微调编辑过的层即可有效移除编辑；微调非编辑层比全层微调导致的衰减更严重；激活空间分析显示微调产生的表示偏移远大于KE。
AI.conclusion: 微调通常会导致知识编辑的显著衰减。通过微调特定层，可以在保持下游性能的同时有效地擦除编辑，这既是移除恶意编辑的手段，也对KE方法的持续有效性构成了挑战。
AI.translation: 知识编辑 (KE) 为更新大语言模型 (LLM) 提供了一种轻量级的替代方案。与此同时，微调仍然是使 LLM 适应新领域和任务的默认操作。尽管它们被广泛采用，但这两个后训练干预措施一直被孤立地研究，留下了一个关键问题：如果我们对已编辑的模型进行微调，这些编辑还能保留吗？这个问题源于实际目标：删除隐蔽或恶意的编辑，以及保留有益的编辑。如果微调损害了编辑（图1），当前的 KE 方法效率就会降低，因为新微调的模型需要重新编辑；如果编辑持续存在，微调后的模型就有传播隐藏恶意编辑的风险，引发严重的安全担忧。为此，我们在 254 种实验配置中系统地量化了微调后的编辑衰减。我们的结果表明，通常情况下，编辑在随后的微调后会大幅衰减。AlphaEdit 在应用于 GPT-J 时，在 zsRE 基准测试中表现出最大的衰减，其中 25.27% 的先前成功的编辑在微调后变得不成功。我们进一步发现，仅对已编辑的层进行微调就足以有效删除编辑，同时只会对下游性能造成轻微的降级。令人惊讶的是，微调非编辑层比全层微调会导致更大的编辑衰减。此外，我们的激活空间分析表明，与 KE 相比，微调在幅度和方向上产生了更大且更连贯的表示偏移。总的来说，我们的研究强调了在更广泛的 LLM 应用流水线中评估 KE 的必要性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在大语言模型中，知识编辑（KE）与后续微调操作之间的冲突。研究发现微调会导致大部分编辑失效，并提出通过微调特定层可以有效擦除编辑，强调了在LLM应用流水线中综合评估KE的重要性。
AI.keywords: 知识编辑, 大语言模型, 模型微调, 模型安全, 灾难性遗忘
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了知识编辑（KE）与微调（Fine-tuning）之间脆弱的共存关系，指出了评估KE时应考虑完整应用流程的必要性。其局限性在于主要基于特定模型和基准，对于不同规模或架构的模型表现可能存在差异。

title: Hard-constraint physics-residual networks for hydrogen crossover prediction and high-pressure extrapolation in PEM water electrolysis
comments: Final peer-reviewed version. Updated to match the published open-access article. DOI and journal reference added
summary: Hydrogen crossover is a critical safety and efficiency constraint in high-pressure polymer electrolyte membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE), but accurate prediction remains difficult because data are limited, transport physics are strongly coupled, and industrial operation requires reliable extrapolation beyond observed conditions. This study develops a hard-constraint physics-residual network (PR-Net) for hydrogen crossover prediction in PEMWE and compares it with a purely data-driven neural network (NN) and a soft-constraint physics-informed neural network (PINN). PR-Net embeds Henry's, Fick's, and Faraday's laws as a deterministic backbone and learns only a residual correction for unmodelled nonlinear effects. The benchmark includes 184 observations from eight peer-reviewed sources across six membrane types, covering 1-200 bar, $25-85°C$, and $0.05-5.0 A cm^{-2}$. PR-Net achieves $R^2 = 99.57 \pm 0.16%$, with 9-fold lower prediction variability than NN and PINN. In pressure-axis extrapolation, PR-Net attains $R^2 = 94.02 \pm 0.92%$ at 200 bar, 2.5 times beyond the training pressure range, compared with $68.06 \pm 5.52%$ for PINN and $58.00 \pm 8.60%$ for NN (p < 0.001). Residual analysis indicates that the learned correction captures part of the high-pressure gas-phase non-ideality and recovers a transport-regime transition near $0.23 A cm^{-2}$ between Fickian diffusion-dominated and Faradaic production-dominated transport. With a computation time of $1.08 \pm 0.34 ms$ on low-power embedded hardware, PR-Net provides a practical framework for real-time crossover monitoring, adaptive process control, and safer high-pressure green-hydrogen operation.

AI.title_translation: 用于PEM电解水氢气渗透预测及高压外推的硬约束物理残差网络
AI.tldr: PR-Net通过将物理定律硬编码为基础模型，仅学习微小残差，从而在PEM电解水氢气渗透预测中实现了极高的精度和卓越的高压外推能力。
AI.motivation: PEM电解水在高压运行下氢气渗透是关键的安全和效率瓶颈，但现有预测方法受限于数据稀缺、强耦合的传输物理机制，且难以在工业工况下实现可靠的外推。
AI.method: 提出硬约束物理残差网络（PR-Net），将亨利定律、菲克定律和法拉第定律作为确定性骨干，仅学习未建模非线性效应的残差修正，并与纯数据驱动神经网络（NN）和软约束物理信息神经网络（PINN）进行了性能对比。
AI.result: PR-Net在预测精度上达到 R² = 99.57%，相比NN和PINN预测波动降低了9倍。在高压外推实验中，PR-Net在200 bar压力下（超出训练范围2.5倍）仍保持 R² = 94.02%，远优于PINN（68.06%）和NN（58.00%），且单次推理仅需约1毫秒。
AI.conclusion: PR-Net为高压PEM电解水中的氢气渗透预测提供了一种高精度、强外推能力且计算高效的解决方案，显著提升了系统运行的安全性与控制水平。
AI.translation: 氢气渗透是高压聚合物电解质膜水电解（PEMWE）中关键的安全和效率约束，但由于数据有限、传输物理机制强耦合，且工业运行需要超出观测条件的可信外推，导致准确预测仍存在困难。本研究开发了一种用于PEMWE氢气渗透预测的硬约束物理残差网络（PR-Net），并将其与纯数据驱动神经网络（NN）和软约束物理信息神经网络（PINN）进行了比较。PR-Net将亨利定律、菲克定律和法拉第定律作为确定性骨干，仅学习未建模非线性效应的残差修正。基准测试涵盖了来自6种膜类型的8个同行评审来源的184个观测数据，覆盖了1-200 bar、25-85°C和0.05-5.0 A cm⁻²的工况。PR-Net实现了 R² = 99.57 ± 0.16%，预测变异性比NN和PINN低9倍。在压力轴外推中，PR-Net在200 bar（超出训练压力范围2.5倍）时达到了 R² = 94.02 ± 0.92%，而PINN为 68.06 ± 5.52%，NN为 58.00 ± 8.60% (p < 0.001)。残差分析表明，所学的修正项捕获了部分高压气相非理想性，并恢复了在 0.23 A cm⁻² 附近从菲克扩散主导到法拉第生产主导的传输机制转换。PR-Net在低功耗嵌入式硬件上的计算时间为 1.08 ± 0.34 ms，为实时渗透监测、自适应过程控制和更安全的绿色氢气高压运行提供了一个实用的框架。
AI.summary: 本文开发了一种硬约束物理残差网络（PR-Net），通过将基础物理定律嵌入网络架构，仅学习非线性残差，实现了PEM电解水氢气渗透的高精度预测。该模型在处理稀缺数据、实现高压工况外推及实时工业监测方面表现出显著优势。
AI.keywords: PEM电解水, 氢气渗透, 物理残差网络, 高压外推, 实时监测
AI.comments: 该研究通过将物理定律作为确定性骨干网络，仅对非线性残差进行学习，有效地解决了数据驱动模型在外推场景下表现不佳的问题。PR-Net不仅在预测精度上优于传统神经网络和PINN，且在计算效率上极高，非常适合工业实时监测场景，是物理机器学习在电化学工程应用中的一个优秀范例。

title: AD-DAE: Alzheimer's Disease Progression Modeling with Unpaired Longitudinal MRI using Diffusion Auto-Encoders
comments: Accepted in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics ( https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11579738 )
summary:
Generative modeling frameworks have emerged as an effective approach to capture high-dimensional image distributions from large datasets without requiring domain-specific knowledge, a capability essential for disease progression modeling. Recent generative approaches have attempted to capture progression by mapping images to a latent space and guiding representations to generate follow-up images from previous time points. However, these methods impose constraints on distribution learning, resulting in latent spaces with limited controllability for generating follow-up images without paired subject-specific longitudinal guidance.
  In order to enable controlled movements in the latent representational space and generate progression images from a previous time-point image without subject-specific guidance, we introduce a conditionable Diffusion Auto-encoder framework that forms a compact latent space capturing high-level semantics and providing means to control generation. Our approach leverages this latent space to condition and apply controlled shifts to the representations of previous time-point images by isolating progression and subject identity information for generating follow-up images. The shifts are implicitly guided by correlating with progression attributes and constraining to Alzheimer's disease specific regions, without paired longitudinal guidance. We validate the generations through image quality metrics, volumetric progression analysis, and downstream tasks in Alzheimer's disease datasets from different sources. This demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach for Alzheimer's progression modeling and longitudinal image generation.

AI.title_translation: AD-DAE：利用扩散自编码器对非配对纵向 MRI 进行阿尔茨海默病病程建模
AI.tldr: 提出一种 AD-DAE 框架，在无需配对纵向数据的情况下，通过扩散自编码器的潜在空间位移实现阿尔茨海默病病程预测与图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成模型在模拟疾病进展时，通常依赖于配对的纵向数据，且潜在空间缺乏对生成过程的精细控制能力。
AI.method: 提出一种可调节的扩散自编码器（AD-DAE）框架，通过将图像映射到紧凑的潜在空间，解耦主体身份与进展信息，并在无需配对数据的情况下，通过与病理属性相关联的潜在空间位移来生成随访图像。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在图像质量指标、体积进展分析以及下游阿尔茨海默病相关任务中表现出色，验证了其在无配对纵向数据场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AD-DAE 框架成功实现了在无配对纵向数据的情况下，通过解耦主体身份与疾病进展信息，对阿尔茨海默病进行有效的病程建模和图像生成。
AI.translation: 生成建模框架已成为一种从大规模数据集中捕获高维图像分布的有效方法，且无需特定领域的先验知识，这对于疾病进展建模至关重要。近期的生成式方法尝试通过将图像映射到潜在空间并引导表征生成后续时间点的图像来捕捉进展。然而，这些方法对分布学习施加了约束，导致潜在空间在缺乏特定受试者纵向配对指导的情况下，对生成后续图像的控制力有限。为了在潜在表征空间中实现可控运动，并在无需特定受试者指导的情况下从前一时间点的图像生成进展图像，我们引入了一种可调节的扩散自编码器框架，该框架形成了一个紧凑的潜在空间，能够捕获高层语义并提供控制生成的方法。我们的方法利用该潜在空间，通过隔离进展和受试者身份信息，对前一时间点图像的表征进行调节和受控位移，从而生成后续图像。这些位移通过与进展属性相关联并限制在阿尔茨海默病特定区域来隐式引导，且无需配对的纵向指导。我们通过图像质量指标、体积进展分析以及不同来源阿尔茨海默病数据集上的下游任务验证了生成结果。这证明了我们的方法在阿尔茨海默病进展建模和纵向图像生成方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 AD-DAE 的扩散自编码器框架，用于阿尔茨海默病的病程建模。该方法通过构建紧凑的潜在空间，在缺乏配对纵向图像的情况下，通过解耦病理进展与主体特征，实现了对随访图像的可控生成。
AI.keywords: 阿尔茨海默病, 扩散自编码器, 纵向MRI, 病程建模, 图像生成
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用扩散自编码器（Diffusion Auto-encoders）在无需配对纵向数据的情况下，实现了对阿尔茨海默病病程进展的建模与图像生成。这解决了传统生成模型依赖配对数据进行轨迹预测的局限性，具有重要的临床应用潜力，但在处理极度复杂的病理变化时其效果仍有待进一步验证。

title: SWE-fficiency: Can Language Models Optimize Real-World Repositories on Real Workloads?
comments: Appearing at ICML 2026. Data, code, and leaderboard are available at https://swefficiency.com/
summary: Optimizing the performance of large-scale software repositories demands expertise in code reasoning and software engineering (SWE) to reduce runtime while preserving program correctness. However, most benchmarks emphasize what to fix rather than how to fix code. We introduce SWE-fficiency, a benchmark for evaluating repository-level performance optimization on real workloads. Our suite contains 498 tasks across nine widely used data-science, machine-learning, and HPC repositories (e.g., numpy, pandas, scipy): given a complete codebase and a slow workload, an agent must investigate code semantics, localize bottlenecks and relevant tests, and produce a patch that matches or exceeds expert speedup while passing the same unit tests. To enable this how-to-fix evaluation, our automated pipeline scrapes GitHub pull requests for performance-improving edits, combining keyword filtering, static analysis, coverage tooling, and execution validation to both confirm expert speedup baselines and identify relevant repository unit tests. Empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art agents reveals significant underperformance. On average, agents achieve less than 0.23x the expert speedup: agents struggle in localizing optimization opportunities, reasoning about execution across functions, and maintaining correctness in proposed edits. We release the benchmark and accompanying data pipeline to facilitate research on automated performance engineering and long-horizon software reasoning.

AI.title_translation: SWE-fficiency：语言模型能优化真实仓库中的实际工作负载吗？
AI.tldr: SWE-fficiency是一个评估大模型性能优化能力的新基准，研究发现当前模型在处理真实代码库的性能优化任务时，表现远低于专家水平。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数基准测试侧重于“修正什么”而非“如何修正”，缺乏针对大型软件仓库性能优化的真实世界评估工具，导致模型在代码推理和实际软件工程任务中的能力难以被有效衡量。
AI.method: 提出SWE-fficiency基准，构建了包含498个任务的测试集，通过自动化流水线从GitHub的性能优化PR中提取数据，结合关键词过滤、静态分析、覆盖率工具和执行验证来设定专家基准并构建测试用例，用于评估智能体在真实仓库中的性能优化能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前最先进的智能体在SWE-fficiency上的表现较差，平均仅能达到专家级提速的0.23倍，主要瓶颈在于无法准确识别优化机会、难以跨函数进行执行推理以及难以保证修改后的代码正确性。
AI.conclusion: 现有的最先进大模型在处理真实软件仓库的性能优化任务时表现不佳，难以达到专家级的优化效果，且在定位瓶颈和维护代码正确性方面存在显著局限。
AI.translation: 优化大规模软件仓库的性能需要代码推理和软件工程（SWE）方面的专业知识，以在保持程序正确性的同时缩短运行时间。然而，大多数基准测试强调的是“修复什么”而不是“如何修复”代码。我们介绍了SWE-fficiency，这是一个用于评估真实工作负载下仓库级性能优化的基准。我们的套件包含了九个广泛使用的数据科学、机器学习和高性能计算存储库（如numpy、pandas、scipy）中的498个任务：给定完整的代码库和缓慢的工作负载，智能体必须调查代码语义、定位瓶颈和相关测试，并生成一个在通过相同单元测试的同时匹配或超过专家加速比的补丁。为了实现这种“如何修复”的评估，我们的自动化流水线从GitHub拉取请求中抓取性能改进编辑，结合关键词过滤、静态分析、覆盖率工具和执行验证，既确认专家加速基线，又识别相关的存储库单元测试。对最先进智能体的实证评估显示出显著的性能不足。平均而言，智能体实现的加速比不到专家加速比的0.23倍：智能体在定位优化机会、推理跨函数执行以及在建议的编辑中保持正确性方面存在困难。我们发布了该基准和配套的数据流水线，以促进自动化性能工程和长程软件推理的研究。
AI.summary: 本文引入了SWE-fficiency基准，旨在评估大模型在真实软件仓库中进行性能优化的能力。该基准通过自动化流水线从GitHub挖掘真实优化案例，测试智能体在保持功能正确性的前提下提升运行效率的能力，揭示了当前模型在复杂软件工程任务中的显著不足。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 软件工程, 性能优化, 自动化基准, 代码推理
AI.comments: 该论文填补了软件工程领域中关于“如何优化代码”这一评估基准的空白。其创新之处在于利用真实的GitHub性能优化PR构建基准，而非合成任务，这极大地提升了评估的真实性与挑战性。局限性在于目前大模型在长序列代码推理和跨函数性能分析方面仍有很大提升空间。

title: You Had One Job: Per-Task Quantization Using LLMs' Hidden Representations
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on AdaptFM: Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference
summary: Many LLM applications require only narrow capabilities, yet standard post-training quantization (PTQ) methods allocate precision without considering the target task. This can waste bits on layers that are less relevant to the task signal while over-compressing layers that are critical for downstream behavior. We propose Task-Aware Quantization (TAQ), a training-free, weight-only mixed-precision PTQ framework that uses a small set of unlabeled task calibration prompts to allocate higher precision to task-relevant transformer layers under a fixed bit budget. TAQ estimates layer importance from hidden representations and output sensitivity, and we instantiate it with three scoring rules: TAQ-IS, based on activation information and stability; TAQ-KL, based on output-distribution sensitivity under a quantization-noise proxy; and TAQ-O, a label-informed oracle diagnostic for analyzing layer sensitivity. Across several benchmarks, TAQ outperforms task-agnostic baselines such in most settings, with especially strong gains in the accuracy--memory ratio. We further validate that these gains translate to real deployment behavior through hardware throughput and latency measurements, and analyze calibration robustness and residual-stream error propagation. Overall, TAQ turns mixed-precision PTQ from a model-centric compression step into a task-conditioned precision-allocation problem. A reference implementation is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAQ-9217/README.md}{\includegraphics[height=1em]{imgs/github-mark.png}}.

AI.title_translation: 你只有一个任务：使用大语言模型的隐藏表示进行逐任务量化
AI.tldr: TAQ 是一种新型混合精度量化方法，通过利用任务相关的隐藏层特征动态分配模型精度，显著提升了 LLM 在特定任务下的压缩效率与硬件部署性能。
AI.motivation: 标准后训练量化（PTQ）未考虑特定任务需求，导致在非关键层浪费比特，而在关键层过度压缩，影响模型性能。
AI.method: 提出 Task-Aware Quantization (TAQ) 框架，通过无标签任务提示校准，利用隐藏层表示和输出敏感度（TAQ-IS, TAQ-KL, TAQ-O）评估层重要性，在固定比特预算下实现混合精度分配。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，TAQ 在准确率与内存比率方面均优于任务无关的基准方法，并验证了其在实际硬件吞吐量和延迟方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: TAQ 框架有效地通过任务感知实现混合精度量化，在保持模型性能的同时显著提升了压缩效率和硬件部署表现。
AI.translation: 许多大语言模型（LLM）应用仅需要有限的能力，但标准的后训练量化（PTQ）方法在分配精度时并未考虑目标任务。这可能导致在与任务信号相关性较低的层上浪费比特，同时对下游行为至关重要的层进行过度压缩。我们提出了任务感知量化（TAQ），这是一种无需训练、仅针对权重的混合精度 PTQ 框架，它使用少量无标签的任务校准提示，在固定比特预算下为任务相关的 Transformer 层分配更高精度。TAQ 通过隐藏表示和输出敏感度来估计层的重要性，并实例化了三种评分规则：基于激活信息和稳定性的 TAQ-IS、基于量化噪声代理下输出分布敏感度的 TAQ-KL，以及用于分析层敏感度的标签知情预言机诊断 TAQ-O。在多个基准测试中，TAQ 在大多数设置下均优于任务无关的基准，特别是在准确率-内存比方面增益显著。我们进一步验证了这些增益通过硬件吞吐量和延迟测量转化为实际部署行为，并分析了校准鲁棒性和残差流误差传播。总的来说，TAQ 将混合精度 PTQ 从以模型为中心的压缩步骤转变为任务条件下的精度分配问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了任务感知量化（TAQ），这是一种无训练的混合精度后训练量化框架。它通过分析少量无标签任务提示下的隐藏层表示，动态调整各层的精度分配，从而在固定比特预算下最大化模型在特定任务上的性能。
AI.keywords: 任务感知量化, 混合精度, LLM压缩, 隐藏表示, 硬件效率
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将模型压缩从“以模型为中心”转变为“以任务为中心”，通过分析隐藏层表示来动态分配精度。其局限性在于需要少量无标签的任务提示（calibration prompts），且对于极度多样化的任务场景的通用性有待进一步观察。

title: Power Hardware-in-the-loop Interfacing via $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ Model Matching
comments: To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 European Control Conference, 6 pages, 6 figures
summary: This paper presents an $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ model matching control-based approach to the problem of power hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) interfacing. The objective is to interconnect a grid simulation and a physical device via an interface in a way that is stable and accurate. Conventional approaches include the ideal transformer method (ITM) and its impedance-based variants, which trade accuracy for stability, as well as some $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ control-based approaches, which do not make use of all the available information in their optimization for accuracy. Designing for transparency, as opposed to accuracy as existing approaches do, would achieve both accuracy and stability, while making use of all the dynamical information present in the idealized interconnection of the grid and device. The approach proposed in this paper employs model matching to formulate the PHIL problem as an $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ control problem using transparency as the explicit frequency-domain control objective. The approach is experimentally validated in a real-time resistive-load PHIL setup, and is found to achieve accuracy levels that are comparable or superior to those of an ITM-based interface.

title: Scalable Synthesis of distributed LLM workloads through Symbolic Tensor Graphs
summary: Optimizing the performance of large language models (LLMs) on large-scale AI training and inference systems requires a scalable and expressive mechanism to model distributed workload execution. Such modeling is essential for pre-deployment system-level optimizations (e.g., parallelization strategies) and hardware design-space explorations. While recent efforts have proposed collecting execution traces from real systems, access to large-scale infrastructure remains limited to major cloud providers. Moreover, traces capturing execution on a specific platform cannot be easily adapted to study alternate software and/or hardware configurations, especially at scale. We introduce STAGE, a framework that synthesizes high-fidelity execution graphs to accurately model distributed AI workloads (including LLMs and MoEs). STAGE supports a comprehensive set of parallelization strategies, allowing users to systematically explore a wide spectrum of model architectures and system configurations. STAGE demonstrates its scalability by synthesizing high-fidelity LLM traces spanning over 128K GPUs, while preserving tensorlevel accuracy in compute, memory, and communication. STAGE is publicy available at https://github.com/astra-sim/stage

AI.title_translation: 通过符号化张量图实现分布式 LLM 工作负载的可扩展合成
AI.tldr: STAGE 是一个用于合成大规模分布式 LLM 执行轨迹的框架，无需真实基础设施即可进行高保真的系统优化和硬件性能探索。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模 AI 模型性能建模方法依赖于真实硬件轨迹的收集，但由于基础设施访问受限，且轨迹难以适应不同软硬件配置，导致在大规模系统优化和硬件设计空间探索上存在困难。
AI.method: 引入了 STAGE 框架，利用符号化张量图（Symbolic Tensor Graphs）来合成高保真的分布式 AI 工作负载执行图。该方法支持多种并行化策略，并能根据用户定义的模型架构和系统配置生成相应的执行轨迹。
AI.result: STAGE 成功合成了跨越 128K GPU 的高保真 LLM 执行轨迹，并在计算、内存和通信方面保持了张量级别的准确性。
AI.conclusion: STAGE 提供了一种可扩展且高保真的分布式 LLM 工作负载建模框架，通过符号化张量图有效地支持了大规模系统优化和硬件设计空间探索。
AI.translation: 在大型 AI 训练和推理系统上优化大语言模型（LLM）的性能，需要一种可扩展且具有表现力的机制来建模分布式工作负载的执行。这种建模对于部署前的系统级优化（如并行化策略）和硬件设计空间探索至关重要。尽管近期的研究尝试从真实系统中收集执行轨迹，但大规模基础设施的访问权限仍仅限于少数主要云服务商。此外，捕获特定平台执行情况的轨迹无法轻易适应以研究替代的软件和/或硬件配置，特别是在大规模场景下。我们引入了 STAGE，这是一个合成高保真执行图以准确建模分布式 AI 工作负载（包括 LLM 和 MoE）的框架。STAGE 支持一套全面的并行化策略，允许用户系统地探索各种模型架构和系统配置。STAGE 通过合成跨越 128K GPU 的高保真 LLM 轨迹展示了其可扩展性，同时在计算、内存和通信方面保持了张量级别的准确性。STAGE 已在 https://github.com/astra-sim/stage 公开。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 STAGE，这是一个通过符号化张量图合成高保真分布式 AI 工作负载执行图的框架。它支持多种并行化策略，使用户能够系统地探索各种模型架构和系统配置，并展示了在 128K GPU 规模下的可扩展性，从而解决了大规模分布式 LLM 建模的瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 分布式 LLM, 符号化张量图, 工作负载建模, 并行化策略, 系统仿真
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的符号化张量图方法，解决了大规模分布式模型训练和推理中性能建模的局限性。其核心优势在于摆脱了对真实大规模基础设施的依赖，并具备极高的扩展性（支持128K GPU），为系统设计和硬件优化提供了灵活的仿真工具。局限性在于该方法基于符号化合成，其准确性依赖于所建模系统的参数配置是否精确。

title: GaRLILEO: Gravity-aligned Radar-Leg-Inertial Enhanced Odometry
comments: Accepted for publication at the International Journal of Robotics Research on 30 April, 2026
summary: Deployment of legged robots for navigating challenging terrains (e.g., stairs, slopes, and unstructured environments) has gained increasing preference over wheel-based platforms. In such scenarios, accurate odometry estimation is a preliminary requirement for stable locomotion, localization, and mapping. Traditional proprioceptive approaches, which rely on leg kinematics sensor modalities and inertial sensing, suffer from irrepressible vertical drift caused by frequent contact impacts, foot slippage, and vibrations, particularly affected by inaccurate roll and pitch estimation. Existing methods incorporate exteroceptive sensors such as LiDAR or cameras. Further enhancement has been introduced by leveraging gravity vector estimation to add additional observations on roll and pitch, thereby increasing the accuracy of vertical pose estimation. However, these approaches tend to degrade in feature-sparse or repetitive scenes and are prone to errors from double-integrated IMU acceleration. To address these challenges, we propose GaRLILEO, a novel gravity-aligned continuous-time radar-leg-inertial odometry framework. GaRLILEO decouples velocity from the IMU by building a continuous-time ego-velocity spline from SoC radar Doppler and leg kinematics information, enabling seamless sensor fusion which mitigates odometry distortion. In addition, GaRLILEO can reliably capture accurate gravity vectors leveraging a novel soft S2-constrained gravity factor, improving vertical pose accuracy without relying on LiDAR or cameras. Evaluated on a self-collected real-world dataset with diverse indoor-outdoor trajectories, GaRLILEO demonstrates state-of-the-art accuracy, particularly in vertical odometry estimation on stairs and slopes. We open-source both our dataset and algorithm to foster further research in legged robot odometry and SLAM. https://garlileo.github.io/GaRLILEO

title: Interaction-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction
summary: This paper focuses on a challenging setting of simultaneously modeling geometry and appearance of hand-object interaction scenes without any object priors. We follow the trend of dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting based methods, and address several significant challenges. To model complex hand-object interaction with mutual occlusion and edge blur, we present interaction-aware hand-object Gaussians with newly introduced optimizable parameters aiming to adopt piecewise linear hypothesis for clearer structural representation. Moreover, considering the complementarity and tightness of hand shape and object shape during interaction dynamics, we incorporate hand information into object deformation field, constructing interaction-aware dynamic fields to model flexible motions. To further address difficulties in the optimization process, we propose a progressive strategy that handles dynamic regions and static background step by step. Correspondingly, explicit regularizations are designed to stabilize the hand-object representations for smooth motion transition, physical interaction reality, and coherent lighting. Experiments show that our approach surpasses existing dynamic 3D-GS-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing dynamic hand-object interaction.

title: Skin-R1: Clinical Knowledge-Guided Dermatological Diagnosis Using Vision-Language Models
summary:
Vision--language models (VLMs) have recently shown promise for assisting clinical reasoning in dermatological diagnosis. However, their trustworthiness and clinical utility remain limited by three key challenges: heterogeneous datasets with inconsistent diagnostic labels and concept annotations, the lack of grounded diagnostic rationales for reliable reasoning supervision, and limited scalability when transferring knowledge from small, densely annotated datasets to large collections with sparse labels.
  To address these challenges, we propose Skin-R1, a dermatology-oriented VLM that integrates textbook-grounded clinical reasoning supervision with reinforcement learning (RL) to improve the accuracy and robustness of diagnostic prediction. First, we construct a textbook-based reasoning generator that synthesizes hierarchy-aware and differential-diagnosis (DDx) diagnostic trajectories derived from authoritative dermatology knowledge. Second, these trajectories are used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), establishing a clinically grounded reasoning foundation for the model. Finally, we introduce an RL training framework that incorporates the hierarchical structure of dermatological diseases into the reward design, enabling the model to generalize grounded diagnostic reasoning to large-scale datasets with sparse annotations.
  Extensive experiments across multiple dermatology benchmarks demonstrate that Skin-R1 consistently improves diagnostic accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art Med-VLM baselines. Ablation studies further highlight the critical role of grounded reasoning supervision introduced during the SFT stage.

title: DCC: Data-Centric Compilation of Machine Learning Kernels for Processing-In-Memory Architectures
summary: High-performance Host processors can integrate Processing-In-Memory (PIM) devices, which can accelerate memory-intensive kernels of Machine Learning (ML) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), by leveraging the large memory bandwidth available at PIM cores. However, Host processor needs consecutive elements distributed across DRAM banks, while PIM cores need consecutive elements within their local banks. This necessitates data rearrangements in ML kernel execution that pose significant performance and programmability challenges, further exacerbated by the need to support diverse PIM devices. Current compilation approaches lack systematic optimization for diverse ML kernels and multiple PIM devices, and may largely ignore data rearrangement costs during the compute code optimization step. We show that data rearrangements and compute code optimization are interdependent, and need to be jointly optimized during the tuning process. Therefore, we design DCC, the first data-centric ML compiler for PIM systems that jointly co-optimizes data rearrangements and compute code in a unified tuning process. DCC integrates a multi-layer PIM abstraction to support multiple PIM backends. DCC enables effective co-optimization of data partitioning strategies with compute loop partitioning schemes. DCC applies PIM-specific code optimizations, and leverages a fast and accurate performance prediction model to select the bestperforming code schedule for a given kernel on a target PIM architecture. Our evaluations in various individual ML kernels show that DCC achieves up to 7.68x speedup (2.21x average) on HBM-PIM, and up to 13.17x speedup (3.92x average) on AttAcc PIM, over GPU-only execution. In end-to-end LLM inference, DCC on AttAcc accelerates GPT-3 and LLaMA-2 by 4.52x average (up to 7.71x in LLaMA-2) over GPU. DCC is open-sourced at https://github.com/SPIN-Research-Group/DCC.

AI.title_translation: DCC：面向内存处理架构的机器学习内核数据中心化编译技术
AI.tldr: DCC是一个新型ML编译器，通过联合优化数据重排与计算代码，解决了PIM架构中的性能瓶颈，大幅提升了LLM等模型的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 主机处理器与PIM核心对数据分布要求存在冲突，导致昂贵的数据重排开销，而现有编译技术缺乏对数据重排与计算代码的联合优化，难以充分发挥PIM架构的性能。
AI.method: 提出DCC编译器，采用统一的调优流程联合优化数据重排与计算代码；设计多层PIM抽象以支持多种后端；利用快速精确的性能预测模型选择最优代码调度策略。
AI.result: DCC在单个ML内核上实现了最高7.68倍（HBM-PIM）和13.17倍（AttAcc）的加速；在端到端LLM推理中，使GPT-3和LLaMA-2的推理速度平均提升了4.52倍。
AI.conclusion: DCC通过联合优化数据重排与计算代码，有效解决了PIM系统中的性能瓶颈，显著提升了ML模型（特别是LLM）在不同PIM架构上的推理速度。
AI.translation: 高性能主机处理器可以集成内存处理（PIM）设备，通过利用PIM核心可用的巨大内存带宽，加速包括大语言模型（LLMs）在内的机器学习（ML）模型的内存密集型内核。然而，主机处理器需要跨DRAM库分布的连续元素，而PIM核心需要其本地库内的连续元素。这使得ML内核执行中的数据重排带来巨大的性能和可编程性挑战，且在支持多样化PIM设备时进一步加剧。当前的编译方法缺乏对多样化ML内核和多种PIM设备的系统性优化，并且在计算代码优化步骤中往往忽略了数据重排成本。我们证明了数据重排和计算代码优化是相互依赖的，需要在调优过程中进行联合优化。因此，我们设计了DCC，这是第一个用于PIM系统的以数据为中心的ML编译器，它在统一的调优过程中联合协同优化数据重排和计算代码。DCC集成了一个多层PIM抽象以支持多个PIM后端。DCC实现了数据分区策略与计算循环分区方案的有效协同优化。DCC应用了PIM特定的代码优化，并利用一个快速且准确的性能预测模型为目标PIM架构上的给定内核选择性能最佳的代码调度。我们在各种单个ML内核上的评估表明，DCC在HBM-PIM上实现了最高7.68倍（平均2.21倍）的加速，在AttAcc PIM上实现了最高13.17倍（平均3.92倍）的加速，优于仅使用GPU的执行。在端到端LLM推理中，DCC在AttAcc上将GPT-3和LLaMA-2的推理速度平均提升了4.52倍（LLaMA-2最高达7.71倍），优于GPU。DCC已在https://github.com/SPIN-Research-Group/DCC开源。
AI.summary: DCC是一款针对PIM架构的以数据为中心的ML编译器，它通过在统一的调优框架中联合优化数据重排和计算代码，消除了PIM系统中的数据布局冲突，显著提升了包括LLM在内的机器学习内核在多种PIM硬件上的执行效率。
AI.keywords: PIM, 编译器, 机器学习, 数据重排, LLM
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了“以数据为中心”的编译思想，打破了以往数据重排与计算优化分离的局限。它不仅解决了PIM架构中数据分布不匹配的痛点，还通过多层抽象实现了对不同PIM硬件的通用支持，是PIM领域编译优化方向的重要进展。

title: Beluga: Block Synchronization for BFT Consensus Protocols
summary: Modern high-throughput BFT consensus protocols use streamlined push-pull mechanisms to disseminate blocks and keep happy-path performance optimal. Yet state-of-the-art designs lack a principled and efficient way to exchange blocks, which leaves them open to targeted attacks and performance collapse under network asynchrony. This work introduces the concept of a block synchronizer, a simple abstraction that drives incremental block retrieval and enforces resource-aware exchange. Its interface and role fit cleanly inside a modern BFT consensus stack. We also uncover a new attack, where an adversary steers honest validators into redundant, uncoordinated pulls that exhaust bandwidth and stall progress. Beluga is a modular and scarcity-aware instantiation of the block synchronizer. It achieves optimal common-case latency while bounding the cost of recovery under faults and adversarial behavior. We integrate Beluga into Mysticeti, the consensus core of the Sui blockchain, and show on a geo-distributed AWS deployment that Beluga sustains optimal performance in the optimistic path and, under attack, delivers up to 3x higher throughput and 25x lower latency than prior designs. The Sui blockchain adopted Beluga in production.

AI.title_translation: Beluga：BFT共识协议的区块同步机制
AI.tldr: Beluga是一种新型区块同步器，它解决了BFT协议在面临网络压力或攻击时的性能崩溃问题，通过资源感知机制显著提升了系统在攻击下的吞吐量与延迟表现。
AI.motivation: 现代高吞吐BFT协议缺乏原则性的区块交换机制，导致在网络异步或遭受攻击时容易出现性能崩溃，且存在被攻击者利用冗余拉取耗尽带宽的风险。
AI.method: 提出了“区块同步器”抽象，通过模块化和资源感知的机制来管理区块检索；设计了针对冗余拉取攻击的防御策略，并将其集成到Mysticeti共识核心中。
AI.result: 在AWS地理分布式部署测试中，Beluga在正常运行路径下保持最优性能；在遭受攻击时，相较于现有设计，吞吐量提升至3倍，延迟降低至25倍，且已被Sui区块链采用。
AI.conclusion: Beluga通过模块化的区块同步器设计，在保持常规路径性能最优的同时，有效防御了针对带宽的DoS攻击，是现代BFT共识协议中实现鲁棒区块同步的有效方案。
AI.translation: 现代高吞吐量BFT共识协议使用简化的推拉机制来分发区块，并保持理想路径下的性能最优。然而，最先进的设计缺乏原则且高效的区块交换方式，这使得它们在网络异步情况下容易受到针对性攻击并导致性能崩溃。本文引入了“区块同步器”的概念，这是一种驱动增量区块检索并强制执行资源感知交换的简单抽象。其接口和角色能够完美契合现代BFT共识栈。我们还发现了一种新的攻击方式，攻击者可以引导诚实的验证者进行冗余的、不协调的拉取，从而耗尽带宽并阻碍进展。Beluga是区块同步器的一种模块化且具备稀缺性感知（scarcity-aware）的实例化。它在实现最优常规延迟的同时，限制了故障和对抗行为下的恢复成本。我们将Beluga集成到Sui区块链的共识核心Mysticeti中，并在AWS地理分布式部署中展示了Beluga在乐观路径下保持了最优性能，且在受到攻击时，其吞吐量比现有设计高出3倍，延迟降低了25倍。Sui区块链已在生产环境中采用了Beluga。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Beluga，一种针对BFT共识协议的模块化且具备资源感知能力的区块同步器。它通过规范化的区块检索接口，解决了现有协议在网络异步及恶意攻击下的性能瓶颈，成功防御了冗余拉取攻击，并在Sui区块链的生产环境中验证了其卓越的性能与稳定性。
AI.keywords: BFT共识, 区块同步, 资源感知, 网络异步, 性能优化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了“区块同步器（block synchronizer）”这一抽象概念，解决了现代BFT协议中区块交换机制的缺陷。它不仅在理论上定义了资源感知的交换方式，还通过发现并防御一种新型的冗余拉取攻击，显著提升了系统在极端网络环境下的鲁棒性。其在Sui区块链中的生产级应用证明了该方案的高效性和实用性。

title: Real Time Proportional Throughput Maximization: How much advance notice should you give your scheduler?
summary:
We will be exploring a generalization of real time scheduling problem sometimes called the real time throughput maximization problem. Our input is a sequence of jobs specified by their release time, deadline and processing time. We assume that jobs are announced before or at their release time. At each time step, the algorithm must decide whether to schedule a job based on the information so far. The goal is to maximize the value of the sum of the processing times of jobs that finish before their deadline, this is often called real time throughput with proportional weights.
  We extend this problem by defining a notion of \(t\)-advance-notice, a measure of how far in advance each job is announced relative to their processing time.
  We show that there exists a class of algorithms \(τ-\textsc{Persist}\) parametrized by some value \(τ\in [1,\infty)\). If an input sequence has \(t\)-advance-notice, \(τ-\textsc{Persist}\) is \(\frac{τ- 1}{τ^2 +τ- 1}\)-competitive. In particular, we show that for any \(t \leq \frac{1}{2}\), there is an algorithm that achieves \(\frac{t-t^2}{1+t-t^2}\)-competitiveness and for any \(t \geq \frac{1}{2}\), there is an algorithm that achieves \(\frac{1}{5}\)-competitiveness.
  We also give an upper bound of any algorithm that relies on input sequences having \(t\)-advance-notice. We show that the competitive ratio of any algorithm can be at most \(\frac{t}{2t+1}\) against input sequences that have \(t\)-advance-notice. In particular, we show that regardless of how much advance-notice is given, no algorithm can reach \(\frac{1}{2}\)-competitiveness.

title: Warm-Starting Iterative Gaussian Processes for Faster Sequential Inference
comments: Previous version appeared as Improving Iterative Gaussian Processes via Warm Starting Sequential Posteriors in SPIGM Workshop, NeurIPS 2025
summary: Efficient Gaussian process (GP) inference is critical for sequential decision-making tasks such as active learning, online prediction, and Bayesian optimization. Iterative approaches of approximating the GP posterior using solvers like conjugate gradients, stochastic gradient descent, or alternating projections avoid cubic costs, but often require many iterations to converge, limiting their efficacy when the posterior is updated frequently with new data. To address this, we introduce three warm-start strategies that exploit solutions of smaller linear systems to substantially speed-up convergence when updating the posterior with new data. Our methods are supported by theoretical analysis showing reduced initialization error in reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) distance, and by empirical results on regression benchmarks and Bayesian optimization tasks. Across solvers, warm-starting achieves speed-ups of up to 19x when solving to tolerance, and produces more accurate posterior estimates under fixed compute budgets, directly improving optimization performance. These results establish warm-starting as a simple, effective, and broadly applicable tool for scaling Gaussian processes in sequential settings.
comment: Previous version appeared as Improving Iterative Gaussian Processes via Warm Starting Sequential Posteriors in SPIGM Workshop, NeurIPS 2025

AI.title_translation: 用于更快序列推理的热启动迭代高斯过程
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入热启动策略，利用先前计算的解加速高斯过程的迭代求解，在序列任务中实现了高达19倍的加速并提升了预测精度。
AI.motivation: 在主动学习、在线预测和贝叶斯优化等序列任务中，高斯过程的迭代求解器往往需要大量迭代才能收敛，导致频繁更新后验时计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了三种基于先前较小线性系统解的热启动策略，通过在更新后验时初始化求解器来加速收敛，并提供了RKHS距离下的理论误差分析。
AI.result: 在回归基准测试和贝叶斯优化任务中，该方法最高实现了19倍的加速，且在固定计算预算下提供了更准确的后验估计，直接提升了优化性能。
AI.conclusion: 热启动策略是一种简单、有效且通用的工具，能够显著加速序列高斯过程推理，在固定计算预算下提高预测精度并优化决策性能。
AI.translation: 高效的高斯过程（GP）推理对于主动学习、在线预测和贝叶斯优化等序列决策任务至关重要。使用共轭梯度、随机梯度下降或交替投影等求解器逼近GP后验的迭代方法避免了立方级成本，但通常需要多次迭代才能收敛，限制了其在频繁更新后验数据时的效能。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了三种热启动策略，利用较小线性系统的解来显著加快更新后验数据时的收敛速度。我们的方法得到了理论分析的支持，证明了其在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）距离中减少了初始化误差，并通过回归基准测试和贝叶斯优化任务的实验结果得到了验证。在不同求解器中，热启动在达到容差要求时实现了高达19倍的加速，并在固定计算预算下产生了更准确的后验估计，直接改善了优化性能。这些结果确立了热启动作为一种简单、有效且广泛适用的工具，用于扩展序列设置中的高斯过程。
AI.summary: 本文针对序列高斯过程推理中迭代求解收敛缓慢的问题，提出了三种热启动策略。通过利用先前计算的解来初始化当前求解过程，该方法显著加快了收敛速度，并在理论和实验上证明了其在提高效率与精度方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 高斯过程, 序列推理, 热启动, 贝叶斯优化, 迭代求解器
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入热启动（warm-starting）策略解决了高斯过程在序列决策任务中迭代求解收敛慢的问题。其创新点在于利用前一次迭代的解作为当前计算的起点，不仅在理论上证明了误差界限，且在实际应用中取得了显著的加速效果。该方法实现简单且通用，对于提高贝叶斯优化等计算密集型任务的效率具有重要意义。

title: Contrastive vision-language learning with paraphrasing and negation
summary: Contrastive vision-language models continue to be the dominant approach for image-text retrieval. Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) trains two neural networks to align their image and text embeddings in a shared latent space. As a challenging case-study for neurosymbolic AI, recent results evaluating CLIP on negated or paraphrased text have shown mixed performance as these are difficult to define formally for text data. Negation produces the opposite meaning using various possible but small lexical changes. Paraphrasing may use very different textual expressions to denote essentially the same thing. As a result, learning of paraphrasing and negation together poses a significant challenge because of the above mismatch between changes in syntax and intended meaning expected to be captured by distances in embedding space. This paper proposes a new CLIP contrastive loss function capable of balancing the requirements of having both paraphrasing and negation. It applies training triplets consisting of original, paraphrased and negated text generated by multiple large language models to the evaluation of CLIP models. The approach, called SemCLIP, aims to learn semantically-relevant and simple embeddings, placing paraphrased captions nearer to the original image embeddings while at the same time pushing negated captions farther away. Empirically, SemCLIP is shown to be capable of preserving roughly the same performance as CLIP augmented with either negation or paraphrasing. Although direct comparisons are difficult to make because the problem of learning with both negation and paraphrasing is different, an expected benefit of SemCLIP should be robustness when applied zero-shot to downstream image classification tasks. Our experiments confirm such robustness as measured by difference in accuracy (mean-accuracy delta) between original and negated captions on five downstream datasets.

AI.title_translation: 基于同义改写与否定的对比视觉-语言学习
AI.tldr: SemCLIP通过引入新的损失函数和LLM生成的数据，增强了CLIP模型对文本否定和同义改写的语义处理能力，提升了下游任务的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）模型在处理文本的否定和同义改写时表现不佳，因为这些语言现象涉及复杂的语法变化与语义一致性之间的矛盾，难以在共享嵌入空间中有效映射。
AI.method: 提出SemCLIP模型，采用包含原始、同义改写和否定文本的训练三元组（由大语言模型生成），并设计了一种新的对比损失函数，旨在将同义改写文本的嵌入拉近至图像嵌入，同时将否定文本的嵌入推远。
AI.result: SemCLIP在保持CLIP原有性能的基础上，显著提升了模型在处理否定和同义改写时的鲁棒性，在五个下游数据集的零样本图像分类任务中，验证了其在面对原始与否定标题时的准确率差异更小。
AI.conclusion: SemCLIP通过引入一种新的对比损失函数，成功在保持原有性能的同时，增强了模型对文本否定和同义改写的语义理解能力，并在下游零样本任务中表现出更好的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 对比视觉-语言模型仍然是图像-文本检索的主流方法。对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）训练两个神经网络，将它们的图像和文本嵌入对齐到一个共享的潜在空间。作为神经符号AI的一个具有挑战性的案例研究，最近在否定或改写文本上评估CLIP的结果显示性能不一，因为这些在文本数据中很难正式定义。否定通过各种可能但微小的词汇变化产生相反的含义。改写可能使用非常不同的文本表达来表示基本相同的事物。因此，由于语法变化与嵌入空间距离所预期的意图含义之间的上述不匹配，同时学习改写和否定构成了巨大的挑战。本文提出了一种新的CLIP对比损失函数，能够平衡同时具有改写和否定的要求。它将由多个大语言模型生成的由原始、改写和否定文本组成的训练三元组应用于CLIP模型的评估。这种称为SemCLIP的方法旨在学习语义相关且简单的嵌入，将改写后的标题放置在更靠近原始图像嵌入的位置，同时将否定的标题推得更远。实证表明，SemCLIP能够保持与通过否定或改写增强的CLIP大致相同的性能。尽管由于同时学习否定和改写的问题不同，直接比较很困难，但SemCLIP的一个预期好处应该是零样本应用于下游图像分类任务时的鲁棒性。我们的实验通过测量五个下游数据集上原始标题和否定标题之间的准确率差异（平均准确率增量）证实了这种鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文针对CLIP模型在处理文本否定和同义改写时的不足，提出了SemCLIP框架。通过利用大语言模型生成的三元组数据，并结合一种新型的对比损失函数，SemCLIP有效地平衡了同义文本的聚集与否定文本的分离，提升了模型的多模态语义理解能力及零样本任务下的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 对比学习, CLIP, 语义理解, 否定, 同义改写
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用大语言模型生成的数据来增强对比学习模型，解决CLIP在处理语义逻辑（如否定和同义改写）时的脆弱性。其创新点在于引入了平衡这两种相反语义需求的损失函数，为提升多模态模型的鲁棒性提供了新思路。

title: DAPS++: Rethinking Diffusion Inverse Problems with Decoupled Posterior Annealing
summary: From a Bayesian perspective, score-based diffusion solves inverse problems through joint inference, embedding the likelihood with the prior to guide the sampling process. However, this formulation fails to explain its practical behavior: the prior offers limited guidance, while reconstruction is largely driven by the measurement-consistency term, leading to an inference process that is effectively decoupled from the diffusion dynamics. We show that the diffusion prior in these solvers functions primarily as a warm initializer that places estimates near the data manifold, while reconstruction is driven almost entirely by measurement consistency. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{DAPS++}, which fully decouples diffusion-based initialization from likelihood-driven refinement, allowing the likelihood term to guide inference more directly while maintaining numerical stability and providing insight into why unified diffusion trajectories remain effective in practice. By requiring fewer function evaluations (NFEs) and measurement-optimization steps, \textbf{DAPS++} achieves high computational efficiency and robust reconstruction performance across diverse image restoration tasks.

title: SWITCH: Benchmarking Modeling and Handling of Tangible Interfaces in Long-horizon Embodied Scenarios
summary: Tangible control interfaces (TCIs), such as appliance panels, remotes, elevators, and embedded GUIs, are a fundamental component of everyday human-built environments. Interacting with these interfaces requires agents not only to ground language in visual observations,but also to execute actions, track temporally evolving state changes, and verify whether intended outcomes have been achieved. However, existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate open-loop perception or single-step action execution, failing to capture this continuous cycle of interaction, feedback, and correction. We introduce SWITCH, a benchmark for closed-loop interactive reasoning with TCIs in realistic egocentric environments1. SWITCH comprises 1,170 temporally interactive videos across diverse functional categories, providing structured annotations of instructions, actions, state transitions, outcomes, and recovery behaviors over time. To probe generative world modeling, SWITCH also evaluates video generation models on interaction-centered tasks using both LLM-as-judge and human evaluation2.Experiments with frontier proprietary and opensource multimodal models reveal persistent weaknesses in fine-grained visual-temporal perception, outcome verification, and error recovery, highlighting SWITCH as a testbed for closed-loop embodied intelligence.

title: Laboratory and field testing of a residential heat pump retrofit for a DC solar nanogrid
summary: Residential buildings are increasingly integrating large devices that run natively on direct current (DC), such as solar photovoltaics, electric vehicles, stationary batteries, and DC motors that drive heat pumps and other major appliances. Today, these natively-DC devices typically connect within buildings through alternating current (AC) distribution systems, entailing significant energy losses due to conversions between AC and DC. This paper investigates the alternative of connecting DC devices through DC distribution. Specifically, this paper shows through laboratory and field experiments that an off-the-shelf residential heat pump designed for conventional AC systems can be powered directly on DC with few hardware modifications and little change in performance. Supporting simulations of a DC nanogrid including {historical heat pump and rest-of-house load measurements,} a solar photovoltaic array, and a stationary battery suggest that connecting these devices through DC distribution could decrease annual electricity bills by 12.5% with an after-market AC-to-DC heat pump retrofit and by 16.7% with a heat pump designed to run on DC. The associated savings in gross nanogrid energy are 8% and 9.2%, respectively.

AI.title_translation: 住宅直流太阳能微网热泵改造的实验室与现场测试
AI.tldr: 将住宅热泵改为直流供电可减少能源转换损耗，显著降低电费支出并提升微网能效。
AI.motivation: 解决当前住宅中直流设备（如光伏、电池、直流电机）通过交流配电系统连接时产生的重复转换能源损耗问题。
AI.method: 通过实验室与现场实验对现成的交流热泵进行硬件改造，使其能够直接由直流电供电，并结合历史负载数据、光伏阵列和电池储能进行系统仿真分析。
AI.result: 实验表明改造后的热泵性能基本不变；仿真显示直流配电可使年度电费降低12.5%至16.7%，总能源消耗降低8%至9.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过直流供电改造住宅热泵是可行的，且能有效减少能源转换损耗，显著降低电力成本。
AI.translation: 住宅建筑正越来越多地集成原生直流（DC）设备，如太阳能光伏、电动汽车、固定式电池以及驱动热泵和其他主要电器的直流电机。目前，这些原生直流设备通常通过交流（AC）配电系统连接，由于交流与直流之间的转换，导致了显著的能源损耗。本文探讨了通过直流配电连接直流设备的替代方案。具体而言，本文通过实验室和现场实验表明，一款为传统交流系统设计的现成住宅热泵，在极少硬件修改且性能变化微小的情况下，可以直接由直流电供电。包含历史热泵和其余住宅负载测量、太阳能光伏阵列以及固定式电池的直流微网仿真分析表明，通过直流配电连接这些设备，使用售后交流转直流热泵改造可使年度电费降低 12.5%，使用原生直流热泵可降低 16.7%。由此带来的微网总能源节约分别为 8% 和 9.2%。
AI.summary: 本文研究了将住宅直流设备直接接入直流配电系统的可行性。通过实验验证了传统交流热泵经简单改造即可在直流环境下高效运行，仿真结果进一步证实了直流微网在降低电费和提升能效方面的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 直流微网, 住宅热泵, 能源效率, 直流配电, 太阳能光伏
AI.comments: 该研究通过实验验证了将传统交流热泵改造为直流供电的可行性，并量化了直流微网在减少能源转换损耗方面的经济效益，为提高住宅能源效率提供了实用且具有成本效益的途径。

title: A SAT-based Approach for Specification, Analysis, and Justification of Reductions between NP-complete Problems
summary: We propose a novel framework for developing, analyzing, and validating reductions between NP-complete problems. Powered by the SAT-based constraint solver URSA, our methodology introduces several distinct features that set it apart from other related approaches. The proposed workflow effectively bridges the crucial gap between informal, high-level reduction descriptions and formalized mathematical proofs. By supplementing rather than replacing human intuition, this interactive methodology serves as an aid for exploring relationships between NP-complete problems.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于SAT的NP完全问题间归约的规范、分析与验证方法
AI.tldr: 利用SAT求解器将NP完全问题的归约过程形式化，帮助研究人员填补非正式描述与严谨数学证明之间的空白。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决NP完全问题归约中， informal（非正式）的高层描述与严谨的数学证明之间存在脱节的问题，并辅助研究人员进行归约的探索。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于SAT求解器（URSA）的交互式框架，将NP完全问题之间的归约过程转化为SAT约束问题进行分析与验证。
AI.result: 构建了一个能够辅助研究人员开发、分析和验证NP完全问题归约的框架，并证明了其在弥合高层描述与形式化证明之间差距的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过SAT求解器成功实现了对NP完全问题归约过程的辅助开发、分析与验证，为理论计算研究提供了一种高效的形式化工具。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于开发、分析和验证NP完全问题之间归约的新颖框架。在基于SAT的约束求解器URSA的支持下，我们的方法引入了几个使其区别于其他相关方法的独特特征。所提出的工作流程有效地弥合了非正式、高层归约描述与形式化数学证明之间的关键鸿沟。通过补充而非取代人类直觉，这种交互式方法为探索NP完全问题之间的关系提供了一种辅助手段。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于SAT求解器URSA的新型框架，旨在辅助NP完全问题之间归约的构建、分析与验证。该方法通过将归约过程形式化，弥补了高层直觉描述与正式数学证明之间的差距，为研究人员提供了一种有效的辅助工具。
AI.keywords: NP完全问题, 归约, SAT求解器, 形式化验证, URSA
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法，利用SAT求解器来辅助构建和验证NP完全问题之间的归约。其核心价值在于将直觉性的归约过程形式化，有效填补了高层描述与严谨数学证明之间的鸿沟，是理论计算机科学研究中的一种有益的自动化辅助工具。

title: MonoSR: Open-Vocabulary Spatial Reasoning from Monocular Images
summary: Spatial reasoning (SR), the ability to infer 3D spatial information from 2D inputs, is essential for real-world applications such as embodied AI and autonomous driving. However, existing research primarily focuses on indoor environments and typically relies on multi-view observations, which limits their generalizability to outdoor scenarios and constrains their applicability to monocular images, the most common real-world setting. In this work, we propose MonoSR, a large-scale monocular spatial reasoning dataset that spans diverse scenarios including indoor, outdoor, and object-centric settings, and supports multiple question types. MonoSR provides a path toward open-world monocular spatial reasoning. Beyond introducing the dataset, we evaluate advanced vision-language models to reveal their limitations on this challenging task. We further analyze whether auxiliary information is crucial for monocular spatial reasoning and offer practical guidance for designing future models. These contributions collectively establish a foundation for advancing monocular spatial reasoning in real-world, open-world environments.

AI.title_translation: MonoSR：基于单目图像的开放词汇空间推理
AI.tldr: 提出了一个大规模单目空间推理数据集，并评估了现有视觉语言模型在处理多样化场景时的局限性，为开放世界的空间推理研究提供了基准。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间推理研究多依赖多视角观察且局限于室内场景，难以泛化至更常见的单目图像和开放世界场景。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含室内、室外及以物体为中心场景的大规模单目空间推理数据集，并对先进的视觉语言模型在该任务上的表现进行了评估与分析。
AI.result: 揭示了现有视觉语言模型在单目空间推理任务上的局限性，并分析了辅助信息对该任务的影响，为未来模型设计提供了指导。
AI.conclusion: MonoSR 提出了一个大规模单目空间推理数据集，为评估和开发开放世界下的空间推理模型奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 空间推理（SR）是从二维输入推断三维空间信息的能力，对于具身智能和自动驾驶等现实应用至关重要。然而，现有研究主要集中在室内环境，且通常依赖多视角观察，这限制了它们在室外场景的泛化能力，并限制了它们在最常见的现实设置——单目图像上的适用性。在这项工作中，我们提出了 MonoSR，一个大规模单目空间推理数据集，涵盖了包括室内、室外和以物体为中心在内的多种场景，并支持多种问题类型。MonoSR 为开放世界的单目空间推理提供了一条路径。除了引入数据集外，我们还评估了先进的视觉语言模型，揭示了它们在这一挑战性任务上的局限性。我们进一步分析了辅助信息对于单目空间推理是否至关重要，并为设计未来模型提供了实用指导。这些贡献共同为推进现实、开放世界环境中的单目空间推理奠定了基础。
AI.summary: MonoSR 是一项旨在推动开放世界单目空间推理的研究，通过引入一个涵盖多样化场景的大规模数据集，评估了现有视觉语言模型的能力，并探讨了提升模型在单目图像下空间推理性能的关键因素。
AI.keywords: 单目空间推理, 视觉语言模型, 数据集, 开放世界, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文通过构建大规模数据集填补了单目图像空间推理任务的空白，并对现有视觉语言模型进行了基准测试，对于推动具身智能和自动驾驶在开放世界中的应用具有重要意义。然而，论文主要侧重于数据集构建和基准分析，未提出新型模型架构。

title: Exploiting Low Scanwidth to Resolve Soft Polytomies
comments: 24 pages. Submitted to DMTCS. Major revision. An extended abstract appeared in the proceedings of SOFSEM 2026
summary: Phylogenetic networks allow modeling reticulate evolution, capturing events such as hybridization and horizontal gene transfer. A fundamental computational problem in this context is the Tree Containment problem, which asks whether a given phylogenetic network is compatible with a given phylogenetic tree. However, the classical statement of the problem is not robust to poorly supported branches in biological data, possibly leading to false negatives. In an effort to address this, a relaxed version that accounts for uncertainty, called Soft Tree Containment, has been introduced by Bentert, Malík, and Weller [SWAT'18]. We present an algorithm that solves Soft Tree Containment in $2^{O(Δ_T \cdot k \cdot \log(k))} \cdot n^{O(1)}$ time, where $k = \operatorname{sw}(Γ) + Δ_N$, with $Δ_T$ and $Δ_N$ denoting the maximum out-degrees in the tree and the network, respectively, and $\operatorname{sw}(Γ)$ denoting the "scanwidth" [Berry, Scornavacca, and Weller, SOFSEM'20] of a given tree extension of the network, while $n$ is the input size. Our approach leverages the fact that phylogenetic networks encountered in practice often exhibit low scanwidth, making the problem more tractable.
comment: 24 pages. Submitted to DMTCS. Major revision. An extended abstract appeared in the proceedings of SOFSEM 2026

AI.title_translation: 利用低扫描宽度解决软多分支问题
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用低扫描宽度特性来高效解决系统发育网络中“软树包含”问题的新算法，提高了在存在不确定性生物数据时的分析鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统的树包含问题在处理生物数据中支持度较低的分支时缺乏鲁棒性，容易导致假阴性结果。因此，作者旨在通过解决“软树包含”问题来更好地处理系统发育数据中的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出了一种时间复杂度为 $2^{O(Δ_T \cdot k \cdot \log(k))} \cdot n^{O(1)}$ 的新算法，该算法通过利用系统发育网络中树扩展的“扫描宽度”（scanwidth）这一参数，优化了软树包含问题的求解过程。
AI.result: 成功设计并实现了一种针对软树包含问题的参数化算法，该算法证明了当网络具有较低的扫描宽度时，该问题是可计算的。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用系统发育网络的低扫描宽度特性，可以有效降低软树包含问题的计算复杂度，从而使其在处理具有不确定性的生物数据时变得更加可行。
AI.translation: 系统发育网络允许对网状进化进行建模，捕捉诸如杂交和水平基因转移等事件。在此背景下，一个基本的计算问题是树包含问题，即询问给定的系统发育网络是否与给定的系统发育树兼容。然而，该问题的经典陈述对于生物数据中支持度较差的分支不够稳健，可能会导致假阴性。为了解决这个问题，Bentert、Malík 和 Weller [SWAT'18] 引入了一个考虑不确定性的松弛版本，称为软树包含。我们提出了一种算法，在 $2^{O(Δ_T \cdot k \cdot \log(k))} \cdot n^{O(1)}$ 时间内解决软树包含问题，其中 $k = \operatorname{sw}(Γ) + Δ_N$，$Δ_T$ 和 $Δ_N$ 分别表示树和网络中的最大出度，$\operatorname{sw}(Γ)$ 表示给定网络树扩展的“扫描宽度”[Berry, Scornavacca, and Weller, SOFSEM'20]，而 $n$ 是输入大小。我们的方法利用了实际中遇到的系统发育网络通常表现出低扫描宽度的事实，使得该问题更易于处理。
AI.summary: 本文针对系统发育网络中传统的树包含问题在处理不确定性数据时的局限性，研究了“软树包含”问题。作者提出了一种基于“扫描宽度”参数的算法，利用实际生物数据中网络结构往往具有低扫描宽度的特点，显著提升了该问题的计算可行性。
AI.keywords: 系统发育网络, 树包含, 软树包含, 扫描宽度, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“扫描宽度”（scanwidth）这一拓扑参数，为解决系统发育网络中的“软树包含”问题提供了一种高效的算法。其创新点在于利用了实际生物数据中网络结构往往具有低扫描宽度的特性，从而将原本计算复杂的难题转化为在特定参数下可处理的问题，对系统发育分析具有重要意义。

title: LaGen: Towards Autoregressive LiDAR Scene Generation
summary: Generative world models for autonomous driving (AD) are of great value in applications such as data augmentation, closed-loop simulation, and safety-critical scenario evaluation. Unlike the widely studied image modality, in this work we explore generative world models for LiDAR data. Existing generation methods for LiDAR predominantly focus on single frame generation or lack the capacity for interactive simulation, while existing prediction approaches require multiple frames of historical input and can only deterministically predict multiple frames at once. Both paradigms fail to support long-horizon interactive generation. To this end, we introduce \textbf{LaGen}, which, to the best of our knowledge is the first autoregressive framework capable of generating long-horizon LiDAR scenes in a frame-by-frame, interactive manner. LaGen is able to take a single-frame input as a starting point and effectively utilize bounding box information as conditions to generate high-fidelity 4D scene. In addition, we introduce a scene decoupling estimation module to enhance the model's interactive generation capability for object-level content, as well as a noise modulation module to mitigate error accumulation during long-horizon generation. We extensively evaluate LaGen's performance in controlled data generation and long-horizon scene generation on the nuScenes dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that LaGen achieves state-of-the-art performance, especially on later frames. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LaGen.

AI.tldr: LaGen是首个支持长时序、交互式生成的自回归LiDAR场景生成框架，有效解决了自动驾驶仿真中的数据增强与场景模拟难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的LiDAR生成方法多局限于单帧或缺乏交互性，而预测方法依赖多帧历史且仅能确定性预测，无法满足自动驾驶中长时序、交互式场景仿真的需求。
AI.method: 提出了LaGen框架，采用自回归方式逐帧生成LiDAR场景；引入场景解耦估计模块以增强对象级交互生成能力；引入噪声调制模块以抑制长时序生成中的误差累积。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，LaGen在受控数据生成和长时序场景生成任务中均达到了最先进的性能，特别是在后期帧的生成质量上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: LaGen通过自回归框架实现了高质量的长时序交互式LiDAR场景生成，在nuScenes数据集上表现出优于现有方法的性能，为自动驾驶的模拟与评估提供了有力工具。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶（AD）的生成式世界模型在数据增强、闭环仿真和安全关键场景评估等应用中具有巨大价值。与研究广泛的图像模态不同，本文探索了用于LiDAR数据的生成式世界模型。现有的LiDAR生成方法主要集中于单帧生成，或缺乏交互式仿真的能力，而现有的预测方法则需要多帧历史输入，且只能一次性确定性地预测多帧。这两种范式都无法支持长时序的交互式生成。为此，我们引入了LaGen，据我们所知，这是第一个能够以逐帧、交互式方式生成长时序LiDAR场景的自回归框架。LaGen能够以单帧输入作为起点，并有效地利用边界框信息作为条件来生成高保真的4D场景。此外，我们引入了一个场景解耦估计模块来增强模型对对象级内容的交互生成能力，以及一个噪声调制模块来减轻长时序生成过程中的误差累积。我们在nuScenes数据集上对LaGen在受控数据生成和长时序场景生成方面的性能进行了广泛评估。实验结果表明，LaGen实现了最先进的性能，特别是在后期帧上。代码已在 https://github.com/szzhou88/LaGen 公开。
AI.summary: LaGen是一个用于自动驾驶的自回归LiDAR场景生成框架，支持从单帧输入出发进行长时序、交互式的4D场景生成。该模型通过场景解耦和噪声调制技术，克服了传统方法在交互性和误差控制上的缺陷。
AI.keywords: LiDAR生成, 自动驾驶, 自回归模型, 长时序仿真, 场景解耦
AI.comments: LaGen的创新之处在于其自回归生成机制，填补了LiDAR场景生成在长时序和交互式生成方面的空白。通过场景解耦和噪声调制模块，有效解决了长序列生成中的误差累积问题，是自动驾驶仿真领域的一项重要进展。

title: Stay Unique, Stay Efficient: Preserving Model Personality in Multi-Task Merging
summary: Model merging has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling multi-task capabilities without additional training. However, traditional basic merging methods often experience performance degradation due to parameter conflicts, even when applied to similar tasks. While recent personalized merging frameworks successfully preserve task-specific information to maintain performance, they typically incur storage overhead. In this paper, we propose Decomposition, Thresholding, and Scaling (DTS), an approximation-based personalized merging framework that pushes task-specific storage efficiency. DTS first applies singular value decomposition to the task-specific information and retains only a small subset of singular values and vectors. It then introduces a novel thresholding strategy that partitions singular vector elements into groups and assigns a scaling factor to each group. To enable generalization to unseen tasks, we further extend DTS with a variant that fuses task-specific information in a data-free manner based on the semantic similarity of task characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DTS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while requiring only 1\% extra storage per task. Furthermore, experiments on unseen tasks show that the DTS variant achieves significantly better generalization performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/krumpguo/DTS.

AI.title_translation: 保持独特，保持高效：在多任务合并中保留模型个性化
AI.tldr: DTS框架通过SVD压缩和阈值缩放技术，以仅1%的额外存储开销实现了高性能的多任务模型合并与泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型合并方法要么在多任务合并时因参数冲突导致性能下降，要么在保持模型个性化性能时带来了沉重的存储负担。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DTS（Decomposition, Thresholding, and Scaling）的框架：1. 利用奇异值分解（SVD）提取任务特定信息并进行压缩；2. 引入阈值策略将奇异向量分组并分配缩放因子；3. 开发了一种基于语义相似度的数据无关变体，以实现对未见任务的泛化。
AI.result: 实验表明，DTS在仅需1%额外存储开销的情况下，性能优于现有的先进基准方法，且在未见任务的泛化测试中表现显著。
AI.conclusion: DTS框架通过高效的压缩和语义融合策略，在极低的存储约束下实现了卓越的多任务性能和泛化能力，为模型高效合并提供了新的技术路径。
AI.translation: 模型合并已成为一种无需额外训练即可实现多任务能力的有前途的范式。然而，传统的合并方法即使在相似任务中，也常因参数冲突而导致性能下降。虽然最近的个性化合并框架成功地保留了特定任务信息以维持性能，但它们通常会产生存储开销。在本文中，我们提出了分解、阈值和缩放（DTS），这是一种基于近似的个性化合并框架，旨在提高特定任务的存储效率。DTS首先对特定任务信息应用奇异值分解，仅保留一小部分奇异值和向量。随后，它引入了一种新颖的阈值策略，将奇异向量元素分组并为每组分配缩放因子。为了实现对未见任务的泛化，我们进一步扩展了DTS，开发了一种基于任务特征语义相似性、以数据无关方式融合特定任务信息的变体。大量实验表明，DTS在每个任务仅需1%额外存储的情况下，始终优于最先进的基准方法。此外，对未见任务的实验表明，DTS变体实现了显著更好的泛化性能。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/krumpguo/DTS 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为DTS的模型合并框架，通过奇异值分解、分组阈值和缩放技术，在极低存储成本下保留了模型的多任务个性化能力，并实现了良好的任务泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 模型合并, 存储效率, 奇异值分解, 多任务学习, 模型个性化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具创新性的模型合并方法，通过奇异值分解（SVD）和创新的阈值缩放策略，在大幅降低存储开销的同时保持了模型的多任务性能，解决了现有个性化合并框架存储成本过高的问题。其数据无关的语义泛化能力也是该研究的一大亮点。

title: ClusterStyle: Modeling Intra-Style Diversity with Prototypical Clustering for Stylized Motion Generation
summary: Existing stylized motion generation models have shown their remarkable ability to understand specific style information from the style motion, and insert it into the content motion. However, capturing intra-style diversity, where a single style should correspond to diverse motion variations, remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we propose a clustering-based framework, ClusterStyle, to address this limitation. Instead of learning an unstructured embedding from each style motion, we leverage a set of prototypes to effectively model diverse style patterns across motions belonging to the same style category. We consider two types of style diversity: global-level diversity among style motions of the same category, and local-level diversity within the temporal dynamics of motion sequences. These components jointly shape two structured style embedding spaces, i.e., global and local, optimized via alignment with non-learnable prototype anchors. Furthermore, we augment the pretrained text-to-motion generation model with the Stylistic Modulation Adapter (SMA) to integrate the style features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art models in stylized motion generation and motion style transfer.

title: See, Think, Learn: A Self-Taught Multimodal Reasoner
comments: Accepted at The Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in integrating visual perception with language understanding. However, effective multimodal reasoning requires both accurate perception and robust reasoning, and weakness in either limits the performance of VLMs. Prior efforts to enhance reasoning often depend on high-quality chain-of-thought (CoT) data, obtained via labor-intensive human annotations, costly proprietary models, or self-training methods that overlook perception. To address these limitations, we propose a simple yet effective self-training framework called See-Think-Learn (STL). At its core, STL introduces a structured reasoning template that encourages the model to see before thinking, first extracting visual attributes in textual form, then using them to guide reasoning. The framework jointly improves perception and reasoning by having the model generate and learn from its own structured rationales in a self-training loop. Furthermore, we augment the training data with negative rationales, i.e. explanations that justify why certain answer choices are incorrect, to enhance the model's ability to distinguish between correct and misleading responses. This fosters more discriminative and robust learning. Experiments across diverse domains show that STL consistently outperforms baselines trained directly only on answers or self-generated reasoning, while qualitative analysis confirms the high quality of its rationales. STL thus provides a cost-effective solution to enhance multimodal reasoning ability of VLMs.
comment: Accepted at The Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026

AI.title_translation: 看、想、学：一种自学型多模态推理机
AI.tldr: STL是一种新的自训练框架，通过结构化的“先看后想”模板和负面推理学习，在无需人工标注的情况下提升了多模态模型的感知与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态模型推理能力受限于感知与推理的脱节，且提升推理能力的传统方法往往高度依赖昂贵的人工标注或专有模型，缺乏对视觉感知的有效整合。
AI.method: 提出See-Think-Learn (STL)自训练框架，采用结构化推理模板要求模型先提取视觉属性再进行推理，并通过生成和学习自身的结构化解释进行迭代；同时引入负面推理样本以增强模型的辨别能力。
AI.result: STL在多个领域均优于仅基于答案或普通自生成推理的基准模型，且生成的推理过程质量更高，证明了其在增强多模态推理能力方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: STL框架通过结构化的自训练机制和负面推理样本，显著提升了视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力，为该领域提供了一种高效、低成本的改进方案。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在将视觉感知与语言理解相结合方面取得了显著进展。然而，有效的多模态推理既需要准确的感知，也需要稳健的推理，任何一方的薄弱都会限制VLMs的性能。以往提升推理能力的努力往往依赖于高质量的思维链（CoT）数据，这些数据通常通过劳动密集型的人工标注、昂贵的专有模型或忽视感知的自训练方法获得。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种简单而有效的自训练框架，称为See-Think-Learn（STL）。STL的核心在于引入了一个结构化的推理模板，鼓励模型在思考之前先“看”，即首先以文本形式提取视觉属性，然后利用这些属性引导推理。该框架通过让模型在自训练循环中生成并学习其自身的结构化理由，从而共同提升感知和推理能力。此外，我们通过负面理由（即解释为何某些答案选项是错误的）来增强训练数据，以提升模型区分正确和误导性响应的能力。这促进了更具辨别力和稳健的学习。在不同领域的实验表明，STL始终优于仅直接基于答案或仅基于自生成推理训练的基准模型，定性分析也证实了其理由的高质量。因此，STL为增强VLMs的多模态推理能力提供了一种具有成本效益的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为See-Think-Learn (STL)的自训练框架，旨在提升视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力。该框架通过结构化模板强制模型先提取视觉属性再进行推理，并利用自生成的结构化解释进行循环训练，同时引入负面解释以提高模型的辨别力，从而在无需额外人工标注的情况下显著提升了模型性能。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 多模态推理, 自训练, 结构化思维, 负面推理
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种无需人工标注或昂贵专有模型辅助的自训练框架，通过结构化的“先看后想”模板和引入负面推理样本，有效解决了多模态模型在感知与推理能力上的脱节问题。该方法具有很高的实用价值和低成本优势。

title: When, How Long and How Much? Interpretable Neural Networks for Time Series Regression by Learning to Mask and Aggregate
summary:
Time series extrinsic regression (TSER) refers to the task of predicting a continuous target variable from an input time series. It appears in many domains, including healthcare, finance, environmental monitoring, and engineering. In these settings, accurate predictions and trustworthy reasoning are both essential. Although state-of-the-art TSER models achieve strong predictive performance, they typically operate as black boxes, making it difficult to understand which temporal patterns drive their decisions. Post-hoc interpretability techniques, such as feature attribution, aim to to explain how the model arrives at its predictions, but often produce coarse, noisy, or unstable explanations. Recently, inherently interpretable approaches based on concepts, additive decompositions, or symbolic regression, have emerged as promising alternatives. However, these approaches remain limited: they require explicit supervision on the concepts themselves, often cannot capture interactions between time-series features, lack expressiveness for complex temporal patterns, and struggle to scale to high-dimensional multivariate data.
  To address these limitations, we propose MAGNETS (Mask-and-AGgregate NEtwork for Time Series), an inherently interpretable neural architecture for TSER. MAGNETS learns a compact set of human-understandable concepts without requiring any annotations. Each concept corresponds to a learned, mask-based aggregation over selected input features, explicitly revealing both which features drive predictions and when they matter in the sequence. Predictions are formed as combinations of these learned concepts through a transparent, additive structure, enabling clear insight into the model's decision process.
  The code implementation and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/FlorentF9/MAGNETS.

title: PBFuzz: Agentic Directed Fuzzing for PoV Generation
summary: Proof-of-Vulnerability (PoV) input generation is a critical task in software security and supports downstream applications such as path generation and validation. Generating a PoV input requires solving two sets of constraints: (1) reachability constraints for reaching vulnerable code locations, and (2) triggering constraints for activating the target vulnerability. Existing approaches, including directed greybox fuzzing and LLM-assisted fuzzing, struggle to efficiently satisfy these constraints. This work presents an agentic method that mimics human experts. Human analysts iteratively study code to extract semantic reachability and triggering constraints, form hypotheses about PoV triggering strategies, encode them as test inputs, and refine their understanding using debugging feedback. We automate this process with an agentic directed fuzzing framework called PBFuzz. PBFuzz tackles four challenges in agentic PoV generation: autonomous code reasoning for semantic constraint extraction, custom program-analysis tools for targeted inference, persistent memory to avoid hypothesis drift, and property-based testing for efficient constraint solving while preserving input structure. Experiments on the Magma benchmark show strong results. PBFuzz triggered 57 vulnerabilities, surpassing all baselines, and uniquely triggered 17 vulnerabilities not exposed by existing fuzzers. PBFuzz achieved this within a 30-minute budget per target, while conventional approaches use 24 hours. Median time-to-exposure was 339 seconds for PBFuzz versus 8680 seconds for AFL++ with CmpLog, giving a 25.6x efficiency improvement with an API cost of 1.83 USD per vulnerability.
