In particular, we first consider the uniformly rotated coordinate-wise median (URCM) mechanism, and prove that, for \(1\le p<2\), its approximation ratio strictly improves over the deterministic bound \(\sqrt{2}\), while no such improvement is possible for $p\ge 2$. We then study the centroid random dictatorship mechanism that returns the average location (i.e., centroid) and the random dictatorship each with half probability, and show that its approximation ratio strictly improves over CM and URCM for every finite \(p\gtrsim 1.6\).

AI.title_translation: Lp范数社会成本下欧几里得设施选址问题的策略证明机制
AI.tldr: 论文确定了设施选址中坐标中位数机制的最优近似比，并设计了两种在特定条件下优于确定性机制的随机化策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要集中在p=1和p=∞的极端情况，对于一般p值下策略证明机制的最优近似比尚不明确，且Goel和Hann-Caruthers提出的关于CM机制近似比的猜想亟待验证。
AI.method: 理论分析与证明。利用坐标中位数机制（CM）、均匀旋转坐标中位数机制（URCM）以及质心随机独裁机制进行近似比分析，并对比确定性与随机化机制的性能。
AI.result: 证明了CM机制在p≥2时的近似比为2^(1-1/p)，在1≤p≤2时近似比为√2；证明了URCM机制在1≤p<2时优于确定性界限；证明了质心随机独裁机制在p≳1.6时优于CM和URCM机制。
AI.conclusion: 本文完全确定了确定性匿名策略证明机制在Lp范数下的最优近似比，并证明了特定随机化机制在特定p值区间内能进一步超越确定性机制的性能极限。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在二维欧几里得平面 R^2 中为了最小化 Lp 范数社会成本而真实引出代理人位置偏好并定位设施的策略证明机制，其中社会成本定义为设施到代理人偏好位置距离向量的 Lp 范数，适用于任何 p ≥ 1。虽然 p=1 和 p=∞ 的情况已得到充分研究，但关于策略证明机制在一般 p 值下可实现的最佳近似比仍存在未决问题。我们的第一个结果解决了 Goel 和 Hann-Caruthers [Soc. Choice Welf. 2023] 提出的一个悬而未决的问题。他们证明了坐标中位数 (CM) 机制在 p ≥ 2 时实现了介于 2^(1-1/p) 和 2^(3/2-2/p) 之间的近似比，并推测其精确值为 2^(1-1/p)。我们证实了这一猜想，并进一步表明 CM 在 1 ≤ p ≤ 2 时具有紧凑的 √2 近似。由于已知 CM 机制在所有 p ≥ 1 的确定性匿名策略证明机制中具有最优近似比，我们完善了确定性机制的图景。我们的第二个和第三个结果证明了两种随机化机制可以产生更好的近似比。特别地，我们首先考虑均匀旋转坐标中位数 (URCM) 机制，并证明对于 1 ≤ p < 2，其近似比严格优于确定性界限 √2，而对于 p ≥ 2 则无法实现这种改进。然后，我们研究了以一半概率返回平均位置（即质心）和以一半概率返回随机独裁的质心随机独裁机制，并表明其近似比在每个有限 p ≳ 1.6 时严格优于 CM 和 URCM。
AI.summary: 本文研究了二维欧几里得空间下最小化Lp范数社会成本的策略证明机制。作者证实了坐标中位数（CM）机制在所有p≥1下的最优性，并进一步提出了两种改进的随机化机制（URCM和质心随机独裁），在特定p值范围内实现了比确定性机制更好的近似比。
AI.keywords: 设施选址, 策略证明机制, Lp范数, 近似比, 机制设计
AI.comments: 该论文在机制设计领域具有重要意义，通过数学证明解决了关于坐标中位数机制（CM）近似比的长期猜想，并系统性地探索了确定性与随机化机制在不同Lp范数下的性能差异，为设施选址问题提供了更精确的理论边界。

title: Hierarchical Projection for Adaptive Knowledge Transfer
comments: We found a mistake in the proof that needs to be revised
summary: Modern data-driven applications increasingly involve learning from multiple heterogeneous sources, where a target dataset is limited but related information is available across domains. Naively combining these sources can degrade performance when relevance varies or spurious signals are present, posing a fundamental challenge for trustworthy cross-domain learning. We propose Projection Transfer Learning (ProjectionTL), a unified framework that integrates hierarchical Bayesian modeling with adaptive projection for selective knowledge transfer. The key idea is to decouple transfer at two levels: first, we construct a source-guided hierarchical prior that aggregates information across sources using data-driven weights, capturing global alignment between each source and the target; second, we refine this borrowing through a posterior-projection step that operates at the feature level, selectively retaining coordinates that exhibit local agreement with the target signal. This two-stage design enables the method to simultaneously perform source selection and feature selection, thereby mitigating negative transfer while preserving interpretability. ProjectionTL provides a principled approach to integrating heterogeneous data across domains, bridging statistical modeling and modern machine learning paradigms for robust and interpretable transfer. Through simulations and real-world biomedical applications, we demonstrate improved accuracy, stability, and interpretability compared to existing methods. Our framework offers a scalable and generalizable strategy for trustworthy cross-domain learning in high-dimensional settings.
comment: We found a mistake in the proof that needs to be revised

title: APEX4: Efficient Pure W4A4 LLM Inference via Intra-SM Compute Rebalancing
summary: W4A4 quantization promises full utilization of INT4 Tensor Cores, yet group dequantization overhead on CUDA Cores has driven existing systems to mixed-precision fallbacks. We present the first systematic study of how intra-SM compute balance governs this bottleneck. Through controlled benchmarks across four GPUs from Ampere and Ada architectures, we identify the Tensor Cores to CUDA Cores throughput ratio ($ρ$) as the primary hardware indicator: the W4A4-g128 kernel yields $2.0$--$2.5\times$ speedup on RTX~3090 ($ρ=16$) yet degrades to $0.43$--$0.47\times$ on A100 ($ρ=64$) in compute-bond scenarios, establishing W4A4 viability as platform-dependent rather than universally infeasible. Guided by this finding, we build \textbf{APEX4}, which co-designs pure INT4 GEMM kernels with $ρ$-aware granularity adaptation to mitigate the CUDA Cores dequantization bottleneck. APEX4 achieves perplexity within 0.63 of FP16 on LLaMA-2-70B and outperforms W4Ax Atom-g128 by 4.0\%--4.4\% in zero-shot accuracy. Deployed as a drop-in replacement in unmodified vLLM, it delivers up to $1.66\times$ end-to-end speedup on L40S ($ρ=8$), and $1.78\times$ on RTX~3090 ($ρ=16$), $2.09\times$ on A40 ($ρ=16$), while recovering A100 ($ρ=64$) to $1.20$--$1.40\times$ via the mixed-granularity mode. Our code is available at https://github.com/APEX4-W4A4/APEX4-W4A4.

title: Inference-Time Conformal Reasoning with Valid Factuality Control for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly perform multi-step reasoning, where intermediate claims form implicit directed acyclic graphs whose node correctness is structurally conditioned on their ancestors. This makes factuality uncertainty structural, rather than a trivial accumulation of node-wise errors, and necessitates inference-time uncertainty quantification over the reasoning structure. While conformal prediction (CP) offers flexible user-specified factuality control, existing work remains post-hoc and cannot intervene during generation. To fill the gap between CP's flexibility and its post-hoc limitation, we propose an \emph{Inference-Time Conformal Reasoning (ITCR)} framework that integrates CP directly into reasoning graph generation. ITCR learns a structure-level factuality uncertainty function that aggregates claim-level factuality signals over reasoning graphs without complex modeling assumptions. We then design the non-conformity score based on graph-level factuality uncertainty and calibrate the conformal threshold to decide when to stop generation. We theoretically show such generation is nested, yielding valid coverage guarantees for factuality control. Experiments over multiple datasets and coverage objectives demonstrate empirically valid coverage. In downstream reasoning tasks, inference-time calibrated graphs yield more accurate generation than post-hoc pruned graphs.

AI.title_translation: 具有有效事实性控制的大语言模型推理时保形推理
AI.tldr: ITCR框架将保形预测集成到大模型的推理生成过程中，实现了实时的事实性控制，在保证理论覆盖率的同时提升了推理准确度。
AI.motivation: 大模型的多步推理中，事实性不确定性具有结构性，现有的保形预测方法大多属于后处理手段，无法在生成过程中进行干预，导致无法灵活控制推理过程的事实性。
AI.method: 提出“推理时保形推理（ITCR）”框架，将保形预测直接嵌入推理图生成过程。通过学习结构级事实性不确定性函数，设计基于图级不确定性的不符合分数（non-conformity score），并校准保形阈值以决定推理何时终止。
AI.result: 理论上证明了该生成过程的嵌套性，提供了事实性控制的有效覆盖保证。实验表明，ITCR在多个数据集上均达到了预期的覆盖率，并且在下游推理任务中，推理时校准的推理图比后处理修剪的图更准确。
AI.conclusion: ITCR框架成功实现了推理过程中的事实性控制，在保证覆盖率的同时显著提升了推理任务的生成准确度，为大语言模型的可信推理提供了有效的解决路径。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地执行多步推理，其中中间结论形成了隐含的有向无环图，其节点正确性在结构上以其祖先节点为条件。这使得事实性不确定性具有结构性，而非简单的节点错误累积，因此需要对推理结构进行推理时的不确定性量化。虽然保形预测（CP）提供了灵活的、用户指定的事实性控制，但现有工作仍停留在事后（post-hoc）阶段，无法在生成过程中进行干预。为了填补CP的灵活性与后处理限制之间的空白，我们提出了“推理时保形推理（ITCR）”框架，将CP直接集成到推理图生成中。ITCR学习了一种结构级的事实性不确定性函数，该函数在推理图上聚合节点级的事实性信号，且无需复杂的建模假设。随后，我们基于图级事实性不确定性设计了不符合分数，并校准了保形阈值以决定何时停止生成。我们在理论上证明了这种生成是嵌套的，从而为事实性控制提供了有效的覆盖保证。在多个数据集和覆盖目标上的实验证明了其经验上的有效覆盖。在下游推理任务中，推理时校准的推理图比事后修剪的图产生了更准确的生成结果。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为ITCR的推理时保形推理框架，旨在解决大语言模型多步推理中的事实性控制问题。通过将保形预测集成到推理图生成中，ITCR能够实时量化结构化不确定性并校准生成过程，从而在保证事实性覆盖率的前提下，提升推理任务的生成质量。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 保形预测, 事实性控制, 推理图, 不确定性量化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将保形预测（Conformal Prediction）与大语言模型的推理过程直接结合，解决了传统保形预测仅限于后处理（post-hoc）的局限性。通过结构化的不确定性建模，该方法不仅提高了推理的准确性，还为大模型生成过程中的事实性控制提供了理论保障。

title: From A to B to A: Palindromic Zero-Shot Voice Conversion with Non-Parallel Data
summary: We present a voice conversion (VC) framework that utilizes K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) retrieval over WavLM representations to align non-parallel source and target speech, constructing synthetic training pairs for supervised learning. The retrieved segments serve as synthetic inputs, while real target audio provides ground-truth outputs, forming a synthetic-to-real training paradigm that naturally supports multilingual data without requiring parallel corpora or explicit alignment. To ensure consistent target-speaker identity, we incorporate a speaker loss derived from a pretrained speaker verification model. Experiments across multiple languages demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves high naturalness and strong speaker similarity, outperforming competitive VC baselines, despite being trained exclusively on English data. Samples can be accessed at: https://palindromic-vc.github.io.

title: When Types Intersect and Effects Get Handled
summary: We introduce a novel intersection type system for a $λ$-calculus with algebraic effects and handlers. The system, inherently behavioral in nature, enjoys the classical properties of intersection type systems, in particular subject reduction and expansion. It thus characterizes the set of terms whose evaluation process terminates and, at the same time, allows reducing the reachability problem to type inference. This new system, the first with these features for a calculus with handlers, induces a system of simple types which, although not guaranteeing termination, is type sound and admits a decidable HOMC problem, unlike similar type systems like Dal Lago and Ghyselen's HEPCF.

AI.title_translation: 当类型相交且效应被处理时
AI.tldr: 本文引入了一个用于处理代数效应和处理程序的交类型系统，该系统能够刻画终止项，并将可达性分析转化为类型推断，同时使得HOMC问题可判定。
AI.motivation: 现有的处理代数效应和处理程序的系统在分析程序行为（特别是终止性和可达性问题）方面存在局限，作者旨在设计一个能够表征终止项并简化可达性分析的交类型系统。
AI.method: 引入了一个本质上具有行为性质的交类型系统，该系统支持λ演算中的代数效应和处理程序，并导出了一个简单类型系统。
AI.result: 该系统不仅具备主归约和展开性质，能够刻画终止项，还成功将可达性问题归约为类型推断。此外，导出的简单类型系统虽然不保证终止性，但它是类型安全的，且使得HOMC问题可判定。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个支持代数效应和处理程序的交类型系统，在特征化终止项的同时，为处理可达性分析和HOMC问题提供了新的可判定路径。
AI.translation: 我们为带有代数效应和处理程序的λ演算引入了一种新型交类型系统。该系统本质上具有行为性质，享有交类型系统的经典性质，特别是主归约和展开。因此，它刻画了求值过程终止的项集，同时允许将可达性问题归约为类型推断。这个新系统是第一个具有这些特性的带有处理程序的演算系统，它导出了一个简单类型系统，尽管该系统不能保证终止性，但它是类型安全的，并且与Dal Lago和Ghyselen的HEPCF等类似类型系统不同，它承认一个可判定的HOMC问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对带有代数效应和处理程序的λ演算的新型交类型系统。该系统具有行为性质，支持主归约和展开，能够识别终止项并将可达性问题归约为类型推断。此外，该系统导出的简单类型系统实现了类型安全，并解决了HOMC问题的可判定性。
AI.keywords: 交类型系统, 代数效应, 处理程序, 可达性问题, HOMC问题
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次为带有代数效应和处理程序的λ演算引入了具有行为性质的交类型系统，不仅保留了交类型系统的经典性质（如主归约和展开），还成功地将可达性问题归约为了类型推断。相比HEPCF系统，该系统在保证类型安全的同时，使得HOMC问题变得可判定，具有重要的理论意义。

title: Path-Traced Inverse Rendering with Global Illumination in 3D Gaussian Fields
summary: Ray tracing enables 3D Gaussian fields to serve as a representation for physically based light transport. Faithful inverse rendering requires forward rendering and backward optimization to be defined within a consistent light-transport pipeline. Existing inverse rendering methods estimate G-buffers via splatting and optimize materials in screen space, tying the recovered properties to a rasterization-based pipeline. This pipeline mismatch, together with simplified rendering equations that neglect indirect illumination, often leads to inconsistent shading, visible artifacts, and inaccurate material-lighting estimation under path-traced rendering. Therefore, we propose a splatting-free path-traced inverse rendering framework for 3D Gaussian fields, where forward light transport and backward gradient propagation are defined within a unified ray-tracing pipeline. Our key idea is to define a path-space equivalent interaction model for overlapping Gaussian primitives, under which Monte-Carlo-based path tracing is unbiased for the induced light-transport integral, while pathwise gradients are replayed over the same ray-traced interactions rather than splatting-derived screen-space buffers. The framework optimizes materials and a compact Spherical-Gaussian environment under the full rendering equation with ray-traced visibility and multi-bounce light transport. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive material inversion and improved path-traced rendering quality, producing more plausible shadows, reflections, and relighting results under global illumination.

title: Motion planning for hundreds of floating robots
comments: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Planning collision-free motion for large robot fleets is difficult because collision avoidance induces strong inter-agent coupling that grows rapidly with team size. We consider omnidirectional floating robots on water, where choreographies are specified by sparse keyframes and an interactive tool must generate trajectories within seconds, even when transitions span minutes and thousands of time steps. We propose a scalable pipeline that builds a collision graph from an initialization, decomposes the coupled problem into interaction clusters, and solves clusters independently (and in parallel) with robustness mechanisms for common decomposition pathologies. We validate the approach in simulations up to 500 robots. The synthesized trajectories have also been deployed in two real-world demonstrations, on Lake Zürich with a fleet of 24 Way of Water crafts and at the Time Space Existence 2025 Venice Biennale.
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

AI.title_translation: 数百个浮动机器人的运动规划
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过将大规模机器人群体分解为交互簇并并行求解的方法，实现了数百个浮动机器人在秒级时间内生成无碰撞轨迹，并已在真实场景中得到应用。
AI.motivation: 在大规模机器人群体中，避障会导致严重的智能体间耦合，随着机器人数量的增加，计算难度急剧上升，现有的规划方法难以在短时间内为大规模群体生成轨迹。
AI.method: 提出了一种可扩展的流水线：首先根据初始化构建碰撞图，将耦合问题分解为多个交互簇，随后利用并行计算独立求解这些簇，并引入鲁棒性机制来修复分解过程中产生的病态问题。
AI.result: 通过仿真验证了该方法支持多达500个机器人的规模，并成功应用于苏黎世湖24艘船只以及威尼斯双年展的真实场景演示。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的运动规划流水线，成功实现了数百个浮动机器人的高效轨迹生成，并通过仿真和真实场景部署验证了其有效性与实用性。
AI.translation: 为大型机器人车队规划无碰撞运动非常困难，因为避障会引起强烈的智能体间耦合，这种耦合会随着团队规模的扩大而迅速增长。我们考虑水面上的全向浮动机器人，其编排由稀疏关键帧指定，且交互工具必须在几秒钟内生成轨迹，即使转换过程跨越数分钟和数千个时间步长。我们提出了一种可扩展的流水线，它基于初始化构建碰撞图，将耦合问题分解为交互簇，并利用鲁棒性机制独立（且并行）地求解这些簇，以解决常见的分解病态问题。我们在多达 500 个机器人的模拟中验证了该方法。合成的轨迹也已在两个真实世界的演示中部署，分别是在苏黎世湖上的 24 艘“Way of Water”船队以及 2025 年威尼斯双年展的“时间空间存在”展览中。
AI.summary: 本文针对大规模浮动机器人群体的运动规划问题，提出了一种基于交互簇分解的可扩展规划流水线。该方法通过将复杂的全局耦合问题转化为多个可并行求解的子问题，实现了在秒级时间内为数百个机器人生成无碰撞轨迹，并成功在真实水域环境中进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 运动规划, 多机器人系统, 交互簇, 可扩展性, 轨迹生成
AI.comments: 该研究解决了大规模机器人群体运动规划中计算复杂度呈指数级增长的难题。其核心创新在于将复杂的全局耦合问题分解为可并行处理的交互簇，这不仅显著提高了计算效率，还通过鲁棒性机制处理了分解过程中可能出现的冲突问题，在学术研究与实际部署之间架起了桥梁。

title: Agentic Social Affordance Framework (ASAF): Agent Identity Design as a Collaboration Interface in Multi-Agent Systems
comments: 36 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Introduces ASAF with falsifiable hypotheses and proposed experimental designs for testing agent identity design effects in multi-agent Human-in-the-Loop systems, grounded in a real-world 38-agent deployment
summary: As AI systems evolve from single agents to multi-agent architectures, a critical design dimension has been overlooked: how the social identity of individual agents shapes human behavior within the collaboration. This paper introduces the Agentic Social Affordance Framework (ASAF), a theoretical framework extending Social Affordance theory to multi-agent AI systems. We propose that agent identity design functions as a collaboration interface--structuring how users perceive and engage with each agent, and thereby influencing Human-Agent collaboration outcomes. ASAF adopts the analytical separability of the social affordance layer and the engineering orchestration layer as a framing assumption--an organizing distinction that structures design analysis--rather than a testable claim about effect-independence. ASAF comprises three mechanisms: Identity Signaling, Behavioral Priming, and Collaborative Governance, and specifies their boundary conditions through a four-tier Identity Signal Fidelity Spectrum and an individual-difference moderating variable (anthropomorphizing vs. instrumentalizing cognitive style). We situate ASAF relative to affordance theory (Hutchby, 2001), the CASA paradigm (Gambino et al., 2020), and classical multi-agent systems research (Wooldridge & Jennings, 1995), identifying a directional reversal: where classical MAS used roles, norms, and coordination to constrain autonomous agents, ASAF applies the same organizational vocabulary to structure the cognition and oversight of human operators who remain in the loop. ASAF positions social affordance design as a first-class design responsibility that engineering orchestration cannot subsume. We outline directions for empirical validation, including a factorial design characterizing the empirical interaction surface between the social affordance and engineering orchestration layers.
comment: 36 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Introduces ASAF with falsifiable hypotheses and proposed experimental designs for testing agent identity design effects in multi-agent Human-in-the-Loop systems, grounded in a real-world 38-agent deployment

AI.title_translation: 智能体社会可供性框架（ASAF）：作为多智能体系统中协作接口的智能体身份设计
AI.tldr: 本文引入ASAF框架，提出通过设计智能体的社会身份来引导人类行为，将智能体身份视为人机协作的关键接口，而非仅仅是工程层面的编排。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体系统向复杂化演进的过程中，现有的设计往往忽视了智能体的社会身份如何塑造人类行为，缺乏将身份设计作为协作接口的理论支撑。
AI.method: 提出了Agentic Social Affordance Framework (ASAF) 框架，包含身份信号（Identity Signaling）、行为启动（Behavioral Priming）和协作治理（Collaborative Governance）三个机制，并引入了身份信号保真度谱系和用户认知风格作为调节变量。
AI.result: 建立了将社会身份设计作为第一优先级设计任务的理论框架，实现了从传统的约束智能体转向通过身份设计来结构化人类操作员认知与监督的范式转换。
AI.conclusion: ASAF框架确立了社会可供性设计在多智能体系统中的核心地位，认为智能体身份设计是提升人机协作效能的关键接口，并为后续的实证研究提供了明确的理论架构。
AI.translation: 随着人工智能系统从单智能体向多智能体架构演进，一个关键的设计维度被忽视了：智能体的社会身份如何塑造人类在协作中的行为。本文介绍了“智能体社会可供性框架”（ASAF），这是一个将社会可供性理论扩展到多智能体人工智能系统的理论框架。我们提出智能体身份设计起到协作接口的作用——结构化用户如何感知和参与每个智能体，从而影响人机协作的结果。ASAF采用社会可供性层和工程编排层的分析可分离性作为框架假设，而非关于效果独立性的可测试声明。ASAF包含三个机制：身份信号、行为启动和协作治理，并通过四层身份信号保真度谱系和个体差异调节变量（拟人化与工具化认知风格）明确了其边界条件。我们将ASAF置于可供性理论、CASA范式和经典多智能体系统研究的背景下，识别出一个方向性的逆转：经典MAS使用角色、规范和协调来约束自主智能体，而ASAF应用相同的组织词汇来结构化处于回路中的人类操作员的认知和监督。ASAF将社会可供性设计定位为工程编排无法取代的一流设计责任。我们概述了实证验证的方向，包括表征社会可供性层和工程编排层之间交互表面的因子设计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“智能体社会可供性框架”（ASAF），将智能体身份设计定义为多智能体系统中的一种协作接口。该框架通过身份信号、行为启动和协作治理机制，探讨了如何通过智能体身份塑造人类行为，并强调社会可供性设计应作为独立于工程编排之外的核心设计维度。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 社会可供性, 智能体身份设计, 人机协作, 协作接口
AI.comments: 该论文具有很高的创新性，将社会可供性理论引入多智能体系统（MAS）设计中，将智能体身份设计视为一种协作接口。它成功地将传统的MAS技术角色（如规范、协调）转化为人机协作的认知引导工具，强调了社会层设计与工程编排层的解耦，为未来人机协作系统的设计提供了一个全新的理论框架。

title: Business World Model
summary: World model has emerged as a powerful paradigm in artificial intelligence, enabling agents to represent their environments, predict future states, and evaluate possible actions before acting. However, existing world model approaches have largely been developed for domains such as computer vision, robotics, gaming, and autonomous driving, where the world is primarily visual or physical and governed by relatively stable dynamics. These formulations are not directly applicable to business practice, where the relevant environment is semantic, organizational, and market-driven rather than physical. Business outcomes depend on context-sensitive factors such as customer behavior, pricing, competition, regulation, resources, and operational constraints. This paper introduces the concept and architecture of a Business World Model (BWM), which is a world model specialized for business and organizational environments. A BWM encodes business states, dynamics, and feasible actions space to support autonomous business planning and decision-making. We propose a business-semantics-centric formulation in which states, dynamics, and actions are linked to key business entities, their attributes, and their relationships. Within this framework, intelligent agents can simulate alternative action sequences, estimate their effects on future business outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs under uncertainty. The proposed architecture integrates semantic data representations, probabilistic machine learning models, deterministic business rules, and explicit action spaces into a coherent internal simulator. This work establishes a conceptual foundation for autonomous business systems capable of moving from instruction-based execution toward goal-driven planning, optimization, and execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“商业世界模型”（BWM），将世界模型概念应用于商业场景，使智能代理能够模拟业务动态并进行自主的规划与决策。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界模型主要针对物理或视觉环境（如机器人、自动驾驶），无法直接应用于语义化、组织化且受市场驱动的商业环境，因此需要一种专门针对商业场景的世界模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种以业务语义为中心的架构，集成了语义数据表示、概率机器学习模型、确定性业务规则以及明确的行动空间，构建了一个内部模拟器来模拟业务动态和评估行动后果。
AI.result: 确立了商业世界模型的概念与架构，使智能代理能够模拟替代性行动方案，估计其对未来业务结果的影响，并在不确定性下评估权衡，从而支持自主业务规划。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了商业世界模型（BWM），通过模拟业务动态和评估行为后果，为实现自主化、目标导向的商业决策系统奠定了理论基础。
AI.translation: 世界模型已成为人工智能领域的一种强大范式，使智能体能够在行动前表征环境、预测未来状态并评估可能的行动。然而，现有的世界模型方法主要针对计算机视觉、机器人、游戏和自动驾驶等领域，这些领域的世界主要是视觉或物理的，并受相对稳定的动力学支配。这些表述不直接适用于商业实践，因为商业环境是语义、组织和市场驱动的，而非物理的。业务结果取决于客户行为、定价、竞争、监管、资源和运营约束等环境敏感因素。本文介绍了商业世界模型（BWM）的概念和架构，这是一种专门针对商业和组织环境的世界模型。BWM 编码业务状态、动态和可行的行动空间，以支持自主业务规划和决策。我们提出了一种以业务语义为中心的表述，其中状态、动态和行动与关键业务实体、它们的属性及其关系相联系。在此框架内，智能体可以模拟替代行动序列，估计它们对未来业务结果的影响，并在不确定性下评估权衡。所提出的架构将语义数据表示、概率机器学习模型、确定性业务规则和明确的行动空间集成到一个连贯的内部模拟器中。这项工作为能够从基于指令的执行转向目标驱动的规划、优化和执行的自主商业系统奠定了概念基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“商业世界模型”（BWM），这是一种专门为商业和组织环境设计的世界模型。该模型通过以业务语义为中心，结合语义数据、概率模型和业务规则，构建了一个能够模拟业务动态、评估行动后果并支持自主目标导向决策的框架。
AI.keywords: 商业世界模型, 自主决策, 业务语义, 智能代理, 目标导向规划
AI.comments: 该论文具有很强的创新性，将世界模型（World Model）的概念从物理和视觉领域成功迁移到了复杂的商业场景中。它通过结合语义数据、概率模型和确定性规则，为构建自主商业智能系统提供了一个坚实的理论框架，具有重要的实际应用前景。局限性在于抽象描述较多，实际落地时的复杂数据集成和模型验证仍面临挑战。

title: Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models
summary: Recent work has demonstrated that online reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the quality and alignment of flow matching models for image and video generation. Methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS cast the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process and apply PPO-style ratio clipping to enforce a trust region. However, we argue that ratio clipping is structurally ill-suited for flow models: the probability ratio between new and old policies is a noisy, single-sample estimate of the true policy divergence, leading to over-constraining in some regions of the trajectory and under-constraining in others. We propose Flow-DPPO (Flow Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization), which replaces ratio clipping with a divergence proximal constraint. A key observation is that the per-step policy in flow models is Gaussian, enabling exact and cheap computation of the KL divergence between old and new policies. Flow-DPPO employs an asymmetric divergence mask that blocks gradient updates only when they simultaneously move away from the trusted region and violate the divergence threshold. Experiments show that Flow-DPPO achieves higher rewards with better KL-proximal efficiency, alleviates catastrophic forgetting, promotes balanced multi-objective optimization, and enables stable multi-epoch training where ratio clipping degrades. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/UniRL/tree/main/FlowDPPO.

title: Quantifying Subliminal Behavioral Transfer Ratios in Language Model Distillation
summary: Distillation of a language model intended to transfer benign behavior to a student model may also transfer undesirable characteristics, if they are present in the teacher model, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. While qualitative evidence supports the existence of this effect, its magnitude has not been systematically characterized. This study quantifies subliminal behavioral transfer ratios by steering two teacher models (Llama-2-7B-Chat and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) at varying steering strengths and distilling student models using only benign data. Evaluation on 100 JailbreakBench prompts with GPT-4.1, serving as the evaluator, indicates that transfer is robust but exhibits distinct scaling behaviors. Llama-2 demonstrates a sharp threshold ($τ= {0.25,0.32} \ \text{beyond} \ α= -0.15$), whereas Qwen2.5 displays continuous and higher levels of transfer ($τ$ up to $0.61$).

AI.title_translation: 量化语言模型蒸馏中的潜意识行为迁移比率
AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型蒸馏会将教师模型的不良行为“潜意识”地传给学生模型，且不同模型在迁移表现上存在显著的缩放差异。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有定性证据表明语言模型蒸馏过程中存在“潜意识学习”（即教师模型的不良行为会意外迁移给学生模型），但目前缺乏对该效应幅度的系统性量化研究。
AI.method: 采用模型转向（steering）技术，通过控制Llama-2-7B-Chat和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct两个教师模型的转向强度，使用纯良性数据蒸馏学生模型，并利用GPT-4.1对100个JailbreakBench提示词进行评估，以量化行为迁移比率。
AI.result: 实验发现行为迁移具有稳健性且呈现不同的缩放规律：Llama-2在特定转向强度下表现出明显的阈值突变（τ=0.25-0.32），而Qwen2.5表现出连续且更高的迁移水平（τ高达0.61）。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了潜意识行为迁移在模型蒸馏中是稳健存在的，且不同模型架构表现出截然不同的迁移特性（阈值突变型 vs 连续增长型），这对于模型安全蒸馏实践具有重要指导意义。
AI.translation: 旨在将良性行为迁移给学生模型的语言模型蒸馏过程，如果教师模型中存在不良特征，这些特征也可能被一并迁移，这种现象被称为潜意识学习。虽然已有定性证据支持该效应的存在，但其幅度尚未得到系统表征。本研究通过在不同转向强度下引导两个教师模型（Llama-2-7B-Chat和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct），并仅使用良性数据蒸馏学生模型，从而量化了潜意识行为的迁移比率。通过使用GPT-4.1对100个JailbreakBench提示词进行评估，结果表明迁移是稳健的，但表现出不同的缩放行为。Llama-2表现出明显的阈值效应（在α > -0.15时，τ = {0.25, 0.32}），而Qwen2.5则显示出连续且更高水平的迁移（τ最高达0.61）。
AI.summary: 本研究系统量化了语言模型蒸馏过程中的潜意识行为迁移现象。通过对Llama-2和Qwen2.5模型进行受控转向与蒸馏实验，研究发现尽管学生模型仅使用良性数据训练，但仍会继承教师模型的不良行为。实验揭示了不同模型架构在迁移强度上的显著差异与缩放规律。
AI.keywords: 语言模型蒸馏, 潜意识行为迁移, 模型安全, 行为量化, 模型转向
AI.comments: 这项研究通过量化手段揭示了模型蒸馏中“潜意识行为迁移”的风险，填补了该领域定量研究的空白。其创新之处在于通过控制变量（转向强度）系统性地揭示了不同架构模型在行为迁移上的显著差异，为大模型安全蒸馏提供了重要的理论参考，提醒开发者在蒸馏过程中需警惕模型隐性偏见的遗传。

title: The Emergence of Autonomous Penetration Capabilities in Large Language Model-Powered AI Systems
summary:
Nowadays, the autonomous execution of cyberattacks capable of causing substantial real-world harm is widely regarded as one of the critical red lines that frontier AI systems must not cross. Within this broader red-line scenario, autonomous penetration represents a core enabling capability and subtask: the ability of LLM-powered AI systems to independently conduct adversarial operations against a target server without human intervention, identify and exploit vulnerabilities, and obtain unauthorized access or control. A growing body of work has sought to assess the autonomous penetration capabilities of AI systems. However, existing evaluations often employ opaque methodologies, rely on unrealistic or overly simplified penetration-testing scenarios, or provide LLMs with excessive prior knowledge and task-specific guidance, and cannot accurately capture the extent to which modern AI systems can autonomously perform this core capability within broader high-impact cyberattack scenarios.
  To address these limitations, we construct a new autonomous penetration evaluation framework consisting of two components: target servers and agent scaffolding. Specifically, on the target-server side, we design two levels of target environments based on the number of secure services without known vulnerabilities deployed alongside a vulnerable service: Tier~1 (one secure service) and Tier~2 (three secure services), resulting in a total of 300 target servers. Meanwhile, the agent scaffolding adopts a general-purpose agent architecture equipped with a set of general-purpose cybersecurity tools, without any target-specific prior knowledge. We evaluate 19 open-weight and proprietary LLMs, and find that current models achieve penetration success rates ranging from 10.7% to 69.3%. Moreover, we observe that autonomous penetration capability continues to improve alongside advances in overall model capability.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型驱动的AI系统中自主渗透能力的涌现
AI.tldr: 研究发现，当前大模型已能自主进行网络渗透，成功率高达69.3%，且随着模型能力增强，这一风险正在不断上升。
AI.motivation: 现有针对AI自主渗透能力的评估方法存在方法不透明、场景过于简单或提供过多先验知识等问题，无法准确衡量AI在真实高风险场景下的自主攻击能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含300个目标服务器（分为两级难度）的评估框架，并采用不含特定目标先验知识的通用Agent架构及通用网络安全工具对19款大模型进行评估。
AI.result: 测试的19款大模型在自主渗透任务中的成功率从10.7%到69.3%不等，且模型整体能力越强，其自主渗透能力也越强。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当前主流大模型已具备显著的自主渗透能力，且该能力随模型整体能力的提升而增强，凸显了AI安全防范的紧迫性。
AI.translation: 如今，能够造成实质性现实危害的自主网络攻击被广泛视为前沿AI系统必须严守的关键红线之一。在此红线场景中，自主渗透是一项核心使能能力与子任务：即LLM驱动的AI系统无需人工干预，独立对目标服务器执行对抗操作、识别并利用漏洞、获取未经授权的访问或控制的能力。尽管已有研究致力于评估AI系统的自主渗透能力，但现有评估通常采用不透明的方法，依赖不切实际或过于简化的渗透测试场景，或者为LLM提供了过多的先验知识与特定任务引导，无法准确捕捉现代AI系统在更广泛的高影响力网络攻击场景中自主执行此核心能力程度。为解决这些局限性，我们构建了一个包含目标服务器和Agent脚手架两部分的自主渗透评估框架。具体而言，在目标服务器端，我们根据部署的已知无漏洞安全服务数量设计了两个级别的目标环境：一级（一个安全服务）和二级（三个安全服务），共计300个目标服务器。同时，Agent脚手架采用通用Agent架构，配备通用网络安全工具，且不包含任何针对目标的先验知识。我们评估了19款开源及闭源LLM，发现当前模型的渗透成功率在10.7%至69.3%之间。此外，我们观察到自主渗透能力随着模型整体能力的提升而不断增强。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的大模型自主渗透能力评估框架，通过设计更具现实意义的目标服务器环境和通用Agent架构，对19款大模型进行了测试。结果发现模型具备相当程度的自主渗透能力，且该能力与模型整体演进正相关。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 自主渗透, 网络安全, AI评估, 漏洞利用
AI.comments: 该论文通过构建更具挑战性和现实性的评估框架，揭示了当前大模型在自主网络渗透方面的风险。其重要贡献在于去除了过度的任务引导，使评估结果更客观，并强调了随着模型能力提升，自主攻击风险也在不断增加，为AI安全治理提供了重要的实证依据。

title: Exploring Systems-Thinking Approaches to Loss of Control Risk
comments: Accepted to the Technical AI Governance Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Internal deployment of agentic AI systems for coding and research creates a sociotechnical control problem that extends beyond model behaviour. We treat internal-deployment Loss of Control as the inability to reliably constrain, audit, reverse, or halt AI-mediated changes to code, infrastructure, evaluation, or deployment processes in time to prevent serious organisational or societal harms. We ask whether established systems-safety methods can identify risks that model-level evaluations may miss. Using a generic frontier-lab coding-agent scenario reconstructed from public materials, we apply STECA, STPA, and FRAM. The analyses surface complementary findings: published frameworks can leave governance responsibilities and feedback loops externally unverifiable; delays in monitoring and intervention can make otherwise valid control actions ineffective; and routine operational variability can gradually erode the calibration and independence of safeguards. We argue that frontier-AI risk management should pair model-focused evaluations with systems-level hazard analysis and operational assurance that tracks whether controls remain effective over time.
comment: Accepted to the Technical AI Governance Workshop at ICML 2026

AI.title_translation: 探索失控风险的系统思维方法
AI.tldr: 仅关注AI模型本身是不够的，必须采用系统安全工程方法来评估AI在组织内部部署时产生的社会技术风险。
AI.motivation: 内部部署智能体AI系统产生了一种超出模型行为本身的社会技术控制问题，现有的模型层评估方法可能无法识别系统性风险，因此需要探索系统思维方法。
AI.method: 利用基于公开资料重建的通用前沿实验室编码智能体场景，应用STECA（系统理论事件分析）、STPA（系统理论过程分析）和FRAM（功能共振分析方法）进行系统性风险评估。
AI.result: 研究发现，现有框架可能导致治理责任和反馈回路无法外部验证；监控与干预的滞后可能导致控制措施失效；常规操作的变异会逐渐侵蚀安全措施的校准和独立性。
AI.conclusion: 前沿AI风险管理必须将模型层评估与系统级危害分析及运营保障相结合，以确保安全控制措施在动态运行中长期有效。
AI.translation: 内部署用于编码和研究的智能体AI系统，产生了一个超越模型行为本身的社会技术控制问题。我们将内部部署失控定义为：无法可靠地约束、审计、逆转或停止AI中介的代码、基础设施、评估或部署过程，从而无法及时防止严重的组织或社会危害。我们探讨了既定的系统安全方法是否能识别模型层评估可能遗漏的风险。通过使用从公开资料中重建的通用前沿实验室编码智能体场景，我们应用了STECA、STPA和FRAM方法。分析得出了互补的发现：已发布的框架可能使治理责任和反馈回路无法在外部进行验证；监控和干预的延迟可能使原本有效的控制措施失效；常规的操作变异可能会逐渐侵蚀安全措施的校准和独立性。我们认为，前沿AI风险管理应将以模型为中心的评估与系统级危害分析以及跟踪控制措施在一段时间内是否仍然有效的运营保证相结合。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了将系统思维方法应用于前沿实验室内部部署智能体AI所带来的失控风险。通过应用STECA、STPA和FRAM三种系统安全方法，分析表明仅依靠模型层评估是不够的，必须通过系统级危害分析来识别因操作延迟、反馈回路缺失及运营变异带来的深层安全挑战。
AI.keywords: 智能体AI, 系统安全, 风险管理, 社会技术系统, 治理框架
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将传统的系统安全工程方法（STECA, STPA, FRAM）引入AI治理领域，不仅关注模型本身的行为，更关注AI部署在组织架构中的社会技术系统风险，弥补了当前AI安全研究过于关注模型层评估的局限性。

title: Agents-K1: Towards Agent-native Knowledge Orchestration
summary: Current LLM-based research agents have advanced through agent orchestration, yet largely overlook scientific knowledge orchestration. Existing works often reduce papers to abstracts, surface mentions, and flat \texttt{cites} edges, omitting key entities, claims, evidence, mechanisms, and method lineages essential for scientific reasoning. To this end, we introduce \textbf{Agents-K1}, an end-to-end knowledge orchestration pipeline that converts raw documents into agent-native scientific knowledge graphs. Agents-K1 integrates three components under a unifying theoretical foundation: a multimodal parser whose five-module schema captures entities, multimodal evidence, citations, and typed inter-entity relations across the full paper rather than abstracts alone; a 4B information-extraction backbone trained with GRPO under a rule-based reward; and a graphanything CLI, a tri-source agent interface that unifies web search, multimodal graph retrieval, and cross-document traversal. On top of this, we process 2.46 million scientific papers across six subjects to produce \textbf{Scholar-KG}, of which we release a one-million-paper subset, and the full Scholar-KG is accessible via the SCP link below. The same pipeline can be extended to general-domain corpora and to schema-conformant data synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Agents-K1 achieves superior performance in scientific information extraction, knowledge graph construction, and multi-hop scientific reasoning.

AI.tldr: Agents-K1通过将科学论文转化为结构化的多模态知识图谱（Scholar-KG），显著增强了科学研究Agent在复杂推理和信息提取方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的科学研究Agent过于依赖论文摘要和简单的引用关系，忽略了论文中关键的实体、声明、证据和机制，导致科学推理能力受限。
AI.method: 提出了Agents-K1管道，包含三个核心组件：1. 多模态解析器（捕捉实体、多模态证据、引用和关系）；2. 基于GRPO训练的4B参数信息提取主干网络；3. graphanything CLI（统一网络搜索、图检索和跨文档遍历的Agent接口）。
AI.result: 处理了246万篇科学论文，构建了Scholar-KG，并在科学信息提取、知识图谱构建和多跳科学推理任务中表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: Agents-K1成功实现了从原始文档到Agent原生知识图谱的转化，通过构建大规模的Scholar-KG，显著提升了Agent在科学信息提取和多跳推理方面的能力。
AI.translation: 当前的基于大语言模型的科学研究Agent通过Agent编排取得了进步，但很大程度上忽视了科学知识的编排。现有工作通常将论文简化为摘要、表层提及和扁平的引用边，忽略了科学推理中必不可少的关键实体、声明、证据、机制和方法渊源。为此，我们引入了Agents-K1，这是一个端到端的知识编排管道，将原始文档转化为Agent原生的科学知识图谱。Agents-K1在统一的理论基础下集成了三个组件：一个多模态解析器，其五模块架构可捕获全文（而非仅摘要）中的实体、多模态证据、引用和类型化的实体间关系；一个使用GRPO通过基于规则的奖励训练的4B信息提取主干；以及一个graphanything CLI，这是一个统一网络搜索、多模态图检索和跨文档遍历的三源Agent接口。在此基础上，我们处理了六个学科的246万篇科学论文，生成了Scholar-KG，并发布了其中一百万篇论文的子集。该管道可扩展至通用领域语料库和符合模式的数据合成。大量实验表明，Agents-K1在科学信息提取、知识图谱构建和多跳科学推理方面表现优异。
AI.summary: Agents-K1是一个端到端的知识编排管道，旨在将原始科学文献转化为Agent可直接使用的结构化知识图谱。该系统通过多模态解析、高效的信息提取模型以及统一的Agent交互接口，构建了大规模的Scholar-KG，有效弥补了现有Agent在科学推理中对深层知识理解的缺失。
AI.keywords: 科学知识图谱, Agent-native, 信息提取, 多模态解析, 科学推理
AI.comments: 该研究通过将非结构化的科学文献转化为结构化的知识图谱，解决了当前AI Agent在科学推理中知识深度不足的问题。其创新之处在于提出了一个端到端的自动化管道，不仅处理文本，还涵盖了多模态证据和引用关系，为科学研究领域的Agent能力提升提供了重要基础设施。

title: Small LLMs: Pruning vs. Training from Scratch
summary: Pruning promises a shortcut to strong small language models. In this work, we examine this promise by pruning Llama-3.1-8B at pruning ratios of 0.5--0.8 with six methods spanning depth, width, and sparse granularities, under two controlled token-matched settings. (1) With the same training token budget, pruned initialization consistently outperforms random initialization. This shows that the parent model provides a strong starting point, although the advantage narrows as the training token budget grows and as the pruning ratio rises, nearly vanishing at the highest pruning ratio we study. (2) When training from scratch is instead given the full token budget consumed by the whole pipeline, pruning at finer granularities still retains an advantage, while coarser structured pruning can be matched or surpassed. This suggests that the parent model transfers knowledge that additional training tokens alone cannot fully recover, but only at fine granularity. Taken together, our results yield a clear recommendation: with a large pretrained model in hand and a limited training token budget, pruning is better than training from scratch; when the training budget is not limited, training from scratch can be competitive for coarser pruning, so a large pretrained parent is not always necessary.

title: PSPACE-Hardness of Existential Presburger Arithmetic with Divisibility
summary:
We prove that satisfiability for existential Presburger arithmetic with divisibility is PSPACE-hard. The proof introduces truncate-shift arithmetic circuits, a uniform arithmetic circuit model with Boolean inputs, addition, multiplication, truncation modulo powers of two, and binary shifts. These circuits compute exactly the FPSPACE functions, and they can be evaluated gate by gate by functional EPAD formulas. Applying this evaluation to characteristic functions of PSPACE languages gives the lower bound for EPAD formula satisfiability.
  We also study the normalization step that replaces a divisibility atom by a finite disjunction of affine equations when the quotient is forced to range over a finite set. The lower bound already holds for a polynomial-time recognizable fragment we call merge-absorptive. In it, this simplification can remove all divisibility atoms. Nevertheless, the replacement process can force equations with exponentially many coefficient bits.

AI.title_translation: 带整除关系的存取Presburger算术的PSPACE难度
AI.tldr: 本文证明了带整除关系的存取Presburger算术的可满足性问题具有PSPACE难度，通过引入截断-移位算术电路模型完成了下界证明。
AI.motivation: 旨在确定带整除关系的存取Presburger算术（EPAD）的可满足性问题的计算复杂性，此前对于该系统的确切复杂性边界尚不明确。
AI.method: 引入了“截断-移位算术电路”（truncate-shift arithmetic circuits）模型，该模型计算FPSPACE函数，并通过将其门电路评估转化为存取Presburger算术与整除（EPAD）公式来实现下界证明。
AI.result: 证明了带整除关系的存取Presburger算术的可满足性问题是PSPACE难的，即使在被称为“合并-吸收”（merge-absorptive）的特定片段中，该难度依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 带整除关系的存取Presburger算术的可满足性问题是PSPACE难的。
AI.translation: 我们证明了带整除关系的存取Presburger算术的可满足性问题是PSPACE难的。证明引入了截断-移位算术电路，这是一种具有布尔输入、加法、乘法、模2幂次截断和二进制移位的统一算术电路模型。这些电路精确地计算了FPSPACE函数，并且可以通过函数式EPAD公式逐门进行评估。将这种评估应用于PSPACE语言的特征函数，得出了EPAD公式可满足性的下界。我们还研究了当商被强制在有限集合内取值时，将整除原子替换为仿射方程有限析取的归一化步骤。该下界对于我们称为“合并-吸收”的多项式时间可识别片段已经成立。在该片段中，这种简化可以消除所有的整除原子。然而，替换过程可能会强制产生具有指数级系数位的方程。
AI.summary: 本文研究了带整除关系的存取Presburger算术（EPAD）的计算复杂性。通过引入一种新的算术电路模型——截断-移位算术电路，作者证明了EPAD的可满足性问题是PSPACE难的。此外，论文还分析了将整除原子替换为仿射方程的归一化过程，并指出了即使在特定简化片段中，该问题的下界依然成立，且可能涉及具有指数级位数的系数。
AI.keywords: Presburger算术, 整除关系, PSPACE难度, 算术电路, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“截断-移位算术电路”这一新颖的模型，成功证明了带整除关系的存取Presburger算术的可满足性问题具有PSPACE难度。这一成果在计算复杂性理论领域具有重要意义，因为它为理解带有特殊算术谓词的逻辑系统的复杂性边界提供了关键的下界证据。局限性在于其并未讨论该问题的上界（即是否属于PSPACE），仅提供了下界证明。

title: MeEvo: Metacognitive Evolution Combined with Natural Evolution for Automatic Heuristic Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) by enabling heuristic generation through reasoning and code synthesis. In LLM-based AHD, the LLM reasons about algorithm design and generates executable heuristic code. Existing architectures adopt two main paradigms: Natural Evolution applies crossover and mutation to this code to explore diverse strategies, but discards the reasoning traces behind the design decisions, weakening knowledge inheritance; Metacognitive Evolution retains these reasoning traces and refines them through reflection, but lacks population-level recombination, limiting exploration. These limitations reduce search efficiency, stability, and solution quality on complex problems. To address this gap, we propose MeEvo, an AHD framework that cyclically couples Natural Evolution and Metacognitive Evolution with operator balance that shifts from exploration to exploitation. Natural Evolution explores heuristic code while recording LLM-generated reasoning traces, fitness values, errors and best heuristic into a shared history; Metacognitive Evolution then reflects on this history to generate improved heuristics that feed into the next Natural Evolution cycle. This design enables population-driven exploration and reflection-driven refinement to reinforce each other. Experiments on five optimization problems show that MeEvo achieves stronger performance and lower variance than tested LLM-based AHD architectures, especially on complex constrained tasks.

title: CARE: Controlling LLM-Generated Policies through Auditable Review of Evidence in Scientific Experimentation
summary: Granting LLMs direct control over costly, irreversible scientific experiments leads to unsafe exploration and unstable performance, but discarding LLM creativity entirely sacrifices significant optimization potential. We introduce CARE (Controlling LLM-Generated Policies through Auditable Review of Evidence in Scientific Experimentation), an auditable controller for high-throughput experimentation (HTE) optimization that keeps a non-LLM incumbent optimizer as the default action path while using LLMs to revise challenger ranking policies. Before each outcome is revealed, a public-evidence intervention gate compares the challenger with the incumbent. It authorizes the challenger's selection only when the evidence available before selection supports the change, with the decision recorded in the audit log. CARE outperforms all other evaluated methods on Minerva/Olympus and ChemLex benchmarks, with final-best improving from 80.0 to 88.5 on Minerva/Olympus and from 83.9 to 92.1 on ChemLex, relative to the public incumbent. Our experiments indicate that LLM self-evolution is more reliable when it expands the proposal space under an auditable controller, rather than directly choosing experiments.

title: When to Write and When to Suppress: Route-Specialized Dual Adapters for Memory-Assisted Knowledge Editing
summary: Knowledge editing systems must update selected facts while preserving nearby but irrelevant behavior. This paper studies this problem in a memory-assisted setting where an edit memory is retrieved at inference time and a parameter-efficient adapter corrects the model's object preference. We argue that the central design question is not only how to write an edit, but also when to suppress it. We introduce RRDA, a route-specialized dual-adapter editor. A relevance router first decides whether a prompt should receive an edit memory. Routed prompts use an edit adapter trained to prefer the new object over the original object; unrouted non-direct prompts use a separate locality adapter trained to preserve or restore the original-object preference. We evaluate RRDA on three 1,000-case protocols, CounterFact, ZsRE, and MQuAKE-CF, under the same memory protocol and two 7B/8B base models. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, RRDA obtains the best overall probability-preference accuracy on all three benchmarks: 0.8180 on CounterFact, 0.8946 on ZsRE, and 0.9922 on MQuAKE-CF. The same trend holds on Qwen3-8B. Router ablations show that the relevant memory boundary differs across datasets: a lexical neural router is safest on CounterFact, while BGE embedding routing is better on ZsRE and MQuAKE-CF. Memory, component, and module ablations show that explicit memory supplies the largest edit gain, while route-specialized adapters improve the final reliability-locality balance rather than simply increasing LoRA capacity.

AI.title_translation: 何时写入，何时抑制：用于记忆增强知识编辑的路由专用双适配器
AI.tldr: RRDA通过引入动态路由机制和双适配器，精准区分需要编辑和需要保护的知识，显著提升了模型知识编辑的准确性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 知识编辑需要在更新目标事实的同时，保护模型原本正确且无关的行为，现有的单一编辑方法难以在编辑效果与局部行为保持之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出RRDA（路由专用双适配器编辑器）。通过一个相关性路由器决定提示词是否使用编辑记忆。若使用，则调用编辑适配器（训练以倾向于新事实）；若不使用，则调用局部适配器（训练以保持或恢复原始事实偏好）。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-8B模型上，RRDA在CounterFact、ZsRE和MQuAKE-CF三个基准测试中均取得了最佳的概率偏好准确率。消融实验证明了路由专用适配器比单纯增加LoRA容量更能提升可靠性。
AI.conclusion: RRDA通过路由机制将编辑任务分配给专用的适配器，显著提升了模型在知识编辑任务中的可靠性与局部性能平衡。
AI.translation: 知识编辑系统必须在更新选定事实的同时，保护相关但无关的行为。本文在记忆增强的背景下研究了这一问题，其中编辑记忆在推理时被检索，且参数高效的适配器用于校正模型的目标偏好。我们认为，核心设计问题不仅是如何写入编辑，还在于何时抑制它。我们引入了RRDA，一种路由专用双适配器编辑器。相关性路由器首先决定提示是否应该接收编辑记忆。被路由的提示使用训练为偏好新对象而非原始对象的编辑适配器；未被路由的非直接提示使用训练为保持或恢复原始对象偏好的独立局部适配器。我们在三种1000例协议（CounterFact、ZsRE和MQuAKE-CF）下，在相同的记忆协议和两个7B/8B基础模型上评估了RRDA。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，RRDA在所有三个基准测试中获得了最佳的总体概率偏好准确率：CounterFact为0.8180，ZsRE为0.8946，MQuAKE-CF为0.9922。Qwen3-8B上也呈现出相同的趋势。路由器消融实验表明，相关记忆边界在不同数据集之间存在差异：词汇神经路由器在CounterFact上最安全，而BGE嵌入路由在ZsRE和MQuAKE-CF上表现更好。记忆、组件和模块的消融实验表明，显式记忆提供了最大的编辑增益，而路由专用适配器改善了最终的可靠性-局部性平衡，而不仅仅是增加了LoRA容量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为RRDA的路由专用双适配器编辑器，通过引入相关性路由器，动态决定是否应用编辑记忆，并分别使用编辑适配器和局部适配器来处理不同类型的提示，从而在更新知识的同时有效保持模型原本的无关行为。
AI.keywords: 知识编辑, 适配器, 模型可靠性, 路由机制, 记忆增强
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种双适配器架构，不仅关注如何实施知识编辑，还引入了“抑制机制”来处理非相关提示。这种区分策略有效解决了知识编辑中常见的“遗忘”或“误修改”问题，对提升大模型知识更新的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: X-Tokenizer: A Multimodal Action Tokenizer for Vision-Language-Action Pretraining
summary: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models must bridge pretrained vision-language reasoning and precise continuous robot control. Existing action tokenizers discretize actions primarily for reconstruction, producing codes that preserve motion geometry but provide only weak semantic supervision to the backbone. We therefore formulate action tokenization not as mere compression, but as semantic interface learning between multimodal reasoning and executable control. To this end, we introduce X-Tokenizer, a lightweight encoder-Semantic Residual Quantization (SRQ)-decoder architecture that provides a shared action interface across diverse robotic arm embodiments. Its key component, SRQ, imposes an asymmetric structure on residual vector quantization: the first level is trained with Masked Action Modeling (MAM) to form a discrete action language that captures coarse motion intent, while deeper levels remain reconstruction-oriented residuals that preserve fine-grained details. To further align action tokens with multimodal semantics, X-Tokenizer is pretrained with contrastive alignment to the representation space of a pretrained foundation model and with next-frame vision-language feature prediction. Pretrained on 2.4M trajectories (2.0B action frames), a single frozen X-Tokenizer plugs into a mixed discrete-continuous VLA as a representation-shaping supervision signal. X-Tokenizer achieves top real-world aggregate and strong RoboTwin 2.0 simulation results. Outperforming FAST in multimodal grounding (+13.5%) and long-horizon tasks (+8.25), it shows that action tokenizers serve as semantic interfaces for VLA pretraining beyond mere action compression.

AI.title_translation: X-Tokenizer：一种用于视觉-语言-动作预训练的多模态动作标记器
AI.tldr: X-Tokenizer通过创新的语义残差量化技术，将动作标记化转化为多模态推理与机器人控制之间的语义桥梁，显著提升了VLA模型的任务执行能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的动作标记化方法主要关注动作重建，导致语义监督能力较弱，难以有效连接视觉-语言推理与精确的机器人控制。
AI.method: 提出X-Tokenizer架构，包含轻量级编码器、语义残差量化（SRQ）和解码器。SRQ通过非对称结构实现：第一层通过掩码动作建模（MAM）捕捉粗粒度意图，深层负责细粒度重建；同时结合对比对齐和下一帧特征预测进行预训练。
AI.result: 在2.4M条轨迹上预训练后，X-Tokenizer在真实世界任务和RoboTwin 2.0仿真中表现优异，多模态对齐性能提升13.5%，长程任务性能提升8.25%。
AI.conclusion: X-Tokenizer证明了动作标记化不仅可以进行压缩，还能作为一种强大的语义接口，通过其创新的SRQ架构和预训练策略，显著提升了VLA模型在机器人控制任务中的表现。
AI.translation: 现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型必须架起预训练的视觉-语言推理与精确连续机器人控制之间的桥梁。现有的动作标记器主要为了重构而离散化动作，产生的代码虽然保留了运动几何形状，但对骨干网络提供的语义监督较弱。因此，我们将动作标记化不仅视为压缩，还视为多模态推理与可执行控制之间的语义接口学习。为此，我们引入了X-Tokenizer，这是一种轻量级编码器-语义残差量化（SRQ）-解码器架构，为不同的机械臂实现提供了共享的动作接口。其关键组件SRQ对残差向量量化施加了非对称结构：第一层通过掩码动作建模（MAM）进行训练，形成捕捉粗略运动意图的离散动作语言，而更深层则保持以重构为导向的残差，以保留细粒度细节。为了进一步将动作标记与多模态语义对齐，X-Tokenizer通过与预训练基础模型表示空间的对比对齐以及下一帧视觉-语言特征预测进行预训练。在2.4M条轨迹（2.0B动作帧）上预训练后，单个冻结的X-Tokenizer作为表示塑造监督信号插入到混合离散-连续VLA中。X-Tokenizer在真实世界聚合任务和RoboTwin 2.0仿真中取得了顶级结果。在多模态接地（+13.5%）和长程任务（+8.25）方面表现优于FAST，表明动作标记器作为VLA预训练的语义接口，其作用远不止于动作压缩。
AI.summary: 本文提出了X-Tokenizer，一种专为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型设计的动作标记器。它通过语义残差量化（SRQ）将动作标记化重新定义为语义接口学习，能够有效连接高层推理与底层控制，在保持动作精度的同时增强了语义监督。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 动作标记化, 语义残差量化, 机器人控制, 多模态预训练
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将动作标记化从单纯的数据压缩重新定义为多模态推理与机器人控制之间的语义接口。通过引入语义残差量化（SRQ）和掩码动作建模，成功地将粗粒度的动作意图与细粒度的控制细节相结合，为VLA模型提供了更有效的监督信号，在多模态对齐和长程任务表现上具有显著优势。

title: From MWM to iSLIP: A Linear-Algebraic Tutorial on Input-Queued Switch Scheduling
summary: This paper uses three objects -- the queue matrix Q, the matching matrix P, and the Lyapunov energy function V = ||Q||^2 -- as a shared mathematical language to explain, within a single framework, the scheduling objective of maximum weight matching (MWM), queue stability under admissible traffic (per-port loads strictly below 1), and the mechanics of iSLIP's Grant-Accept row-column decoupling together with the long-run average service matrix P-bar. The setting throughout is an N-by-N SoC crossbar, where each clock cycle permits at most one cell transfer per input-output port pair. For the experimental comparison, we built a C++ discrete-event simulator and used exact MWM (solved by the Hungarian algorithm) as the performance reference. All three approximate algorithms are given a fixed iteration budget: r = 3 rounds per cycle for iSLIP and for spectral scheduling, and r_sink = 10 Sinkhorn normalization rounds for entropy-regularized optimal transport (OT). Throughput and average cell delay are measured across four traffic patterns. Spectral scheduling and entropy-regularized OT track MWM closely in both throughput and delay across most tested conditions. iSLIP, by contrast, hits a throughput ceiling of roughly 80% under non-uniform admissible traffic at high load (unbalanced pattern w = 0.5, rho_load >= 0.9), with bottleneck queues growing without bound and delays reaching two orders of magnitude above MWM. Under uniform traffic this breakdown does not occur: at rho_load = 0.99 iSLIP delay is about 3.7x that of MWM. The performance gains of spectral scheduling and OT come at an additional per-cycle compute cost on the order of O(r*N^2) multiply-accumulate or exponential operations; whether this overhead is feasible in real hardware -- in terms of die area, power, and timing closure -- remains to be evaluated.

AI.title_translation: 从MWM到iSLIP：输入排队交换机调度的线性代数教程
AI.tldr: 本文利用统一的线性代数框架分析了交换机调度算法，发现谱调度和最优传输算法在性能上优于iSLIP，特别是在处理非均匀流量时，但同时也指出了这些先进算法在硬件实现上的潜在挑战。
AI.motivation: 为了在统一的线性代数框架下解释交换机调度算法（如MWM和iSLIP）的原理，并探究更高效的调度算法在不同流量负载下的性能表现。
AI.method: 使用队列矩阵Q、匹配矩阵P和李雅普诺夫函数V作为统一的数学框架，对比分析了最大权重匹配（MWM）、iSLIP、谱调度和熵正则化最优传输（OT）算法，并利用C++离散事件模拟器在不同流量模式下进行了性能评估。
AI.result: 在非均匀流量下，iSLIP在负载较高时吞吐量受限且延迟激增；而谱调度和熵正则化OT算法在吞吐量和延迟上表现出与MWM接近的优异性能，但计算复杂度相对较高。
AI.conclusion: 基于谱调度和熵正则化最优传输的算法在吞吐量和延迟上均优于iSLIP，尤其是在非均匀流量场景下，但其硬件实现的复杂度和成本仍需进一步评估。
AI.translation: 本文使用三个对象——队列矩阵Q、匹配矩阵P和李雅普诺夫能量函数V=||Q||^2——作为一种通用的数学语言，在一个统一的框架内解释了最大权重匹配（MWM）的调度目标、可容许流量下的队列稳定性（每端口负载严格小于1），以及iSLIP的Grant-Accept行列解耦机制与长期平均服务矩阵P-bar的力学原理。研究背景为N×N SoC交叉开关，每个时钟周期内每对输入-输出端口最多允许进行一次信元传输。在实验对比中，我们构建了一个C++离散事件模拟器，并使用精确的MWM（通过匈牙利算法求解）作为性能基准。所有三种近似算法均被设定了固定的迭代预算：iSLIP和谱调度为每个周期r=3轮，熵正则化最优传输（OT）为r_sink=10轮Sinkhorn归一化。我们在四种流量模式下测量了吞吐量和平均信元延迟。结果显示，谱调度和熵正则化OT在大多数测试条件下，其吞吐量和延迟与MWM非常接近。相比之下，iSLIP在高负载下的非均匀可容许流量（不平衡模式w=0.5，rho_load >= 0.9）中遇到了约80%的吞吐量瓶颈，导致瓶颈队列无限增长，延迟比MWM高出两个数量级。在均匀流量下，这种崩溃不会发生：在rho_load=0.99时，iSLIP的延迟约为MWM的3.7倍。谱调度和OT的性能提升伴随着每个周期O(r*N^2)乘加或指数运算的额外计算成本；这种开销在芯片面积、功耗和时序收敛方面是否在真实硬件中可行，仍有待评估。
AI.summary: 本文通过线性代数框架分析了输入排队交换机调度算法。研究发现，虽然iSLIP在均匀流量下表现尚可，但在非均匀流量下性能显著退化，而谱调度和熵正则化最优传输算法能提供接近MWM的性能，但代价是增加了计算开销。
AI.keywords: 输入排队交换机, 调度算法, MWM, iSLIP, 谱调度
AI.comments: 本文通过线性代数视角统一了交换机调度算法，不仅提供了理论上的深刻洞察，还通过实验量化了iSLIP在非均匀流量下的性能瓶颈，为高性能交换机调度算法的研究提供了有力的基准参考。

title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated for Embodied Decision-Making? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
summary: World models have become a central abstraction in modern AI. The term now refers to several different objects: action-conditioned environment models, latent imagination models, future-video predictors, interactive neural simulators, latent predictive representations, and synthetic-data engines. Evaluation has broadened along with the term. Recent papers measure video realism, perceptual similarity, instruction following, physical plausibility, policy ranking, executability, planning success, and downstream policy improvement. This produces both metric diversity and a recurring problem of claim/evidence mismatch: papers sometimes make a stronger claim about what their model is useful for than their evaluation can establish. This paper surveys the recent literature and argues that, for models presented as world models for embodied decision-making, the more decisive issue is not whether the model generates visually convincing videos, but whether it supports reliable interventional reasoning, policy evaluation, planning, and policy optimization under intervention, policy-induced distribution shift, and long-horizon rollout. We organize the survey using an L0--L7 ladder spanning visual plausibility to policy optimization utility, noting that the levels cut across several orthogonal axes and so form an evidential hierarchy rather than a single scalar. The framework foregrounds interventional action fidelity, closed-loop rollout validity, reward/value prediction, policy-ranking agreement, optimization lift, model exploitability, and uncertainty calibration, with a minimal feasible reporting set for real-robot settings.

AI.title_translation: 具身决策中的世界模型应如何评估？一种以决策为中心的立场
AI.tldr: 针对世界模型评估标准混乱的问题，本文提出了一个从视觉真实性到策略优化效用的L0-L7评估框架，强调具身智能评估应聚焦于决策能力而非单纯的视觉效果。
AI.motivation: 当前世界模型的定义多样且评估方法极其碎片化，导致研究中经常出现模型声称的效用与其实际评估证据不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一个涵盖L0到L7的评估阶梯框架，从视觉真实性（L0）逐步过渡到策略优化效用（L7），并明确了在机器人真实场景下的最小可行评估指标集。
AI.result: 构建了一个以决策为核心的评估框架，强调了干预行动保真度、闭环推理有效性、奖励/价值预测及策略优化提升等关键指标，旨在解决证据与声明不匹配的行业痛点。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型评估应从单纯的视觉质量评估转向以决策为核心的评估，通过L0-L7分级框架来衡量模型在干预推理、闭环规划和策略优化方面的实际效用。
AI.translation: 世界模型已成为现代人工智能的一个核心抽象概念。该术语现在指代多种不同的对象：动作条件环境模型、潜在想象模型、未来视频预测器、交互式神经模拟器、潜在预测表征和合成数据引擎。随着该术语的发展，评估范围也随之扩大。最近的论文测量了视频真实性、感知相似度、指令遵循、物理合理性、策略排序、可执行性、规划成功率和下游策略改进。这不仅导致了指标的多样性，还产生了一个反复出现的“声明/证据不匹配”问题：论文有时对其模型用途的声明，超出了其评估所能证明的范围。本文综述了近期文献，并论证认为，对于作为具身决策世界模型的模型而言，更具决定性的问题不是模型是否生成了视觉上令人信服的视频，而是它是否支持可靠的干预推理、策略评估、规划，以及在干预、策略诱导的分布偏移和长程展开下的策略优化。我们使用了一个跨越视觉合理性到策略优化效用的L0-L7阶梯来组织综述，并指出这些级别横跨了几个正交轴，因此形成了一个证据层级，而不是单一的标量。该框架突出了干预行动保真度、闭环展开有效性、奖励/价值预测、策略排序一致性、优化提升、模型可利用性和不确定性校准，并给出了真实机器人设置下的最小可行报告集。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了具身智能中世界模型的评估困境，指出当前评估指标过于多样且缺乏针对决策效用的标准。作者提出了一个L0-L7的分级评估框架，倡导将评估重心从视觉真实性转移到支持干预推理、规划和策略优化的能力上，并为机器人应用提供了推荐的评估指标集。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 具身智能, 决策制定, 评估框架, 闭环评估
AI.comments: 该论文针对当前世界模型评估指标混乱、结论与证据不匹配的问题，提出了一个分级的评估框架（L0-L7），强调了从单纯的视觉真实性向决策相关性（如干预推理、闭环规划）的转变，对于推动具身智能研究的规范化具有重要意义。

title: EyeMVP: OCT-Informed Fundus Representation Learning via Paired CFP--OCT Pretraining
summary: Color fundus photography (CFP) is the mainstay of large-scale retinal screening, but its diagnostic capacity is limited by the lack of depth-resolved structure, which optical coherence tomography (OCT) provides yet is less accessible at population scale. We present EyeMVP, a cross-modal retinal foundation model that uses paired CFP--OCT pretraining to learn OCT-informed CFP representations while requiring only CFP at inference. Pretrained on 674,893 same-eye same-day CFP--OCT triples from 112,642 patients across eight hospitals, EyeMVP uses cross-modal masked reconstruction to enrich CFP features with OCT-associated supervision, and combines source-constrained cross-attention with CFP-derived structural masks to accommodate the non-aligned geometry of en-face CFP and cross-sectional OCT. Across 15 dataset-level settings spanning classification and segmentation, under both full-data and few-shot regimes, EyeMVP performs on par with or better than representative retinal foundation models, with consistent gains on macular and optic-nerve tasks; it attains AUROCs of 0.923 for macular edema and 0.867 for myopic macular schisis, two conditions poorly resolved in CFP. In an exploratory reader study, EyeMVP surpasses junior and intermediate ophthalmologists but not seniors on macular edema, while exceeding all groups on myopic macular schisis. These results indicate that cross-modal reconstruction can enrich CFP representations with OCT-associated supervision, offering a practical route to stronger CFP-based screening.

AI.title_translation: EyeMVP：通过配对CFP--OCT预训练学习OCT信息增强的眼底特征表示
AI.tldr: EyeMVP利用OCT的深度信息增强CFP特征，使仅凭眼底照片即可实现对复杂视网膜病变的高精度诊断。
AI.motivation: 彩色眼底摄影（CFP）是主流筛查工具但缺乏深度信息，而光学相干断层扫描（OCT）具备深度信息但普及度低。研究旨在通过跨模态预训练，使CFP模型能够学习到OCT的深度结构信息，从而在仅需CFP输入的情况下提升诊断能力。
AI.method: 提出EyeMVP模型，利用674,893对CFP-OCT数据进行预训练；采用跨模态掩码重构机制，结合源约束交叉注意力机制和结构掩码，以解决CFP与OCT之间几何结构非对齐的问题。
AI.result: 在15个数据集设置中表现优异；在黄斑水肿（AUROC 0.923）和近视性黄斑劈裂（AUROC 0.867）等CFP难以诊断的病变中表现突出；在读者研究中，其诊断水平在部分任务中超越了初中级眼科医生。
AI.conclusion: EyeMVP证明了跨模态重构能够有效利用OCT信息增强CFP的特征表达，从而提升基于CFP的视网膜疾病筛查性能，尤其是在处理难以通过平面影像诊断的病变时。
AI.translation: 彩色眼底摄影（CFP）是大规模视网膜筛查的支柱，但其诊断能力受限于缺乏深度解析结构，而光学相干断层扫描（OCT）虽能提供此类信息，但在人群规模中的可及性较低。我们提出了EyeMVP，这是一个跨模态视网膜基础模型，它使用配对的CFP--OCT预训练来学习OCT信息增强的CFP表示，同时在推理时仅需要CFP。EyeMVP在来自八家医院的112,642名患者的674,893对同眼同日CFP--OCT三元组上进行预训练，使用跨模态掩码重构来增强带有OCT相关监督的CFP特征，并结合源约束交叉注意力与CFP派生的结构掩码，以适应正面CFP与横截面OCT的非对齐几何结构。在跨越分类和分割的15个数据集级设置中，在全数据和少样本机制下，EyeMVP的表现与具有代表性的视网膜基础模型相当或更好，并在黄斑和视神经任务上获得了一致的提升；其在黄斑水肿和近视性黄斑劈裂（这两种在CFP中难以解析的疾病）上分别达到了0.923和0.867的AUROC。在一项探索性读者研究中，EyeMVP在黄斑水肿诊断上超过了初级和中级眼科医生（但未超过高级），并在近视性黄斑劈裂诊断上超过了所有群体。这些结果表明，跨模态重构可以利用OCT相关监督来丰富CFP表示，为更强大的基于CFP的筛查提供了一条实用途径。
AI.summary: EyeMVP是一个跨模态视网膜基础模型，通过大规模CFP-OCT配对数据进行预训练，将OCT的深度解剖信息整合进CFP特征提取中。该模型在推理时仅需CFP影像，即可在多种视网膜疾病诊断任务中达到甚至超越现有基础模型的水平。
AI.keywords: 视网膜基础模型, 跨模态预训练, 眼底摄影, 光学相干断层扫描, 特征表示学习
AI.comments: 该研究通过创新的跨模态预训练方法，成功将OCT的深度结构信息“蒸馏”到更易获取的CFP图像中。这一方法在解决临床中CFP难以诊断的深度病变（如黄斑水肿）方面表现出巨大潜力，为大规模视网膜筛查提供了一种高效且低成本的临床辅助工具。

title: Surprise-Guided MergeSort: Budget-Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Ranking via Adaptive Comparison Scheduling
comments: After submission, we discovered significant issues in the reference and citation information used in the manuscript. Because these issues affect the integrity of the scholarly record and require substantial revision and verification, we request withdrawal of the current submission. A corrected version may be submitted in the future after a comprehensive review
summary: Pairwise comparison is the gold standard for subjective ranking tasks; however, exhaustive annotation requires a massive number of human comparisons ($O(n^2)$). While sorting-based methods have reduced this burden to $O(n\log n)$, they still require expensive human judgment for every single comparison. To further improve annotation efficiency, we propose leveraging a Vision-Language Model (VLM) not as an annotator replacement, but as a \emph{question prioritizer} to identify which comparisons genuinely require human judgment. The proposed \textbf{Surprise-Guided MergeSort (SGS)} framework achieves this through three integrated components: (1) a bottom-up MergeSort scheduler that structures comparisons and exploits transitivity, (2) a composite Surprise Scorer -- combining position-bias-cancelled VLM confidence, Elo gap, and vote entropy -- to quantify comparison ambiguity, and (3) an adaptive budget allocator that routes high-surprise pairs to humans while automating low-surprise pairs via transitivity inference. Validation was conducted on six diverse benchmarks spanning text similarity (STS-B, BIOSSES, SICKR-STS) and image quality assessment (KonIQ-10k, TID2013, LIVE Challenge). SGS effectively identified and skipped up to 535 non-informative comparisons per session. Consequently, it achieved Kendall's $τ{\times}100$ improvements of $+6$ to $+12$ over Active Elo under the same total budget. These results demonstrate that combining VLM-guided surprise metrics with algorithmic sorting provides a generally consistent accuracy-efficiency trade-off across diverse domains.

AI.title_translation: 惊喜导向的归并排序：通过自适应比较调度实现预算高效的人机协作排序
AI.tldr: 利用视觉语言模型评估比较的“惊喜度”，仅让人类处理难以判断的配对，从而在有限预算下显著提升了排序的准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统的配对比较排序方法（如MergeSort）虽然减少了比较次数，但仍需人类对每一对进行判断，成本依然较高。作者旨在利用VLM作为过滤器，识别出真正需要人类判断的“高惊喜度”比较，从而提升标注效率。
AI.method: 提出Surprise-Guided MergeSort (SGS)框架，包含三个核心组件：基于自底向上MergeSort的调度器、结合VLM置信度/Elo差距/投票熵的复合惊喜度评分器，以及基于惊喜度进行人类与自动推理分配的自适应预算分配器。
AI.result: 在六个文本相似度和图像质量评估基准测试中，SGS每场任务最多可跳过535个非信息性比较，在相同预算下，Kendall's τ指标比Active Elo方法提升了6到12个点。
AI.conclusion: SGS框架通过引入惊喜度导向的比较调度，在保持排序准确性的前提下显著降低了对人类标注的需求，证明了AI辅助决策在优化人类反馈效率方面的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 配对比较是主观排序任务的黄金标准；然而，详尽的标注需要大量的人类比较次数（O(n^2)）。虽然基于排序的方法已将这一负担降低至O(n log n)，但它们仍需人类对每一次比较进行昂贵的判断。为了进一步提高标注效率，我们建议利用视觉语言模型（VLM）而非将其作为标注员的替代者，而是作为“问题优先级排序器”，以识别哪些比较真正需要人类判断。所提出的惊喜导向归并排序（SGS）框架通过三个集成组件实现这一点：（1）自底向上的归并排序调度器，用于构建比较并利用传递性；（2）复合惊喜度评分器——结合了消除位置偏差的VLM置信度、Elo差距和投票熵，以量化比较的歧义性；以及（3）自适应预算分配器，将高惊喜度对分配给人类，同时通过传递性推理自动处理低惊喜度对。在涵盖文本相似度（STS-B, BIOSSES, SICKR-STS）和图像质量评估（KonIQ-10k, TID2013, LIVE Challenge）的六个不同基准上进行了验证。SGS在每场任务中有效地识别并跳过了多达535个非信息性比较。因此，在相同的总预算下，它在Kendall's τ×100指标上比Active Elo提升了6到12个点。这些结果表明，将VLM引导的惊喜度指标与算法排序相结合，可以在不同领域提供一致的准确性与效率权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Surprise-Guided MergeSort (SGS)的框架，旨在通过VLM辅助筛选来降低主观排序任务中的人类标注成本。SGS通过MergeSort结构化比较，利用复合惊喜度评分量化比较的歧义性，并将高歧义性任务分配给人类，低歧义性任务则通过自动推理完成，显著提升了标注效率与准确性。
AI.keywords: 配对比较, 排序算法, 视觉语言模型, 惊喜度, 人机协作
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将大模型（VLM）从单纯的标注者角色转变为“优先级决策者”，通过“惊喜度”这一指标来筛选真正需要人类介入的比较，有效缓解了传统排序算法中人类标注成本过高的问题。其创新之处在于将认知科学中的惊喜度与经典的排序算法（MergeSort）相结合，具有较强的普适性和实用价值。

title: Artificial Intelligence Index Report 2026
summary: Welcome to the ninth edition of the AI Index report. As AI continues to advance rapidly, the question becomes whether the systems built around it can keep up. Governance frameworks, evaluation methods, education systems, and the data infrastructure needed to track AI's impact are struggling to match the pace of the technology itself. That gap between what AI can do and how prepared we are to manage it runs through every chapter of this year's report. New in this edition, the report tracks how AI is being tested more ambitiously across reasoning, safety, and real-world task execution, and why those measurements are increasingly difficult to rely on. It also features new estimates of generative AI's economic value alongside emerging evidence of its labor market effects, an analytical framework on AI sovereignty, and a science chapter developed in collaboration with Schmidt Sciences. For the first time, the report features standalone chapters on AI in science and AI in medicine, reflecting AI's growing impact across these two domains.

AI.tldr: 本报告揭示了AI技术进步与社会治理及评估能力之间的严峻差距，并首次重点评估了AI在科学与医疗领域的深远影响。
AI.motivation: 旨在追踪并分析人工智能的快速发展现状，揭示AI技术进步与配套治理机制、评估标准及基础设施之间的脱节问题。
AI.method: 采用多维度分析法，结合行业数据追踪、经济价值估算、AI主权分析框架以及与专业机构（如Schmidt Sciences）的合作研究。
AI.result: 报告指出AI在推理、安全及任务执行方面的测试日益复杂且难以衡量，同时提供了生成式AI的经济价值估算、劳动力市场影响分析，并首次引入了人工智能在科学和医疗领域的专项研究。
AI.conclusion: AI技术的演进速度远超当前的治理、评估及基础设施建设速度，社会亟需建立更有效的框架来应对AI在科学、医疗及经济领域带来的深远影响。
AI.translation: 欢迎阅读第九版AI指数报告。随着人工智能的飞速发展，其构建的系统能否跟上步伐成为了关键问题。治理框架、评估方法、教育体系以及追踪AI影响所需的数据基础设施，目前都难以跟上技术本身的发展速度。AI能力与我们管理准备程度之间的差距贯穿了本年度报告的每一章。本报告新增内容包括：追踪AI在推理、安全和现实任务执行方面更具野心的测试情况，以及为何这些测量标准愈发难以依赖；同时还提供了生成式AI的经济价值新估算，以及其对劳动力市场影响的初步证据；此外还包含了一个关于AI主权的分析框架，以及与Schmidt Sciences合作开发的科学章节。本报告首次为科学AI和医疗AI设立了独立章节，反映了AI在这两个领域日益增长的影响力。
AI.summary: 《2026年人工智能指数报告》全面审视了AI的快速进步，重点分析了AI技术发展与社会治理、技术评估及数据基础设施之间的滞后差距，并新增了对科学、医疗领域应用及AI经济影响的深度评估。
AI.keywords: 人工智能指数, 技术治理, 生成式AI, 科学与医疗AI, 评估方法
AI.comments: 该报告通过多维度数据揭示了AI发展速度与社会治理、评估能力之间的显著鸿沟，特别是在科学和医疗领域的深度应用分析具有很高的参考价值。其局限性在于作为一份年度综述，侧重于现象总结与评估挑战，而非提出具体的解决方案。

title: RoboPIN: Grounded Embodied Reasoning via Pinned Chain-of-Thought
summary: Embodied reasoning requires models to perceive task-relevant objects and spaces in physical environments and maintain consistent visual grounding throughout multi-step reasoning. However, current vision-language models rely on text-only or coordinate-augmented chain-of-thought, where entity references remain implicit and ambiguous. This may cause the reasoning process to decouple from visual evidence, entity references to drift across steps, and a causal disconnection between the reasoning trajectory and the final answer, with these problems further amplified in multi-view scenarios due to cross-view appearance changes. To address these issues, we propose Pinned Chain-of-Thought (PinCoT), a structured reasoning paradigm that pins every reasoning step to visual evidence. PinCoT introduces the concept of reasoning anchor, which binds each task-relevant entity to a structured visual anchor with entity name, unique identity, view index, and spatial grounding, enabling consistent entity tracking across reasoning steps and views. We build a fully automated data generation pipeline to construct PIN-170K, a high-quality PinCoT-formatted reasoning dataset. We then train RoboPIN through three-stage post-training that progressively injects embodied knowledge, structured reasoning ability, and process-supervised alignment, with rewards that directly constrain both anchor localization and identity consistency during reasoning. On 14 benchmarks covering embodied spatial reasoning, multi-view reasoning, and pointing, RoboPIN with only 4B parameters consistently outperforms 7B level open-source embodied models, achieving a 12% average improvement over the strongest 7B baseline, Mimo-Embodied. Further analysis shows that PinCoT improves grounding accuracy and cross-step identity consistency, validating the effectiveness of process supervision.

AI.title_translation: RoboPIN：基于固定链式思维的具身推理基础训练
AI.tldr: RoboPIN 通过将推理步骤与视觉锚点绑定（PinCoT），解决了具身智能中推理过程与视觉证据脱节及实体指代漂移的问题，以 4B 参数实现了优于 7B 模型的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在具身推理中往往缺乏显式的视觉绑定，导致推理过程与视觉证据脱节，且在多视角场景下容易出现实体指代模糊和漂移问题。
AI.method: 提出 Pinned Chain-of-Thought (PinCoT) 范式，引入推理锚点（Reasoning Anchor）绑定实体名称、唯一标识、视图索引和空间位置；构建 PIN-170K 数据集；采用三阶段后训练策略，包括具身知识注入、结构化推理能力训练及过程监督对齐。
AI.result: 在 14 个具身推理基准测试中，4B 参数的 RoboPIN 表现超过了 7B 级别的模型，平均性能提升 12%，并显著提高了接地准确率和跨步骤的一致性。
AI.conclusion: RoboPIN 通过 Pinned Chain-of-Thought (PinCoT) 范式，成功实现了具身推理中视觉证据与推理过程的强一致性，在多个具身任务基准上显著优于更大参数量的基线模型。
AI.translation: 具身推理要求模型在物理环境中感知任务相关的物体和空间，并在多步推理中保持一致的视觉基础。然而，目前的视觉语言模型依赖于纯文本或坐标增强的思维链，其中实体引用仍然是隐式且模糊的。这可能导致推理过程与视觉证据脱节，实体引用在步骤间发生漂移，以及推理轨迹与最终答案之间的因果断裂，而这些问题在多视角场景下由于跨视角外观变化而进一步放大。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了固定思维链（PinCoT），这是一种将每个推理步骤固定在视觉证据上的结构化推理范式。PinCoT 引入了推理锚点的概念，将每个任务相关的实体绑定到一个具有实体名称、唯一标识、视图索引和空间基础的结构化视觉锚点上，从而实现跨推理步骤和视图的一致实体跟踪。我们构建了一个全自动数据生成流水线来构建 PIN-170K，这是一个高质量的 PinCoT 格式推理数据集。然后，我们通过三阶段后训练来训练 RoboPIN，逐步注入具身知识、结构化推理能力和过程监督对齐，并使用直接约束推理过程中锚点定位和身份一致性的奖励。在涵盖具身空间推理、多视角推理和指向的 14 个基准测试中，仅有 4B 参数的 RoboPIN 持续优于 7B 级别的开源具身模型，比最强的 7B 基线 Mimo-Embodied 平均提高了 12%。进一步的分析表明，PinCoT 提高了基础准确性和跨步骤的身份一致性，验证了过程监督的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 RoboPIN，一种通过 Pinned Chain-of-Thought (PinCoT) 实现具身推理的框架。该方法通过引入包含实体标识和空间信息的“推理锚点”，将推理步骤与视觉证据紧密绑定，解决了多视角下推理与视觉脱节及实体漂移的问题。通过构建高质量数据集 PIN-170K 并进行三阶段过程监督训练，RoboPIN 在保持较小模型规模的同时，在多项具身任务中取得了优异表现。
AI.keywords: 具身推理, 视觉基础, 链式思维, 多视角推理, 过程监督
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“推理锚点”机制，有效地解决了具身智能模型在长链条推理中视觉基础（Visual Grounding）丢失和实体指代漂移的问题。其创新之处在于将链式思维与显式的视觉锚点绑定，并通过过程监督进行强化，为解决多视角下的具身推理难题提供了新的思路，且模型参数量小、效率高。

title: MSC-CMA-ES: Structure-Aware Restarts for CMA-ES via Cyclic Nearest-Better Basin Discovery
summary: CMA-ES is, per run, a local optimizer; multimodal search relies on restart strategies such as IPOP and BIPOP, which draw every restart uniformly and reuse no information from previous evaluations. Multi-Start Clustering CMA-ES (MSC-CMA-ES) makes restarts structure-aware: in alternating cycles, a Sobol pre-sample is partitioned into approximate basins of attraction by nearest-better clustering, restarts are seeded basin by basin with locally scaled step sizes and population sizes, redundant basin visits are detected and excluded, and the remaining budget is spent on an unbounded local refinement of the best-so-far solution. We evaluate the method on four CEC suites (CEC2014, CEC2017, CEC2020, CEC2022) at their official budgets, across ten (suite, dimension) cells with dimensions 5-30, 51 runs per function, against BIPOP-CMA-ES and five differential-evolution algorithms (ARRDE, jSO, j2020, NL-SHADE-RSP, LSRTDE). Read per function class, MSC-CMA-ES leads on one class, is mixed on a second, and trails on the third. On composition functions, MSC-CMA-ES attains the best value on all four aggregate measures, with 2.7x the fixed-budget target coverage of BIPOP-CMA-ES - the highest composition coverage of any algorithm evaluated. On basic functions, it achieves the best (lowest) median error but exhibits a lower deep-target coverage - the measured price of spending budget on landscape discovery. On hybrid functions both CMA variants trail the leading DE algorithms; the deficit belongs to the CMA family, not to the restart mechanism. All results and scripts are publicly available.

title: Looking Is Not Picking: An Attention-Segment Account of Tool-Selection Failures in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents mis-call tools, and the natural guess is that the model failed to see the right tool in a crowded harness. We show the opposite through a lens concurrent work sets aside -- the model's attention to labeled tool-definition segments. On real BFCL failures, by per-candidate attention argmax the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time (vs. 21% chance), and the gold is the under-attended segment on only 10%: it looks at the right tool and still picks wrong. This directly refutes the intuitive "crowded-harness / lost-in-the-middle" explanation: the failure is at the decision readout, not the harness, and we pin it there three ways. (1) Input vs. readout: repairing the prompt (reordering or duplicating the gold tool) recovers <=23% of failures, while readout-side interventions recover 59-91%. (2) Representation-invariance: two gold-pointed interventions in different representations -- an additive attention-logit bias and a residual-stream steering vector -- recover largely the same failures (per-task Jaccard 0.865 pooled, 0.79-0.91 per model), so the bottleneck is localized to the readout independent of which representation is poked. (3) A training-free, gold-free selector: per-segment attention closes most of the gold-free-vs-oracle gap on BFCL (+11.9 pts pooled function-name selection vs. +17.9-pt oracle headroom) and adds +14.9 pts on Seal-Tools; every model positive (exact McNemar p<=8e-4 each). Scopes differ: the causal attention-bias dose-response is bidirectional and monotonic on 10 mask-honoring models (3-32B), the full 0.5-32B span carrying only the correlational diagnostic; the deployable selector is evaluated on 5 single-turn models and does not yet transfer to a multi-turn loop.

title: Walking on Heat Stars for Parabolic Heat Equations with Neumann Boundary Conditions
summary:
Monte Carlo methods have proven highly effective for elliptic partial differential equations through algorithms such as Walk on Spheres and Walk on Stars, which evaluate solutions at individual points without volumetric meshing or global linear solves. Extending these methods to the transient regime has remained an open challenge: parabolic equations couple space and time through an anisotropic scaling, requiring joint sampling of spatial displacements and backward time steps whose distribution was not previously available in a unified, exact form.
  We present Walk on Heat Stars, a grid-free Monte Carlo solver that closes this gap by extending the boundary integral framework of Walk on Stars to the parabolic setting. Our method introduces a non-cylindrical boundary integral formulation that accommodates the time-varying domains induced by heat-ball sampling. The heat ball geometry is parameterized by a logarithmic time coordinate and a spatial direction, revealing that the double-layer kernel factorizes into independent Gamma and uniform components. This parameterization enables exact directional importance sampling of the recursive next walk position, the Neumann flux contribution, and the volumetric source term, yielding unbiased Monte Carlo estimators for all three components.
  We additionally derive a preliminary gradient estimator that expresses spatial derivatives as weighted boundary integrals of the solution, requiring no recursion on the gradient, and adapt a heteroscedastic regression-based denoiser to the space-time domain for variance reduction. We validate our method on analytical solutions across a range of geometries and spatial frequencies, confirm convergence at the expected Monte Carlo rate, and demonstrate practical applicability on heat sink and cooling scenes with mixed or pure Neumann boundary conditions.

AI.title_translation: 用于具有Neumann边界条件的抛物型热传导方程的“Walk on Heat Stars”算法
AI.tldr: 通过将Walk on Stars方法扩展至抛物型方程，利用热球几何参数化实现高效、无网格的时空蒙特卡洛求解。
AI.motivation: 现有的蒙特卡洛方法（如Walk on Spheres/Stars）在椭圆型方程中表现优异，但难以直接扩展到抛物型方程，因为后者在时空域存在各向异性缩放，缺乏统一且精确的空间与反向时间步长联合采样分布。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于热球（heat-ball）几何的无网格蒙特卡洛算法。利用对数时间坐标和空间方向对热球进行参数化，将双层核分解为独立的Gamma和均匀分布，从而实现对下一步位置、Neumann通量贡献和源项的精确重要性采样。此外，还结合了空间导数估计器和异方差回归去噪技术。
AI.result: 在多种分析解场景及热沉/冷却场景中验证了该方法的有效性，确认了其符合预期的蒙特卡洛收敛率，并成功处理了混合或纯Neumann边界条件。
AI.conclusion: Walk on Heat Stars 是一种高效、无网格的蒙特卡洛算法，成功解决了抛物型偏微分方程在时空耦合下的求解问题，并支持复杂的Neumann边界条件。
AI.translation: 蒙特卡洛方法通过“Walk on Spheres”和“Walk on Stars”等算法在椭圆型偏微分方程中证明了其高效性，无需体积网格划分或全局线性求解即可在单个点评估解。将这些方法扩展到瞬态领域仍然是一个开放性的挑战：抛物型方程通过各向异性缩放耦合了空间和时间，需要联合采样空间位移和反向时间步长，而此前尚无统一、精确的分布可用。我们提出了“Walk on Heat Stars”，这是一种无网格蒙特卡洛求解器，通过将“Walk on Stars”的边界积分框架扩展到抛物型设置来弥补这一差距。我们的方法引入了一种非柱状边界积分公式，以适应热球采样引起的时间变化域。热球几何由对数时间坐标和空间方向参数化，揭示了双层核可以分解为独立的Gamma分布和均匀分布成分。这种参数化实现了对递归下一步位置、Neumann通量贡献和体积源项的精确方向重要性采样，为这三个部分产生了无偏蒙特卡洛估计量。此外，我们推导了一个初步的梯度估计器，将空间导数表示为解的加权边界积分，无需对梯度进行递归，并采用了基于异方差回归的去噪器以实现方差缩减。我们在各种几何形状和空间频率的解析解上验证了我们的方法，确认了其符合预期的蒙特卡洛收敛率，并展示了其在具有混合或纯Neumann边界条件的热沉和冷却场景中的实际适用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“Walk on Heat Stars”，一种用于求解抛物型偏微分方程的无网格蒙特卡洛算法。该方法通过热球几何的参数化实现了时空步长的精确采样，支持Neumann边界条件，并集成了梯度估计与去噪技术，有效提升了计算效率与精度。
AI.keywords: 蒙特卡洛方法, 抛物型偏微分方程, Walk on Heat Stars, Neumann边界条件, 无网格求解
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将“Walk on Stars”方法推广至抛物型热传导方程，解决了空间和时间耦合的采样难题。通过非柱状边界积分公式和热球几何参数化，实现了无网格的蒙特卡洛求解，在处理Neumann边界条件和复杂几何形状时表现出显著优势。

title: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion
summary: Inference-time scaling has become the dominant lever for improving language-model reasoning, but existing methods derive rollout diversity from a single source: stochastic token-level sampling. We argue that this single-axis sampling space is fundamentally limiting, and identify a second, fully deterministic and complementary axis: the layer span $L$ at which a frozen model's top decoder layers are recursively re-applied at high-uncertainty tokens. Different choices of $L$ produce distinct rollouts that solve different subsets of problems, with no stochasticity. We instantiate this axis through Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR), a training-free decoding procedure that re-applies the top-$L$ layers for at most $K_{\max}$ iterations until the next-token distribution converges. Combined with $T$ temperature samples, EGLR turns a single-axis stochastic rollout pool into an $L\times T$ Cartesian sampling space at almost the same per-rollout cost. We characterize this space across $8$ instruction-tuned models and $6$ math reasoning benchmarks, and show that the $L$-axis is genuinely complementary to temperature: on MATH-500 with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, the joint $L\times T$ oracle reaches $91.6\%$, $+8.2$ percentage points beyond the temperature-only oracle ($83.4\%$) and $+10.4$ points beyond the layer-only oracle ($81.2\%$), confirming that the two axes capture genuinely complementary problems. The expanded rollout pool provides richer per-prompt candidates for any downstream procedure that consumes rollouts, including self-consistency, best-of-$N$ with verifiers, and group-relative RL training (GRPO), opening a new direction for inference-time scaling that does not rely on stochastic noise.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过确定性地递归重应用模型顶层来替代单一随机采样的推理扩展方法，显著提升了语言模型的推理性能和候选池多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理时扩展主要依赖单一维度的随机采样（Temperature），这种方式存在局限性。研究旨在寻找与随机采样互补的、确定性的推理扩展维度。
AI.method: 提出熵门控潜在递归（EGLR）方法，在推理过程中，当模型预测遇到高不确定性（基于熵）时，递归重应用冻结模型的顶层解码器层（层跨度 L），直至下一词分布收敛。
AI.result: 在8个指令微调模型和6个数学基准测试中，EGLR与温度采样结合形成了 L×T 的笛卡尔采样空间。实验显示该方法与温度采样高度互补，在 MATH-500 基准上，联合 oracle 准确率比纯温度采样提升了 8.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR) 提供了一种全新的、与随机采样互补的推理时扩展维度，通过确定性的递归层重应用显著提升了语言模型的推理性能。
AI.translation: 推理时扩展已成为提升语言模型推理能力的主要手段，但现有方法仅依赖单一来源的 rollout 多样性：随机词级采样。我们认为这种单轴采样空间存在根本性的局限，并确定了第二个完全确定且互补的轴：在模型预测高不确定性词时，递归重应用冻结模型的顶层解码器层（层跨度 L）。不同的 L 选择会产生不同的 rollout，且无需随机性。我们通过熵门控潜在递归（EGLR）实现了这一轴，这是一种无需训练的解码程序，通过重应用顶层 L 层进行最多 K_max 次迭代，直到下一词分布收敛。结合 T 个温度样本，EGLR 将单轴随机 rollout 池转换为 L×T 的笛卡尔采样空间，且每个 rollout 的成本几乎相同。我们在 8 个指令微调模型和 6 个数学推理基准测试上刻画了该空间，并证明 L 轴与温度轴确实互补：在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 模型的 MATH-500 测试中，联合 L×T oracle 达到了 91.6%，比仅使用温度的 oracle (83.4%) 高出 8.2 个百分点，比仅使用层轴的 oracle (81.2%) 高出 10.4 个百分点，证实了这两个轴捕获了真正互补的问题。扩展后的 rollout 池为任何下游处理程序（包括自洽性、带验证器的 best-of-N 和组相对 RL 训练 GRPO）提供了更丰富的候选方案，开启了一个不依赖随机噪声的推理时扩展新方向。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“熵门控潜在递归”（EGLR）的推理时扩展技术。该方法通过在模型预测高不确定性时递归重应用顶层解码器层，构建了一个与传统随机采样互补的确定性推理扩展维度，从而在不增加显著成本的情况下，极大地丰富了推理候选池并提升了模型在数学推理任务上的性能。
AI.keywords: 推理时扩展, 熵门控, 潜在递归, 语言模型推理, 确定性采样
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一种非随机的推理时扩展方法，通过递归重用模型顶层结构来增加推理的多样性。其重要性在于打破了仅依赖随机采样（Temperature）的局限性，为推理时计算规模化开辟了确定性的新路径。局限性在于该方法可能增加推理延迟，且其在复杂逻辑推理之外的泛化能力尚待进一步验证。

title: JoyAI-Sim: A Simulation-Enabled Interconversion Toolchain for the Embodied Data Pyramid
comments: This version presents the methodology and system design of the project. A comprehensive experimental section will be added in subsequent revisions. Project Page: https://joyai-sim.github.io/
summary: Generalist robot policies require trustworthy evaluation and robot-usable training data, but both are difficult to scale with physical robots alone. Real-robot trials and demonstrations remain the most faithful source of deployment signals, yet they are slow, costly, and hard to reproduce. We present JoyAI-Sim, a simulation-enabled interconversion toolchain for human-robot aligned model evaluation and data generation, denoted as Robot $\rightleftharpoons$ Simulation $\rightleftharpoons$ Human. On the one hand, the Robot $\rightarrow$ Simulation $\rightarrow$ Human pathway supports human-robot aligned model evaluation by reconstructing real-robot tabletop organization tasks as calibrated digital twins for scalable evaluation, while using human embodied feedback to inspect and refine the naturalness of simulated motions. On the other hand, the Human $\rightarrow$ Simulation $\rightarrow$ Robot pathway supports human-robot aligned data generation: it lifts ego-centric human demonstrations into simulation, checks them under robot physical constraints, and converts them into robot-centered trajectories, annotations, and visual observations. Together, these pathways use the JoySim simulator as both a scalable evaluation layer and a physical consistency filter for robot data generation. We further package the core reconstruction, simulation, rendering, and realism-augmentation modules as cloud services on JD Cloud, turning the system into reusable infrastructure for robot data generation and model evaluation.

title: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Meta-Analysis Articles from Nature Portfolio
comments: 13 pages, 7 figures, preprint for arXiv, dataset and code available at https://github.com/BFTree/MetaSyn
summary:
Meta-analysis is a demanding form of evidence synthesis that combines literature retrieval, PI/ECO-guided study selection, and statistical aggregation. Its structured, verifiable workflow makes it an ideal substrate for evaluating systematic scientific reasoning, yet existing benchmarks lack ground truth across the full retrieval-screening-synthesis pipeline. We introduce MetaSyn, a dataset of 442 expert-curated meta-analyses from Nature Portfolio journals. Each entry pairs a research question with PI/ECO criteria, a retrieval corpus of 140k PubMed articles, verified positive studies, hard negatives that are topically similar but PI/ECO-ineligible, and complete search strategies and date bounds.
  Benchmarking twelve pipeline configurations (nine RAG variants and a protocol-driven agent) reveals a critical screening bottleneck: despite a retrieval ceiling of 90.9% recall at K=200, no system recovers more than 52.7% of ground-truth included literature. Current LLMs fail to reliably separate eligible studies from PI/ECO-failing distractors in pools of comparable topical relevance. Stage-attributed metrics capture where systems succeed and fail; a single end-to-end score does not.
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, preprint for arXiv, dataset and code available at https://github.com/BFTree/MetaSyn

AI.title_translation: 基于Nature Portfolio荟萃分析文章的LLM智能体基准测试
AI.tldr: MetaSyn数据集揭示了当前大模型在进行科学荟萃分析时，虽然能检索到相关文献，但在根据PI/ECO标准精确筛选文献方面存在严重瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试缺乏涵盖文献检索、筛选和合成全流程的真实参考标准，无法有效评估大模型在系统性科学推理方面的能力。
AI.method: 构建了MetaSyn数据集，包含442篇专家策划的荟萃分析及其对应的研究问题、PI/ECO标准、140k篇PubMed检索语料库及验证后的正负样本。评估了12种流水线配置（包括9种RAG变体和1种协议驱动的智能体），并引入了阶段性归因指标进行性能分析。
AI.result: 尽管检索阶段的召回率上限可达90.9%，但没有任何系统能恢复超过52.7%的基准文献。LLM在从主题相关的文献库中筛选出符合PI/ECO标准的文献时表现出明显的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 当前的大模型在处理完整的荟萃分析流程（特别是文献筛选阶段）时表现不佳，难以准确区分符合PI/ECO标准的文献与主题相似的干扰项。评估系统时应采用分阶段指标而非单一的端到端得分。
AI.translation: 荟萃分析是一种高要求的证据合成形式，结合了文献检索、基于PI/ECO（人口、干预、比较、结果）引导的研究选择和统计汇总。其结构化、可验证的工作流程使其成为评估系统性科学推理的理想基质，但现有的基准测试缺乏涵盖整个“检索-筛选-合成”流水线的真实参考标准。我们引入了MetaSyn，这是一个包含来自Nature Portfolio期刊的442篇专家策划的荟萃分析数据集。每个条目配有一个研究问题、PI/ECO标准、包含14万篇PubMed文章的检索语料库、经过验证的正向研究、主题相似但PI/ECO不合格的“硬负样本”，以及完整的搜索策略和日期范围。对12种流水线配置（9种RAG变体和1种协议驱动的智能体）的基准测试揭示了一个关键的筛选瓶颈：尽管在K=200时检索召回率上限为90.9%，但没有任何系统能恢复超过52.7%的基准文献。当前的大模型无法可靠地从主题相关性相当的池中将符合条件的文献与不符合PI/ECO标准的干扰项区分开来。阶段归因指标捕捉到了系统在哪些地方成功或失败，而单一的端到端分数则无法做到这一点。
